11614519.label: Major findings and research outcome
11614519.value: The findings have shown different modes through which the governmentality of creative practices occurs and expands. While the rise of Adobe in- and as- the apparatus of governmentality of creativity and creative practices can be associated with the liberalization of education, this process has not occurred evenly: this governmentality is situated, not only within an institutional, political, or social (Charrieras, Darchen & Willsteed 2021), but also a technologically dense “ecology of distant interconnected creative tools” (Charrieras 2024). This density contributes to the “naturalization” of the technical “environment” which then participates in the internalization of the discourse on creativity that “naturalizes” the digital (Charrieras 2023). The findings also show that this apparatus transcends defined structures. Indeed, even within defined structures, differentials in exposure exist, making the governmentality of creative practices an open-ended process that remains subject to negotiations. Digitality introduces an element of indeterminacy that complexifies the Foucauldian perspective (Charrieras 2024). Furthermore, while the process on internalization of the cultural norms and practices brought about by creative software is potent and affects users who may not define themselves as “creative”, the control over the definition of creative practices is never complete but is subject to renegotiation, albeit in unequal terms. In this regard, the role of internalization through consumption of cultural content is ambiguous: while homogenization is facilitated around the minimum common denominator (which, in most cases tends to be the dominant existing framework, i.e., major creative software companies’ tools, ideas, imaginaries, and so on), a part of the definition of creativity evades the control of Adobe apparatus (of control over creative practices) (Darchen, Wilsteed, Charrieras, forthcoming; Charrieras 2023, Charrieras 2024). This requires an investigation into the conditions under which an apparatus is challenged. The governmentality of creative practices through creative software reconfigures a conception creativity as widely shared and a mere function of a tool, and access to it, instead of being predetermined by in-born talent (the myth of the creative genius) or privilege. The (conditional) ubiquity of Adobe software introduces creativity as everyday practice, and as a tool of individual empowerment. Furthermore, within Adobe’s apparatus, (tools for) creativity and productivity are intertwined: on the one hand the individual “creative” is “emancipated” or “empowered” by the option of owning (literally at the tip of their fingers, as an extension of their selves) the tools that they need to build their own creative entrepreneurial self. On the other hand, the tools for productivity become “creative”; this contributes to an expansion of the governmentality of creative practices. Creativity therefore becomes a differentiator, creating an expectation of creativity in other areas of productive economy.

11614519.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11614519.value: The period covered in this research precedes the explosion of tools such as ChatGPT which have democratized the use of AI in the everyday life, including to produce creative outputs. This new context affects Adobe’s ability to impose and determine its form of governmentality of creative practices. Future research should examine Adobe’s response to a reduced effectiveness in its ability to impose a certain regime of creativity. Such research should identify the role of other platforms, such as social media, in affording or limiting this phenomenon. Proposed course of action: - Identify a platform, and the ways in which it contributes to modify the actors, tools, factors that affect the governmentality of creative acts - Describe the emerging forces that modify or disrupt this governmentality of creative practices - Identify the effects of such change on the evolution of the discourses and practices of established creative software companies such as Adobe - Document the evolution of the wider apparatus that governs creative practices: how can apparatus accommodate those disruptive forces. - Identify the effects of those changes on the creative practices and especially what identifies a creative person as such.

11614519.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11614519.value: How do conceptions of creativity become accepted as norms and how do they permeate the practices, institutions, and discourses on digital creativity? This research addresses these questions by analysing the performativity of Adobe creative software from a Foucauldian perspective. This emphasizes the internalization of norms under the influence of institutionalised forces that “govern” creative practices. Creative software companies have redefined the discourses and practices on creativity. From pioneering a shift to a subscription-based cloud-centric model, to the development AI tools such as Firefly, Adobe has reshaped creative practices, the (modes of) access to creative tools, the relation between creativity and ‘productivity’, and the very definition of “artist” or “creatives”. This evolution is determined by, and co-determines, an ecosystem of institutional, economic and sociopolitical forces that affects the discourse and practices on creativity. This research contributes to literature by documenting the ways in which creative software companies have increasingly governed creative practices, and redefined “creativeness”. This project adapts a postructuralist perspective to the analysis of the interwoven forces that govern creative practices and the role of Adobe. It applies Foucauldian analysis to Adobe’s evolving discourse to identify the mechanisms through which conceptions of creativity become accepted, internalized, performed, or transformed.

11614919.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11614919.value: The hypothalamic–pituitary–adrenal (HPA) axis plays an important role in homeostatic and allostatic adjustments to environmental challenges. However, how stress and aging affect the level of cortisol, the end product of this neuroendocrine axis, is not completely understood (Chahal & Drake, 2007). In a pioneering study of the factors integral to the relationship between successful aging and cortisol, the PI and his associates (Lai et al., 2012; Lai, Evans, & Chong, 2017) found that Chinese elders who spent more time and effort cultivating their social relationships with family, relatives, friends, and neighbors exhibited lower levels of diurnal cortisol in the saliva and a steeper diurnal decline. This specific diurnal rhythm of cortisol, characterized by lower diurnal levels and more effective deactivation of the HPA axis, has also been observed in younger age groups in prior studies (e.g., Ice, 2005; Kumari et al., 2010) and a recent study by the PI and his associates (Lai, Leung, Lee, Lam & Berning., 2018). An earlier study of 2,120 Chinese elders in Hong Kong showed that the cultivation of social ties predicted successful aging (Chong et al., 2012). Thus, the findings reported by Lai et al. (2017) can be taken to imply that those who grow old more successfully may be biologically younger than their peers. This idea has been coined the “rejuvenation hypothesis” (Lai & Lee, in press). Despite the significance of these findings, the psychological mechanisms that translate positive social motivation into a younger diurnal cortisol profile have not been identified. Moreover, the potential effect of a younger cortisol profile on health has not been adequately addressed. The proposed study will aim to bridge these knowledge gaps by testing the rejuvenation hypothesis. We predict that a stronger motivation to cultivate social ties will serve to enhance social embeddedness. We expect that this in turn will rejuvenate the diurnal cortisol profiles of older individuals and increase their telomere length, an index of cellular aging (Tomiyama et al., 2012). As cortisol (Fried & Walston, 1999; Sapolsky, Krey, & McEwen, 1986; Spiegel & Sephton, 2001) and telomere length (e.g., Njajou et al., 2009) are crucial biomarkers of health and aging, the findings of the proposed study will inform the composition of effective intervention programs and social policies for promoting health and successful aging in the elderly. 下丘腦 - 垂體 - 腎上腺（HPA）軸在環境變化中對體內穩態和應變穩態調節起重要作用。然而，壓力和老齡化如何影響這種神經內分泌軸的最終產物—皮質醇—的水平，對此尚未有完全的理解。在一項開創性的研究中，首席研究者及其同事針對成功老齡化與皮質醇之間的關聯因素進行了探索，並發現在花費更多時間和精力培養與家人、親戚、朋友和鄰居的社會關係的華人長者中，其唾液呈現較低的皮質醇晝夜變化水平及較急劇的晝夜衰減速度。這種特定的皮質醇晝夜節律，具有較低的晝夜變化水平和對HPA軸去活化更有效的特徵。在以往的研究項目以及首席研究者和其同事一項近期的研究中，從年輕受驗者身上也觀察到這種皮質醇的晝夜節律。一項更早期的研究調查了2120名香港華人長者，並表明社會關係的培養預示著成功老齡化。因此，這些研究成果意味著那些老齡化更成功的人在生理上可能比同齡人更年輕。由此，首席研究者及其同事提出了「恢復活力假說」。 儘管這些發現意義重大，但是將積極的社會動機轉化為較年輕的皮質醇晝夜變化特徵的心理機制尚未被確認。此外，年輕皮質醇狀態對健康的潛在影響也尚未得到充分關注。擬議的研究旨在通過測試「恢復活力假說」來填補這些知識空缺。 我們預測，培養社會關係的強烈動力將有助於增強社會融入性。 我們預期這將使老年人的皮質醇晝夜節律年輕化並增加其端粒長度（即細胞衰老的指標）。由於皮質醇和端粒長度是健康和老齡化的重要指標，本研究將會為制定針對老年人健康和成功老齡化的有效干預措施以及社會政策提供重要訊息。

12100219.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12100219.value: 肥胖的發生發展與腸道菌群紊亂密切關聯。不同腸道菌在肥胖預防或致病機制中扮演著不同角色。因此，腸道菌群已經成為治療肥胖的有效靶標。人參是一種常用草藥，臨床和實驗研究均已證明人參可改善肥胖及其伴隨的腸道菌群紊亂。然而，人參抗肥胖活性的分子機制仍然未知。我們的初步研究表明人參水提物可改善高脂飲食小鼠的肥胖表型（脂肪堆積與炎症）和腸道菌群紊亂，並可作用於與肥胖相關的幾種關鍵腸菌屬（如真細菌屬、脫硫弧菌屬、乳桿菌屬等）。在此基礎之上，本項目旨在進一步研究以腸道菌群為靶標的人參抗肥胖機制。我們提出如下假說：人參水提物中皂苷類和多糖類成分所含有的結構特異的糖基（如1→2/4/6連接β-D-吡喃葡萄糖基、1→4連接β-D-吡喃半乳糖醛酸基、1→3/4/5/6連接α-L-吡喃鼠李糖基、α-L-呋喃阿拉伯糖基、β-D-吡喃半乳糖基等）可與不同肥胖相關腸菌（如真細菌屬、脫硫弧菌、乳桿菌屬、雙歧桿菌屬等）所編碼的特異性糖酶（如β-D-葡萄糖苷酶、α-L-阿拉伯糖苷酶、α-L-鼠李糖苷酶、β-葡聚糖酶、果膠酶等）選擇性作用，從而促進這些菌的生長，進而觸發多重減肥分子機制（如改善多糖、膽汁酸、膽碱類物質代謝、抑制脂多糖導致的炎症及代謝紊亂、調節脂質代謝相關蛋白的表達等）。為驗證該假說，我們提出如下研究：1）從人參水提物中製得含特異性糖基結構的人參皂苷及多糖組分/單體化合物；2）評價這些組分/單體化合物對高脂飲食誘導的肥胖及腸道菌群紊亂的療效；3）闡述不同組分/單體化合物對腸道菌群特異性作用的糖酶機制；4）研究不同組分/單體化合物抗肥胖作用的腸道菌群介導的特異性分子機制。通過以上研究的整合分析，我們將闡明腸道菌群所介導的人參皂苷與人參多糖抗肥胖作用中的糖基結構特異性機制。該研究將為理解人參改善肥胖的內在機制以及從人參中開發新的減肥產品提供科學依據。此外，該研究以人參中人參皂苷與多糖改善肥胖的不同機制為創新點，以期為其他草藥中多成分協同作用的分子機制研究提供新的視角。

12100219.label: Realisation of objectives
12100219.value: Objective 1: This objective was fully achieved as follows: Dried ginseng slices were boiled in water, and the resulting solution was precipitated by adding ethanol. The precipitate was washed with Sevag reagent (a mixture of isoamyl alcohol and CHCl3 in a 1:4 ratio). After dissolving the precipitate in water, it was dialyzed for 48 h with a molecular cut-off of 3.5 kDa. The resulting dialyzate was lyophilized, yielding GP (172.6 g). The supernatants obtained after ethanol precipitation were concentrated till dry. The concentrates were then diluted in water and extracted with water-saturated n-butanol. The extracts were combined and freeze-dried to obtain GS (17.58 g). The physicochemical and structural properties of GP and GS were characterized. In brief, the phenol-sulfuric acid method was performed to determine the content of total sugar in GP. The uronic acid content in GP was determined by m-hydroxyl diphenyl assay. Neutral polysaccharides (NP) and acidic polysaccharides (AP) fractions in GP were separated using DEAE-cellulose column chromatography. The molecular weight distributions of NP and AP were determined by high-performance gel permeation chromatography (HPGPC) on an Agilent 1200 system equipped with a refractive index detector. The FT-IR spectra of NP and AP were determined using a Nicolet 380 FT–IR spectrophotometer. Monosaccharide compositions of NP and AP were analyzed by high-performance liquid chromatography with a diode-array detector (HPLC-DAD). Methylation analysis was performed to determine the glycosidic linkages present in NP and AP through gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS). Typical GS was qualitatively and quantitatively determined by using ultra-performance liquid chromatography coupled with quadrupole time-of-flight mass spectrometry (UPLC-QTOF-MS/MS, Waters Acquity UPLC core system coupled with Waters Synapt G2 QTOF mass spectrometer) and ultra-performance liquid chromatography- triple quadrupole mass spectrometry (UPLC-QqQ-MS, Agilent 1290 UPLC system coupled with a 6460 QqQ mass spectrometer), as we established before. Objective 2: This objective was fully achieved as follows: C57BL/6J mice (18-22 g) were randomly distributed and fed with either a standard chow diet (10% kcal fat; Research Diets, USA) or an HFD (60% kcal fat; Research Diets, USA) plus daily administration of either saline or GP, GS by intragastric gavage (i.g.) for 7 weeks. The dosages of GP and GS were calculated with reference to the clinical dosage (9 g ginseng herbal material/day, recommended by Chinese Pharmacopoeia, 2020 edition) and converted into mouse dosage by the standard human equivalent dose conversion equation. The body weight and energy intake of the animals were measured every week during the study. Oral Glucose tolerance test (OGTT) was performed at the end of week 6th. After 6 h fast with free access to water, mice were intragastrically gavaged with 2 g/kg glucose. Blood glucose was measured in tail vein blood at 0, 15, 30, 60, 90, and 120 min after the glucose gavage. The area under the curve (AUC) was calculated to quantify the OGTT results. After 7 weeks of treatment, whole blood was collected from the ophthalmic venous plexus, and serum was separated with an anticoagulant. After the trial, mice were sacriﬁced by cervical spondylolisthesis, and then the adipose tissues were weighed immediately after the sacriﬁce. The adipose, ileum tissues and cecal contents of each mouse were collected for the Subsequent analysis. Then, real-time qPCR was performed to determine the relative expression of inflammatory cytokines (TNF-α and IL-1β) mRNA in ileum tissue and thermogenesis relative genes (UCP-1, PGC-1α, and PRDM 16) in BAT. Objective 3: This objective was fully achieved as follows: Total fecal genomic DNA samples were extracted, and then processed to construct metagenome shotgun sequencing libraries with insert sizes of 400 bp using Illumina TruSeq Nano DNA LT Library Preparation Kit. Each library was sequenced by the Illumina HiSeq X-ten platform (Illumina, USA) with PE150 strategy at Personal Biotechnology Co., Ltd. (Shanghai, China). Raw sequencing reads were processed to obtain quality-ﬁltered reads for further analysis according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Once quality-ﬁltered reads were obtained, taxonomical classifications of metagenomics sequencing data from each sample were performed using Kaiju with greedy-5 mode against an nr-derived database. The carbohydrate-active enzymes (CAZymes) expressed in the faecal microbial genomes in the GP and GS groups mice were annotated and analyzed using mmseqs2 with the “search” mode against the protein databases of CAZy databases. The integrated analysis of chemical analysis and metagenomics was conducted to study the relationship between the structural properties of GP and GS, and the CAZymes encoded in their enriched gut bacteria. Objective 4: This objective was fully achieved as follows: The functionality of the non-redundant genes in the faecal microbial genomes of GP and GS groups mice were annotated and analyzed using the Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) database based on the metagenome sequencing data. The correlation analysis between gut microbiota and functions was performed to study the role of gut microbiota in the anti-obesity effects of GP and GS. The levels of short-chain fatty acids (acetate, propionate, butyrate, and succinate) in faeces were determined by UPLC-QqQ-MS after derivatization. Real-time qPCR was performed to determine the relative expression of GPR 43/41 mRNA in the ileum. Serum GLP-1 and PYY were quantified using commercial mouse GLP-1 and mouse PYY ELISA kits. The activities of key enzymes of IGN, namely phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase (PEPCK) and glucose-6-phosphatase (G6Pase) in caecal contents were determined using PEPCK and G6Pase activity kits, respectively. The intestinal contents of IGN’s intermediate (glucose 6-phosphate, G6P) and end product (glucose) were determined using G6P and glucose assay kits. Objective 5: This objective was fully achieved as follows: Differential analysis was conducted to identify gut microbiota specifically regulated by GP and GS in HFD-fed mice. Then, correlation analysis between gut microbiota and functions was performed to investigate the relationship between gut microbiota specifically enriched by GP or GS treatment, and CAZymes and KEGG functional genes. The integrated analysis of structural properties, obesity phenotypes, differential gut microbiota and their functions was conducted, to explore the structural specificity of the glycosyl groups in GP and GS involved in their gut microbiota-targeted anti-obesity effects.

12100219.label: Major findings and research outcome
12100219.value: Firstly, we found that GP and GS comprised abundant glycosyl groups, but their structural properties were different. GP contained two major groups: starch-like glucans, such as 1,4-glucans and 6-branched-1,4-glucans, and heterogeneous pectins, such as rhamnogalacturonan-I, homogalacturonan and arabinogalactan, in which 1,4-linked glaA, 1,3/1,4/1,3,6-linked gal and 1,5/1,3,5-linked ara residues occur with high molar ratios (Int. J. Biol. Macromol., 2023, 247 (12): 125843, publication No.2 in Part C). GS are structurally elucidated to be triterpene saponins that are mainly composed of a dammarane skeleton with various monoglycosyls and oligoglycosyls attached to the C-3 and C-20 positions (Commun. Biol., 2021, 4(14): 549, publication No.4 in Part C). Secondly, oral administration of GP or GS suppressed HFD-induced adiposity by reducing fat accumulation, ameliorating glucose intolerance and inflammation, reinstating gut microbiota dysbiosis, and promoting BAT thermogenesis. The suppressive effects of GP and GS on most obese phenotypes were transferable via FMT from treated HFD-fed mice to HFD-fed mice, providing further evidence that both treatments’ effects were mediated by gut microbiota (Food. Funct., 2021, 12 (9): 3954-3964, publication No.3 in Part C). Moreover, we found that GP and GS, with their structurally diverse glycosyl groups, favour the specific CAZymes encoded in distinct gut bacteria, which thereby selectively stimulate the growth of these bacteria. In specific, GP treatment increase the abundance of CAZymes (GH97, PL9_1, GH35, and GH43) exhibiting activities such as glucanase, pectate lyase, galactanase, and arabinanase. GS treatment selective increase the abundance of GH16_5, a glycosidase enzyme capable of breaking down the glycosidic linkages between the aglycone and glycosyls within GS. The bacterial species that encoded these CAZymes were accordingly enriched by GP or GS treatment. Furthermore, bacterial species enriched by GP or GS encode specific functional genes that participate in specific molecular mechanisms for combating HFD-induced obesity. In specific, the bacterial species enriched by GP or GS encode specific functional genes that participate in the synthesis of short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs), thereby resulting in different levels of SCFAs. In addition, GP and GS activated intestinal gluconeogenesis (IGN) by impacting different nodes in the process. The integrated analysis of the above results suggested that GP and GS interacted differently with gut microbiota due to their structural specificity, thereby triggering specific molecular and cellular mechanisms involved in suppressing adiposity and energy intake in HFD-fed mice, particularly those underlying SCFAs -GLP-1/PYY signalling and IGN activation (paper in preparation, publication No.1 in Part C).

12100219.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12100219.value: The results advance the broader understanding of how and why gut microbiota mediate the anti-obesity effect of ginseng, thereby providing a solid scientific basis for further developing pharmaceutical products (e.g., prebiotics and probiotics) from ginseng for the management of obesity. Next, we will seek collaboration with Beijing Tong Ren Tang Chinese Medicine Co., LTD, which is our long-term partner, to develop pharmaceutical products, such as prebiotics (GP, GS), probiotics (the gut bacteria) and/or combinations, for preventing or treating dietary fat-induced obesity. Then, we will work together with doctors in the clinical department of our university to devise clinical trials for testing the efficacy of our products on obese patients. In addition, the specific bacterial species involved in these mediations, as well as the underlying mechanisms, remain unknown. To address this knowledge gap, a new ECS project has been proposed as a continuation of the funded GRF project.

12100219.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12100219.value: In this study, we found that two major active components of ginseng, GP and GS, interacted differently with gut microbiota due to their structural specificity, thereby triggering specific molecular and cellular mechanisms involved in the suppression of adiposity in HFD-fed mice. The study contributes to a broader understanding of the chemical constituents that play a crucial role in the gut microbiota-mediated anti-obesity effect of ginseng, thereby providing a solid scientific basis for further developing health products (e.g., prebiotics) from ginseng for the management of obesity. Furthermore, by using the treatments of HFD-induced obesity with GP and GS as a case study, we substantiated how multiple components in an herb work by hitting multiple targets in gut microbiota. It enriches our understanding, expands the scientific interpretation of the rationale of herbal medicines, and should inspire further research in the field of herbal medicine-based new drug discovery.

12100719.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12100719.value: 卵巢癌是妇科恶性肿瘤中死亡率最高的一类癌症，其对化疗药物的抗药性是目前临床治疗的极大挑战。美登素对抗药性卵巢癌细胞系具有很好的抗癌活性，但是由于其不能区分肿瘤细胞和正常细胞而导致很严重的毒性，限制了其向临床应用的转化。美登素的抗体偶联衍生物也因此被开发来减轻毒副作用并进入了临床试验，如mirvetuximab soravtansine (IMGN853)用来治疗顺铂耐药的卵巢癌患者。然而，抗体-美登素偶联物仍然存在一些问题。相比与抗体，核酸适配子具有低免疫原性，高组织穿透性并且很难产生抗药性，已被广泛应用于靶向识别。核仁素适配子AS1411（NucA），已经展现了很好的肿瘤靶向性和低毒性等特点。这个适配子与仅在肿瘤（包括卵巢癌）细胞表面表达的核仁素蛋白相结合，从而达到肿瘤识别的目的。 因此，我们设计并合成了一种核仁素适配子-美登素偶合物（NucA-MTS）用来治疗耐药性的卵巢癌病人。核仁素适配子赋予了此偶合物高水溶性，高效液相色谱法证明NucA-MTS在人血浆中保持高稳定性。此外，美登素对核仁素适配子的修饰并没有显著改变核仁素适配子对其靶蛋白的识别作用。核仁素适配子则显著增加了偶合物在耐药性卵巢癌中的摄入量，并且主要是通过依赖于核仁素的细胞巨饮方式。更重要的是，核仁素适配子增加了偶合物对于耐药细胞株的抑制活性。基于以上发现，我们假设核仁素适配子可以选择性的将偶合物带入到化疗耐药的卵巢癌组织及细胞中，改善偶合物的抗肿瘤活性和降低毒性。 在顺铂耐药和紫杉醇耐药的两个异种移植卵巢癌小鼠模型中，我们会测试一下三个假设： （1） 验证核仁素适配子协助偶合物在卵巢癌组织和细胞中的特异性分布； （2） 评价核仁素适配子对偶合物抗肿瘤活性的改善效果； （3） 检查核仁素适配子对偶合物毒性的减轻情况。 这项工作不仅提出了利用适配子-美登素偶合物作为下一代个性化治疗耐药性卵巢癌的策略，同时也建立了一个发展智慧型化合物的创新科技平台，通过将天然产物用适配子修饰用于癌症靶向治疗。

12100719.label: Realisation of objectives
12100719.value: 1. To validate the NucA facilitates the distribution of NucA-MTS in ovarian tumor tissue and cells- fully achieved. For examining the nucleolin aptamer-mediated changes in tumor distribution of the injected fluorescence-labeled nucleolin aptamer-maytansine conjugate at both tissue and cellular level, 8 weeks old female BALB/c nude mice were inoculated subcutaneously with 2×106 platinum-resistant A2780 cells and paclitaxel-resistant HEY-T30 cells in the left armpit. Two weeks after inoculation, mice bearing a tumor of around 10 mm diameter were used for distribution assay. Each tumor-bearing nude mice then will be randomly divided into three groups of 10 mice, and NucA-MTS-Rh, CRO-MTS-Rh or Rh at a single dose of 0.5 mg Rh/kg were given to the mice of each group respectively by intravenous route (i.v.) via the tail vein. The mice were sacrificed 4 h after injection and the tumor and major organs (brain, heart, lung, liver, spleen and kidney) were collected for biophotonic imaging. We observed a strong accumulation of NucA-MTS-Rh in tumor tissue compared to the control groups, and relative comparable accumulation in liver and kidney among all the groups. Tumor, kidney and liver tissues were dissected for cryosections and further histology analysis for observing the distribution of the conjugates in tumor and other tissues. The statistics of the tissue distribution in tumor and major organs were consistent with the biophotonic data. The dominant localization of the injected conjugates in tumor tissue/cells and few localizations of the injected conjugates in liver, kidney and other tissue/cells were found in NucA-MTS-Rh group compared to CRO-MTSRh control group and Rh group. 2. To evaluate the NucA improves the anti-ovarian tumor activity of NucA-MTS in vivo – fully achieved. For detecting the nucleolin aptamer-mediated changes in antitumor activity of the NucA-MTS conjugate, 8 weeks old female BALB/c nude mice were inoculated subcutaneously with 2×106 platinum-resistant A2780 cells and paclitaxel-resistant HEY-T30 cells in the left armpit. Each tumor bearing nude mice with a tumor diameter approximately 5 mm were randomly divided into six groups of 10 mice. NucA-MTS, CRO-MTS or MTS at a dosage of 0.5 mg MTS/kg were given to mice of three groups by i.v. twice a week for four weeks. NucA or CRO group at a dosage of 1.2 umol/ kg will be given to mice of two groups by i.v. twice a week for four weeks. Another group of mice were given vehicle solution as the control group. The mice in NucA-MTS showed significantly reduced tumor growth in both tumor size and weight, and ki-67 expression in tumor sections by IHC staining compared with CRO-MTS or MTS treated groups. 3. To examine NucA decreases the toxicities of NucA-MTS in vivo – fully achieved. For detecting the nucleolin aptamer-mediated changes in liver-related toxicity after a single injection of the NucA-MTS conjugate, 8 weeks old female BALB/c nude mice were inoculated subcutaneously with 2×106 platinum-resistant A2780 cells and paclitaxel-resistant HEY-T30 cells in the left armpit. 12100719.label: Major findings and research outcome
12100719.value: Ovarian cancer, the most lethal of all gynecologic neoplasms, is often associated with drug resistance, which becomes the major challenge in the clinical treatment. Maytansine (MTS), an exceptionally potent anticancer agent, shows excellent cytotoxicity to a range of drug-resistant cancer cell lines, including ovarian cancer. However, it could not distinguish cancer cells from normal cells and induces severe systemic toxicity, which restrains its further application in clinical treatment. Accordingly, antibody-drug conjugates of MTS derivatives have been developed for the increase of tumor targeting and the reduction of toxicity. Several successful antibody-MTS derivative conjugates have entered clinical trials, such as mirvetuximab soravtansine (IMGN853) for treating platinum-resistant ovarian cancer patients. However, there are still disadvantages of antibody-MTS conjugates. In comparison with antibodies, nucleic acid aptamers have limited immunogenicity, excellent tissue penetration and are unlikely to develop resistance, thus, have been widely used as tumor recognition elements. For example, an anti-nucleolin aptamer (NucA) AS1411, had shown good tumor targeting property with an acceptable safety profile in patients. This aptamer interacts with nucleolin protein, which is found expressing on the surface of ovarian cancer cells and many other cancer cells. Our group designed and synthesized a nucleolin aptamer-MTS conjugate (NucA-MTS) with a non-cleavable thioether linker for the treatment of drug-resistant ovarian cancer. The NucA conferred NucA-MTS with high water solubility and the stability of NucA-MTS in human serum was verified by high performance liquid chromatograph. In addition, the MTS conjugation did not considerably affect the binding affinity between NucA and its target protein nucleolin, which was supported by both molecular dynamic simulation and isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC). The NucA modification was shown to facilitate the uptake of NucA-MTS in drug-resistant ovarian cancer cell lines (platinum-resistant A2780 and paclitaxel-resistant HEY-T30). The uptake of the conjugate is mainly by macropinocytosis in a nucleolin expression-dependent manner. Moreover, the NucA increased the in vitro cytotoxicity and mitosis inhibition of NucA-MTS in platinum/paclitaxel- resistant ovarian cancer cells, while the activity of the conjugate was better than that of a non-specific aptamer-MTS conjugate. In this project, we validated that the NucA could facilitate the selective distribution of NucA-MTS in chemo-resistant ovarian cancer tissues/cells, and thus improving the anti-ovarian tumor activity and decreasing the toxicities of NucA-MTS.

12100719.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12100719.value: The further step of this research will be looking at the translational value of this conjugate using patient-derived xenograft mouse models and evaluate the antitumor activities and toxicities of NucA-MTS.

12100719.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12100719.value: Our group designed and synthesized a nucleolin aptamer-MTS conjugate (NucA-MTS) with a non-cleavable thioether linker for the treatment of drug-resistant ovarian cancer. The NucA conferred NucA-MTS with high water solubility and the stability of NucA-MTS in human serum. The NucA modification was shown to facilitate the uptake of NucA-MTS in drug-resistant ovarian cancer cell lines, and facilitate the selective distribution of NucA-MTS in chemo-resistant ovarian cancer tissues/cells, and thus improving the anti-ovarian tumor activity and decreasing the toxicities of NucA-MTS. This project not only provided the next generation personalized MTS derivatives for multidrug-resistant ovarian cancer therapy, but also established an innovative technology platform to develop smart compounds by modifying natural products with aptamers for cell targeted therapy.

12101019.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12101019.value: 目前 2 型糖尿病正在全球範圍內流行。胰島素受體 (Insulin Receptor) 在細胞表面與胰島素結合並通過細胞質激酶快速地傳導信號。胰島素受體在控制胰島素反應和葡萄糖不耐受發揮重要作用，但在正常生理以及特定病理環境下，胰島素受體的調節機制尚不清楚。 研究顯示，MMP14基因突變與2型糖尿病的發病率有著關聯性。儘管MMP14基因突變與胰島素抵抗之間存在聯繫，但MT1-MMP調節胰島素反應的分子機制尚不明。本研究組初步發現，在使用飲食誘導的肥胖型小鼠和老年普通餵養的小鼠的肝臟組織中，MT1-MMP的表達顯著增加。為了驗證MT1-MMP的基因敲除對高脂飲食誘導葡萄糖不耐受的影響，本研究組利用Mmp14缺陷的小鼠作為模型，以野生型小鼠為對照，同樣喂以高脂飲食，發現Mmp14+/-小鼠的體重增加較慢，葡萄糖耐受性較佳，同時胰島素反應也比較好。我們也發現，在老年普通餵養的小鼠中，Mmp14+/-小鼠的葡萄糖耐受性和胰島素反應，均比野生型小鼠的反應為佳。由於胰島素受體在控制胰島素反應發揮重要作用，因此我們進一步研究MT1-MMP能否調節胰島素受體的表達。在Mmp14-/-肝臟和骨骼肌組織中，胰島素受體的蛋白表達水準顯著升高，但胰島素受體的基因轉錄水準並沒有因MT1-MMP的缺失而改變。同樣地，在Mmp14-/-肝細胞中，胰島素受體的蛋白表達水準也顯著升高。更為重要的是，我們發現Mmp14的基因敲除增強了在肝細胞中胰島素信號通路反應。本研究基於前期研究結果假說: 高脂飲食或身體衰老會誘導全身性MT1-MMP的表達增加，而MT1-MMP會抑制胰島素的信號通路，從而降低胰島素反應。 為了進一步驗證MT1-MMP有調控胰島素反應的作用，我們將研究（1）MT1-MMP切割胰島素受體並抑制胰島素信號通路的分子機制; （2）MT1-MMP的過表達會否誘導胰島素抵抗; （3）抑制MT1-MMP能否改善肥胖型小鼠和老年普通餵養的小鼠中的胰島素易感性和葡萄糖耐量。本研究將前瞻性地探究MT1-MMP對胰島素受體的調節機制。 這不僅能推進我們對胰島素抵抗分子機制的認識，還有助於發展治療糖尿病相關疾病的新方法以及延長健康壽命的策略。

12101019.label: Major findings and research outcome
12101019.value: Insulin sensitivity progressively declines with age. Currently, the mechanism underlying age-associated insulin resistance remains unknown. Here, we identify membrane-bound matrix metalloproteinase 14 (MT1-MMP/MMP14) as a central regulator of insulin sensitivity during ageing. Ageing promotes MMP14 activation in insulin-sensitive tissues, which cleaves Insulin Receptor to suppress insulin signaling. MT1-MMP inhibition restores Insulin Receptor expression, improving insulin sensitivity in aged mice. The cleavage of Insulin Receptor by MT1-MMP also contributes to obesity-induced insulin resistance and inhibition of MT1-MMP activities normalizes metabolic dysfunctions in diabetic mouse models. Conversely, overexpression of MT1-MMP in the liver reduces the level of Insulin Receptor, impairing hepatic insulin sensitivity in young mice. The soluble Insulin Receptor and circulating MT1-MMP are positively correlated in plasma from aged human subjects and non-human primates. Our findings provide mechanistic insights into regulation of insulin sensitivity during physiological ageing and highlight MT1-MMP as a promising target for therapeutic avenue against diabetes.

12101019.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12101019.value: We are currently collaborating a metalloproteinase inhibitor expert, Prof. Xin Ge in The University of Texas at Houston to develop two lines of MT1-MMP specific inhibitors. In our previous collaborative studies, we have demonstrated that 3A2, a specific neutralizing antibody against MT1-MMP, is effective in the treatment of obesity (Nature Metabolism, 2022), diabetes (Nature Communications, 2022) and SARS-CoV-2 infection (Nature Communications, under revision) in a safe and efficient manner. In our unpublished studies, we have further validated the in vivo efficacy of this antibody in the treatment of metabolic dysfunctions in nonhuman primate models. In addition to this antibody, we have also developed another small-molecule inhibitor with the technology of PROTAC. This inhibitor binds to MT1-MMP to promote its proteasome-mediated degradation and crosses the blood-brain barrier to target neuronal MT1-MMP. In the near future, we will develop new therapeutics with MT1-MMP as a major target for the management of metabolic diseases and other age-related disorders.

12101019.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12101019.value: Type 2 diabetes (T2D), a chronic metabolic disorder, has currently become a global epidemic. Identifying a factor that specifically controls insulin actions and investigating how it regulates insulin sensitivity during ageing may pave the way for innovative therapeutic strategies against T2D and other metabolic dysfunctions. Our recent findings identified a proteolytic enzyme called membrane-type 1 matrix metalloproteinase (MT1-MMP) as a promising therapeutic target for the management of diabetes. Insulin sends signals to cells to take sugar out of the blood by binding with Insulin Receptor (IR). Controlling the level of IR can therefore affect the ability of insulin to regulate blood sugar levels. We found that the activation of MT1-MMP increased with age in mice. The aged mice with depleted MT1-MMP exhibited improved insulin sensitivity and glucose tolerance, suggesting that increased MT1-MMP activity could be a risk factor causing insulin resistance in ageing. We further demonstrated that in cells with active MT1-MMP, a significant reduction in IR and thus insulin signalling was observed. It could be explained by MT1-MMP clipping IR from the surface of the insulin-sensitive cells, which blocks insulin from binding to IR and thus reduces insulin signalling.

12101519.label: Realisation of objectives
12101519.value: The four objectives have been achieved. 1. We have confirmed that AT-I synergizes the anti-melanoma effects of MK-8776 in xenograft mouse models. The obtained results are as follows: 1) AT-I combined with MK-8776 (hereinafter referred to as AT-I-plus-MK-8776) synergistically inhibited tumor growth in mice. To determine whether AT-I synergizes the anti-melanoma effects of MK-8776 in mice, an A375 melanoma-bearing BALB/c-nu/nu mouse model was employed. The mice inoculated with A375 cells were daily i.p. administered with vehicle (control), AT-I (20 mg/kg), MK-8776 (4 mg/kg), AT-I-plus-MK-8776, or dinaciclib (5 mg/kg, a CDK2 inhibitor in phase III trials, positive control) for 15 consecutive days. We found that AT-I-plus-MK-8776 synergistically and significantly inhibits melanoma growth in mice. During the treatment, AT-I-plus-MK-8776 significantly decreased tumor volume from day 9. After 15 days of intervention, values of tumor weights are 0.618 ± 0.254 g in the vehicle control group, 0.307 ± 0.088 g in the MK-8776 group, 0.164 ± 0.043 g in the AT-I group, and 0.051 ± 0.009 g (CDI = 0.62) in AT-I-plus-MK-8776 combination group. Values of tumor volumes on day 15 were 913.8 ± 309.1 mm3 in the vehicle control group, 459.5 ± 159.7 mm3 in the MK-8776 group, 404.1 ± 92.8 mm3 in the AT-I group, 137.8 ± 26.1 mm3 (CDI = 0.67) in AT-I-plus-MK-8776 group. The positive control dinaciclib (tumor weight = 0.085 ± 0.010 g, tumor volume = 158.0 ± 33.8 mm3), although less potent than that of AT-I-plus-MK-8776, significantly inhibits A375 melanoma growth. No significant influence on weight gain and food consumption, nor abnormalities at necropsy or clinical signs were observed during the experiments. No mouse death was observed during the experiment. 2) AT-I-plus-MK-8776 prolonged the survival time of C57/BL6 mice bearing B16 melanoma. To determine the effects of AT-I-plus-MK-8776 on animal survival time, we employed a B16 melanoma-bearing C57/BL6 mouse model. Our results showed that, compared to vehicle groups, AT-I-plus-MK-8776 significantly prolongs mouse survival time for seven days (P= 0.0018). 3) AT-I-plus-MK-8776 suppressed Cdk2/RAD51 and MITF/FANC/BRCA pathways in mouse A375 melanoma xenografts. Western blot results showed that AT-I downregulated the protein levels of MITF, FANCD2, BRCA1, Cdk2, and RAD51, and AT-I-plus-MK-8776 synergistically downregulated levels of the abovementioned DNA repair-related proteins in A375 xenografts. 2. We have confirmed that inhibiting Cdk2 contributes to the anti-melanoma effects of AT-I-plus-MK-8776 in cell models The obtained results are as follows: 1) Constitutive activation of Cdk2 diminished the effect of AT-I-plus-MK-8776 in inhibiting RAD51 expression, inducing DNA damage, and reducing cell viability in melanoma cells. We observed increased RAD51 expression in Cdk2 constitutively activated A375 (A375Cdk2+) cells compared to that in A375 negative control (A375NC) cells. AT-I-plus-MK-8776 significantly and synergistically inhibited Cdk2 and RAD51 expression, and induced apoptosis, S phase arrest and DNA damage repair in A375 melanoma cells. However, the effects of AT-I-plus-MK-8776 were less potent in A375Cdk2+ cells. These results suggested that inhibiting Cdk2 signaling contributes to the anti-melanoma effects of AT-I-plus-MK-8776 in melanoma cells. 3. We have examined how Cdk2 is inhibited by AT-I-plus-MK-8776 The obtained results are as follows: 1) AT-1 directly inhibits Cdk2 activation. To determine the direct effects of AT-I on Cdk2 activity, we employed CDK2/CyclinE1 Kinase Enzyme System (Progema, V4488) and CDK2/CyclinA2 Kinase Enzyme System (Progema, V2971). Our results showed that 1 µM AT-1 can significantly inhibit both CDK2/CyclinE1 and CDK2/CyclinA2 Kinase activities. These results suggest that AT-I can directly inhibit the activity of Cdk2. 2) AT-I-plus-MK-8776 activates the p53/p21 pathway. Our RNA-seq and qPCR results showed that AT-I-plus-MK-8776 upregulated mRNA levels of p53 and p21 in melanoma cells. Western blot results showed that protein levels of phosph-p53 (Ser15), p53, and p21 are higher in AT-I-plus-MK-8776-treated groups than in the control group. To further establish the role of p53 in the anti-melanoma effects of AT-I-plus-MK-8776, siRNA against TP53 was used to knock down the expression of p53 in melanoma cells. Immunoblotting results showed that the knockdown of p53 diminished the effects of AT-I-plus-MK-8776 in lowering the protein levels of Cdk2 and RAD51 and inducing PARP cleavage in melanoma cells. Moreover, AT-I-plus-MK-8776’s cytotoxicity in TP53-knockdown melanoma cells is less significant than that in negative control siRNA transfected melanoma cells, indicating that the cytotoxicity of AT-I-plus-MK-8776 is decreased by p53 knockdown. These results show that enhancing p53/p21 signaling is involved in the anti-melanoma effects of AT-I-plus-MK-8776. 3) AT-I-plus-MK-8776 inhibits MITF transcriptional activity. To determine whether AT-I-plus-MK-8776 affected the MITF/FANC/BRCA pathway in melanoma cells, protein levels of MITF, FANCD2, and BRCA1 were detected after treatments with AT-I, MK-8776, AT-I-plus-MK-8776 or dinaciclib for 24 h. Western blotting results showed that 100 µM of AT-I significantly lowered MITF, FANCD2, and BRCA1 protein levels. And AT-I-plus-MK-8776 synergistically downregulated the protein levels of MITF, FANCD2, and BRCA1 in A375 and IGR-1 cells. Besides inhibiting FANCD2 expression, AT-I-plus-MK-8776 lowered the protein level of the monoubiquitinated isoform of FANCD2 in melanoma cells. Of note, the inhibitory effects of AT-I-plus-MK-8776 on protein levels of FANCD2 and BRCA1 were more potent than the effects of dinaciclib in A375 and IGR-1 melanoma cells. These results indicate that AT-I-plus-MK-8776 synergistically inhibits the MITF/FANCD2/BRCA1 pathway in melanoma cells. 4. We have confirmed that AT-I-plus-MK-8776 exerts synergistic anti-melanoma effects and inhibits Cdk2 signaling in diverse melanoma cell lines The obtained results are as follows: To determine the effects of AT-I-plus-MK-8776 in different melanoma cell lines, we employed a panel of metastatic melanoma cell lines with different genetic backgrounds (A375 (BRAFV600E), IGR-1(BRAFV600K, RAC1P29S), G361 (LKB1-null), SK-MEL-28 (BRAFV600E, TP53L145R, PTENA499G, EGFRP753S), MEWO (TP53G72L,E258K, NF1-null), SK-MEL-5 (BRAFV600E, CDKN2A-null). Results showed that AT-I and MK-8776 synergistically (CDI < 1) reduced the viabilities of metastatic melanoma cells and showed less cytotoxicity in mouse fibroblasts L929 and human hepatocytes MIHA cells. In both A375 and IGR-1 melanoma cells, AT-I-plus-MK-8776 induced apoptosis, S phase arrest, and DNA damage activated the p53/p21 pathway, inhibited MITF activity, and suppressed Cdk2 signaling.

12101519.value: We have found that AT-I has Cdk2-inhibiting activity and synergizes the anti-melanoma effects of MK-8776 in cell and mouse models. 12101519.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12101519.value: We found that AT-I-plus-MK-8776 exerts anti-melanoma in both cell and mouse models. We provided evidence for the Cdk2 signalling-related mechanism of action of AT-I, a natural sesquiterpene found in the Chinese medicinal herb Baizhu, in treating melanoma. Our findings provide chemical and pharmacological justifications for the clinical use of Baizhu in treating melanoma and lay the groundwork for developing AT-I-plus-MK-8776 as an effective and safe agent in melanoma treatment/prevention. Additionally, we found that concurrent inhibition of Chk1 and Cdk2 is a potential strategy for melanoma treatment/prevention, and found that the Cdk2/RAD51 pathway is potentially involved in the pathogenesis of melanoma.

12102219.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12102219.value: 癌症是目前世界上引起人類死亡的主要原因之一。在香港，結直腸癌在過去的連續四年中是導致新發癌症病例數量最多的癌症，並且該癌症發病率仍處於上升趨勢。無論癌症的類型如何，高達90％的癌症死亡來源於癌症轉移患者。癌症轉移需要多個步驟，其中包括癌細胞從無柄上皮狀態向移動間充質狀態的轉變。通過經歷上皮-間質轉化（EMT），癌細胞變得具有高度入侵性。因此，癌症轉移的傾向與EMT表型的增強呈正相關性。例如，癌症轉移導致癌細胞的遷移能力和入侵性增加、E-鈣粘蛋白缺失、細胞外基質蛋白增加以及對細胞凋亡抵抗性的增加。因此，我們認為以EMT途徑為靶向的化藥治療是抑制癌症發展和轉移的可行策略。 貝殼扇烷（ent-kaurane）是一類天然二萜類化合物，在香茶菜屬（Isodon）（唇形科）植物中大量存在。 在以往的25年中，我們從來自16種不同香茶菜屬植物中鑒定了隸屬於18個貝殼扇烷亞結構類型的70多個二萜類化合物。其中一些化合物，尤其是化合物5和12，在我們做的體外和體內實驗中顯示出了很高的抗腫瘤活性。我們最近還發現這種類型的貝殼扇烷型二萜對結直腸癌細胞生長有明顯的抑制作用，並且也觀察到它們有減弱EMT表型的作用。其中，最具抗癌細胞生長和轉移的化合物是那些C環中具有官能團的四環貝殼扇烷型二萜。如果我們的研究能得到足夠的結構和活性關係（SAR），我們將能夠通過添加和/或取代官能團的方式對貝殼扇烷骨架進行化學修飾，得到改善對EMT抑制性質的化合物，從而控制癌症轉移。為此，我們將能夠得到毒性和相關副作用大大減少的貝殼扇烷型類似物。本研究的目標是推進貝殼扇烷型二萜化合物作為治療轉移性結直腸癌的潛在候選藥物。為實現這一目標，我們提出以下實施方案： 1）合成貝殼扇烷類似物作為用於控制結直腸癌入侵和轉移的抗癌製劑; 2）闡明貝殼扇烷型化合物抗惡性結直腸癌入侵和轉移的能力及它們用於治療惡性結直腸癌的靶標; 3）體內驗證貝殼扇烷型化合物的抗腫瘤和抗轉移功效。 最終，我們認為貝殼扇烷型類似物是可以作為控制癌症發展和轉移的有效EMT抑制劑，並成為克服目前會引起耐藥性的化療主體藥物的替代藥物。

12102219.label: Realisation of objectives
12102219.value: The cited references refer to the following attached files in PART C (page numbers refer to the pages in Task Pane of the pdf file of the full completion report): 1. NPR1: publication No1 (p15-27); 2. NPR2: publication No2 (p28-39); 3. IJMS: publication No3 (p40-49); 4. Phytochem: publication No4 (p50-61); 5. CCL: publication No5 (p62-68); 6. ZCLPhD: PhD thesis, Student trained (ZHAO Chenliang) (p298-459). A.1. Isolation of Natural Ent-Kaurene Compounds from Plants (to fulfill Objective 1: b.1.4) We obtained additional natural ent-kaurene (refer to BC: 2; IJMS: 1 and 2) and 14 tricyclic diterpenoids (refer to NPR2: 1 and 2; Phytochem: 1-7; CCL: 1 and 2; BC: 1; Molecules2: 1 and 2) from several Isodon plants. Unlike the tetracyclic ent-kaurenes, the 14 tricyclic diterpenoids showed much weak cancer cell inhibitory effects. We synthesized 26 tricyclic diterpenoid derivatives from lophanic acid, but none of them exhibited cancel cell inhibitory effects at 20 µM (refer to Molecules1: 3a-n, 4, 5a-h, 6a-c in Schemes 1-2). We thus reaffirmed that ent-kauranes represent a class of diterpenoids that merit further anticancer study. A.2. Synthesis of Ent-Kaurene Analogs (to fulfill Objective 1: b.1.3) ABBREVIATION: FA: flexicaulin A (9 in Scheme 1 in CR); FA3: oxoflexicaulin A (11 in Scheme 1 in CR); HA: henryin A (Scheme 3.3 of page 157 in ZCLPhD); OR: oridonin (Scheme 1 in NPR1); 5F (Scheme 3.2 of page 155 in ZCLPhD). We synthesized over 180 novel ent-kaurene analogs incorporating oxygen, nitrogen, sulfur, phosphate and selenium atoms, using FA, HA, OR and 5F as scaffolds. A.2.1. Synthesis of ent-kaurene analogs FA FA3, the oxo-form at C-11 of FA, produced 20 new derivatives (10b, 33-51) upon reacting with various aldehydes and ketones at C-7 and C-14 hydroxys (refer to Scheme 2 and Figure 3 in CR). A.2.2. Synthesis of ent-kaurene analogs of HA Synthesis of triazolyl derivatives-Michael addition of HA, followed by a click reaction, yielded 25 new analogs (S11i, S11ii-S11xxv) (refer to Scheme 3.3 of page 157 in ZCLPhD). Synthesis of phosphinate and amine derivatives-Michael addition of HA or its 1-oxo-7, 14-acetonide analog with various phosphonates and amines produced 8 new analogs (S12a-S12i) (refer to Scheme 3.4 of page 159 in ZCLPhD). A.2.3. Synthesis of ent-kaurene analogs of OR Oridonin, a 7, 20-epoxy-ent-kaurane, was converted to three series of derivatives by introducing different substituted phenyl moieties at 1-OH, 7, 14-OH and C-17, respectively (refer to Schemes 1-3 of NPR1). Synthesis of 1-oxo, 7, 14-acetal derivatives---By using the Scheme 1 synthetic route, 28 new analogs (1a-14a, 1b-14b) were synthesized. Synthesis of 1-O-derivatives---By using the Schemie 2 synthetic route, 6 new analogs (1c-6c) were synthesized. Synthesis of thio-Michael adduct derivatives---By using the Scheme 3 synthetic route, 8 new sulfur containing analogs (1d-8d)) were synthesized. A.2.4. Synthesis of ent-kaurene analogs of 5F 5F possesses a 11α-hydroxyl, a 19-carboxylic and a 15, 16, 17-α, β-unsaturated ketone groups, which were used for the structure derivatization by using the synthetic routes depicted in Schemes 2.1-2.5 of pages 101-106, and Schemes 3.1-3.2 of pages 154-155 in ZCLPhD. Synthesis of 11-hydroxyl derivatives---By using the Schemes 2.1-2.3 synthetic routes, 49 new analogs (S1a-S1k, S2a-S2s, S4a-S4s) were synthesized. Synthesis of 11-carboxylic derivatives---By using the Scheme 2.4 synthetic route, 5 new analogs (S5a-S5e) were synthesized. Synthesis of Michael adduct derivatives---By using the Schemes 2.5, 3.1 and 3.2 synthetic routes, 33 new analogs (S6a-S6c, S7a-S7c, S8a-S8x, S10a-S10c) were synthesized. A.3. Assessment of Anticancer Activity of Ent-Kaurene Derivatives (to fulfill Objective 1: b.1.2) The new ent-kaurene analogs were evaluated for their cell killing activities against a panel of human cell lines. About half of them exhibited superior activities than their parent compounds. Among the FA analogs, 14 (FA3, 10b, 33-37, 39-42, 47, 49, and 51) showed similar or better activities (refer to Table 2 of page 11 in CR). Among the HA analogs, only 3 (S11i, S12f, and S12i) showed similar or slightly less activities (refer to Table 4.2 of pages 215-217 in ZCLPhD). Among the OR analogs, 20 (1b-14b, and 1c-6c) showed 2-10 times better activities (refer to Table 1 of page 5 in NPR1). Among the 5F analogs, 69 (S1a-S1i, S1k, S2a-S2c, S2e-S2i, S2k-S2p, S2r, S2s, S4a-S4s, S5a-S5e, S7c, S8a-S8c, S8e-S8q, and S8u-S8x) showed 2-30 times better activities (refer to Table 4.1 of pages 207-215 in ZCLPhD). A.4. To Delineate the Anti-Proliferative and Anti-Metastatic Properties of Ent-Kaurene Diterpenes Using Cellular Platforms (to fulfill Objective 1: b.2.2 to b.2.4 and b.3.4) A.4.1. Anticancer methanism study Since FA3 showed superior antitumor effects to FA, it was investigated for its anti-proliferative and anti-metastatic protential in cellular assays. Our fingdings found that FA3: 1) inhibited growth, colony formation and proliferation of HCT116 cells (refer to 2.4 of pages 12-13 in CR); 2) induced apoptosis and regulated intrinsic apoptotic markers (refer to 2.5 of pages 13-16 in CR); 3) induced senescence, modulated senescence markers (refer to 2.6 of pages 16-20 in CR); 4) inhibited NF-κB signaling pathway (refer to 2.7 of pages 20-22 in CR); 5) inhibited migration of HCT-116 cells (refer to 2.8 of pages 22-23 in CR); 6) inhibited metastatic markers (refer to 2.8 of pages 22-23 in CR); 7) induced the metastasis regulator STAT3 (refer to 2.9 of pages 23-24 in CR); 8) suppressed STAT3 signaling pathwy (refer to 2.10 of pages 24-27 and 2.12 of pages 33-34 in CR). A.4.2. Synthesis of biotin-conjugate probe of 5F Due to the significant anticancer role of the D-ring of ent-kauranes, we utilized 5F to synthesize several biotin-linked probes at C-19 in order to investigate the protein targets of ent-kaurene compounds. Several biotin-conjugated probes (S14a, S14b, S14c, and S14d) were successfully synthesized, with or without an α, β-unsaturated keto system. These probes will be employed in identifying the targets associated with anticancer activity, enabling a comprehensive comparison of the underlying mechanisms among the compounds through pull-down assays (refer to 4.3 of pages 223-225 in ZCLPhD). A.5. FA3 and Its Acetal Analogs 10b, 33, 36 and 45, and HA and its Michael Adduct S12i Retarded Tumor Growth in Nude Mice. (to fulfill Objective 1: b.3.2 to b.3.3) We evaluated the effects of FA3, 10b, 33, 36, 45, HA and S12i on tumor growth in BALB/c nude mice comparing with the clinically used drugs fluorouracil (5-FU) and etoposide (ETP) (refer to 2.11 of pages 27-33 in CR, and 4.2 of pages 221-223 in ZCLPhD). In the studies, we observed the following: 1) FA3 remarkably inhibited tumor growths with certain toxicity by killing 3 mice by the end of the experiment; 2) Compounds 10b and S12i at 20 mg/kg at showed similar inhibitory activities to 5-FU at 25 mg/kg, but 10b and S12i at 40 mg/kg displayed more potent tumor inhibitory effects, with no observed signs of toxicity in the mice. 3) Compounds 36 and 45 at 50 mg/kg demonstrated significant tumor reductions. Interestingly, treatment of 45 showed a body weight increase compared to the vehicle group, indicating the potential for administering higher dosages of 45 to enhance its antitumor efficacy. 4) In the orthotopic stuty, FA3 at 10 mg/kg showed superior antitumor activity than 5-FU at 25 mg/kg.

12102219.label: Major findings and research outcome
12102219.value: 1) We have isolated various natural diterpenoids, including several additional ent-kaurene diterpenoids, and synthesized 26 analogs derived from a tricyclic diterpenoid. Our research revealed that none of these compounds demonstrated inhibitory effects against A549 and HCT116 cell lines. This outcome underscores the significance of ent-kauranes as a class of diterpenoids deserving of further exploration for their potential anticancer properties (NPR2, IJMS, Phytochem, CCL, Molecules1, Molecules2, BC). 2) We have synthesized over 180 new ent-kaurene analogs incorporating oxygen, nitrogen, sulfur, phosphate and selenium atoms by using the natural flexicaulin A (FA), henryin A (HA), oridonin (OR) and 5F as synthetic scaffolds (NPR1, CR). 3) About half of all the newly synthesized ent-kaurene analogs exhibited superior cell killing activities against a panel of cancer cell lines comprising with A549 (lung), A375 (melanoma), HCT116 (colorectal), HT29 (colorectal), PANC-1 (pancreatic) and 293T (embryonic kidney) cells compared to their parent compounds. The Michael adduct and the 7, 14-acetal derivatives could significantly increase the anticancer activities with much reduced toxicicity (NPR1, CR, ZCL PhD Thesis). 4) We examined the anti-proliferative and anti-metastatic effects of ent-kaurenes in HCT116 cellular models. Our in vitro and in vivo mechanistic studies revealed that FA3 exhibits significant anti-proliferative and anti-metastatic properties by inducing senescence and targeting NF-κB, STAT3 signaling pathways (NPR1, CR). 5) We have synthesized four biotin-linked probes of 5F at C-19 in order to elucidate the protein targets of ent-kaurene compounds (ZCL PhD Thesis). 6) The 7, 14-acetal derivatives (10b, 33, 36 and 45) of FA3 were found to markedly suppress tumor growth more effectively than the clinically used drugs fluorouracil (5-FU) and etoposide (ETP). Compound 36 did not result in significant changes in body weight compared to the vehicle group, suggesting lower toxicity in mice. Interestingly, the groups treated with 45 showed an increase in body weight compared to the vehicle group by the end of the experiment, indicating the potential for administering higher dosages of 45 to enhance its antitumor efficacy. In the orthotopic mouse model stuty, FA3 at 10 mg/kg showed superior antitumor activity than 5-FU at 25 mg/kg (NPR1, CR). 7) Ten research papers have been published (NPR1, NPR2, IJMS, Phytochem, CCL, Molecule1, Molecule2, BC), and one manuscript is in preparation for Cancer Research (CR). 8) The study results have been presented in 10 international conferences with 12 presentations. 9) One PhD student has graduated (ZCL PhD Thesis).

12102219.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12102219.value: Our ongoing research endeavors have led to the synthesis of a diverse range of over 180 ent-kaurene compounds, with an intriguing discovery that nearly half of them exhibited enhanced anti-proliferative activities compared to their parent compounds. Some of the Michael adduct derivatives in the D-ring of ent-kaurenes exhibited comparable or even superior activities to their parent compounds, highlighting their high potential for advancement as anticancer drug candidates, attributed to their lack of α, β-conjugate systems and consequently lower toxicities. Furthermore, our investigations of the acetal analogs have unveiled a substantial reduction in toxicity in murine models during our in vivo assessments, revealing incorporating a 7, 14-acetal group onto an ent-kaurene structure as an additional viable strategy for anticancer drug development of this type of compounds. In addition to these encouraging findings, the elucidation of the structure-activity relationships and the underlying mechanisms of action of ent-kaurene compounds from our study offer invaluable insights to guide strategic structural modifications aimed at optimizing the druggability of these ent-kaurene analogs. This comprehensive understanding, including considerations of toxicology and pharmacokinetics, paves the way for more focused and targeted refinement of ent-kaurene analogs in furture preclinical and clinical studies.

12102219.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12102219.value: Cancer remains a significant global health challenge, being a leading cause of mortality worldwide. In Hong Kong, colorectal carcinoma has consistently ranked as the most prevalent cancer type for the past years, with its incidence rate on a steadily increaing. Metastasis, the spread of cancer from its original site to other parts of the body, is a crucial factor in cancer-related deaths, accounting for about 90% of cases across different cancer types. Our research, conducted through cell-based and animal studies, has revealed the potential of ent-kaurane derivatives, a class of natural diterpenoids commonly found in plants of the Isodon genus within the Lamiaceae family, to effectively inhibit tumor growth in colorectal carcinoma cells, demonstrating promising anti-metastatic properties. By synthesizing over 180 novel ent-kaurane analogs, we have gained valuable insights into their structure-activity relationships (SAR), enabling the design of more potent compounds for controlling cancer metastasis while minimizing toxicity. Specifically, our investigations have identified two types of ent-kaurene compounds, namely Michael adducts and 7, 14-acetal analogs, as particularly potent in suppressing cancer cell proliferation. Through further refinement, these compounds can be tailored to develop additional analogs with enhanced druggability, positioning them as potential candidates for the treatment of metastatic colorectal cancer.

12102719.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12102719.value: A growing body of evidence indicates that chloroplasts play critical roles in sensing pathogen infection and other stresses and in relaying the information to the nucleus for activation of an appropriate immune response. SIGMA FACTORs (SIGs) are proteins that mediate initiation of transcription in chloroplasts. SIB1 was initially identified by its interaction with SIG1 in Arabidopsis chloroplasts. We previously found that SIB1 functions as a positive regulator of the plant immune response. Another group later found that SIB1 is also localized in the nucleus, where it acts as a co-activator of the transcription factor WRKY33 to enhance expression of defense-related genes. These findings indicate that SIB1 might link chloroplast-nucleus communication with the defense response by coordinating expression of both chloroplast and nuclear genes, but the underlying mechanism remains to be defined. Intriguingly, the SIB1 gene is also among the limited number of Arabidopsis genes that are subjected to a non-canonical capping of its transcripts. Eukaryotic mRNAs generally contain a methyl guanosine cap (m7G cap) at their 5´ ends. In recent years, some RNAs, in both prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells, were found to contain a non-canonical 5’ cap - the NAD cap. We developed a method termed NADtag-Seq, which is based on a click chemistry reaction to tag NAD-capped RNAs (NAD-RNAs) followed by direct RNA sequencing using the Oxford Nanopore sequencing platform, for genome-wide identification of NAD-RNAs. We found that NAD-RNAs are produced selectively from several hundred genes in Arabidopsis. Most NAD-RNAs in plants are produced from nuclear-encoded genes that produce proteins that function in the chloroplast. SIB1 is one Arabidopsis gene that produces a high proportion of RNAs capped with NAD amongst its transcript pool. Our recent findings suggest that NAD-RNAs in plants might be involved in regulating gene expression through chloroplast-nucleus cross-talk. We will use SIB1 as an example to analyze the mode of action of NAD-RNAs in controlling gene expression and study how SIB1 regulates chloroplast-nucleus communication during the immune response. We will determine whether SIB1’s NAD-RNAs can be translated and how changes in SIB1’s NAD-RNA levels might affect SIB1 expression and the immune response. This study will not only define the role of SIB1 in plant immunity but also further the general understanding of the molecular function of NAD-RNAs. 越來越多的證據表明，葉綠體在感知病原體侵染和其他外界逆境以及將這些逆境信號傳遞給細胞核來激活適當免疫反應的過程中發揮著重要作用。SIGMA因子(SIGs)調控葉綠體基因轉錄的起始过程。擬南芥SIB1蛋白最初發現在葉綠體中與SIG1相互作用。我們之前的研究發現SIB1在植物的免疫響應過程中起正調節的作用。另外一個研究小組隨後發現SIB1也可以在細胞核裡激活 WRKY33轉錄因子來增強相關抗病基因的表達。這些發現暗示了SIB1可能通過協調葉綠體基因和核基因的表達來連接葉綠體-細胞核之間對抗病響應的信號傳導，然而這一分子機制還需進一步闡明。 有意思的是，SIB1基因也是擬南芥中產生含有非典型帽子結構的RNA的基因之一。真核生物的mRNA的5’端含有一個被甲基化的鳥嘌呤核苷酸帽子結構（m7G）。近幾年來，在原核生物和真核生物中都發現了一些RNA在其5’端含有一個非典型的帽子結構—NAD 帽子結構。我們基於點擊化學反應的原理開發了一種叫做NADtag-Seq的方法，能夠對NAD-RNAs加一個RNA標簽然後對這些RNA用納米孔測序平台直接進行測序，以此對這些NAD-RNA進行鑒測。我們發現在擬南芥中有幾百個基因產生NAD-RNA。植物中高丰度的NAD-RNA大多是蛋白在葉綠體中行使功能的核基因产生的。SIB1基因產生的mRNA有很高比例是NAD-RNAs。 我們的發現顯示植物中的NAD-RNAs可能通過葉綠體和細胞核之間的信號交流來調控基因的表達。我們將以SIB1為例來分析NAD-RNAs如何調控基因表達以及探究SIB1如何在植物抗病響應中來調控葉綠體和細胞核之間的信號傳遞。我們將確定SIB1的NAD-RNA 能否被翻譯成蛋白質以及SIB1的NAD-RNA豐度的變化如何影響SIB1的表達和植物免疫反應。本研究不僅將明確SIB1在植物免疫中的作用，還將進一步促進對NAD-RNAs的分子功能的了解。

12102719.label: Realisation of objectives
12102719.value: SIB1 was initially known for its binding to the Sigma Factor 1 that mediates transcription in chloroplasts. Later it was found to interact with a few WRKY proteins to regulate nuclear gene expression as a co-activator. We previously identified SIB1 as an early pathogen-inducible gene and acts as a positive regulator in the defense response. Those findings raise a possibility that SIB1 might play a role in chloroplast-nucleus communication during the immune response. This project aims to further define the role of SIB1 in chloroplast-nucleus communication. 1. Establishment of methods for identifying and characterization NAD-capped RNAs and the possible role of NAD-capped transcripts from SIB1 Our initial finding indicated that transcripts of SIB1 could be NAD-capped. We developed the NAD tagSeq II method (Zhang et al, 2021, PNAS) for profiling of NAD-capped RNAs, and the method was later modified for identifying NAD-RNAs in eukaryotic organisms. More recently, we developed another method termed precision NAD-RNA sequencing (pNAD-seq) with enhanced sensitivity and accuracy for identifying NAD-RNAs (unpublished). It was found that a small portion of SIB1 transcripts in the plants infected with P. syringae could be NAD-capped. However, since the SIB1 gene is expressed at a very low level in plants under normal conditions, we could not tell if any of its transcripts in uninfected plants could also be NAD-capped. SIB1’s NAD-capped transcripts, total transcripts, and protein levels were all increased in response to pathogen infection; however, it remains to be determined if its NAD-RNAs play any direct role in the increased expression of SIB1. Earlier reports suggested that NAD-capped mRNAs could be translated. Our in vitro translational analysis using wheat-germ extracts also indicated that NAD-mRNAs could be translated. However, those reports on the identification of NAD-RNAs were based on the findings from the methods in which canonical m7G-capped mRNAs were likely misidentified as NAD-RNAs (Zhang et al, 2021, PNAS; Hu et al, 2021, PNAS). Our new findings indicate that NAD-RNAs are typically small, mostly ranging in size from 30nt to 300nt. Similarly, the NAD-capped transcripts from SIB1 were also found to be small. The findings indicate that SIB1’s NAD-capped transcripts are unlikely to code for proteins; more likely, they play a regulatory role, although the exact molecular mechanism remains to be defined. 2. Identification and characterization of SIB1-interacting proteins and revealing a novel mechanism of the plant ER stress response mediated by Sec23A through the ER-chloroplast communication SIB1 was initially identified by its interaction with chloroplast SigA and later by its interaction with WRKY33. We hypothesized that SIB1 might interact with more proteins, and therefore we used SIB1 as a bait to systemically identify its interacting proteins through the Y2H screen. The full-length SIB1 protein was found to cause auto-activation of the reporter genes in the Y2H system, and its activation domain is likely in the C-terminus. We found that the N-terminus (1-100 aa) did not lead to auto-activation and used it as bait in the Y2H screen. The screen led to the identification of the previously known SIB1-interacting proteins including SigA, WRKY20, and WRKY33. More proteins were identified as the putative SIB1-interacting proteins. These include additional WRKY proteins (WRKY2, WRKY3, WRKY4, WRKY8, WRKY 25, WRKY 25, WRKY51), a Sec23 protein (Sec23A), a chloroplast heat shock protein, and a member of RNA 3’-terminal phosphate cyclase family that was known to be localized in chloroplasts. Its interaction with Sec23A is intriguing as Sec23A is known to be involved in vesicle transport of proteins from the ER to Golgi, suggesting that SIB1 could also be located in the ER and shuttled to chloroplasts under certain conditions. We have confirmed that SIB1 and Sec23A interact in planta through co-IP and BiFC assays. Interestingly, we found that SIB1 is localized in the ER under normal conditions. Under ER stress (such as the stress triggered by the redox reagent DTT and SA), it accumulated in chloroplasts. Sec23A is known to be localized in the ER. Similarly, we found that under the ER stress, Sec23A was also localized in chloroplasts. To determine if Sec23A is involved in the ER stress tolerance, we obtained the sec23a knockout mutant, the mutant was indeed found to be more sensitive to growth inhibition caused by the ER stress. The sib1 knockout mutant showed only slightly less tolerant to the ER stress than wt seedlings although the SIB1 overexpression lines were found to be more tolerant to the ER stress. The results indicate that Sec23A plays a more important role in the ER stress tolerance than SIB1. These findings are included in a manuscript under preparation. 3. The molecular functions of SIB1 and SEC23A in the ER-chloroplast communication in response to the ER stress Our initial hypothesis is that under stress (such as pathogen infection), SIB1 produces NAD-capped mRNAs. NAD-mRNAs might code for a protein that is not identical as the one coded by m7G-mRNAs and might have a different function, such as being targeted to chloroplasts as chloroplast-localized SIB1 has a different size from that of the nucleus-localized SIB1. However, while we carried out the project, we realized that the above hypothesis is not valid since we found that the NAD-capped SIB1 transcripts are small and are more likely regulatory RNAs. We are working on defining the molecular mechanism of regulatory function of NAD-RNAs. We have found that under normal conditions, SIB1 proteins were mostly localized in the nucleus but were also retained to the ER. Under the ER stress, SIB1 was localized in the nucleus and chloroplasts. It is possible that chloroplast localized SIB1 proteins were transferred from the ER in response to the stress to regulate expression of chloroplast genes. Sec23A might play an important role in the ER-chloroplast communication in the ER stress response. Based on the aforementioned findings, the future direction of this project has shifted towards comprehending the specific roles of SIB1 and Sec23A in facilitating communication between the ER and chloroplasts. Currently, we are analyzing transcriptome profiles (using rRNA-depleted RNA samples) of wt, sib1, the SIB1 overexpression line, and sec23a to determine how expression of chloroplast genes and nuclear genes is affected by the mutations in pathogen-infected and uninfected plants. In addition, we are analyzing chloroplast proteome profiles of the wt and sec23a plants under the normal condition and the SA treatment to identify any other proteins that could be shuttled from the ER to chloroplasts mediated by Sec23A.

12102719.label: Major findings and research outcome
12102719.value: 1) We have developed different methods for profiling NAD-capped RNAs in prokaryotic and eukaryotic organisms. Some of the SIB1 transcripts produced in the pathogen-infected plants were found to be NAD-capped. The NAD-capped transcripts were found to be typically short (30-300nt), and they are unlikely to code for proteins. Instead, they are more likely to serve regulatory functions. 2) Through Y2H screen using SIB1 as bait, we identified new putative SIB1-interacting proteins. One of them is Sec23A. Sec23A was previously known to be involved in trafficking of vehicles from the ER to Golgi. We have confirmed that SIB1 and Sec23A interact in planta. In addition, we found that SIB1 and Sec23A are localized to the ER under normal growth conditions; however, they are localized in chloroplasts when plants are under the ER stress. Besides, their interaction also occurs in the ER under normal conditions and in chloroplasts under the ER stress. The sec23a and sib1 mutations caused an altered response to the ER stress, further supporting the finding on the role of these proteins in the ER stress response. 3) Our study has provided evidence suggesting that Sec23A-mediated protein trafficking plays a crucial role in transporting proteins from the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) to chloroplasts in regulating chloroplast function in response to ER stress. Further investigation and analysis could potentially uncover a fascinating new mechanism underlying the plant's response to ER stress through the communication between the ER and chloroplasts mediated by Sec23A and SIB1. This research avenue holds promising potential for expanding our understanding of the intricate interplay between these organelles in the plant stress response.

12102719.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12102719.value: Our future study will focus more on the role of Sec23A-mediated protein trafficking between the ER and chloroplasts, including shuttling of SIB1, in regulating chloroplast function in response to ER stress. We will identify additional proteins that might be transported from the ER to chloroplasts under the ER stress through chloroplast proteomics analysis and/or by purifying Sec23A-containing vesicles. The biological and molecular functions of these proteins will be further determined through various genetic and molecular analyses. The molecular function of NAD-capped SIB1 transcripts will also be further defined. This research avenue holds promising potential for expanding our understanding of the intricate interplay between these organelles in the plant stress response.

12102719.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12102719.value: Land plants face constant challenges from adverse environmental conditions, such as pathogen infections and various abiotic stresses. Plants have evolved various mechanisms to adapt to adverse conditions. Within plant cells, different organelles play a role in sensing stress and coordinating their response. In the case of the Arabidopsis SIB1 protein, it was previously known to be localized and functional in both the nucleus and chloroplasts. The aim of our project was to delve deeper into the mechanism by which SIB1 mediates the response to stresses, including pathogen infections. Through our research, we made a new discovery that SIB1 is also localized in the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) under normal growth conditions. Furthermore, under ER stress, which can be triggered by certain biotic and abiotic stresses, SIB1 accumulates in chloroplasts. This finding suggests that SIB1 may undergo transportation from the ER to chloroplasts in response to stress, likely be facilitated by a Sec23A-mediated vesicle-trafficking process, to regulate the expression of chloroplast genes. Overall, our study contributes to a broader understanding of the intricate interplay between organelles in the plant stress response, expanding our knowledge of how plants adapt to and cope with adverse conditions.
