12600519.label: Major findings and research outcome
12600519.value: As an attempt to bridge the gap between computer-assessed and human-assessed translation output, we seek to explore how to augment the evaluation metrics of BLEU of MT based on House’s (1997) model. Papineni et al. (2002) claim that BLEU is a reliable MT evaluation metric since it correlates with human evaluation for individual sentence judgment. However, translation is never simply an act of rendering one language into another. Instead, it is preconditioned by the languages and cultures in which the communication is based (Gentzler 2017). The evaluation carried out by BLEU is only a score of the matched n-grams between the reference translation and the MT version.Algorithm of MT works well with statistics and the regularity of languages. Nuances of communication at discourse, pragmatic and social levels, however, are better understood and rendered by human. Therefore, rather than relying solely on MT, a better model of human intervened-MT is necessary. In the present project, we discovered that the evaluation of the translation quality on the translation produced by the self-trained NMT model cannot rely on the automatic evaluation metric, BLEU, as it does not identify the textual problems. Futher, we also found that House's TQA model could evaluate the error categories at discourse levels, such as pramatic, semantic and genertic accuracy. However, it would be more effective with the adoption of MQM model to annotate and categorise errors. Therefore, a consolidated human-driven evaulation should be implmented with assessing the MT translation quality.

12600519.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12600519.value: Medical translation is one of the most important fields in professional translation practice and has gained increasing attention from translation researchers due to the huge demand for medical translation services around the globe (Montalt 2011). Translation is considered one of the most effective approaches for making the latest research and development of medicines, vaccines, and medical devices visible to other communities. However, medical translation is a particularly challenging field for NMT as domain-specific datasets are not readily available for training, which prevents NMT systems from performing high-quality work. This is troubling since making information accessible in different cultural contexts is essential in medical and healthcare services, as it could be an effective approach to advancing human health. The future development of this research could adopt the NMT method to evaluate the error classification from the MT output produced by an industrialized model, namely Google's NMT system, and an NMT model using a state-of-the-art method trained in the future project. It does not mean to create a rivalry between the two NMT models, but to distinguish the performance of a specialist-type and a generic-type NMT models.

12600519.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12600519.value: Despite the development of machine translation (MT) having grown exponentially and various MT systems having been applied to translation tasks over the past years, the accuracy of MT output on the domains where resources are scarce often remains unsatisfactory, mainly due to the insufficient data training of the MT system. This is particularly true for the training of the neural machine translation (NMT) system, as it is data-hungry and would not be able to perform up to standard in emerging domains where parallel data are less available; for example, the application of the NMT method in translating medical texts is still limited. This research attempted to trained an NMT model with 7.63GB of data, using a semi-supervised domain adaptation approach. In ddition, the research project also proposed the significance of the human-driven evaluation method in assessing the translation quality on the translations produced by the self-trained NMT model. The researchers further suggested that Juliane House's translation quality assessment model can be supplmented by Lommel et al.?s (2014) multidimensional quality metric (MQM) model to closely annotate the error categories.

12600819.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12600819.value: Social workers’ workplace well-being is an important issue, not only for themselves, but also for their service users. The focus of this research study is to examine work conditions and psychological factors which may lead to the positive state of workplace well-being such as work engagement and the negative state of workplace well-being such as burnout and health problems among young adult social workers aged 21-29 in four Chinese cities: Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, and Hong Kong. In the past decade, a number of studies on workplace well-being, mostly conducted in western societies, have supported the dual processes in the job demands-resources (JD-R) model where job demands positively predict burnout while job resources positively predict work engagement. However, this model is not free of critique. First, it is suggested that job demands be unpacked into two different types: hindrance and challenge. Second, the model does not take personal resources into account. Finally, the psychological mechanisms which may explain how job demands and job resources lead to relevant workplace well-being are still unknown. In this study, an emerging construct, namely collective psychological ownership (CPO), which refers to a collective sense shared by co-workers that they feel they own the organization, will be tested for its role in the relationship between work conditions and workplace well-being. This study will examine how CPO affects job demands and job resources understood in an expanded notion on their influences on work engagement, burnout, and health problems of young adult social workers. A mixed-method research methodology will be adopted for collecting empirical data in Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, and Hong Kong. Questionnaire surveys will be designed specifically to test the CPO conceptual model. Focus groups will aim at discussing general topics regarding the influences of various work conditions on workplace well-being and how young adult social workers handle their various states of workplace well-being. The emphasis of individual interviews with the social worker respondents will be on understanding their work experience, and their perceptions about the influence of CPO on workplace well-being. Interventions on enhancing workplace well-being by leveraging on personal resources will be provided to 120 young adult social workers in the four Chinese cities. Both intervention and control groups will be included to test the effectiveness of the interventions. The findings of this study will inform research studies on and interventions for developing young adult social workers’ workplace well-being. 社會工作者的職場幸福感，於其本身及其服務對象，都是重要的課題。本研究聚焦於影響中國四個城市，包括上海、廣州、深圳及香港的21-29歲的青年社會工作者的職場幸福感的工作條件及心理因素。這些因素可能引起青年社會工作者的正面職場狀態，如工作投入；也可能引起其負面的職場狀態，例如工作懈怠及健康問題。在過去的十年間，不少研究關注職場幸福感，不過主要是西方的研究。這類研究支持“工作資源-要求”模型在解釋職業倦怠及工作投入方面的有效性。該模型強調兩個部分，第一，工作資源可以增加工作投入；第二，工作要求可能增加職業倦怠。但也不乏對這個模型的批評。 首先，有人提出工作要求應該解構為兩個不同類型：阻力型工作要求及挑戰型工作要求。第二， 這個模型並沒有考慮屬於個人資源的因素。最後，這個模型尚未解釋工作要求和工作資源如何導致職場幸福感的機制。本研究將一個嶄新的概念——集體心理擁有感 （CPO）引入青年社會工作者幸福感的研究。CPO意指同工們共享的一種對機構的集體擁有感。我們將檢測CPO在工作條件及職場幸福感的關係當中扮演的角色。本研究將檢測CPO如何作用於延展意義上的工作要求和工作資源對青年社會工作者的工作投入、職業倦怠及健康的影響。我們將採取混合的研究方法，分別到上海、廣州、深圳和香港四個城市收集實證數據。問卷調查將用於概念模型的檢驗。焦點小組旨在討論一些有關不同工作條件對職場幸福感的影響和青年社會工作者如何面對不同狀態的職場幸福感之類的一般話題。與青年社會工作者的個別訪談將用於探索他們的工作經驗，還有他們對CPO如何影響職場幸福感的理解。介入研究將以個人資源為槓桿，提升120名來自上述四個城市的青年社會工作者的職場幸福感。介入研究包括控制組和介入組，主要為了檢測介入的有效性。本研究的發現，將有助於啟發未來改善青年社會工作者職場幸福感的有關研究和介入方案。

12601419.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12601419.value: The revival in ci poetry reached its height in the Qing dynasty. It helped to produce a rich range of literary phenomena, which consisted, in essence, of the pingdian (evaluation and highlighting) criticism on Qing ci poetry. The pingdian criticism on Qing ci poetry means the evaluation and highlighting on a given Qing ci poetry text by Qing critics. Although the pingdian criticism to ci poetry had been used before the Qing period, it was only frequently and widely adopted by Qing critics. There are approximately more than 300 works of the pingdian criticism on Qing ci poetry by Qing critics, however, little research to date has fully discussed this important phenomenon. This project aims to examine the following aspects: (1) investigating the style and format of the pingdian criticism on Qing ci poetry as well as its growth and development, (2) investigating the transmission and circulation of Qing ci poetry, (3) investigating the interrelated aspects of the pingdian criticism and other forms of ci poetry criticism [including “talks on lyrics” (cihua) and prefaces and postfaces, and so on], (3) investigating how the pingdian criticism represented the critics’ subjective experience and intuition of the present in the process of the aesthetics of interpretation, (4) investigating the characteristics of the pingdian criticism activities in literati communities of ci poetry and, (5) investigating the other related issues on the theories of ci poetry of the Qing dynasty through the comments and information recorded in the pingdian editions of Qing ci poetry. Concurrently, for a new understanding of Qing ci poetry, this project will provide a re-evaluation of the literary values of an individual author and the literary achievement and activities of women ci writers. In order to achieve the above goals, this project will employ an interdisciplinary methodology adopted from the fields of philology, literary history and cultural history. 詞學評點在宋代即已產生，至明代得到發展，而至清代走向繁盛。評點是清詞發展中的一個重要現象，也是硏究清詞和清代詞學的一個重要角度。本課題通過還原詞壇創作的某些具體生態，如創作時的本事，包括時間、地點、事由、參加者等，更進一步地瞭解作家的動態性的創作過程，特別是其群體活動的狀況，增強對清詞創作和理論的發展關係的理解。清詞評點中對不少詞學理論中的重大問題都有所回應，例如詞的起源，詞的音調聲韻，詞的風格特色，詞的本色正變，詞風的南北宋之爭，詞體創作的學問化等，均可以和詞的序跋、詞話等其他詞學批評形式加以互動，互相印證。而且，評點直接面對具體作品所體現出的直觀性或當下性，也有著特別的意義。通過這樣的研究，對清詞和清代詞學理論，做出更深入的思考。

12601419.label: Realisation of objectives
12601419.value: 評點是清代詞學的重要文獻。清代詞學號稱中興，許多方面都有新的成績。在清代 ，無論是通代詞選，還是本朝詞選，或者是家集、地域性選集，甚至詞別集，其中都有大量的評點，其數量遠遠超過以往歷朝歷代。本課題將清詞評點視為清代詞學理論中的一個重要內容，進行全面研究，探討其特定的價值，但在具體執行此一研究計劃時，並不拘囿於其字面意義，而是將清詞文本的各個方面都考慮進去，從文本的關聯中探討清詞和清代詞學的內容發展、風格特徵、美學特色、性別意識等。另外，清代的詞和詩有著緊密的關係，探討清詞，難免會涉及到清詩，因此，執行研究計劃時，若發現有價值、有意義的問題，也會將詩和詞結合起來，加以思考。具體而言，本課題討論了清代女性作家的詠物之作和行旅之作，揭示了她們創作空間的擴大及其所體現的文學和社會價值，並從理論上闡發了批評家們對女性從事文學創作的合理化所進行的辯說。常州詞派的開創者張惠言創作的起點很高，以往的研究對其影響力從何時展開缺少認識，本課題在這方面有所發現，通過其去世不久後詞壇對其《水調歌頭》五首的模仿，確認了其理論經由本鄉走向全國的過程。本課題還考察了社會的變遷對清詞創作的影響，特別集中在詠前朝史和當代史方面，指出這是詞史理論的進一步發展，是對傳統詞學的一個貢獻。另外，現代著名學者程千帆在詩詞鑒賞上有著真知灼見，本課題也總結了其鑒賞理論，並結合1980年代以來詩詞鑒賞熱的出現，闡述了其意義。本課題也試圖將宏觀論述和具體的文本分析結合在一起，因此，對清代的一些有特色的詞作品，也進行了細緻闡釋。本課題增強了對清詞發展的認識和理解，體現了清詞研究的新進展。

12601819.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12601819.value: 連結名稱：十八世紀植物學的共同命名法

12601819.label: Project Objectives
12601819.value: To broaden the understanding of early modern botanical nomenclature and its practices and highlight the lasting importance of synonyms in the eighteenth century and beyond as indices and repositories of information. To demonstrate that identifying synonyms was a practice that involved the botanical community as a whole and that from this networked approach resulted specific forms of scientific publishing. To investigate the widespread phenomenon of posthumously publishing the manuscripts and illustrations that were left behind after the death of a botanist – not in their original form but with expanded and corrected synonymies. To analyze how this international and intergenerational process turned editors, translators, and correspondents into co-authors. To deepen the understanding of early modern botany as an information science.

12601819.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12601819.value: This project explores far-reaching forms of co-authorship in late seventeenth-century and eighteenth-century botanical nomenclature that resulted from the necessity of procuring and processing ever-growing amounts of information. To this end two interrelated, but so far largely unresearched scholarly practices will be investigated: first, the collaborative identification of so-called synonyms, that is, different names given to a plant by different botanists in the absence of a binding nomenclature, in a process that took up a considerable amount of every botanist’s time; and second, the widespread phenomenon of posthumously publishing the botanical manuscripts and illustrations that were left behind after a scholar’s death. Often several consecutive authors were involved in a publishing process whose aim was less to make the material available to the botanical community in an original version than to update, correct and rearrange it, especially the synonyms. The resulting layering of information shaped not only the appearance of the published text, but also a concept of scientific authorship. Botanical names were an assemblage of contributions by many; the botanical author was a ‘composite’. This three-year project will show, first, that the comparative process of identifying synonyms required and generated an ever-expanding mass of data, which was used continuously to supplement and rearrange plant names. The primary sources of information were botanical publications, including the illustrations they contained, and botanical correspondence. Second, it will argue that although the greatest care was taken, work on synonyms was never entirely free of errors, which meant that the lists of synonyms and the taxonomical classification of plants had to be constantly corrected. This required long-term international collaborations, the aggregated results of which were published in continuously updated versions or editions of a text. Third, it will argue that these collaborations resulted in far-reaching forms of co-authorship. Case studies on the posthumous publication of Charles Plumier’s (1646-1704) and Paul Hermann’s (1646-1695) papers by the Dutch botanist Johannes Burman (1707-1780) and others will trace how editors, correspondents, and translators all contributed to collecting, updating, and correcting information on plant names. Synonymies were co-authored through an international and intergenerational process of information layering. And, fourth, the project will demonstrate that this networked approach generated networked names that reflect the epistemic interconnectedness of the botanical community. 此課題探討十七世紀晚期、十八世紀植物學命名法的共同創作方法，其有深遠影響，源於要搜集與處理大量信息。為了此課題，我們要探究兩種學術方向，它們互相關連，但卻極少人研究：第一，對所謂的同義詞的集體界定，即是在沒有共享的命名法前，不同植物學家對某一相同植物定下的不同名字，這浪費了大量時間；第二，在某植物學學者死後，出版其留下的作品與插圖時的廣泛現象。通常來說，幾位接續的學者在此出版過程中，其目標並非以原有版本供給植物學社群，而是更新、改正、重新編排其出版物，特別是那些同義詞。由此而來的信息編排決定了不僅僅是出版作品的面貌，還包括了科學創作的概念。植物學名稱是眾人貢獻的集成；植物學作者是一個「綜合體」。

12601919.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12601919.value: Accruing research in recent years has prompted the “bilingual advantage hypothesis”, positing that the need for language control during bilingual processing enhances executive functioning. This advantage is believed to transfer to non-linguistic activities, creating neurocognitive benefits across the lifespan (Bialystok, 2017). The cognitive functions under discussion include the ability to inhibit irrelevant information, flexibility in updating mental schemas, and efficiency in switching between tasks. However, inconsistent results from various approaches have questioned the existence of this phenomenon (Paap et al., 2018). Such mixed findings may reflect the wide-ranging bilingual experiences of the participants and the diverse contexts under which they perform language tasks. Against this background, a promising approach lies in comparing specific bilingual populations differing in the cognitive demands they face during daily language processing (Bialystok, 2017). In particular, simultaneous interpreting is performed under extreme time pressure, which exerts high demands on several executive and linguistic functions. Abundant research suggests that interpreters outperform non-interpreter bilinguals in tasks measuring executive functioning. This has motivated the “interpreter advantage hypothesis” (García, 2014), which involves three central questions: 1) do the stringent demands faced by interpreters during bilingual processing lead to significant cognitive enhancements?; 2) if yes, to what extent is such an advantage specific to simultaneous interpreting or general to other forms of expertise in inter-lingual reformulation (e.g., written translation)?; and 3) when does the advantage, if it exists, emerge during an interpreter’s training or experience? This project aims to answer these questions through a longitudinal study where student interpreters are compared with student translators and bilingual students without training in interpreting and translation. Performance data will be collected at three time points over a two-year training program. Professional interpreters and professional translators will also be tested as benchmarks against which to assess the students’ performance. Validated tests will be used to measure participants’ executive functioning, verbal working memory, semantic processing, and a working memory component that integrates information from different sources. A dual-task methodology will be adopted to test how much participants rely on different working memory components when processing verbal information. This study differs from past studies in that the participants are more closely compared regarding the specific context where their two languages are used and in its choice of non-verbal memory components as potential areas of interest. More generally, our unique approach to sampling and testing can shed novel light on the adaptive capacity of bilingual cognitive systems. 近年雙語研究提出｢雙語優勢論｣，主張處理雙語過程中的語言掌控對「執行功能」具有強化作用。研究顯示，這一優勢也會影響非語言活動，對神經認知產生終身效益(Bialystok, 2017)。各項研究涵蓋的認知功能，包括：抑制無關資訊的能力、更新心理基模的靈活度，以及轉換任務的效率。然而，由於研究結果各不相同，雙語優勢是否存在，仍受到質疑(Paap et al., 2018)。研究結果不一，可能歸因於研究參與者廣泛的雙語經歷，以及他們執行語言任務時的多樣情境。有鑑於此，比較不同雙語群體處理日常語言所需的認知能力，是值得嘗試的研究取向(Bialystok, 2017)。特別就同聲傳譯而言，該活動在時間極度緊張的情況下進行，對某些執行功能和語言功能帶來高度要求。大量研究顯示，在各種衡量執行功能的任務中，口譯員的表現比非口譯員雙語者更好。因此，García (2014)提出｢口譯優勢論｣，涵蓋三個核心問題：1）口譯員在處理雙語時面對的高度要求，是否對認知有重大強化作用？2）如果有，這種優勢多大程度反應同聲傳譯的經驗，或其實也廣泛體現在其他從事語言轉換的專職（例如：筆譯）？3）倘若優勢存在，在口譯訓練或口譯經歷中，該優勢會於何時出現？為了回答上述問題，本研究將透過長期追蹤，比較口譯學生、筆譯學生，和無口筆譯訓練的雙語者。研究資料將在為期兩年的訓練課程中，分三個時間點採集。專業口譯員和專業筆譯員也會參與測試，與學生表現做對比評估。本研究將採用驗證過的測驗來衡量參與者的執行功能、語言工作記憶，語義處理，和一個整合多源信息的工作記憶元素。另外，本研究將透過一種雙重任務的方法，測試參與者在處理語言訊息時對不同工作記憶元素的依賴程度。本研究和過往研究的不同有兩點：一是根據參與者使用雙語的具體情境來相互比較；二是選擇非語言記憶的元素作為潛在關照點。廣義上來講，本研究的取樣和測試方法獨特，可能就雙語認知系統的適應能力提出新的研究方向。

12602719.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12602719.value: This project examines rituals directed at the environment in early China, examining ritual action and conceptions of the environment in Warring States, Qin, and Han China (475 BCE – 220 CE). Due to the growing contemporary concern over the environment, there has been increased scholarly interest in philosophies of the environment from early China, yet there have been no studies on religious practice in shaping peoples’ understandings of the environment. This project will address this omission, by examining ritual action in early China, considering ritual as a means through which knowledge of the environment was obtained. Ritual was one of the fundamental ways in which the peoples of early China, and other ancient civilizations, attempted to manage and understand their environment. Seasonal rituals sought to regulate the seasons, and harmonize man’s place within the cosmos. Prayers and sacrifices were frequently performed to influence weather, entreating the heavens to induce or stop rainfall. Sacrifices were often a first line of defence against adverse environmental conditions: floods, droughts, or locusts, to name but a few. Men tried not only to predict the weather, but to use weather itself as a prognosticatory tool. While the specific rituals performed in early China were unique to their particular time and place, these categories of ritual activity transgress geographical and temporal boundaries. This project examines ritual action as an attempt to engage with the environment, and, through these engagements, to view how people gained information about their environment. This knowledge obtained from ritual action was an important part of the body of knowledge that was also formed from the observation and study of the natural world. In the ancient philosophical texts, rituals directed at the environment are often dismissed as superstition, and in contemporary scholarship, environmental rituals are subsumed into other categories of ritual practice, studied for their role in maintaining social organization, or dismissed as under-theorized. This ignores the fact that ritual action and religious perspectives were among the most common ways that people of various social groups understood their environment. This project will provide us with a more complete understanding of human-environment interaction in early China. As this type of ritual is not unique to early China, or the ancient world more broadly, theorizing environmental ritual as a distinct category will open up new discourses in environmental studies, both historical and contemporary. 本研究重點考察戰國至秦漢時期(公元前475年—公元220年)的典禮、祭祀與自然間的關係。鑒於當代對環境議題的關注日益增長，學人有關中國古代早期自然觀的研究興趣也不斷倍增，但至於宗教活動是如何形塑人們對自然的理解，學界對這一課題的研究仍然匱乏。在本研究看來，禮或宗教儀式是獲取自然知識的一種手段。於中國古代早期的人們及其他古代文明而言，禮是他們試圖征服、管理、理解自然的基本方式之一。月令試圖調節歲時節氣，使天地人達到和諧統一。因祈雨或止雨的需要，禱告和祭祀也時常發生。祭祀還會在諸如洪水、乾旱、蝗災等惡劣自然災害發生時舉行。儀禮和宗教活動是不同社會群體觀察和理解自然最常見的方式之一。由於此種典禮并非中国古代早期或其他更广泛的古代文明世界所独有，因此將自然禮理論化並將之作為一種獨特的範疇，將為環境研究開闢新的歷史的和現代的話語。

12602719.label: Realisation of objectives
12602719.value: Religion and the Environment in Early China sought to understand the ways in which the peoples of early Chinese states interacted with their environment through non-scientific means. In particular, the project focused on the relationship between religion and the environment, ritualized understandings of the environment, the environment within the context of correlative cosmology and mantic systems, and the dichotomy between philosophical musings on the environment and the actual environmental policies of early Chinese states. In so doing, the project demonstrated first, that there were many different ideas about the relationship between humans and the environment in circulation during this period and that the ideas that have seemed most popular to us due to their ubiquity in texts from the period were not necessarily those that had the greatest influence on state policies. Second, the project demonstrated that ideas about the environment, and man’s relationship to it, were shaped not only by philosophical ideas or by proto-scientific or technological discoveries, but were strongly influenced by ideas about religion and the cosmos. Further, environmental policies were also subject to ideas about rulership and history. Through these major points, the project has highlighted the complexity of the ideas about the environment in early China and demonstrated that when examining the environment in a pre-modern society, we must consider a wide variety of perspectives and topics that would be dismissed by modern scientific discourse on the environment. Drawing attention to this complexity both broadly and through several specific case studies is one of the key achievements of this project, details of which will be highlighted below. The first objective, “to identify perceptions of the environment as demonstrated in rituals directed at the environment,” has been accomplished through the study of both rituals directed at the environment as well as through the ritualized understandings of the environment expressed in recently retrieved bamboo manuscripts held by Beijing University. By studying these rituals and ritualized understandings of the environment, the PI has demonstrated that ideas about the environment were one part of a complex understanding of the cosmos and man’s place in it. In a recently published article, the PI has shown how weather, particularly rain, was used as a prognosticatory tool, integrated and intertwined with ideas about astronomy and morality. While some scholars, such as Wang Chong, attempted to debunk some superstitions about rain, even this most rational and cynical scholar noted the connection between rainfall and the movement of the moon through the asterisms. As most studies of the early Chinese environment have focused on the state’s technological interventions in the environment, as well as their promotion of agriculture, this project has demonstrated that a philosophy of use is too simplistic, and to form a more comprehensive picture of early ideas about the environment, we must take religious and ritualized ideas seriously. The third objective, to “highlight the importance of ritual theory developed from early Chinese religious practices” is best exemplified by the PI’s article, “Repairing the Yellow River Breach at Huzi: Flood Control and Immortality during the reign of Han Wudi” (Etudes Chinoises, accepted). By using the case study of the repairs to a major breach of the Yellow River during the reign of Han Wudi, this article argues that the government prioritized ritualized and religious understandings of the environment over the well-being of the people who inhabited the flooded area. When the initial repair to the breach failed, the government understood it to be a signal from Heaven that they should not interfere. When, some 20 years later, the emperor was embarking on his quest to become an immortal, he realized that it was important to repair the breach to demonstrate his mastery over water. The breach was finally repaired when the emperor began to position himself within a lineage of sage rulers, and when he had received encouraging signs from Heaven. The integration of religious and ritualized ideas about the environment help to explain not only this particular case, but the ways in which environmental decisions were made by the early Chinese. This perspective will be applied by the PI to comparable societies, notably Rome, where the Tiber river was a source of floods but also considered to have religious significance. The second objective, “to resolve the division between theoretical discussions about ritual and the environment with the actual practice of environmental ritual in early China” was reshaped somewhat during the course of the investigation due to the discoveries made in the sources and in response to the majority of the literature discussing early Chinese environmental philosophy. Here, the PI focuses on one important text from early China, The Book of Lord Shang (shangjun shu 商君書) which has never been read as a text espousing any sort of environmental philosophy. In reaction to the abundance of scholarship which focuses on Daoist texts and argues that the early Chinese had more eco-friendly or less-anthropocentric conceptions of the environment, the PI demonstrates that although these texts may have contained these ideas, they were not the dominant strain of thought influencing environmental policy. Instead, by focusing on The Book of Lord Shang, we can see that the environmental policy of the early Chinese states was quite exploitive, and that we, as modern scholars, should be careful not to only look at these non-dominant, more eco-friendly beliefs. While this portion of the project is less concerned with ritual and religion, it continues the project’s emphasis on highlighting and examining the plurality of views about the environment in early China, and, indeed, the ancient world. The drafting of an article based on this research is currently well underway, and the PI plans to submit it to the journal Environmental History within the coming months. Overall, the project has demonstrated that in order to understand early Chinese conceptions of the environment, it is essential that we take religious and ritualized ideas and experiences seriously, alongside philosophical ideas and evidence from technological interventions. These ideas will be expanded, as the PI will transform these initial investigations into a comparative project, examining the early Chinese religious and ritualized understandings of the environment alongside those from Rome. The final result will be a book manuscript, which incorporates evidence from both early China, derived from this project, and from Rome. The prospectus for this monograph is currently being drafted by the PI.

12602719.label: Major findings and research outcome
12602719.value: The major finding of the project is that religious ideas and ritualized experiences informed ideas about the environment in early China much more than has previously been supposed. The majority of studies about the Chinese environment have primarily utilised scientific data about environmental change and examined technological interventions, or they have focused solely on philosophical discussions. This project makes an important contribution by demonstrating that religious ideas were an important part of people's perception of the environment, and that the peoples of early China used rituals as a primary means of interacting with the environment. Such an understanding is very important for future studies, as it reminds scholars that the early Chinese did not perceive the environment in the same ways that we do now, and, while scientific and technological studies of the period are of great importance, they do not represent how people at the time actually engaged with the world around them. While the study undertaken in this project was confined only to early China, its findings and methods can be applied to other pre-modern societies, where religion and ritual were often one of the first places that people turned to when they encountered unexpected phenomena or environmental change. Further, the project has shown that ideas about the environment were wholly integrated into people's worldviews. Rather than being simply a resource to be exploited, or a force that could bring good or ill fortune, the environment was a source of knowledge, legitimization, and something that could be entreated to aid the people or the state.

12602719.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12602719.value: The research conducted in this project will be expanded to include other geographical regions. This project focused on the rituals and religious ideas about the environment in early China. The PI plans to take these findings and use them to interrogate sources from ancient Rome, and potentially ancient Greece and the ancient Near East. Because religion and ritual were of such fundamental importance in these societies, it is expected that their ideas and attitudes about the environment were very much influenced by religious and ritualized understandings. By applying what has been found about early China in this project to other societies, the PI will be able to produce a monograph that is broader in scope, and will be of greater importance to research worldwide.

12602719.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12602719.value: Many studies of the environment in early China have focused on scientific research about environmental change, or on the technological capabilities of early Chinese states in managing their environment, e.g. regarding agriculture or water control. Other studies have discussed philosophical texts within the context of the contemporary environmental movement. Religion and the Environment in early China has shown that rather than simply being philosophically or technologically focused, the conception of the environment in early China was highly influenced by religious ideas and understandings formed through ritual engagement with the environment. In studying religious ideas and ritual action, this study has demonstrated that ideas about the environment were far more complex than has previously been assumed, and that these religious and ritualized understandings could sometimes take precedence over the immediate needs of the people.

12602919.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12602919.value: The Chinese diaspora and the nature of Chinese civic organizations have been widely documented. Little is known, however, about the endeavors of Chinese state apparatuses’ transitional strategies and the changing characters of overseas Chinese hometown associations (CHTAs). This proposed project will fill this research gap by examining state-diaspora relations in East and Southeast Asia against the backdrop of China’s increasing integration in the global economy and the increase in Chinese overseas migration in recent years. Specifically, this project will compare the evolving form and function of CHTAs in Hong Kong, Taipei, Singapore and Penang (which differ in their proximity to China’s influence and their embeddedness in the host communities) to assess the ecology, boundary and boundlessness of China’s global influence from a temporal and transnational perspective. First, this project will identify the conditions that account for the revival of CHTAs across the four metropolises and explain why CHTAs are more robust in some regions than in others. Revival is defined as whether these century-old organizations have expanded in size, territory, or service and transcended class, generation or border. Second, we will examine whether the restructuring originated with the immigrants’ voluntary actions, was incentivized by Chinese capital investment, was appropriated by the Chinese state’s overseas and united-front works or was neutralized by the host city’s authorities. This comparative research design will uncover to what extent the development of CHTAs shapes and is shaped by voluntarism, capital and coercion. Third, we will classify the functions of CHTA into different socio-political categories across time and locality to reveal how CHTAs have made and remade the societies in China’s periphery and diasporic regions. Our interdisciplinary team will adopt a mixed method approach composed of digital mapping, elite interviews, respondent-driven sampling and ethnography to reveal the conditions that have transformed and mediated the organizational form and associational practices of CHTAs in different host communities. By offering a thorough description of the trend, impetus and impact of CHTAs’ associational practices, this project will advance the conceptualization of civil society in different regimes and socio-economic contexts. By assessing whether China’s state-diaspora relations are more embedded in temporal and local dynamics or more determined by the scale of Chinese transnational capital investment and government intervention, this project will lay the groundwork for a critical analysis of Global China. 中國僑民和中國民間組織的性質有著廣泛研究。然而，鮮為人知的是中國國家機器的跨國戰略與及同鄉會組織居中的變遷角色。在中國加強全球經濟一體化和海外華人移民增長的背景下，這項目將通過研究東亞和東南亞的「國家－僑民關係」來填補這一研究空白。具體來說，這個項目將比較同鄉會在香港、台北、新加坡和檳城不斷發展的形式和功能（它們的不同之處在於跟中國影響力的距離和在東道社區的嵌入程度）評估中國在全球影響力的生態和邊界，提供跨時間和跨國的視角。 首先，這項目將確立導致同鄉會跨越四大都市的復興條件，並解釋為什麼同鄉會在某些地區更形強大。復興被定義為這些具有百年曆史的組織是否具出現規模、領域或服務形式的重組和擴展，並超越階級、世代或邊界。其次，我們將研究復興是否起源於移民自願行為、受到中國資本投資牽引、受中國政府海外和統戰系統主導、或被當地政府約束。這種比較研究設計，將揭示同鄉會的形態、發展和形式，多大程度上是由自願、資本和強制形成。第三，我們將把同鄉會的功能分為不同的社會政治類別，以分析同鄉會的發展，如何在中國的外圍和海外地區製造和重塑中國身份和群體。 我們的跨學科團隊，將採用混合研究方法，包括精英訪談、受訪者驅動抽樣、人類學誌和大數據分析，以展現是甚麼條件，令同鄉會在不同寄住社區出現轉變。通過深入描述同鄉會實踐的趨勢、動力和影響，這項目將推動公民社會研究的概念化。通過評估中國的「國家－僑民關係」是由當地社區的嵌入程度和組織動力所驅動，還是更多地由中國跨國資本投資和政府政策所主導，這個項目更有助奠定「全球中國」分析框架的基礎。

12603519.label: Project Objectives
12603519.value: 從文化史的宏觀角度，梳理宋元賞玩文化的源流及內容，重點放在元人對前朝遺物的體認，與及此體認如何成為文學創作的一環。 從宮廷文化的角度，探討元代中期大都宮廷文人群體的「宋石」書寫是如何批判接受北宋賞石文化，考察此類遺物對蒙元皇帝、宮廷文人的文化和政治意義。 從文人群體和隱逸文化的角度，考察元代後期江南文人（包括那些曾在大都供職但後來退居南方的漢族和非漢族文人）如何與當時蘇州崑山文人群體，形成新的藝術中心，並以詩文方式賦予宋石意義以及藉此建構一己在政治以外的身份。 擬將北宋賞石文化四位代表的藏品和詩文題跋，以及元人對此的討論，彙編成冊，為研究宋元文學的學者提供參考。

12603519.value: 筆者全盤考察現存元代文獻，發現元人宋石流轉途徑廣泛，包括購買、惠贈、家傳、道中所遇等等。此等情況不必隨即反映在題詠中，收藏家或許秘藏一段時間後才予以示人或易手，而個別宋石的流轉不一定有線索可以追溯，更多的是，相關記載散見於詩文筆記和石硯譜錄裡〔目標1〕。研究發現，元人所藏宋石大部分來自歐陽修、蘇軾、黃庭堅以及宋代宗室、官員、收藏家（徽宗、米芾、文天祥、鄧光薦等）的藏石。如此傾向符合由歐陽修、蘇軾、徽宗、米芾等人開創的賞石文化傳統〔目標1、4〕。 元人書寫最為突出的面向為追慕宋代賞石文化以及發掘宋石承載的道德意涵，形成四條脈絡。第一，承續北宋賞石文化，呼應蘇軾寓意於物的思考、杜綰以小為大的賞石觀點〔目標1、3〕。第二，部分來自南宋宗室官宦的藏石，都與宋末戰亂相關。即是說，對來自北宋的藏石，關注其審美風尚的延續，對來自南宋的藏石，關注該石與舊收藏家的道德連繫〔目標1〕。第三，題詠者大部分是元代中期宮廷文人，他們承認蒙元治統，賞玩故宋宗室石硯時，不從世變看待，傾向轉化其歷史感為每天使用兼具實用功能的石硯；至於徽宗艮岳遺石在蒙元宮廷以外的流轉，集中出現在先元及元代初期，因為徽宗藝文在元代中後期，是玩物喪志的代稱〔目標2、4〕。第四，元代後期東南文人收藏文天祥的玉帶生硯，此硯成為楊維楨藏品。楊維楨正逢混亂時局，只能寓居杭州、平江等地與時賢唱和，他藉玉帶生硯寄託的個人心聲，表達對仕途的憂慮〔目標3〕。 本研究指出，元人也關注宋石的漏、皺、巨大，宋硯之堅、厚，呈現賞石之主觀審美移情，包括石之怪奇、瘦勁、高聳，石硯之敦厚、淳古，繼而比德於人格之堅貞節概、溫潤厚德力量〔目標1〕。不過，重心不在賦寫宋石外形，而是在於新／舊收藏家的本事，因為所詠之物都是傳承有序的故物。這樣就建構了屬於元人獨有的宋代記憶，宋石題詠所書寫的情感世界，兼有新／舊收藏家的層次，以及題詠者的層次，詩人書寫這些層次之詳略不同，大部分傾向著重舊收藏家的本事。即是說，元代文人關注舊收藏家及題詠者的連結，較少提及元代新收藏家的部分，或許與新的意義仍在積澱有關，例如新收藏家鄧謙、廉希貢在友人的題詠裡的篇幅較少，除非題詠者本身是宋石的新收藏家，一如楊維楨〔目標1、2、3、4〕。研究也發現，元人對待宋代聚歛之臣的藏石非常寬容，物不以人廢，因為新的收藏家可以藉個人品行轉化故物內涵。同時，收藏和餽贈宋石的行為反映舊收藏家重情輕物的物觀，藉題詠者的書寫表達摯誠的行誼。本研究中的題詠者，剛巧都活躍於元代中期，他們在宋石題詠中尤為重要，賦予宋石於當代新的意義連結。因此，宋石的收藏、餽贈、題詠，是元代文人日常交流，連結彼此情誼之途徑。題詠者對舊／新收藏家的讚賞以及從他們的書寫中呈現的誠懇、恭敬、詼諧語調，可以知悉題詠者在元代大都文人群體裡的定位，他們通過參與此類賞石活動，無形中提升了自身的話語權位置〔目標1、2〕。（1194 WORDS）

12603519.label: Major findings and research outcome
12603519.value: 宋石的蒐集和題詠是十三世紀後期，除書畫鑑賞外，最為顯著的藝文活動。宋石經由士人購買珍藏帶入蒙元時空，或由家族傳承至元，或從道中偶得。元人賞玩、經眼和題詠的宋石，多數來自宋代著名鑑賞家藏品，包括宋徽宗、葉夢得、蘇軾、黃庭堅、歐陽修、張夢卿等人的藏石和用硯，以及畫中之石(蘇軾枯木竹石圖)，同時也珍藏南宋宗室及官員藏石，而且都與戰爭人物有關。元人不太關注其真品贋品問題，而關顧宋石承載的審美和道德價值。元人探索宋石的奇、漏、堅質、潤澤、予人世外隱循奇思等特質，藉此繼承宋代寓意於物、以小觀大的物觀，也領略宋人如何在失意中學習自我調適，找到在世變困頓中堅持氣節的力量。關注奇石的人文價值是元人賞石文化的核心，石與石硯是斯世斯文的中介，是人格典範的意義承載，其道德價值包括忠義、廉潔、氣節、文學行誼，由此強調家族傳承、口述歷史的作用，在於鄉國崇敬之心，以及對故國遺老盡矣而史事記錄不存的憂慮。

12603519.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12603519.value: 執行計劃的過程中，有兩個延伸部分可深入研究，一是元人藏當代石、石硯的書寫，這部分的收藏和題詠，較多反映元人對賞石文化的自身觀點，尤其常見於大都宮廷文人群體中；二是元人對當代水石文化的呈現，包括畫上奇石與竹、水、枯木的配搭，以及道中自然山巒中的水石描述，都反映元人對石的奇思與精神境界的探討。筆者會繼續研究這兩個元石部分，結合已完成的四篇宋石論文，最終發展成為一部談元代賞石文化及文學的專著。

12603519.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12603519.value: 元代宋石流轉有二重意思：一是對北宋賞玩觀點的傳承，二是實物的傳承。由此二重性質的石、硯收藏和書寫，看到元人除了關心物的外在物理性質，更重視該物承載的精神世界，其中，蘇軾的自適、困頓中堅持寫作兩點為元人所重。元代宋石書寫有淡然的世變易代之痛惜，更多的是真切反映當時真摯愜意的大都藝文生活和交流，它不同於後代明末清初談物的政治化趨向，而是回歸此物的本身以及個人的自適寄託，成為此一階段最為突出的文化現象。

12603619.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12603619.value: In this research we refer to translation as Wikipedia’s ‘dark matter’: we know it must be there but it is often difficult to locate. We use a number of approaches to track it down: identifying the rare cases where its presence is documented, comparing extracts from different parallel articles or digging back into the articles’ history to discover the origin of translated text fragments. The principle investigator has already applied these techniques to multilingual article sets about the assassination of Russian opposition leader Boris Nemtsov and the poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal and has found that some of the articles resemble collages assembled from small text fragments some of which have been imported from another article within the set – very likely via a reference to an external news source included in that article. We plan to perform a detailed investigation of two or three multilingual article sets chronicling major, rapidly-developing news stories relating to Russia and including significant pages in Chinese, Russian and English plus a relatively open-ended number of others. Identifying the translated material, establishing what it is a translation of and tracking the fate of each translated fragment once inserted in an article are time-consuming tasks requiring detailed, painstaking work but are also necessary stages in the research. Checking for accuracy is not what drives us; what is of interest, rather, is whether these fragments support an article’s point of view and whether the knowledge that each supposedly parallel article contains is therefore in some way distinctive, providing its readers with a somewhat different presentation and interpretation of events. These are important considerations, not least in the light of Wikipedia’s policy of pursuing a neutral point of view: based on the work already carried out by the principal investigator a link does appear to exist between translation and point of view construction, although we are hoping that the project will allow us to draw more wide-ranging conclusions about what that link is. To assist us we will use a number of existing digital tools and plan to develop additional ones. We believe this project will increase our understanding of the dynamics that govern the multilingual Wikipedia and will provide translation studies with valuable case studies on a special type of collaborative translation. The results, we hope, will also be of interest outside academia, and we will ensure that our findings, tools and datasets are made widely available. 本研究項目將翻譯喻為維基百科中的「暗物質」：雖知其必然存在，但卻難尋其蹤。因此，本研究將通過不同方法追尋維基百科中翻譯的蹤跡：發掘其存在的極少數紀錄，提取並對比平行文本中的相關信息，或是反溯源文本以探索譯文片段的出處。本項目負責人已將相關技巧應用於多語種維基語料的研究，主要涉及俄國反對黨領袖鲍里斯·涅姆佐夫暗殺事件以及前俄國探員謝爾蓋·斯克里帕爾和其女尤利婭·斯克里帕爾毒殺案件相關的系列文章。研究表明，部分文本的確涵蓋了源於本系列其他語料的信息片段，並且大多會以外延參考的形式出現在引用文本中。 本研究計劃深入調查分析2到3組由中、俄、英及其他相關語種維基條目組成的多語種文本語料。所選語料涉及與俄國相關並於短期廣為傳播的重大新聞主題，按照時間先後順序整理。確認譯文、原文信息以及追蹤各翻譯語段在文本中的發展轉變是一個耗時耗力的過程，儘管如此，這也是科研進程中不可或缺的一部分。本研究的目的並不在於探究相關翻譯準確與否，而是譯文片段在構建文本意圖中所起的作用，以及這些本應講述相同內容的平行文本是否傳遞了不同的信息，為讀者提供不同的認識角度與闡釋空間。這些都是至關重要的考量，不僅僅是因為維基百科的觀點中立條例，更重要的是因為項目負責人在前期調查中已確認翻譯活動對觀點塑造有切實影響。此項目旨在獲得對此類影響有更清晰的認識，得到更為有意義的結論。為此，需要藉助多種現有電子數據分析工具並研究開發新型工具。本項目將增進有關多語種維基百科的認識，並為翻譯研究中的合作翻譯提供有意義的實證案例。與此同時，項目研究人員希望相關研究成果影響可延伸至學界外相關產業，將盡可能確保項目成果、工具及數據的廣泛共享。

12603619.label: Realisation of objectives
12603619.value: 1. A detailed methodology has been developed in order to facilitate research into this topic. This consists of three parts: the theoretical underpinning of the research, the digital tools that have been developed and the practical approaches that have been assembled. In terms of the theoretical underpinning, there was an increasing realisation of the relevance of narrative theory. As a result, in view of the substantial overlap that exists between point of view (POV) and narrative and the lack of theoreticisation of the former concept, the decision was taken to utilise many of the elements of narrative in the study of the outworkings of this important Wikipedia concept. As a result of this shift in focus, less emphasis has been placed on knowledge production. As regards the digital tools that have been developed, these are described in detail under point 5 below. Taken together, it is believed that they are a significant addition to the set of tools previously available for research in this area, a contribution that was recognised by the awarding of a running-up prize in an HKBU PhD Student Research Excellence Award 2023/24 to Mr Zhilu Tu for his development of WikiAligner (see Part C, Section 11). 2. This aspect of the proposal has resulted in the production of a total of twelve article alignment sets derived from the output of the WikiAligner tool, which have been made publicly available (see Part C, Section 11). In these, a different approach has been adopted from previously. In the PI’s original case study, a complete article set consisting of a total of nine language versions was investigated. Given the numbers involved, this approach was not sustainable, and indeed came to be considered unnecessary as it was concluded that the most relevant data was most likely to be found in the language editions local to or in some way engaged in the news story under investigation. Consequently, for the most part the alignments carried out using WikiAligner (see point 5 below) have tended to focus on Ukrainian and Russian, with English also included as the dominant language in the encyclopaedia and the edition from which most translated material is imported, and also Chinese as a language local to Hong Kong and one in which a distinctive POV is frequently reflected. Consequently, a relatively larger number of less linguistically extensive case studies have been undertaken. These datasets have brought to light a large amount of interesting data. The presence of translation has been found to be widespread, and the examples that have been examined in detail have brought to light significant insights into the contribution of translation to the development of POV within the articles studied, and also into the nature of interlingual collaboration in Wikipedia. It is anticipated that the datasets will continue to be added to, as part of the PI’s ongoing research in this area. 3. The question of shifting emphasis towards the question of narrative in Wikipedia has been addressed under Objective 1 above. Although not new in itself, the use of narrative theory forms a useful tie-in with the concept of POV, which does not appear to have been attempted before. Besides this, the project has touched briefly on three additional areas: a) the English edition of Wikipedia as allegedly relatively free from bias, b) translation flows and c) paratexts, although as suggested in Section 6.2, detailed analysis of these has not yet been possible. Most significantly, however, in the course of the project conference that was hosted by HKBU in December 2021 (see Part C, Section 11), the 22 papers, presentations and workshops touched on topics ranging from minority Wikipedias, political activism and Wikipedia translation for humanitarian or accessibility purposes, via public narratives reflected in Wikipedia and ethical issues, to translatathons and the use of Wikipedia in the translation classroom (for example), this diversity also being reflected to some extent in the papers being included in the Routledge volume. 4. This is reported on in detail in Section 6.1 and can be summarised as follows. Firstly, a detailed methodological toolkit has been assembled, using a framework that is based largely on narrative theory. This has enabled the researchers to conclude that translation does not generally import information into an article neutrally but typically implies a POV that is supportive of that prevailing within the target language article. Secondly, it has emerged that apparently single acts of translation are frequently composed of multiple edits by several editors working semi-independently but with a common purpose in a configuration that we have termed ‘passive collaborativity’. Thirdly, the WikiAligner digital tool that was developed as part of the project is very helpful in pinpointing the location and extent of any translated material that an article may contain. 5. The long-term impact section of the proposal made a number of suggestions of the type of digital research tool that it would be useful to create. A total of three were created and have all been made available to the research community on Github as follows: WikiAligner: https://github.com/LukeTu/WikiAligner WikiTime: https://github.com/LukeTu/Wikitime MultiWikiBlame: https://github.com/LukeTu/MultiWikiBlame Of these, we consider WikiAligner to be of particular significance. This tool forms the subject of two outputs and three conference presentations and is now available in both back-end and front-end versions. The use of WikiAligner leads to significant time-savings for researchers, as by proposing candidate alignments of sentences from pairs of articles from different Wikipedia editions it permits the easy identification of translation pairs. In short, it is the perfect tool for investigating the presence of translated material in Wikipedia – the ‘dark matter’ of the project’s title. We believe that its continued development, use and deployment could form the subject of further funded research. WikiTime is a visualisation tool that reveals the intensity of the editing work on a Wikipedia article over time. MultiWikiBlame can be used to find the first (or last) mention of key words or phrases in the revision histories of bilingual pairs of Wikipedia articles. 6. As stated in the proposal and as described in greater detail in Section 11 of Part C, an account on Zenodo.org, a standard repository for sharing research data, has been set up and a dataset composed of twelve sets of sentence alignments derived from the output of the project tool WikiAligner have been uploaded there (https://zenodo.org/records/10406413). These are all synchronic in nature, reflecting the fact that most of the research focused on that mode. 7. Finally, as also stated in the proposal and detailed in Section 11 of Part C, a WordPress blog titled ‘Wikipedia’s dark matter’ (https://wikipediasdarkmatter.wordpress.com/) has been populated with posts that present both major and more peripheral project findings. Since it was set up it has been accessed by users in nine countries and regions. We do not plan to stop developing the blog following the submission of this report, but rather intend to add at least a limited number of additional posts on an ongoing basis.

12603619.label: Major findings and research outcome
12603619.value: The research contributes to the following three major translation studies themes. 1. It is believed that the project has built on the significant advances translation studies has made in narrative theory. This provides a useful framework for researching POV in Wikipedia because of the strong commonalities existing between social narrative and POV. The project has also clearly indicated the potential for the study of POV to contribute to narrative theory. This is both conceptually justified and convenient as there is little sustained theoretical discussion of POV in any discipline. Bakhtin’s concept of polyphony has been introduced to conceptualise the co-existence of more than one narrative within a single text. The project has developed a wide-ranging, versatile methodology that provides a foundation for nuanced, multi-faceted analysis, both synchronic and diachronic and in both translated and non-translated contexts. In spite of Wikipedia’s well-known Neutral Point of View (NPOV) Policy, the research indicates that the role played by translation is not just one of neutral importation but can be used to frame events in a specific way. In passing it has also become clear that the English Wikipedia does not represent a neutral source of unbiased information (Translation Spaces article). 2. Multiple editors, both bilingual and monolingual, work in a collaborative, participatory manner, cooperatively mediating the import of external material. Existing mechanisms for active, explicit collaboration (such as the Talk pages) seem to be used relatively rarely in instances of translation, the notion of passive, implicit collaborativity better reflecting the way in which self-motivated editors can work together semi-independently to produce finalised wordings. The result is generally wordings supporting a preferred POV, although the polyphonic nature of some Wikipedia article allows different editors’ individual POVs to be at least temporarily accommodated (First Monday article). 3. Issues surrounding translator visibility, voice and positionality have been investigated in the course of the project. The very notion of translation as Wikipedia’s ‘dark matter’ – something that we know is there but are not certain where it is located, how much of it exists or what purpose it is serving – speaks eloquently of the general lack of visibility for translator-editors. That said, the available tools have now been supplemented by our newly-created ones (described in Section 5.3, Objective 5). WikiAligner in particular offers a reliable way of detecting translated material (two chapters in the Routledge volume).

12603619.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12603619.value: The main area for possible further work would be tool development. In particular, WikiAligner is considered to be of special significance, and we intend to continue with its development and deployment. Furthermore, if funding is available, further tools, for which we have a number of ideas, would be likely to prove of value to many researchers working in this area. Among new possible directions, it would now be interested to investigate how POV differs from narrative. On a related note, the concept of polyphony that was proposed within the methodological framework is likely to play an important part in the research’s conceptual landscape moving forward. In addition, the project has at least touched on a number of further topics, three of which are deserving of further attention. Firstly, the notion that the English Wikipedia represents a kind of gold standard in terms of its adherence to the NPOV Policy should be subjected to further scrutiny. Secondly, a more detailed study of translation flows within the multilingual encyclopaedia should be undertaken. Finally, the paratextual aspects of Wikipedia articles, along with their handling by editors when translating, is deserving of further attention.

12603619.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12603619.value: This research has investigated the idea of translation as Wikipedia’s ‘dark matter’, something that we know exists but cannot easily locate. We have used several approaches to uncover translated text material in Wikipedia articles and have analysed multilingual article sets about major Russia-related news stories in Chinese, Russian, English and other languages. Checking translation accuracy has not been the goal; rather, we have examined how translated material impacts an article’s POV. In spite of the encyclopaedia’s well-known NPOV Policy, our research indicates that the role played by translation is not just one of neutral importation but can rather be used to frame events in the manner intended by the translator. It has also elucidated the nature of some of the collaborative mechanisms that are employed, consciously or unconsciously, in achieving this. We have utilised existing digital tools and have developed new ones to assist in the analysis. Our findings, tools and datasets have been and will continue to be widely disseminated, including beyond academia. Importantly, this research raises awareness of the complex provenance of some of the information and knowledge on which we all rely.

12606319.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12606319.value: 文物保育和創造新城市價值：香港三個歷史遺址的比較

12606319.label: Project Objectives
12606319.value: To contribute to knowledge about how and why heritage buildings in Hong Kong are increasingly being transformed into spaces of consumption that both create tension with and complement their other uses. To develop an alternative perspective on gentrification and redevelopment through considering heritage conservation as a set of processes that generate new cultural and economic values in the urban setting. To inform policy on using culture and creativity as the basis for the revitalization of heritage buildings by documenting and interpreting the evolving strategies and approaches in this area on the part of policymakers, cultural workers, and NGOs. To identify how the histories of Hong Kong’s colonial institutions are being reinterpreted in the present as heritage and inform conservation approaches.

To develop an alternative perspective on gentrification and redevelopment through considering heritage conservation as a set of processes that generate new cultural and economic values in the urban setting.

12606319.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12606319.value: Heritage conservation has gained increasing political, cultural and economic importance in urban redevelopment processes in Asian cities in recent years. Built heritage, including buildings and landscapes from the past that are recognized and revalorized with new uses and meanings in the present, has provoked extensive scrutiny and debate. In Hong Kong, community-based aspirations for greater protection of historic places, coinciding with growing interest in heritage on the part of the state and private sector actors, has led to several large-scale conservation projects in centrally-located areas with high land value. While research has examined heritage governance and management in Hong Kong, and attempted to explain and contextualize the ascendance of heritage, as yet there have been no in-depth studies of the ongoing impacts of heritage revitalization schemes. A comparison of projects completed over the last decade can reveal how the material outcomes of evolving conservation approaches reflect the shifting priorities of stakeholders in relation to broader urban processes. This project takes up such a comparison of three sites with historical uses related policing and law and order: the former Hollywood Road Police Married Quarters (PMQ), the former Central Police Station compound (Tai Kwun), and the former Marine Police Headquarters (Heritage 1881). The research will develop a new approach for conceptualizing how heritage conservation in urban Hong Kong produces contradictory and complementary economic and cultural values. Conservation schemes have involved the introduction of creative industries uses, such as studios and galleries, as well as spaces of consumption, such as boutiques and restaurants. But they are also spaces in which collective memory and community are articulated and affirmed. Comparing and contextualizing the material expressions of, and visitor engagements with, the values of heritage will develop new insights on the role of culture in urban change, and will enrich ongoing debate about gentrification and redevelopment and heritage as a public good. The project adopts a mixed qualitative methodology. Historical research will contextualize the study sites by investigating evolving place-based relationships between local residents, businesses, neighbourhood institutions and the colonial administration and HKSAR government. Participant observation, semi-structured interviews with stakeholders and visitors, and analysis of online social media will reveal the present-day characteristics of the sites, including a comparison of i) how historic architecture and spaces are valorized as heritage; ii) new uses introduced at the study sites; and iii) visitor experiences, including as expressed in images and content shared through online social media platforms. 近年，在亞洲都市的市區重建過程中，文物保育的政治、文化和經濟重要性日益提升。包括目前以全新用途和意義來識別及重新穩定其價值的舊建築物和地景在內，歷史建築引起了廣泛的注視和辯論。在香港，正值公私營部門的行動者對文物提高興趣，追求加強保護歷史遺址的社區願望，促成了數項在土地價值較高的中心地區的大規模保育項目。雖然已有研究探討過香港的文物治理和管理，亦嘗試過解釋並脈絡化文物地位的提升，唯仍缺乏研究去深入分析文物活化計劃的持續影響。比較在過去十年完成的項目，可以揭示不斷演化的保育方式的物質成果如何反映持份者在更廣泛的城市過程中不斷調整其優先考慮。本項目比較三個昔日用於警政、法律和秩序方面的歷史遺址：前荷李活道已婚警察宿舍（PMQ）、前中區警署建築群（大館）和前水警總部（Heritage 1881）。本研究將發展新方法來概念化香港都市的文物保育怎樣生產既矛盾又互補的經濟和文化價值。保育計劃引入如工作室和藝廊等創意產業用途，又有如精品店和餐廳等消費空間。但這些亦是表達和肯定集體回憶與社區的空間。比較和脈絡化文物價值的物質表現，以及訪客對重整文物價值的參與，將會對文化在都市轉變中的角色建立新見解，也將豐富關於仕紳化和重建，以及文物作為公共物品的持續辯論。本項目採用混合質性方法論。歷史研究將透過調查在該區居民、商業、社區機構、殖民政府和特區政府之間不斷變化的地方關係，來脈絡化研究地點。參與式觀察、與持份者和訪客進行半結構式訪談，以及分析網上社交媒體將揭示這些歷史遺址的當前特徵，包括比較（一）怎樣重整歷史建築和空間的價值為文物；（二）引入該等遺址的全新用途；及（三）遊覽經驗，包括以照片來表達的經驗和在網上社交媒體平台分享的內容。

12606419.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12606419.value: 前汽车時代的紐約市交通发展史

12606419.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12606419.value: Today, the word “traffic” calls to mind honking cars and blinking stoplights, but the question of how to control movement through the city has a much longer history than these images suggest. This project examines cultural representations and political regulations of traffic in New York City between the advent of the grid plan in 1811 and the common council’s enactment of pioneering traffic statutes in 1897. In the eight-plus decades separating these events, New York cemented its status as the American capital of commerce and culture, a role that drew ever-greater numbers of people and goods to the oblong island of Manhattan. As New York’s merchants, bankers, and industrialists embedded themselves within transnational networks of credit and exchange, they began to conceive of movement through the city’s streets in terms of the circuitry of global capitalism. For most New Yorkers, though, traffic was more than a matter of dollars and cents. Rapid growth strained the city’s street capacity and raised pressing questions about how to manage the movement of a diverse array of vehicles, people, and animals within urban space. The answers to those questions had major implications for understandings of identity, citizenship, and community. Walt Whitman wrote poetry about New York’s traffic; civil rights activists launched lawsuits over it. Yet scholars have not given nineteenth-century traffic the attention it deserves. Most historians trace the origins of traffic management to the Progressive Era in the early twentieth century. In doing so, they align regulation of movement with the professionalization of planning in a process that culminated with the arrival of the automobile, which forcibly recast the street as a site of transit. Urban traffic was a matter of political concern long before the automobile, however. Manhattan faced traffic problems more intensely than other American cities, and communities elsewhere often adopted transportation innovations first implemented in New York. This project draws on recent scholarship in mobility studies to ask questions about how people moved and to unpack the meanings they attached to that movement. It gets at these questions through both a narrative history of traffic regulation and episodic case studies that examine confrontations over transit. This approach, by shedding new light on life in the nineteenth-century city, also reveals continuities with the present day. Questions about who can move in the city—and how, and where, and when—remain critical to the construction of citizenship in the twenty-first century. 擁堵繁忙的都市交通總讓人聯想起刺耳的汽車鳴笛聲及閃爍的紅綠燈，但一座城市的交通規劃與發展往往涉及更多的層面。 1811年，紐約市初步完成道路規劃，至1897年則正式確立一系列相關的交通法令。這期間的紐約也逐漸發展為美國最重要的文化與經濟中心，往來的人口與物流建構出一幅車水馬龍的景觀。商人、銀行家、企業家紛紛聚集在這座四通八達的城市，除了定居於此並展開貿易活動，他們開始意識到都市空間及交通管制的重要性。隨著人口迅速增長，一座城市的發展及規劃也涉及身份認同、公民權益和社區需求等課題。 沃爾特.惠特曼(Walt Whitman)曾以詩歌的形式描述了紐約市的交通情況。民運份子則藉助法律途徑，希望能為民眾爭取紐約公路的使用權。歷史學家大多認為都市交通的管制及發展可追溯至美國20世紀初的進步時代（Progressive Era），並將交通管理的規範化與日後汽車普及化的現象相結合。然而，在汽車未普及之前，19世紀紐約市早已出現擁堵的交通情況，甚至比其他繁忙的城市更嚴重。故此，當時紐約市實施的各項交通管制馬上成了其他城市可以參照的方案。 本文借鑒目前學界有關社會流動的各類研究，首先探討19世紀的不同交通工具如何塑造人們對於“流動性”這一概念的理解。文章也會敘述19世紀的交通管制條例並通過個案呈現都市人口流動所引發的衝突事件。筆者認為通過了解19世紀的交通规划及其演變的過程，將有助於我們回應21世紀的社會如何通过都市生活建构人们對於公民權益的意识。

12607419.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12607419.value: 冷戰時期的創作寫作教學：愛荷華大學國際寫作計劃與香港詩人

12607419.label: Project Objectives
12607419.value: To characterize how the first Hong Kong poets, Dai Tian (1967-1968), Wan Kin-lau (1968-1970), and Gu Cangwu (1970-1971), who attended the University of Iowa’s International Writing Program both absorbed and resisted American Cold War ideology and poetics; To chart the history of Chinese creative writing pedagogy in Hong Kong that accounts for the role of IWP in the formation of Hong Kong’s first poetry writing workshop in the late 1960s; To reassess the broader ideological, literary, and pedagogical implications of Iowa’s role in the reification of world literature, especially in the context of East Asia during the Cold War.

12607419.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12607419.value: 本計劃通過研究首批於20世紀60年代末和70年代初參加愛荷華國際寫作計劃（IWP）的香港作家戴天、溫健騮及古蒼梧，探討冷戰期間愛荷華大學與香港詩歌受到忽視的關係。通過對文學文本的細讀，以及對關鍵歷史文獻及檔案（如資助提案、IWP主任與美國慈善資助機構之間的通信）的研究，本計劃主要關注IWP的冷戰詩學、教育學如何與這些作家在文學觀念上的變化形成互動，其中包括在英國殖民主義與中國文化認同的背景下，他們漸漸加強的政治意識。本計劃首次使用未為研究者注意的一手歷史資料，例如聶華玲與香港作家的通信以及溫健騮在愛荷華州的MFA論文，並前所未有地劃揭示出，愛荷華的創意寫作教學法如何受到英譯中國古典詩歌的影響，又如何由香港詩人革新，以及追溯香港詩歌創作教育史與早期IWP的關係。這些作家一方面接受了愛荷華的教育方法和詩學，特別是愛荷華所強調的個人主義，一方面卻非常了解愛荷華的冷戰角色，甚至積極抵制美國的外交政策。本計劃以香港詩歌為案例，探討愛荷華大學在冷戰期間對東亞作家的支持所形成的廣泛影響，以及它在世界文學作為跨文化循環系統裡的東亞詩歌形塑，扮演了什麼角色。本計劃的果將包括至少三篇期刊文章，每篇文章將探討愛荷華與香港詩人關係的獨一個特面向，並沿此形成一個理論框架，以探究愛荷華大學在香港文學，以及更廣泛的東亞文學中扮演的角色，從而理解愛荷華在國際創意寫作課程和今天的「世界文學」話語中繼續佔據的主導地位。鑑於近年各地（包括中國大陸在內）的MFA課程激增，理解創意寫作作為一個全球化學科的起源尤為迫切。

12607719.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12607719.value: 為廿一世紀提出的一個康德式系統神學

12607719.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12607719.value: Kant’s theory of religion has been among the fastest growing focal areas within the field of Kant scholarship over the past 25 years; publications by the PI have contributed significantly to this discussion. Previously, interpreters typically read Kant as rejecting organized religion and undermining belief in God. Prompted by the PI’s “affirmative” interpretation, increasing numbers of scholars now consult Kant’s texts for insights into specific religious and theological issues. However, nobody has yet explained systematically how Kant’s theology and theory of religion applies to the pragmatic concerns and doctrinal beliefs of real twenty-first century religious believers. This project will fill that gap by producing the first monograph presenting a systematic theology that remains thoroughly Christian--though not necessarily exclusively Christian--while consistently applying insights from Kant’s philosophy of religion. After an introduction that places Kant into his historical/theological context, the book's four parts will examine basic questions and themes relating to: (I) the nature and existence of God; (II) human nature and Christian anthropology’s understanding of it; (III) the central Christian doctrines; and (IV) the most essential points regarding what it means for a person to serve God. Each part’s chapters will include discussion of areas typically covered by systematic theology in the Christian tradition, including: in Part I, the meaning of “God”, the features of God’s nature, the Trinitarian status of God’s relation to humanity, and the possibility and nature of revelation and miracles; in Part II, hamartiology (sin), soteriology (salvation, including forgiveness, grace, and hope), and Christology (including the hypostatic union, and the status of the incarnation and resurrection); in Part III, ecclesiology (the nature and function of a church), bibliology (the role of Scripture), and eschatology (the history of God’s kingdom manifested on earth, and beyond); and in Part IV, the sacraments, the proper function of ritual, and the status of conscience as authentic religion’s core content. Unlike the PI’s previous publications that carefully exegete Kant’s theology and theory of religion, this book will focus on constructing a new systematic Christian theology that unpacks in detail what the Kantian revolution in religion entails for contemporary Christians who take up Kant's challenge. Interpreting traditional doctrines more philosophically need not require twenty-first century Christians to abandon their most cherished convictions, so much as to eschew polarizing perspectives by attuning their theological convictions to the moral dimensions of faith, thus also encouraging non-religious philosophers to be more open to (this Kantian-style) Christianity. 在過去的二十五年裡，康德的宗教理論一直是康德研究中發展最快的焦點之一。PI的出版物在相關討論中作出了重要的貢獻。此前，學者通常認為康德拒絕有組織的宗教並破壞對上帝的信仰。在PI對「肯定」詮釋的推動下，現正有越來越多的學者諮詢康德的文本，以深入了解具體的宗教和神學問題。然而直至目前為止，還沒有人能夠系統地解釋康德的神學和宗教理論如何適用於二十一世紀宗教信徒的實用事務和教義信仰。這個項目將填補這一空白，製作第一部專著，提出一個基督教的（但不一定只是基督教的）系統神學，並同時一貫地應用康德宗教哲學的見解。 在將康德置於其歷史及神學背景中的介紹之後，本書的四個部分將研究以下的基本問題和主題：（一）上帝的本質和存在；（二）人性和基督教人類學對它的理解；（三）主要基督教教義; （四）人侍奉上帝的最基本要點。每個部分的章節將包含一般基督教系統神學涵蓋的領域，包括：第一部分，「上帝」的意義，上帝本性的特質，上帝與人類關係的三位一體特性，以及啟示和奇蹟的可能性及本質；第二部分，罪論（罪）、救贖論（包括寬恕、恩典和希望）、和基督論（包括位格合一，以及道成肉身和復活的地位）；在第三部分，教會學（教會的性質和功能），聖經學（聖經的作用）和末世論（上帝的王國在世間中的歷史表現，以至其他）；第四部分，聖禮及儀式的正確功能，以及良心作為真實宗教的核心內容。 與PI先前仔細解釋康德神學和宗教理論的出版物不同，本書將側重於構建一個新的系統性基督教神學，詳細解讀康德的宗教革命對接受康德挑戰的當代基督徒所帶來的影響。在更哲學地解釋傳統學說的同時，二十一世紀的基督徒不需要放棄他們最珍視的信念，而是通過將他們的神學信念與信仰的道德維度相結合來避開兩極分化的觀點，從而也鼓勵無宗教信仰的哲學家更容易接受（這種康德風格的）基督教信仰。

12608219.label: Realisation of objectives
12608219.value: 1. 從儒家教育的角度考察朝鮮鄉校和書院對儒家經典傳播所起的作用 朝鮮鄉校和書院的資料，現存不多，不易尋獲。筆者通過朝鮮時代的地方邑志、個人文集等材料，整理出朝鮮鄉校學令和書院院規，發現二者對儒家經典在朝鮮半島的傳播起了舉足輕重作用。朝鮮王朝規定每縣設一所鄉校，採用儒家文獻為鄉校教育課本，促使儒家知識在地方上廣泛傳播。舉例來說，嶺南安東府鄉校規定鄉生「常讀《小學》、《儀禮》、《四書》、《五經》、《性理大全》及諸史等書，不挾莊、老、佛經、雜類、百家子集等書。又常習《童蒙須知》」。除《四書》、《五經》外，諸生須誦讀朱子性理學著述，包括《小學》、《童蒙須知》、《家禮》、《近思錄》、《性理大全》，而不能誦讀儒家以外的典籍，否則重罰。 至於書院的影響力，並不下於鄉校。嶺南書院的數量是朝鮮八道之冠，而儒家經典知識是當地書院主要教授內容。例如，李滉(1501-1570)是朝鮮儒學宗師，他在《伊山院規》中提出「諸生讀書，以《四書》、《五經》爲本原；《小學》、《家禮》爲門戶。 」由於東傳儒家典籍種類和數量繁多，故朝鮮學者通過學令及院規為儒家教育確立規範。以上李滉給院生制定治學規範，指出《四書》、《五經》是儒家經典的根源；《小學》、《家禮》是初學者的門徑。他認為士人學習儒家經典，須有治學門徑，建立進學階梯，釐正儒家立學的根本，端本正源。 2. 通過嶺南文化的歷史背景探討嶺南家訓大量湧現的原因 朝鮮王朝把全國分為八道行政區，分別是平安道、咸鏡道、黃海道、京畿道、江原道、忠清道、慶尚道和全羅道。慶尚道稱為「嶺南」，比較來說，該地家訓數最多。地理空間是文化傳播的必然元素，環境越是理想，文化播遷能力越大，被影響的幅員越廣，而受薰陶的人數也越多。筆者發現，朝鮮王朝立國初期已建立陣容廳大的儒家集團，當中不少是來自嶺南的士人。例如安東權近(1352-1409)最具代表性，其著述《五經淺見錄》，考訂《禮記》，至於精微。此為家訓在嶺南大量湧現提供理想的環境因素。同時，在統一新羅時代，嶺南慶州府是國都選址，之後亦成為高麗王朝的東京所在。當地久經華夏典章浸淫，禮樂文物齊備，蘊藏豐厚的儒家文化資源。例如，新羅神文王2年(682)，慶州府設「立國學，置卿一人以掌之」；景德王6年(747)，國學置「諸業博士，助教」，教授儒家經典。深厚的儒家文化積累，奠定慶州府及其周邊地區的文化基礎，鼓動嶺南士人展開及參與儒家文化活動，這是嶺南家訓湧現的主要原因。 3. 從文化身份的角度闡釋在「新華夷」價值觀下嶺南家訓的形成 筆者分析出，文化身份的認同，與文化傳播空間的形成，關係密切。朝鮮知識份子深信自箕子東來傳教，頒授八條以後，朝鮮半島已達到華夏文教水平，屬於「禮義之邦」，朝鮮民族也因此有著華夏身份。他們為了引證自身民族在華夏文教上的優良傳統，於是在國家版圖上尋找適合的文化區域，充當國內儒家文化的起源地。朝鮮時代的嶺南被視為「東國鄒魯」，當地的文化屬性亦因此開始形成。基於華夏身份的自我約定，促使儒家文化在朝鮮社會裡廣泛傳播，特別在嶺南士人的心目中，對儒家文化的承襲使用，便成為了他們帶有普及性的自覺行為。在這種文化意識的帶動下，嶺南家族群體通過撰寫家訓，彰顯自身、家族以及國家民族所抱持的儒家價值觀，藉此體現在文化身份上的華夏特質。 4. 從文體學的角度分析嶺南家訓的書寫文體及其功能 經筆者分析，韓國學者徐守鏞編輯的《嶺南의家訓》296篇，常用文體有「銘」、「戒」、「箴」，另有包括含有勸勉訓戒的家書、詩歌和雜文： (1) 銘(5篇)指是鑄刻在器物、石碑或木板上的格言，主要用來警戒自己或讚頌別人生平的文字。如金士元(1539-1601)〈晚翠堂左右銘〉。 (2) 戒(11篇)有勸戒、禁止的意思。在嶺南家訓中常稱「遺戒」、「遺訓」、「遺命」，它主要是長輩在臨終前提示家人需要遵循的言行規範，也有囑咐親人辦理其身後事的方式。如金係行(1431-1517)〈疾革遺戒〉、金烋(1597-1638) 遺戒五事〉、權得錘(1788-1860)〈諸孫遺誡〉。 (3) 箴(11篇)有規戒和勸諫的意思，含有針對性的議題。如金光粹(1468-1563) 〈警心箴〉、李彥迪(1491-1553) 〈自新箴〉、權好文(1532-1587) 〈家箴〉。 (4) 家書(116篇)屬於親人私辭，信中常帶有呵護關愛之辭。如權柱(1457-1505) 〈與子書〉、金宗直(1431-1493)〈答緻書〉、柳成龍(1542-1607)〈寄子袗〉。 (5) 詩歌(35首)除了柳成龍〈書許魯齋詩〉、〈示子弟〉兩首採用古體外，其他皆以近體寫成。如權紀(1546-1624) 〈勸孫兒等讀書〉、金圻(1547-1603) 〈勉學詩〉、金是柱(1575-1617) 〈臨歿訓戒詩〉。詩歌語言精練，富節奏感，擅感情表達，用作家訓，親情意摯，骨肉關懷，躍然紙上。 (6) 雜文(118)主要由散文體撰寫，此類篇幅較長，選材豐富，也常用序、箋、疏等文體寫成，其中比較特別是「條目」的書寫形式。「條目」採用分條立訓的方式，列舉細目，每條含有獨立題材，互相聯繫，服務同一主題。如李滉〈修身家訓〉、徐聖耇(1663-1735)〈家誡十二條〉等。 5. 從詮釋學的角度考察嶺南家訓的教化性質及應用方式 筆者發現，現存的嶺南家訓遺下深刻的儒家知識改造痕跡，反映在材料的篩選和應用上，對中國經史知識兼容並蓄，以達到教化的功能。例如，權好文(1532-1587)〈家箴〉是嶺南安東權氏家訓，寫成於1584年4月。此篇包括「夫婦之道」、「父子之道」、「兄弟之道」、「使奴婢」、「奉祭祀」、「睦族鄰」等六方面，說明在「修、齊、治、平」上，五倫教化的重要性。〈家箴〉的應用方式先進行字詞解釋，次為引經據典，揭示思想內涵，然後徵引歷史故事，提供佐證。歸納來說，依據嶺南家訓的教化性質和應用，儒家經典知識徹底滲入朝鮮鄉土社會，使家人和族人受到儒家教化薰陶，其中在倫理、修身、為學和生活起居上，最具影響力。 6. 從文本比較的角度探討嶺南家訓與朱熹《小學》異同 隨着高麗晚期朱子學傳入，《小學》備受歷代朝鮮國君尊崇，也在朝鮮士人階層中普及流行，地位與「四書五經」等同。因此，朝鮮嶺南士人擷取《小學》的理念和材料撰寫家訓，相當常見。然而，筆者必須指出，最年寫成的嶺南家訓，內容與《小學》相近，但到了朝鮮晚年，嶺南家訓趨向成熟，在形式及內容上創造出朝鮮本土的的色，例如家訓組詩的出現。許薰(1836-1907)〈訓蒙二十五則〉由25首詩組成。各詩句式相同，除了篇末〈禁南草〉是五律詩外，其餘24首都是五絕詩。每首詩都有明確題旨，內容獨立完整，但又聯繫著訓戒童蒙的主題。舉例來說，〈作字〉教授小童執筆寫字技巧；〈正心〉訓戒個人常要保持莊嚴容止儀態；〈推仁〉倡導愛惜生命，儘管昆蟲草木，一一在乎。以上三首詩雖題旨不同，但又有著同一主題的連貫性：人們能操存本心，文字才寫得端正，與儀表外貌，表裡一致，據此推衍仁愛，踐履萬物生生之道。 7. 從系譜學的角度探討嶺南家族群體與嶺南家訓形成的關係 家族是以血統聯繫而形成的親屬群體，具有很強的凝聚力，族人聚居一地，世代相傳，源遠流長。特別是一些儒學世家，他們紮根鄉土，學問世代相傳，對嶺南家訓的形成有著深遠影響。筆者以嶺南「安東權氏」為例，分析出他們先祖在高麗高宗時在嶺南安東縣落地生根，之後經歷高麗、朝鮮兩朝，已越千載。在家族系譜上，安東權氏始由高麗權守平、權旦、權薄、權準、權廉、權適，後來發展至朝鮮時代的權近、權遇，各人皆科場登第，精通儒家經典。 筆者的結論：儒學世家對嶺南家訓的形成起了關鍵作用。地方族群裡的家訓，最初只是家族成員的個人著述，發展到後來，逐步成為家族成員的群體寫作活動。由於安東權氏是嶺南的世家大族，故在這儒學世家裡便產生豐富的家訓文章。例如，權柱(1457-1505)〈與子書〉、權好文(1532-1587) 〈家箴〉、權紀(1546-1624) 〈孫兒讀書檜谷〉、權益昌(1562-1645) 〈進德箴〉、權泰時(1635-1719) 〈示子致文〉、權斗寅(1643-1719) 〈宗家新創記〉、權斗經(1654-1725) 〈寄子謩〉、權榘(1672-1749) 〈寄子晉〉、權舜經(1676-1744) 〈無窩十誡〉、權相一(1679-1759)〈家範〉、權萬(1688-1749) 〈寄子正容〉、權得錘(1788-1860) 〈諸孫遺誡〉、權翰成(1811-1879) 〈示兒輩說〉、權璉夏(1813-1896) 〈書耆耇兩孫書室〉等。這些家訓不是一時之作，它們大約在15世紀至19世紀之間寫成，具有時間的延續性。

12608219.label: Major findings and research outcome
12608219.value: 1. 發現〈朱子十訓〉是最早出現的嶺南家訓，它的出現與《小學》傳播及嶺南士人關係密切，是嶺南家訓的濫觴。參見〈嶺南家訓的濫觴 ─ 朝鮮〈朱子十訓〉的由來與傳播〉 2. 考察出高麗晚年自科舉出身儒臣集團的形成，以及其奠立「儒學治國」的基礎，對儒家教育在朝鮮半島的廣泛傳播起了關鍵作用。參見〈高麗晚年儒臣集團的形成 ─ 朝鮮王朝儒學政治的濫觴〉 3. 闡釋出嶺南享有「東國鄒魯」文教地位的原因。參見〈朝鮮時代嶺南家訓研究芻議〉 4. 勾勒出嶺南士人重新建構儒家經典知識，創造屬於朝鮮本土的家訓文獻，呈現民族的主體性。參見〈朝鮮時代嶺南家訓研究芻議〉 5. 分析出嶺南士人尊崇《小學》，因而對嶺南家訓的寫成帶來了深遠影響。 參見〈館學•鄉學•家學 ─ 朝鮮嶺南家訓中科舉與修身的關係〉 6. 揭示嶺南士人以《小學》為基礎，締造儒家教育的治學規範，及創造閱讀儒家經典的新方法，實踐了朝鮮儒學本土化的進程。參見〈科業與修身 ─《小學》東傳與朝鮮知識份子的自我形塑〉

12608219.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12608219.value: 本計劃主要採用徐守鏞編的《嶺南의家訓》為研究材料，然則記載在單行本和叢書文集中的家訓著述，以及嶺南以外的朝鮮家訓須進一步研究，俾能揭示朝鮮時代家訓全貌。同時，嶺南家訓的文體形式有獨立研究價值，例如家訓組詩和雜文「日課」等，都能反映有別於中國家訓文體的創新一面。由於嶺南家訓有使用其他物質形式展現，如碑文拓本，也有懸板寫本或簡札本，這些材料需要到嶺南遺址進行實物考察。在漢字文化圈下，中、日、韓都創造出屬於自己國家的家訓，箇中異同，長遠來說，值得作深入探究。

12608219.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12608219.value: 古韓國朝鮮王朝嶺南家訓的大量湧現，與朝鮮君臣以「儒學治國」，朝鮮士人視嶺南為「鄒魯之鄉」，以及嶺南儒學世家的大力推動，關係密切。筆者考察出〈朱子十訓〉是最早出現的嶺南家訓，後來嶺南士人採用箴、戒、銘、家書、詩歌、雜文等文體撰寫家訓，重構儒家經典知識。雖然，儒家文化對嶺南家訓帶來深遠影響，特別是朱熹《小學》，然而，嶺南家訓也帶有韓國本土的特色，這不但成為士人自我形塑的準繩，也反映朝鮮民族主體的內涵。

12608719.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12608719.value: 「墮落」：太空垃圾的雕塑與影像呈現——一種人類對太空的分類法

12608719.label: Project Objectives
12608719.value: To create a new human-centred taxonomy of space debris by building and forming an extensive archive of objects dropped during space flights. To reconstruct this archive in multi-dimensional formats (of photography, sculpture and film). To examine and analyse these objects through reconstructing and filming them. To communicate and disseminate this archive through a Web-based platform that will allow users to view the debris through films, and to recreate the objects through 3D print technology. To contextualise space debris objects in the life stories and personal experiences of the people using them in space.

12608719.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12608719.value: After sixty years of space flight, space debris is an increasing hazard to space travel and satellite systems. The Kessler Syndrome, a runaway chain reaction of collisions, could exponentially increase the amount of debris, affect polar-orbiting bands and destroy satellites, rendering earth orbit impassable. Space environmentalism is a growing movement and concerns are increasing over the future pollution of the moon and other celestial bodies. Existing taxonomies of space debris have focused on the sizes, shapes and orbits of these objects. More recently, researchers have focused on the measurement, mitigation and potential removal of space debris. The proposed project, entitled ‘Dropped’, will seek to apply visual and artistic research methods and outcomes (photography, sculpture and film) to open up the world of space debris for new audiences in meaningful ways. The project will explore the problem of space debris by focusing on the human dimension, and on the stories of objects that have been accidentally dropped or deliberately placed in space by the 533 individuals who have travelled there. This project explores and extends a unique archive I have created of objects that were accidentally dropped during space flight. Through 'Action Research' methods (allowing the research and practice to coexist and co-work simultaneously) and created outputs (in 2D, 3D and 4D) each dropped object will be recreated through photography, sculpture and film for further study or research, thereby enabling the growing problem of space debris to be brought to the public’s attention in new and engaging ways. Through analysis of initial research undertaken at Kingston University since May 2015, and by using historical records, first-person accounts, mission films and observations from earth telescopes, I have (to date) identified and collated a ‘pictorial’ archive of 49 dropped objects. These objects collectively tell a visual and cultural history of space flight and space debris through a human-centred taxonomy. This archive offers powerful, intriguing insights into the personal stories of the astronauts themselves and of the history of spaceflight. The archive provides a unique visualisation of the problem of space debris and the psychology of littering in space. This project will seek to further research and reconstruct these ‘dropped orbiting objects’ in 2D, 3D and 4D forms. It will construct a Web-based platform to make these objects widely accessible as photographs, films and sculptures for further research and study. 經過60年的航天探索，太空垃圾對太空旅行和人造衛星構成的風險越來越大。一個名為「凱斯勒現象」（Kessler Syndrome）的理論假設太空垃圾相撞後會引起無法控制的連鎖反應，導致軌道上的碎片大幅度增加，影響極地軌道、破壞人造衛星，甚至使地球軌道無法通行。隨着太空環境保護主義的重要性與日俱增，人們也日益關注月球及其他星體未來的污染問題。 現時的太空垃圾分類法只著眼於碎片的大小、形狀和運行軌跡。直至最近，研究人員開始集中測量太空垃圾，緩解它們可能構成的危險，甚至試圖清除太空垃圾。 以下擬議的項目名為「墮落」（Dropped），旨在應用視覺和藝術作為研究方法，以攝影、雕塑和電影等不同研究成果將太空垃圾問題呈現於新受眾面前，向他們傳達相關訊息。此項目將從人類的角度出發，透過描述歷史上的533名太空人在軌道上意外留下或刻意放置垃圾的故事，藉以探討太空垃圾問題。 此項目將探索並擴展一個由本人建立的獨特檔案庫，當中藏有各式在太空飛行期間意外掉落的物件。通過「行動研究」方式（意指研究和實踐同時共存和進行）和二維、三維或四維的創作，每件掉落物將通過攝影、雕塑和電影形式再現，以便作進一步分析和研究，並藉此將日趨嚴重的太空垃圾問題以嶄新且吸引的手法引起公眾的關注。 通過分析金斯頓大學（Kingston University）自2015年五月起進行的初步研究，以及利用歷史記錄、第一手資料、宣教電影和地球望遠鏡的觀察，我（迄今）已確認並核對了49件掉落物的「圖象」檔案。通過一種以人類為中心的分類法，這些掉落物共同闡明了太空飛行與太空垃圾的視覺及文化歷史。該檔案庫不但對大空人的個人故事和航天歷史提供引人入勝的有力見解，而且更具體地呈現太空垃圾問題和闡明在太空中亂拋垃圾的心理學。 該項目將尋求以二維、三維或四維方式，進一步研究並重塑這些「軌道墮落物件」，亦會建立網絡平台，讓大眾輕易地取得讓這些掉落物的相片、電影和雕塑，繼而進行進一步的調查和研究。

12608719.label: Realisation of objectives
12608719.value: Extensive research was conducted online through many and numerous websites such as: NASA.org, stuffin.space, https://issarchaeology.org/blog-iss-archaeology/, https://curator.jsc.nasa.gov/lunar/catalogs/other/jsc23454toolcatalog.pdf, https://www.nasa.gov/pdf/617743main_NASA-USG_LUNAR_HISTORIC_SITES_RevA-508.pdf, http://www.collectspace.com/news/news-090711a.html, https://www.nasa.gov/topics/humans-in-space. Further research was conducted at the Science museum in London and the Space Museum in Hong Kong to identify the set of objects for the archive. Selected objects were included through identifying specific objects through astronauts accounts and analysing mission film footage. Additional evidence was gathered for each object including design information and photographs and presented as a comprehensive collection of materials drawing all evidence materials together. The collection can be viewed and accessed at https://www.dropped.space/objects. Many of the objects such as Space glove , space boot , space camera, space food had to be physically reconstructed (as the original objects were still in space or on the moon). Each object was filmed using a slow motion capture camera, these films are presented singularly on the web platform and were also made into a single film output 'Off- Earth' showing all objects sequentially and set to the soundtrack of the voyager Golden Disks. In addition each object was 3d scanned, these scans are available on the web platform. 3D scanned objects were printed in life size multiples in black and white PLA and presented alongside film footage of the objects being dropped in the exhibition 'Dropped' at Osage- Thus replicated in photography sculpture and film. I accomplished all objectives, however, new objects are being discovered as space exploration continues so there will be a need to add objects to the collection as they are deployed and discovered.
