16205719.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16205719.value: Engineered slopes are man-made slope features such as cut slopes, fill slopes and retaining walls. There are more than 58,000 registered engineered slopes in Hong Kong. They were designed for storm conditions with a return period of 10 years; yet much larger storms have occurred frequently in the past. Records show that several hundred engineered slopes could fail in a large storm. For example, 806 engineered slopes failed during a November 1993 rainstorm with a maximum rolling 24h rainfall of 742mm, and 792 engineered slopes failed during a June 2008 rainstorm with a maximum rolling 24h rainfall of 623mm. Serious consequences can result. For example the Po Shan Road landslide and the Sau Mau Ping landslide on 18 June 1972 together caused the loss of 138 lives. In the changing climate, rainstorms of larger magnitudes may occur frequently in the future. The reliability of the large number of existing engineered slopes under extreme rainstorms is therefore of great concern to the public. The primary objective of this proposed study will be to develop a data- and mechanism-driven model for forecasting the performance of engineered slopes in response to extreme rainstorms. The records of over 8000 cases of engineered slope failures in the past 30 years in Hong Kong will be organised to evaluate the failure mechanisms and failure frequency of common types of slopes (cut slopes, fill slopes, rock slopes and retaining walls) as a function of rainfall intensity. A coupled flow-erosion-stability numerical method will then be developed to analyse the multi-faceted physical mechanisms of slope failures initiated by excessive surface runoff, erosion, infiltration, and changes in working mechanisms. The coupled numerical method will be verified using multiple cases of slope failures during past storms. Lastly, the numerical method will be extended to include uncertainties and applied to forecast the reliability of engineered slopes in Hong Kong under more severe future rainstorms than have been experienced previously. The data- and mechanism-driven model developed in this project will make it possible to simulate catchment-scale runoff and erosion, as well as the safety of many engineered slopes inside the catchment during extreme rainfall. The outcome of the research will lay a solid basis for understanding multi-faceted failure mechanisms of engineered slopes, forecasting the slopes’ safety under extreme storm conditions, identifying key risk factors, and developing effective engineering techniques for improving the slope safety during extreme storms. 工程邊坡泛指挖方、填方、擋土牆等人工邊坡。香港有超過58000個登記在冊的人工邊坡，設計標準為抵禦10年一遇的暴雨，但實際暴雨卻更大，因此發生了大量的滑坡。例如，1993年11月暴雨的24小時降雨量達742mm,誘發806個滑坡；2008年6月暴雨的24小時降雨達623mm，誘發792個滑坡。在氣候不斷變化的環境下，未來的降雨強度將更大，香港大量工程邊坡的安全問題因此將更為突出。 本研究課題的主要目的是開發一個由歷史性能數據和物理模型驅動、用於極端暴雨條件工程邊坡安全評估的數學模型。首先根據香港過去30年8000多例滑坡案例，分析挖方、填方、擋土牆等幾類常見邊坡的破壞機理和頻率與降雨強度的關係。之後開發一個土坡徑流-沖蝕-穩定多場耦合數學模型，分析可能由暴雨誘發的各種邊坡破壞模式。最後，將這個耦合模型擴展，納入主要參數的不確定性，進一步評估邊坡在考慮氣候變化的嚴酷暴雨條件下的可靠性。 本課題開發的數據和物理模型驅動的耦合數值模型可以分析流域徑流和沖蝕，及流域內眾多邊坡的穩定性。研究結果將有助於發現暴雨可能導致的各種破壞模式、識別關鍵影響因素、制定有效的邊坡加固措施。

16205719.label: Realisation of objectives
16205719.value: (1) To evaluate the past performance and failure mechanisms of man-made slopes based on a comprehensive dataset of rain-induced slope failures in the past 30 years A comprehensive database was compiled in a geographic information system (GIS) for both statistical and machine learning analyses of man-made slope failures, including seven information layers: man-made slope distribution (59,763 registered slopes as of 2019), rainfall (maximum rolling rainfall amounts of 419 major rainstorms in 1984-2017), past landslide incidents (7933 man-made slope failure incidents in the period of 1984-2017), terrain, geology, land cover, and infrastructure. For statistical analysis, the man-made slopes in Hong Kong are classified into four groups (soil cut slopes, rock cut slopes, fill slopes and retaining walls). Previous statistical rainfall-landslide correlations developed by the GEO are updated using a weighted bilinear regression approach to consider the impact of statistical uncertainty. For machine learning analysis, a total of 43 learning features are extracted, including 15 dynamic features of storm-related rolling and antecedent rainfall and 29 static features of slope information. Landslide time is incorporated into machine learning through storm-based data integration, which advances the application of machine learning capabilities from landslide susceptibility mapping to spatiotemporal landslide forecasting. The machine learning model significantly outperforms the prevailing statistical rainfall-landslide correlations not only in the prediction accuracy but also in the ability to predict both landslide locations and thereby consequences (e.g., scale of landslides). The performances of six widely-used machine learning models are compared, including logistic regression, artificial neural network, bagging, AdaBoost, RUSBoost, and subspace method. While logistic regression is the best model, some models may be not suitable for landslide forecasting due to the issues of overfitting and false alert. The rolling rainfall features are found to be the most critical factors governing slope stability. It is necessary to utilize both short-duration (e.g., 4-h) and long-duration (e.g., 24-h) rainfall features to consider different failure mechanisms of man-made slopes, i.e., shallow-seated failure and deep-seated failure. The statistical and machine learning models illustrate similar increasing trends in failure probability as the rainfall amount increases, with cut slopes having the highest failure probability, followed by fill slopes and retaining walls. The machine learning model predicts considerably higher failure probabilities of cut slopes and retaining walls at extremely high rain intensities (i.e., > 450 mm / 24 h). To adapt to the increasing landslide risk, it is necessary to upgrade the current landslide early warning system from statistical models to machine learning models. Representative outputs: [1] Xiao, T., Zhang, L.M., Cheung, R.W.M., Lacasse, S. (2023). Predicting spatio-temporal man-made slope failures induced by rainfall in Hong Kong using machine learning techniques. Géotechnique, 73(9), 749-765. [2] Xiao, T., Zhang, L.M. (2023). Data-driven landslide forecasting: Methods, data completeness, and real-time warning. Engineering Geology, 317, 107068. (2) To develop a coupled flow-erosion-stability numerical method to analyse the multifaceted physical mechanisms of slope failures initiated by extreme rainfall A multi-facet physical coupled flow-erosion-stability numerical model, EDDA 3.0, is developed, which consists of four components, i.e., data acquisition, landslide and debris flow initiation, debris flow dynamics and deposition, and subsurface flow in the drainage networks. The data inputs include time-dependent rainfall information, digital elevation model, regional soil distribution and properties, drainage network information, etc. The slope stability is evaluated after infiltration analysis. Once a landslide is triggered, the detached material is added to the flow mixture. Meanwhile, the overland flow is also simulated, which contributes to the initiation of debris flows by surface erosion. Then debris flow dynamics is simulated, in which a quadratic rheological model is used to describe the rheological properties of the soil-water mixture and the deposition in flatter areas. The overland flow can exchange with the drainage flow through inlets, and the function of inlets can be influenced by the deposition. The model is validated against a commercial software FLO-2D. Several man-made mitigation measures have been developed to reduce consequences of landslides and debris flows, including interception structures (e.g., check dams, flexible/rigid barriers) and diversion structures. In the numerical simulation, the check dams are modelled by comparing the volumetric concentration of soil-water mixtures and specific thresholds. Within a certain range, the velocity of outflow decreases accounting for the buffering effect and the volumetric concentration of outflow also decreases accounting for the filtering effect. Numerical simulations are conducted to reproduce landslide processes of two cases in Hong Kong and Wenchuan to (1) evaluate the effectiveness of existing man-made mitigation measures and identify the bottlenecks; and (2) suggest new mitigation measures against future extreme storms. Simulation results suggest that serial check dams are effective in reducing downstream deposition and the size of river debris barriers upon large debris flows. The developed numerical model contributes to the robust design of mitigation measures against landslides. Representative outputs: [1] Zhou, S.Y. (2020). Numerical simulation of multi hazard interactions and stress testing of landslide risks in Hong Kong under extreme storms. HKUST PhD Thesis. [2] He, J., Zhang, L.M., Fan, R., et al. (2022). Evaluating effectiveness of mitigation measures for large debris flows in Wenchuan, China. Landslides, 19(4), 913-928. (3) To develop a data- and mechanism-driven slope reliability-rainfall intensity model to forecast the reliability of engineered slopes under foreseeable more severe future rainstorms Based on developed models, the stress testing of man-made slopes in Hong Kong was performed according to the updated 24-h probable maximum precipitation (PMP). Since most man-made slopes are located at Hong Kong Island and Kowloon, the PMP pattern cantered at Hong Kong Island with an NW-SE orientation was considered. Considering an extremely rare rainstorm scenario corresponding to 85% PMP (1066 mm / 24 h, corresponding to a 10,000-year return period), a total of 6975 man-made slopes could fail, of which failures of fill slopes, retaining walls, rock cut slopes and soil cut slopes account for 29.4%, 6.1%, 5.6% and 7.6%, respectively, of their existing population. The northern Hong Kong Island, Kowloon, and the rim of Tai Mo Shan are at higher risk and require suitable policies and strategies for landslide risk management. Similarly, a storm transposition method was adopted to derive the PMP of Shenzhen. The central value of 24-h PMP at Wutong Mountain is estimated as 1675 mm, which is slightly higher than Hong Kong. Four rainfall scenarios are considered in numerical simulation: (1) 2008 Shenzhen rainstorm (280 mm); (2) transposed 2008 Lantau rainstorm (375 mm); (3) scaled 2008 Shenzhen rainstorm (631 mm); (4) 85% of local 24-h PMP (1044 mm). The volume of slope failures in Scenario 3 would be 326,969 m3, which is almost twice that in Scenarios 1 and 2. The areas affected by landslides and debris flows would be around 0.95 km2. When facing an 85% PMP level rainstorm, the simulated volume of slope failures further increases by 6.1%. Landslides and debris flows would happen in the Tanglang Mountain, while barely happen in the small hills like Lianhua Hill and Bijia Hill. The upstream regions of Meilin Reservoir and Longzhu Avenue are locations most prone to landslides and debris flows. Representative outputs: [1] Xiao, T., Zhang, L.M. (2020). Evaluation of performance of engineered slopes under extreme rainstorms. Geo-Congress 2020, pp. 737-743. Reston, ASCE. [2] Qiang, Y.J. (2022). Evaluating storm-related hazards under extreme weather conditions in Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. HKUST PhD Thesis.

16205719.label: Major findings and research outcome
16205719.value: (1) Both statistical rainfall-landslide correlations and machine learning models have been developed to evaluate the past performance and failure mechanisms of man-made slopes and predict the spatio-temporal evolution of man-made slope failures in Hong Kong (Xiao et al., 2023). With a storm-based data integration strategy and multiclass classification on landslide scales, the machine learning framework incorporates landslide time and consequences and advances landslide susceptibility mapping to spatio-temporal forecasting. It significantly outperforms the prevailing statistical rainfall-landslide correlations in terms of prediction accuracy and can predict the real-time evolution of probabilities, scales and spatial distribution of landslides during the progression of a rainstorm, which can never be achieved by statistical methods. It can serve as an essential tool for state-of-the-art landslide risk assessment and early warning. (2) A multi-facet physically coupled surface flow-erosion-stability-landslide dynamics numerical model, EDDA 3.0, has been developed (Zhou, 2020) to properly integrate the drainage network in the urban environment into the dynamic simulation of surface flows, landslides and debris flows. The model is able to simulate the full process of landslides, including rainfall infiltration, surface flow, slope failure initiation, surface erosion, landslide movement, and deposition. Several man-made mitigation measures such as check dams can also be modelled in the model (He et al., 2022). The numerical model is applied to evaluate the effectiveness of existing man-made mitigation measures, identify bottlenecks, and propose new mitigation measures against future extreme storms. It will contribute to a robust design of mitigation measures against landslides. (3) Both data-driven and physically-based stress tests have been conducted to predict likely landslide and debris flow clusters on Hong Kong and Shenzhen considering extreme rainstorms under the changing climate (Xiao and Zhang, 2020; Qiang, 2022). Considering an extremely rare rainstorm scenario corresponding to 85% PMP, a total of 6975 man-made slopes could fail in Hong Kong; the northern Hong Kong Island, Kowloon, and the rim of Tai Mo Shan are at higher risk than other locations. For Shenzhen, the upstream regions of Meilin Reservoir and Longzhu Avenue are locations most prone to landslides and debris flows. The results serve as a basis for the engineering design of landslide prevention and mitigation measures. (4) The outcomes of this project form the basis for two major research awards: Ralph B. Peck Award from American Society of Civil Engineers in 2023 and the Natural Science Award (First Class) from Chinese Society for Rock Mechanics and Engineering in 2022.

16205719.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16205719.value: It is challenging to predict the location and magnitude of landslides timely for warning and engineering design purposes. The emerging machine learning techniques are an attractive potential solution to rapid landslide prediction due to their ability to model complex systems and high computational efficiency after training. A course of action for landslide prediction with machine learning techniques is proposed as follows: (1) Automated landslide mapping: Machine learning methods need to be developed to automatically delineate landslide sources and trails from aerial photos and satellite images. This will greatly enhance the update frequency of the existing landslide inventory in Hong Kong. (2) Full-process landslide prediction: More advanced machine learning models are required to predict landslide locations, sizes, runout paths, and impact areas simultaneously. Each of the existing machine learning models only predicts one component. Issues such as incomplete landslide data needs to be addressed.

16205719.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16205719.value: About 60,000 man-made slopes are in service in Hong Kong and they were designed for storm conditions with a return period of 10 years. In the changing climate, rainstorms of larger magnitudes may occur more frequently. The reliability of the large number of existing man-made slopes under extreme rainstorms is of great concern to the public. This research project aimed to develop both data- and mechanism-driven models for forecasting the performance of man-made slopes in response to extreme rainstorms. Both statistical rainfall-landslide correlations and machine learning models have been developed to evaluate the performance and failure mechanisms of man-made slopes and to predict the spatio-temporal evolution of slope failures in a rainstorm. A multi-facet physical coupled flow-erosion-stability-landslide dynamics numerical model has been developed to simulate the landslide full process at a catchment scale and to evaluate the effectiveness of existing mitigation measures. Data-and physically-based stress tests have been conducted to identify high-risk man-made slopes and landslide-prone areas in extreme rainstorms. The outcomes lay a solid basis for understanding multi-faceted failure mechanisms of man-made slopes, forecasting the slope safety under extreme storm conditions, identifying key risk factors, and developing effective engineering techniques for improving the slope safety against extreme storms.

16205919.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16205919.value: 關於無人船自主引導導航控制系統的研究

16205919.label: Project Objectives
16205919.value: 1. Develop a point-to-point guidance system to generate control objectives via online trajectory planning which enables the USVs to avoid obstacles in real time; Develop a finite-duration feedback control system to realize above control objectives to track the desired trajectory with higher accuracy than conventional control schemes; Develop new observer and filter to further enhance the performance of USVs; Design and fabricate a prototype USV and experimentally verify the effectiveness of the proposed guidance, navigation and control (GNC) system.
rows: 1. Develop a point-to-point guidance system to generate control objectives via online trajectory planning which enables the USVs to avoid obstacles in real time;
Develop a finite-duration feedback control system to realize above control objectives to track the desired trajectory with higher accuracy than conventional control schemes;
Develop new observer and filter to further enhance the performance of USVs;
Design and fabricate a prototype USV and experimentally verify the effectiveness of the proposed guidance, navigation and control (GNC) system.

16205919.label: Realisation of objectives
16205919.value: All the four research objectives are achieved in this project. For objective 1, an extended line-of-sight (ELOS) guidance system was developed for USV path following or trajectory tracking task. Two interrelated along-track and cross-track problems were presented in the design guidance. Since these two types of tracking problems are interactively constrained in most research work, an iteration mechanism was first put forward to optimize the path parameter in each closed loop such that along tracking will not affect cross tracking in the subsequent time period. The proposed guidance law was adjusted by varying the look-ahead distance with the cross-track error such that sideslip in cross tracking can be promptly compensated through appropriate vehicle heading assignment. The guidance mission was to generate the desired states as inputs of the USV control system. Based on the proposed guidance system, a new real-time emergency collision avoidance method for USVs was then proposed, which can flexibly comply with international maritime collision avoidance rules. The results are polished in Journal paper No. 4. For objective 2, a new control system capable of estimating system uncertainty was developed to realize the control objectives. The proposed controller has two components, i.e., online state-constrained polynomial planning and uncertainty-estimated control execution. The online state-constrained polynomial planning is to satisfy all the system state constraints and generate the planning acceleration for the control law to execute. With the unknown uncertainties accurately estimated, the control law was executed at high frequency and established as an algebraic formulation. The state-dependent finite-time reachable control property was analyzed. The proposed controller can achieve short settling time and be insensitive to noise. Few parameters need to be tuned and each parameter has an explicit physical meaning. The results are polished in Journal papers No. 1, 2 and 5. For objective 3, given the fact that the internal states of a system, such as position, velocity, acceleration, etc., naturally obey the integral process of a physical system in kinematics, an adaptive filtering system was proposed to reconstruct the system states at the kinematic level without using any prior knowledge of the statistical properties of measurement noises. In the developed filtering system, each noise-contaminated estimated state is filtered by an average filter with phase delay and amplitude distortion compensated. Unlike existing model-based estimation methods, the dynamic equation is not explicitly used in the developed method, and the uncertainties in the nonlinear dynamic equation can be isolated. Furthermore, its application is more straightforward since no fixed gains are needed to be manually tuned. The results are polished in Journal paper No. 3. For objective 4, a USV prototype was designed and fabricated for experimental validations. The USV prototype is a catamaran equipped with two ducted propellers under the water. Each propeller has three blades and is driven by a servo motor. The USV is equipped with multiple sensors, such as a high-accuracy inertial measurement unit (IMU), a real-time kinematic (RTK) global positioning system (GPS) sensor, and an ultra-wideband (UWB) wireless positioning system. Offshore seaside experiments were conducted to validate the effectiveness of the proposed guidance system, control system, and filtering system. Detailed description of this USV prototype can be found in Journal papers No. 2-5.

16205919.label: Major findings and research outcome
16205919.value: The emphasis of this proposal is on guidance system design, control system design, and filtering system design for USVs. The major findings and research outcomes can be summarized as follows: In the developed guidance system design, given the fact that the USV along-track motion is affected by cross tracking in most conventional synchronous convergence designs, an effective iteration mechanism was used to identify an optimal path parameter such that zero along-track error will not affect the cross tracking in the subsequent time period. To achieve a prompt response and avoid introducing rigorous assumptions in sideslip compensation, an ELOS guidance approach was developed to amend the heading by adapting the look-ahead distance and making a tradeoff between tracking accuracy and response time. On the basis of this ELOS guidance approach, a new real-time emergency collision avoidance method for USVs has been proposed, which can flexibly comply with international maritime collision avoidance rules and solve the problems of existing autonomous obstacle avoidance algorithms, such as high computational complexity and poor real-time performance. This method can handle multiple obstacles and take actions that violate the rules but are safer in high collision-risk situations. Further details can be found in Journal paper No. 4. In the developed control system design, compared with most controllers that use the Lyapunov stability theory to satisfy the state constraints and stabilize the control systems with fine-tuned control gains, a state-dependent controller was developed for a class of nonlinear systems, in which the system present and final state constraints are directly fulfilled by online polynomial planning in kinematics. Since the changes of position and velocity depend on the acceleration, the proposed control law is then to realize the planning acceleration, i.e., the second-order derivative of the state-constrained planning polynomial. Particularly, the proposed control execution indicates that no tedious fine-tuned control gains are required, and the system always has finite-time convergence properties. Compared with the existing disturbance observer methods, the developed control scheme can promptly and accurately estimate all the unknown uncertainties, including the external disturbances and vehicle dynamics, with the aid of system feedback acceleration and the aforementioned polynomial planning acceleration. Furthermore, no gains are needed in the estimation process. Further details can be found in Journal papers No. 1, 2 and 5. For the filtering system design, an adaptive filtering system was developed based on high-order Taylor expansions, enabling the reconstruction of the system’s full states via position measurements. The techniques of noise reduction and delay compensation were utilized to improve estimation performance. Since the developed filtering system is a model-free method, the uncertainties in dynamics will not affect state estimation. Compared with the existing methods, such as the extended Kalman filter (EKF), the passive observer, and the high-order differentiators, it is not necessary to know the statistical properties of measurement noises, and no gains are needed for manual tuning. To verify the developed adaptive filtering system, it was applied to a speed-varying path following control task for USVs, where the system’s accurate full states are required. Further details can be found in Journal paper No. 3. Since present USV development is still in its infancy and only semi-autonomous USVs are in normal use, overall, the above enabling techniques developed for USV maneuver can improve USV autonomy and reduce the need for human control and the negative consequences of human mistakes, such as ineffective, unsafe, and unreliable USV operations.

16205919.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16205919.value: Potential further development of the research and proposed course of action can be summarized as follows: First, an intelligent onboard perception system can be further developed for USVs. The perception system can embed the well-known monocular vision, stereo vision, infrared vision, LIDAR, radar, and sonar. Second, the proposed controller can be further applied to motor control for USV propulsion system to enhance, thereby enhancing the tracking performance of multiple missions since most electric motor drivers usually use PID controllers to realize the electric current loop, speed loop, and position loop. Third, data fusion with multiple sensors can be further developed, enabling the reconstruction of reliable data by combining sensor data or data from different sources in order to reduce the uncertainty of information compared to using a single source. Finally, formation control with multiple USVs can be developed based on the research work of this proposal. As a remedy, USV can help carry out these missions efficiently in cooperation with other vehicles. Hence, developing an efficient formation control scheme with multiple USVs is now of increasing importance in the protection of marine environment and for safeguarding marine rights.

16205919.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16205919.value: USVs are one of the most widely used intelligent platforms to perform dangerous and repetitive tasks in sophisticated and hazardous environments, such as disaster monitoring, exploration of the polluted area, maritime monitoring, communications relay, geophysical survey, military surveillance, and so on. After decades of research and development in this area, USV development is still in its infancy and only semi-autonomous USVs are in normal use. There is a limited amount of USV autonomy because the GNC functions are challenging to be reliable under different working conditions. Further improvement of future autonomous USVs is necessary to reduce the need for human control as well as the negative consequences of human mistakes, such as ineffective, unsafe, and unreliable USV operations. This research work aims to develop a series of enabling techniques for USV GNC functions, such as guidance system design, state-dependent controller design, and filtering system design. These techniques will improve the autonomy of USVs in diverse missions and reduce the number of supervisory interventions required for different working conditions.

16206019.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16206019.value: 化石燃料的大量使用造成了严重的环境问题，包括严重的空气污染和全球变暖。因此，人类需要设计出更加可持续和高效的方式来发电。在各种选择中，固体氧化物燃料电池（SOFC）因其高效率、燃料灵活性和低排放而脱颖而出。然而，它们的工作温度通常高于800℃，阻碍了其大规模商业化。尽管降低工作温度对于降低成本至关重要，但在500-800℃下运行它们会显著降低其输出功率，这主要是因为空气电极（阴极）处的氧还原反应（ORR）的动力学缓慢。 具有ABO3-δ结构的钙钛矿氧化物作为SOFCs的阴极材料被广泛研究，因为它们的性质可以通过改变A和B位元素来调节。相比之下，只有少数研究探讨了阴离子取代，即用另一种阴离子如氟取代氧。值得注意的是，迄今为止所报道的所有这种轻度取代的钙钛矿阴极与未掺杂的材料相比都显示出显著提升的ORR活性和增强的稳定性。 关于阴离子取代如何改善钙钛矿阴极，许多科学问题仍然悬而未决，这是因为最近的研究主要集中在实际应用上。在本研究中，我们计划系统研究阴离子取代如何增强钙钛矿的各种特性，包括其电催化活性、电子和离子电导率以及稳定性。为此，我们将使用SrTixFe1-xO3 δFσ（STFF）作为模型材料，因为氟化显著提高了其活性和稳定性。我们将结合实验和计算展开研究。实验方面，我们将测试传统的粉末样品和定义明确的薄膜样品，以评估氟化材料的内在活性，并探索其表面稳定性。计算方面，我们将使用密度泛函理论计算来探讨电子结构和键合特性。我们还将采用分子动力学模拟，结合数据驱动方法，分析氧扩散的机理。 这项工作旨在提高我们对阴离子取代如何改变钙钛矿的电化学性质和稳定性的理解。本项目的成功实施，将为高性能、高稳定性的阴离子取代型SOFC阴极的合理设计铺平道路。

16206119.value: For objective 1: We characterized the mechanical properties of nanostructured superelastic NiTi with average grain size of 100 nm. The relation between the material properties and the cyclic thermomechanical responses under cyclic tension or compression were established. The research of this part has led to one publication in leading journal of J. Mech. Phys. Solids (see Journal paper # 1 in Part C Section 8). For objective 2, we performed cyclic compressive fatigue experiment on superelastic NiTi tubes and acquired firsthand systematic experimental data on functional fatigue and fatigue life, fatigue crack nucleation and growth, fatigue failure mode and mechanisms in the challenging tube configuration. The effects of material properties, defects, loading condition and tube geometry on the fatigue performance of the tubes were identified. The research of this part has led to two publications in leading journals of Applied Materials Today, Applied Thermal Engineering (see Journal paper # 2, and #3 in Part C Section 8). For objective 3, we performed systematic experiment to identify the roles of key tube geometric parameters in the enhancement of the cyclic fatigue life and cooling efficiency of different NiTi tubular structures for the compression-based solid-state elastocaloric cooling technology. The research of this part has led to one publication in the journal of Applied Thermal Engineering (see Journal paper # 4 in Part C Section 8).

16206119.label: Major findings and research outcome
16206119.value: This project investigated fatigue behavior of NiTi shape memory alloy tubes for the compression-based solid-state cooling technology. Superelastic tubes with grain size of 100 nm were investigated through systematic experiment under cyclic compression. The major finding is that the microstructure (grain size in particular) and the tubular geometry play important roles in fatigue and cooling performances. The research work has led to publication of 4 journal papers in leading international journals in the fields of solid mechanics, materials science and energy and thermal engineering. The project is motivated by the scientific and practical importance of developing compression-based solid-state green refrigeration using shape memory alloy material for cooling devices. The research outcome of this project played a critical role in developing tension- or compression-based solid-state green refrigeration which is a disruptive cooling technology to replace the conventional environmentally harmful vapor-compression refrigeration.

16206119.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16206119.value: The research outcome of this project has played important roles in the recently funded RGC-STG project and the ongoing RAISE+ project application, where a main effort is to develop compression-based solid-state green refrigeration which is a disruptive cooling technology to replace the conventional environmentally harmful vapor-compression refrigeration and to achieve building decarbonization and carbon neutrality in big cities.

16206119.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16206119.value: Superelastic NiTi shape memory alloy has been used as a promising refrigerant in solid-state refrigeration prototypes due to its large latent heat during stress-induced reversible phase transformation (PT). The key challenge to the material is the required high fatigue resistance to ensure a reliable long-term operation of the cooling system. About 100 million PT cycles is needed for a refrigeration device working over a ten-year lifespan. Unfortunately, under cyclic tensile working mode, commercial superelastic NiTi alloy wires and strips have very limited fatigue life and are difficult to meet such stringent requirement. Cyclic compression of NiTi tubes was used in the bulk cooling system prototypes, mainly for an enhanced fatigue performance and more efficient heat transfer with the fluid media. This project investigated fatigue behavior of NiTi shape memory alloy tubes for the compression-based solid-state cooling technology. Superelastic tubes with grain size of 100 nm were investigated through systematic experiment under cyclic compression. The dependence of fatigue performance on the microstructure (grain size in particular) and the tube geometry were established. The project is motivated by the scientific and practical importance of developing compression-based solid-state green refrigerant NiTi material for the disruptive cooling technology.

16206219.value: 2-D MoS2 CMOS晶體管技術與建模

16206219.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16206219.value: Scaling down a transistor dimension below the 5nm technology node is an important factor for continuing the growth of the semiconductor industry, following the Moore's law. Traditional planar complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) transistor technology has reached its limit around the 28nm technology node. Since the 22nm technology, the industry has adopted the more advanced FinFET or silicon on insulator (SOI) transistor structures. To go further down below 5nm, researchers are actively researching structures that have larger perimeters to cross-sectional area ratio for the transistor channels. This has led to the study of transistors fabricated with 2-D materials as well as 1-D carbon-nanotubes. While these emerging transistor technologies may not be able to completely replace the existing mature CMOS technology, they can provide more functionality to the current technology platform, with higher levels of system integration, such as the monolithic stacking of transistors. While there are numerous reports that show the characteristics of individual transistors fabricated using 2-D materials, such as molybdenum disulfide (MoS2) or tungsten diselenide (WSe2), the integration level is very low. In particular, it is difficult to form CMOS logics and most of the reported results are either only for n-channel or p-channel devices. Furthermore, most of the innovation comes from material handling, and therefore the fabrication technology remains primitive. For example, a lot of reported data are from bottom gate structures with the substrate as the gate electrode. This makes it impossible to control individual transistor separately due to shared substrate. To achieve CMOS integration to perform logical computations, it is necessary to form complementary logic using the same the same active material layer with a top-gate structure for easy routing. This project aims to demonstrate the architecture of high performance CMOS logics. Among the known 2-D layered materials, MoS2 is the most well studied. Therefore, we will use MoS2 as the active channel material in this project. To achieve high performance CMOS circuits, innovative approaches must be used to solve a number of key problems, from material selection to structure design, and transistor characteristics modelling. At the end of the project, we will demonstrate the material system (including electrodes, gate dielectrics, and active channel material), and physical transistor structure (top-gate structure) to achieve the CMOS MoS2 technology. Furthermore, a compact model will be formulated to describe the characteristics of the transistors developed to evaluate their performance in different circuits. 根據摩爾定律，縮小5nm技術節點以下的晶體管尺寸是繼續半導體產業發展的重要因素。 傳統的平面互補金屬氧化物半導體（CMOS）晶體管技術已經在28nm技術節點附近達到了極限。 自22nm技術以來，業界採用了更先進的FinFET或絕緣體上矽（SOI）晶體管結構。 為了進一步低於5nm，研究人員正在積極研究晶體管通道的橫截面積比越大的結構。 這導致了對用二維材料和一維碳納米管製造的晶體管的研究。 雖然這些新興晶體管技術可能無法完全取代現有的成熟CMOS技術，但它們可以為當前技術平台提供更多功能，具有更高水平的系統集成，例如晶體管的單片堆疊。 雖然有許多報告顯示使用二維材料製造的單個晶體管的特性，例如二硫化鉬（MoS2）或二硒化鎢（WSe2），但集成度非常低。 特別是，很難形成CMOS邏輯，並且大多數報告的結果僅適用於n通道或p通道器件。 此外，大部分創新來自材料處理，因此製造技術仍然是原始的。 例如，許多報告的數據來自底柵結構，其中襯底作為柵電極。 這使得由於共用襯底而無法單獨控制單個晶體管。 為了實現CMOS集成以執行邏輯計算，有必要使用具有頂柵結構的相同活性材料層形成互補邏輯以便於佈線。 該項目旨在演示高性能CMOS邏輯的架構。 在已知的2-D層狀材料中，MoS2是研究得最好的材料。 因此，我們將在此項目中使用MoS2作為活動通道材料。 為了實現高性能CMOS電路，必須採用創新方法來解決從材料選擇到結構設計和晶體管特性建模等許多關鍵問題。 在項目結束時，我們將演示材料系統（包括電極，柵極電介質和有源溝道材料），以及物理晶體管結構（頂柵結構），以實現CMOS MoS2技術。 此外，將製定一個緊湊的模型來描述所開發的晶體管的特性，以評估它們在不同電路中的性能。

16206219.label: Major findings and research outcome
16206219.value: The project team studied different MoS2 transistor structures and defined the fabrication process and device structure to form CMOS circuits, which completed objective 1 of the project. While the fabrication of n-channel MoS2 transistors has been reported in the literature, the methods to fabricate p-channel MoS2 transistors are less developed. With the limited experimental data on MoS2 p-channel MOSFET, the performances are relatively poor. The team discovered that the key to high-performance p-channel MoS2 transistors is the contact. The initial study focused on the metal to MoS2 contact to understand the physical properties of the metal-to-MoS2 junction. This work was published in the paper entitled "Electrostatics of a van-der-Waals Stacked Monolayer MoS2 PN Junction." Following the understanding of the junction properties, the team found a way to fabricate high-performance p-channel MoS2 transistors by using Nb-doping and property junction cleaning. The work has been published in the paper entitled "High Current Nb-Doped P-Channel MoS2 Field-Effect Transistor Using Pt Contact," partially fulfilling objective 2 of the project. With the success of fabricating the p-channel MoS2 transistor characteristics, the team studied the optimization of the n-channel MoS2 transistors. Together with the demonstration of high-performance p-channel MoS2 transistors, this fulfilled objective 2 of the project. After the structural optimization, the team successfully demonstrated a high-performance complementary circuit composed of only MoS2 active layers. The work was first presented in the conference paper entitled "Complementary Two-Dimensional (2-D) MoS2 FET Technology," which received the best paper award from the 51st European Solid-State Device Research Conference. After that, a more detailed study on the circuit was published in the paper entitled "On-Chip Integrated High Gain Complementary MoS2 Inverter Circuit with Exceptional High Hole-Current P-channel Field-Effect Transistors," including very detailed experimental results. This paper was selected as the Frontispiece of the Issue in Advanced Electronic Material. The successful demonstration of a complementary CMOS circuit formed by MoS2 transistors successfully fulfilled objective 4 of the project. In addition to demonstrating the successful development of the complementary MoS2 transistor technology, the team also carefully studied the device physics and constructed a physical model for the complementary MoS2 transistors to help the device optimization and circuit simulation. This work has been published in the paper entitled "A Full-Region Model for Ultra-Scaled MoS2 MOSFET Covering Direct Source-Drain Tunneling," fulfilling objective 3 of the project.

16206219.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16206219.value: The research project on developing MoS2-based integrated circuits has significant potential for further refinement and improvement. While the team has made important discoveries about the key to making these circuits work well, there is still much to be learned about the underlying physics and optimal fabrication methods. One potential course of action would be to further refine the metal to MoS2 contact, which has been identified as a key factor in the performance of MoS2 transistors. This could involve exploring new materials and methods for making the contact, as well as optimizing the doping and cleaning techniques used in the fabrication process. Another area of focus could be on improving the understanding of the physical properties of MoS2 and how they affect the behavior of the circuits. This could involve further study of the electronic and optical properties of MoS2, as well as the development of new models and simulations to describe the behavior of MoS2-based circuits.

16206219.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16206219.value: The research project aimed to develop a novel transistor structure for MoS2 CMOS logic circuits, fabricate high-performance n-channel and p-channel MoS2 transistors using contact engineering, and demonstrate CMOS circuit function with interconnected p-channel and n-channel transistors. The team discovered that the key to high-performance p-channel MoS2 transistors is in the metal to MoS2 contact. They developed a method for fabricating high-performance p-channel MoS2 transistors using Nb-doping and property junction cleaning. The team successfully demonstrated a high-performance complementary circuit composed of only MoS2 active layers, representing an important step towards the development of MoS2-based integrated circuits. They also constructed a physical model for the complementary MoS2 transistors to help the device optimization and circuit simulation. The significance of this research lies in the potential for faster and more efficient computer chips, which would have a significant impact on many areas of our lives.

16206719.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16206719.value: The urgent demand for multiple voltage domain regulation on system-on-a-chip (SoC) has attracted a huge amount of attention in both academia and industry. Many function blocks with different supply voltages are integrated in a single chip with various loading currents, which make it very challenging for integrated circuit designers to regulate multiple voltage domains in a chip area-efficient and economical way. Although the single-inductor-multiple-output switching converter can regulate multiple outputs with a reduced number of inductors, it is not suitable for this application as it still requires an off-chip expensive bulky inductor and suffers from large output ripples and cross-regulations. The multiple-output switched-capacitor dc-dc converter is not suitable for this application either because it can only provide a few discrete voltage conversion ratios and has a low power density. Low-dropout linear regulators (LDO) is another potential solution. However, conventional analog LDO is generally not suitable for sub-1V SoC applications and it cannot provide area-efficient design as each conventional LDO can only regulate a single load. Thus, it is urgent and necessary to develop a new area-efficient and economical power solution for on-chip multiple voltage domain regulation. In this project, a novel single-controller-multiple-output low-dropout linear regulator will be developed to address the above issues in an area-efficient and economical way. Different control schemes of the feedback controller will be investigated to handle multiple output voltages sequentially and efficiently. Furthermore, an analog-assisted digital control loop, an adaptive clock generator and a push-pull auxiliary loop will be developed to further improve the response time and power efficiency of the LDO. Prototypes will be fabricated and measured to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed single-controller-multiple-output LDO topology and the proposed techniques. 片上系統對多電壓域管理的迫切需求已經吸引了學術界和工業界廣泛關注。將許多不同電源電壓和負載功能的模塊集成在單個芯片上，並要設計省面積低成本的片上多電壓域的管理方案帶來了極大的挑戰。儘管單電感多輸出的開關電源轉換器可以用更少電感數量來管理多路輸出，但是它並不適用于本應用。因為它仍然需要一個昂貴的大體積的片外電感，並且受到輸出紋波過大和交叉干擾的影響。多路輸出的電荷泵電壓轉換器也不適合本應用，因為它只能提供有限的轉換係數，並且能量密度也比較低。低壓差綫性穩壓器是一個潛在的解決方案。然而，一般而言，傳統的類比低壓差綫性穩壓器也不適合電壓低於1伏的片上系統應用。因為它只能管理一路輸出負載，它的面積消耗比較大。因此，研發一個省面積並且經濟合理的片上多電壓域電源管理系統就變得很迫切而且必要。 在本項目中，我們將研發一個新穎的單控制器多路輸出低壓差綫性穩壓器。以一個省面積並且經濟合理的方式來解決上述問題。我們還將研究多種不同的反饋控制方案，從而能夠有序高效地管理多路輸出電壓。此外，我們將研發一個類比輔助數字控制迴路，一個自適應時鐘產生器和一個推拉輔助迴路，從而進一步提高該低壓差綫性穩壓器的反應速度和能源效率。最終，我們將會製造並且測試提出的解決方案原型，從而證明單控制器多路輸出低壓差綫性穩壓器結構和技術的有效性。

16206819.label: Project Objectives
16206819.value: Develop a set of novel approaches to high-resolution MVS with deep learning methods, boost the 3D representation quality in terms of both accuracy and completeness. Integrate learning-based MVS algorithm with very large-scale 3D reconstruction algorithms for higher accuracy and faster 3D reconstruction. Build a large-scale annotated MVS dataset covering diverse scenes that is suitable for training and evaluating MVS algorithms. Further extend the MVS methods into several practical settings, including two-view stereo matching in autonomous driving and visual SLAM system. 16206819.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16206819.value: 多视角立体视觉（Multi-view Stereo, MVS）是指从多幅有重叠图片中重建三位点云的任务。传统方法一般会采用手工设计的相似性指标和正则化方法。而近期的方法采用了深度学习中的卷积神经网络（Convolutional Neural Network, CNN），从而大幅提高了效果。在这些方法中，大部分只专注在双视角立体匹配上，忽视了多视角所能带来的提升。而在基于深度学习的方法中利用多视角信息，难点在于有效的整合相机的几何关系。 针对该问题，本项目将会探索易于扩展的基于深度学习的多视角立体匹配方法。具体而言，本方法将会以一幅参考图像与多幅源图像为输入，并输出与参考图对齐的高分辨率深度图像。为了利用相机的几何信息，本方法使用可微分的单应变换（Homographic Transformation）将图像特征组成三维权值数组。考虑到对其进行正则化的空间及时间复杂度极高，本方法提出使用具有门控循环单元（Gated Recurrent Unit, GRU）来替代传统的三维卷积网络。这种逐步的方法可以将空间复杂度由立方级降至平方级，从而使其适用于高分辨率的多视角重建任务。我们将此方法命名为R-MVSNet。 此外，能否取得高质量的已标注数据同样是基于深度学习方法的一个关键。高质量的已标注数据集一般由经过精确调校的扫描系统采集而来，而这种标准是难以达到的。另外，一些数据集虽包含扫描而来的标注信息，但是无法提供精确的深度图与遮挡关系。因此，本项目将提出一个新的含有上述信息的大量级数据集。首先我们将使用目前已有的最先进的三维重建流水线生成多种场景中的含有贴图的三维模型，再由此生成图像、深度图、遮挡关系等三维重建所需的数据。 我们所提出的多视角立体重建方法已经在多个数据集上达到先进水平，并在排行榜取得高排位。此方法与现有的三维重建流水线的整合也将具有很大潜力，并有希望将三维重建效果推向新的层次。

16206819.label: Realisation of objectives
16206819.value: We have achieved the five objectives of the project. We have developed new methods of high-resolution multi-view stereo (MVS) with deep architectures that give more accurate and complete 3D reconstructions. This is achieved by developing and innovating on the modern neural network architectures for stereo views. The local reconstruction from a subset of selected views are also extended to the integration of more global and complete reconstruction of a large-scale set of views and coverage. Importantly, we have also developed and created a large annotated MVS dataset suitable for training and evaluating performance of state-of-the-art MVS algorithms. Experiments conducted have demonstrated its effectiveness in advancing the state-of-the-art in learning-based MVS algorithms and methods. These learning-based stereo algorithms have also been applied to the visual SLAM and autonomous driving settings. Finally, we have also investigated the multi-task learning of MVS together with high-level semantic segmentation and detection for the efficiency of the overall system performance.

16206819.label: Major findings and research outcome
16206819.value: There are three major research outcomes from this project. The first is a visibility-aware multi-view stereo network architecture that takes into account the pixel-level visibility and formalizes a matching uncertainty map with severe occlusion. This new architecture and framework significantly improves the reconstruction accuracy and robustness in state-of-the-art multi-view stereo approaches. The second is our introduction of BlendedMVS, which is a novel large-scale dataset with sufficient multi-view reconstruction ground truths for learning-based approaches. We have also introduced the critical ambient lighting information during training. Extensive experiments have demonstrated that BlendedMVS allowed the trained model with significantly better generalization ability and also provides the pre-trained models. The third is an introduction of neural surface reconstruction framework that can leverage the learned stereo matching and feature consistency to optimize implicit surface reconstruction from multiple views.

16206819.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16206819.value: The reconstruction from multiple views is one of the most fundamental tasks in computer vision. With the advancement of generative vision, it again gives a very promising direction in innovating the multi-view stereo network architectures and frameworks by incorporating more efficiently the prior knowledge of our surrounding 3D knowledge. These directions are continuously under investigation in our group and with other graduate students in computer vision.

16206819.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16206819.value: There are two fundamental tasks in computer vision, namely, recognition and reconstruction. The fundamental 3D reconstruction from more than one views has been the most challenging and driving force for developing modern computer vision. The 3D reconstruction from multiple views is also called multi-view stereo reconstruction. The modern multi-view stereo algorithms are neural networks that learn from a large amount of existing stereo data sets. We have been proposing and designing these network architectures to learn first the match between pixels from different views, and estimate the corresponding depth of each pixel to create 3D dense point clouds of our surrounding scenes and objects. We can now fully automatically reconstruct a scene or an object from a very large amount of data set very efficiently

16207019.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16207019.value: 基于谱约束的结构化图学习的优化方法

16207019.label: Project Objectives
16207019.value: Structured Graph Learning Via Laplacian Spectral Constraints: To propose a set of formulations for learning multi-component structured graphs from data by utilizing the eigenvalue properties of the Laplacian matrix and to develop efficient optimization methods with low computational complexity and fast convergence. Structured Graph Learning Via Adjacency Spectral Constraints: To propose a set of formulations for learning bipartite and tree structured graphs by uti- lizing the eigenvalue properties of the graph adjacency matrix and to develop efficient optimization methods with low computational complexity and fast convergence. Structured Graph Learning Via Joint Adjacency and Laplacian Spectral Constraints: To develop an optimization framework utilizing the eigenvalue properties of both adjacency and Laplacian matrices for learning regular structured graphs; this formulation can also be used to perform more sophisticated graph based tasks such as bipartite graph clustering and regular graph clustering.

Structured Graph Learning Via Adjacency Spectral Constraints: To propose a set of formulations for learning bipartite and tree structured graphs by uti- lizing the eigenvalue properties of the graph adjacency matrix and to develop efficient optimization methods with low computational complexity and fast convergence.

16207019.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16207019.value: 图是一种基本的数学结构，它由一组顶点（节点）以及它们之间的关系（边）组成。当图中的两个节点相连时，它们之间的边所赋予的权重表示两个节点的相似性。图模型是一种有效的数据表示形式，已广泛应用于科学和工程领域之中，比如社交图，生物图，金融图，运输图，传感器图和神经图。基于图的数据表示是从数据集中提取相关信息的第一步。在许多应用中，数据集通常由非结构化的样本组成，并且潜在的图信息（表示样本之间的关系）并不是现成的。因此从数据集中学习图结构是非常必要的。 学习具有特定结构的图对于诠释和确定图中的数据关系是至关重要的。图上的特定结构可以根据数据的先验信息得到（比如金融中金融机构的数量），或者在某些应用中目标图的结构是特定的（比如在联合聚类中用二分图）。一些常用的结构化图包括多元件图，二分图，连通图，稀疏图，树图和正则图。这些图结构在众多科学领域中出现，包括分子生物学，物理学，机器学习，信号处理，社会网络，金融和政治学。此外，引入结构化图可能有助于提高基于图的复杂任务的性能，例如预测，社区检测，聚类和因果推断。学习结构化图是一个多层面的复杂的问题，目前缺少一个综合框架去解决该问题。图结构涉及到组合，因而在优化问题中引入图结构变得困难。 在本方案中，我们首先展示如何将复杂的组合约束转化成基于图矩阵特征值的可分析的约束。然后我们提出一个统一的优化框架，它可以通过图矩阵的谱约束来实现具有特定结构的图学习。该工作背后的想法是巧妙地整合两个强大的框架：高斯马尔可夫随机场和谱图理论。由此建模得到的优化问题依旧比较复杂，我们计划开发基于最大-最小化框架的有效算法。

16207019.label: Realisation of objectives
16207019.value: Graphs are fundamental mathematical structures consisting of sets of vertices (nodes) and relationships (edges) between them. The weight associated with each edge in the graph represents the similarity among the two vertices it connects. Learning a graph with a specific structure, such as connected sparse graphs, k-component graphs, tree graphs, etc., can be essential for the interpretability and precise identification of the structure of the data graph relationships. The main goal of this project was the development of graph learning methods incorporating structure by controlling the eigenvalues of certain graph matrices. The starting point were methods for unstructured graphs. Controlling the eigenvalues of these graph matrices allows to enforce certain structures in the graph; however, dealing with the eigenvalues in an optimization process is nonconvex and nontrivial. The key was developing efficient and practical algorithms to control the eigenvalues. In particular, the three proposed objectives focus on different graph matrices: 1) Laplacian matrix, 2) adjacency matrix, and 3) both matrices at the same time. In addition to the original three objectives, another three additional objectives were accomplished, namely, 1) learning graphs under heavy tails, 2) developing optimization methods for formulations incorporating high-order statistics (such as portfolios), and 3) characterization and imputation of missing values in heavy-tailed data.

Structured Graph Learning Via Adjacency Spectral Constraints: To propose a set of formulations for learning bipartite and tree structured graphs by uti- lizing the eigenvalue properties of the graph adjacency matrix and to develop efficient optimization methods with low computational complexity and fast convergence.

16207019.label: Major findings and research outcome
16207019.value: The major outcomes of this project were the formulation of a wide variety of graph learning problems under a wide variety of structural constraints and the development of efficient and practical algorithms, which was missing in the literature. In addition, the formulations were extended to work under heavy-tailed data and missing values in the data. Providing a very general framework for real-world applications. The publication output consists of one book chapter, 4 top IEEE journal papers, one top Machine Learning journal paper, 7 conference papers (3 of which published in AISTATS and NeurIPS ought to be considered as journal papers as customary in the machine learning community due to the low acceptance rates of around 20%). In addition, we developed 3 open-source software packages (spectralGraphTopology, sparseGraph, and fingraph) under the programming language R (commonly used in statistics, machine learning, and finance); see https://github.com/convexfi and https://www.danielppalomar.com/software.html for details.

16207019.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16207019.value: During this project we obtained many results, more than expected. Nevertheless, this only opened the door to many other future problems. Three main directions are foreseen for the future of our research group: i) further refining the graph learning methods for time series data (e.g., financial data), ii) exploiting the bipartite structure in graphs with applications to clustering, and iii) exploring low-rank matrix constraints for factor model modeling.

16207019.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16207019.value: Graphs are mathematical structures used to represent data in many fields. They consist of nodes, edges, and weights representing similarity. To extract information from data, a graph-based representation is necessary. Sometimes, a natural graph isn't available, so it's necessary to learn the structure from the data. Learning a graph with a specific structure is important for interpreting data relationships. For example, structured graphs like bipartite, connected, sparse, tree, and regular graphs can improve prediction and clustering tasks. However, structured graph learning is complex, and there's no comprehensive framework. Graph structure is combinatorial, making it hard to enforce via optimization. This project has provided a way to enforce graph structure via eigenvalues and spectral constraints on graph matrices. The optimization formulations are complex, but the resulting algorithms are easy to implement and efficient to execute.

16207119.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16207119.value: Implementing a return policy is a common strategy in online selling. Given that online shoppers bear a high risk of product misfit, they become reluctant to make a purchase if they do not know whether products will meet their expectations. To encourage purchases, a generous return policy, such as hassle-free money back guarantee, is provided by retailers. A generous return policy results in a high return rate, which erodes the retailer’s profit. Hence, it becomes important for the retailers to design an appropriate return policy that strikes a balance between demand stimulation and return rate. Most of the returned products are in good condition, and can be treated as new after repackaging. The returned products in the earlier period can thus be sold together with the remaining inventory in the later periods. In a multi-period selling environment, the return policy should naturally be offered dynamically. On the consumer side, strategic consumers consider not only dynamic prices, but also dynamic refunds when they make purchase decisions. When product resale is an option, it also affects product availability risk in the later period. Hence, the game between the retailer and strategic consumers under the dynamic return policy with product resale becomes complicated. The practical popularity of return policies has engendered increasing attention in marketing and operations management communities. The existing literature has studied return policy in the following aspects: (1) the firm designs the optimal return policy without product resale in various environments; (2) the returned products are differentiated from the new products, e.g., open-box items, and sold separately at a discount price. We are among the first to consider a dynamic return policy over time when the returned products can be resold together with the remaining inventory in the later period. In the proposed project, customers have heterogeneous uncertain valuations of the product, and strategize the timing of their purchases by considering the price path, the refund path, and the availability risk. We will analyze the retailer’s optimal return policy and inventory decision. Likewise, we will investigate how various market conditions and customer characteristics affect the structure of the retailer’s dynamic return policy. We will also evaluate the value of product resale. These results of this study can generate insights on the value of dynamic management of product return and resale, and also complement the literature on strategic customer behavior by examining its impact on the firm’s dynamic return policy. 商家给予消费者产品返回（退货）的权利现已成为网购的一种常规策略。线上消费者购买产品时要承受着产品可能不适合自己的风险，从而降低他们的购买欲望。为了促进线上消费者的购买，一些商家会提供慷慨的退货政策，例如无附加条件的全额退款。另一方面，慷慨的退货政策导致较高的退货率，从而影响商家的利润。因此，一个很重要的问题摆在商家面前：如何制定合理的退货政策从而平衡提高购买率和降低退货率二者之间的矛盾。 退货的产品大多数状况很好，经再次包装后可以作为新产品销售，这样的产品前期退回可以在后期销售。由此带来一个新的问题：在多期销售下，如何制定动态的产品退货政策。相应的，策略型消费者在做决策时，不仅要考虑动态的产品销售价格，还要考虑动态的产品退货价格。特别是退货的产品可以回售时，还直接影响着后期销售的库存。在这样的环境下，商家和消费者之间的博弈显得尤为复杂。 近年来，产品退货策略的研究在市场营销和运作管理领域越来越多。目前的研究主要在以下几个方面：（1） 不存在退货产品回售的情况下，商家如何优化退货政策；（2） 退货的产品低价再次销售。我们的课题是第一个研究前期的退货产品可以在后期作为新产品再次销售的动态退货优化模型。 在我们的模型中，消费者对产品有不同的估值，每个消费者会根据产品的销售价格和可能的退货价格曲线，以及后期购买的获得产品的风险来决定何时购买产品。商家要根据策略型消费者的购买行为调整其退货政策和库存管理决策。我们还将研究不同的市场环境和消费者的特征如何影响商家的动态退货决策，以及评估产品回售的价值。 此课题研究的结果会加强我们对动态管理产品退货和回售的理解，并且丰富了当前有关策略型消费行为对产品退货影响方面的研究。

16207119.label: Realisation of objectives
16207119.value: Motivated by the prevalence of various returns policies in retailing industry, this project studies a monopoly firm’s dynamic return policy with consideration of product resale that may be conducted by the firm itself, or a third-party platform, or even customers themselves. Returned products can be resold at discount via a different channel, or repackaged as new products and resold to customers. Noticing these practices, this project focuses on analyzing the interaction of product returns and product resale under different market conditions. We first consider a scenario where returned products are resold as new items in a later period. The context involves a firm that sells products over two periods to strategic customers who have uncertainty regarding their product valuations prior to making a purchase. The firm determines the prices, refund policy, and stocking quantity at the beginning of the selling season. Customers exhibit strategic behavior by comparing their expected surpluses in both periods and making purchases in the period that yields a higher surplus. Products returned during the first period can be combined with the remaining inventory for resale during the second period. To the best of our knowledge, this study is one of the first to examine the dynamic return policy faced by firms when strategic consumers are present, and product resale is allowed. We characterize the firm’s optimal dynamic return and resale policy under certain conditions, and investigate how resale interacts with strategic consumers and impacts the firm’s pricing and return policy, and overall profit. The firm's optimal policy is heavily dependent on the composition of the market.When high-value consumers, both in terms of valuation and population, outweigh low-value consumers, the firm should exclusively target high-value consumers and refrain from adopting resale. However, when the valuations or sizes of high-value and low-value customers do not differ much, the firm should provide a generous refund to all high-value consumers in the first period and a stricter refund policy to low-value consumers in the second period, potentially not satisfying all of them. In this scenario, all returned products are resold in the second period. We also explore the case where no product sale occurs and compare the firm's profits with and without resale. Our findings indicate that, in general, adopting resale leads to higher profits for the firm. Specifically, the firm benefits more from resale when facing a less differentiated market. Overall, our study sheds light on the firm's optimal return and resale policy, taking into account strategic consumer behavior and market characteristics. Additionally, we analyze the impact of consumers' valuation uncertainty on the firm's return and resale policy. Specifically, we focus on an additive valuation function and conduct numerical investigations to understand how uncertainty affects the firm's selling policy for two types of customers. In general, it is optimal for the firm to offer a generous refund in the first period and a stricter refund policy in the second period. When the valuation uncertainty of high-value consumers is low, the firm's profit decreases as the uncertainty of high-value consumers increases. In this scenario, low-value consumers are prioritized and served in the first period. However, when the valuation uncertainty of high-value consumers is high, the firm benefits from increased uncertainty. As the valuations of high-value consumers become more uncertain, more products are returned, and the firm benefits from both the partial refund and the opportunity to resell these returned products. Overall, our analysis highlights the importance of considering consumers' valuation uncertainty in determining the firm's optimal return and resale policy. However, retailers are not the sole participants in the resale market. An increasing number of consumers are directly reselling their purchased products. The rise of online marketplaces like eBay has made individual consumer resale more convenient. This consumer resale phenomenon has both positive and negative implications for retailers. On one hand, consumer resale provides additional options for consumers to either purchase or resell products. This benefits retailers by increasing consumers' willingness to pay for new products. On the other hand, consumer resale introduces competition and diminishes the retailer's monopoly power in the market. This raises questions about how the existence of consumer resale impacts the retailer's return and resale policy, and whether the retailer is ultimately better off or worse off when consumer resale is present. To address these questions, we examine a two-period model in which the retailer sells products with a return policy. Consumers who purchase products in the first period and find them unsuitable have the option to either return the products by the end of the period or resell them in a marketplace at the beginning of the second period. Consumers who choose to wait will then purchase either resold products from other consumers or new products from the retailer. To investigate the impact of consumer resale on the retailer's optimal return policy, we first analyze a benchmark model where only the retailer is involved in the resale process, and consumers do not have the option to resell. In this scenario, we demonstrate that the retailer consistently benefits from a higher resale value. However, this result no longer holds when both the retailer and consumers have the opportunity to resell. Specifically, if consumers incur lower resale transaction costs compared to the retailer, the retailer will choose not to offer any returns. On the other hand, when the product has a high resale value, the retailer can potentially achieve higher profits compared to a situation where consumer resale is not present. When consumers face higher resale transaction costs than the retailer, the retailer will opt to offer returns for a wider range of product resale values compared to a scenario without consumer resale. Although the retailer offers returns in this case, it may still face challenges due to consumer resale, particularly when the product resale value is moderate. Overall, our analysis highlights that the presence of consumer resale significantly influences the retailer's optimal return policy, with implications for the retailer's profitability and market dynamics.

16207119.label: Major findings and research outcome
16207119.value: We have discovered that when the firm has the ability to resell returned products alongside new ones, it generally achieves higher profits compared to not engaging in product resale. This benefit is more pronounced when the firm operates in a less differentiated market in terms of customer valuations and sizes. Our findings have revealed some interesting insights. Contrary to conventional wisdom, the firm's profit may not always increase with the valuation of high-type consumers. This can occur when there is significant heterogeneity in valuations between high-type and low-type consumers. Additionally, providing more information to customers is not always advantageous. In cases where high-type customers have limited knowledge about the products, it may be more beneficial for the firm to maintain an air of mystery before making the sale. Managers must be mindful of different market conditions and exercise caution when implementing strategies to reduce customer valuation uncertainty. When customers have the ability to resell products independently, the impact on the retailer's profit can vary. Specifically, if the product has a high resale value, the retailer can achieve higher profits compared to a situation without consumer resale. However, if consumers face higher resale transaction costs than the retailer and the product resale value is moderate, the retailer may suffer from consumer resale. Furthermore, we have demonstrated that the retailer's profit may actually decrease as the product resale value increases when both the retailer and consumers have the option to resell. This finding is in contrast to the scenario where only the retailer can resell misfit products, as in that case the retailer consistently benefits from a higher product resale value. Our research has been summarized in the paper "Managing Returns Policy and Product Resale," published in Naval Research Logistics. In addition to this work, we have explored the impact of strategic customer behavior in the case of multi-unit product purchases. We found that multi-unit purchasing behavior can significantly complicate the firm's dynamic pricing policy, as discussed in the paper "Selling Multiple Units to Strategic Consumers," published in Operations Research Letters. Furthermore, we have examined the strategic inventory management within supply chains and identified the manufacturer's strategic rationale for holding inventory, which has important managerial implications. This research is detailed in the paper "Who Carries Strategic Inventory? Manufacturer or Retailer," published in Naval Research Logistics.

16207119.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16207119.value: In our current work, we have assumed a fixed market size to simplify the inventory-related decisions. However, it would be intriguing to explore the impact of an uncertain market size and how it interacts with uncertain valuations, further complicating the firm's return and resale policy. In the model with consumer resale, we have assumed that consumers have a homogeneous value discount on resold products, which aligns with most existing studies on product resale. However, it would be interesting to investigate the model when consumers have heterogeneous value discounts on resold products. Additionally, we could consider incorporating the stock availability of resold products into the analysis. This would provide a more realistic representation of the market dynamics. Furthermore, beyond pricing and refund decisions, the retailer could also make strategic choices regarding its initial stock quantity. By limiting the supply of new products, the retailer can incentivize consumers to purchase new products when resale is not favorable. This aspect could be explored to understand its impact on the retailer's profitability and overall market dynamics. These potential extensions would enrich our understanding of the complexities involved in the retailer's return and resale policy, providing valuable insights for managerial decision-making.

16207119.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16207119.value: This project delves into the impact of returns policies on a monopoly firm's operations in the retail industry. The study takes into account the possibility of product resale through various channels, including the firm itself, third-party platforms, and even customers. Returned products can be sold at a discount through channels such as "open-box" or independently by customers on platforms like eBay. Additionally, some returned products can be repackaged as new and sold alongside new products, particularly for items with labels and tags that were returned due to product misfit. Customers strategically decide when and where to purchase, given these practices. The project analyzes the interaction between product returns, resale, and strategic customer purchasing behavior under different market conditions, providing insights into how the firm should optimally manage its product returns and resale policy.

16207319.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16207319.value: Increasing global energy demand, combined with depleting onshore and shallow water oil/gas reserves, stimulates rapid development of offshore engineering in deep waters, posing unprecedented challenges for offshore geotechnics. Accurate assessment of deformation and bearing capacity of soils that support key offshore infrastructure, including offshore foundations and anchors, is critical to their design and operation. These soils are frequently saturated and directly subjected to large, cyclic or dynamic loads or transferred from supported structures due to strong waves and winds such as hurricanes. Consequently, offshore geotechnical design must tackle three outstanding issues pertaining to these soils: complex loading conditions, complicated soil-water-structure-load interactions, and large soil deformation. All these challenges necessitate developments of advanced soil models and robust numerical modeling techniques. A unified framework that can encapsulate all to provide a comprehensive solution for offshore geotechnics is advantageous but unavailable. This proposal aims to develop an innovative physically based computational multiscale framework to address these challenges for next-generation offshore geotechnical design. The proposed framework features a hierarchical coupling of material point method (MPM) and discrete element method (DEM). The MPM is employed to treat a large deformation boundary value problem (BVP) for granular soils under complex loading conditions, and the DEM solves a meso-scale granular assembly to produce nonlinear, loading history-dependent material response for each material point of MPM. MPM and DEM serve as two-way information-passing engines to communicate between the macro (BVP) and meso (soil assembly) scales for modeling large deformation soil behavior. Hydro-mechanical coupling can be further implemented based on the principle of effective stress. Moreover, MPM is handy to simulate geo-structural components and loads for modeling soil-structure-water-load four-way interactions. The proposed framework will be rigorously benchmarked before application to practical prediction of offshore geotechnical problems. The proposed research offers a general-purpose computational framework enabling rigorous consideration of multiscale, multiphase nature of granular soils and advancing fundamental understanding of critical soil behavior from small strain en route to large deformation regime in the presence of pore water. The framework will provide a tailor-made, new-generation numerical tool for modeling soils relevant to offshore foundations and anchors during their installations and operations, fostering rigorous design of offshore geostructures in shallow/deep waters. The proposed research is relevant to Hong Kong for the future developments of the Great Bay Area and aligns closely with the strategic plans of China and many countries to address energy issues. 全球能源需求的增加，以及陸上和近岸石油/天然氣儲量的減少，促使深水海洋工程的快速發展，同時也給海洋岩土工程帶來了前所未有的挑戰。準確評估重要海洋基礎設施（包括基礎和錨）所在土體的變形和承載能力，對其設計和運行至關重要。海上湧浪和強風也會引起巨大的循環動載荷，通過支撐結構傳遞至海底飽和土體中。海洋岩土工程設計必須解決與這些土體有關的三個突出問題：複雜的荷載條件，複雜的土 - 水 - 結構 - 荷載相互作用以及土體的大變形。這些挑戰都需要研究人員開發先進的土體模型和強大的數值模擬方法。迄今為止還沒有一個統一的框架可以涵蓋這些方面，為海洋岩土工程提供一個全面的解決方案。 本研究旨在開發一個創新性的、基於物理的多尺度計算框架，以應對下一代海洋岩土工程設計所面臨的挑戰。該框架基於物質點法（Material Point Method）和離散元法（Discrete Element Method）的分層多尺度耦合，使用物質點法求解複雜載荷條件下土體的大變形邊界值問題（Boundary Value Problem），而運用離散元法模擬介觀尺度的顆粒代表單元體的變形，以獲得物質點法中每個物質點加載歷史相關的非線性材料力學響應。在計算中，物質點法和離散元法之間進行雙向信息傳遞，使信息可以在宏觀（邊界值問題）和介觀（顆粒組合體）兩個尺度之間進行交換，從而可以模擬土體大變形行為。基於有效應力原理，該多尺度計算框架可進一步實現水-應力耦合問題的模擬。此外，物質點法還可以方便地模擬岩土結構部件和荷載，從而模擬土 - 結構 - 水 - 載荷四向相互作用。在應用於海洋岩土工程的實際問題之前，該框架還將經過嚴格的基準標定測試。 本研究提出的通用計算框架，能夠嚴格考慮顆粒土體的多尺度和多相性質，提升我們對含水土體的臨界行為的基本認識（從小應變階段到的大變形階段）。針對海洋基礎附近土體的分析、錨的放置與維護以及淺水/深水中海洋結構的合理設計，該框架將提供新一代的數值模擬工具。本研究與香港大灣區的未來基建發展密切相關，並與中國及多個國家解決能源問題的戰略計劃緊密契合。

16207319.label: Realisation of objectives
16207319.value: PI Zhao and Co-I Soga have collaborated closely over the project period. All three research objectives proposed in the project have been successfully achieved. Specifically, we have made the following achievements pertaining to the three objectives: (a) Objective 1: We have developed a novel coupled MPM-DEM framework to tackle large deformation problems in geotechnical engineering. The discrete nature of granular media is fully considered by adopting DEM assemblies to faithfully reproduce their nonlinear response under different loading conditions without having to use phenomenological constitutive models. The DEM feeds the continuum domain modeler MPM at each material point with the resolved constitutive responses to find global solutions. We have benchmarked the coupled MPM-DEM and demonstrated its capacities in simulating a wide range of engineering problems as reported in J1, J2, and C1. We have further extended the framework to multiphysics problems involving saturated granular media in large deformation regime. The developed multiphase multiscale framework has been demonstrated to be powerful in capturing both quasi-static and dynamic multiphysics responses in various engineering scenarios. Related works have been reported in J3, J4, C2, C3 and C4. (b) Objective 2: We have extended the multiscale MPM-DEM approach to true 3D modeling and have developed effective and scalable MPI-based parallel computing schemes for implementation in distributed supercomputer. The computational efficiency has been further improved by an innovative thread-block-wise parallelism for DEM assemblies which allows to fully unleash the power of GPU computing. The integrated multiscale framework has been validated by various problems. Related works have been reported in J5. (c) Objective 3: We have further developed an open-source DEM code SudoDEM and a machine learning-enabled DEM code NetDEM for efficient and accurate modelling of irregularly-shaped granular particles. The proposed DEM solvers could be effortlessly incorporated into the MPM-DEM multiscale framework to enhance its functionality and for practical geotechnical predicitons. Relevant works have been reported in J6, J7, and J8.
