16304519.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16304519.value: Nitroxy Organosulfate (NOS) compounds derived from monoterpenes (NOSMT) are molecules produced in the atmosphere incorporating signatures from both anthropogenic pollutants (e.g., SO2, NOx) and organic compound emissions from the nature in the oxidative atmospheric environments. NOSMT are consistently detected in atmospheric environments ranging from remote, rural, forest, suburban to urban environments. Its chemical linkages to both anthroposphere and biosphere make NOSMT potential markers to monitor anthroposphere-biosphere interactions. Despite the ubiquitous presence, their formation mechanisms are unclear due to a lack of available standards for NOSMT compounds and key immediate precursors. An examination of existing laboratory study evidence leads us to propose three immediate precursors to NOSMT, namely diol, epoxide, and hydroxyl nitrate. Our recent advance in synthesizing a series of organosulfates and NOS compounds derived from MT has partially lifted this bottleneck. In this work, we propose to conduct smog chamber experiments to individually test the potential immediate organic precursors in the presence of NO2 and SO2 or acid sulfate seed aerosols. The goal is to test the hypothesized pathways and to obtain NOSMT formation yields. Field samples will also be collected from contrast atmospheric environments in regard to the relevant precursors (MT, SO2, NOx) and key influential physical parameters (relative humidity, temperature). We will also build an aerosol C & N analyzer by integrating an aerosol C analyzer and a NOx analyzer for the determination of total organic nitrogen in chamber samples and field filter samples. The mechanistic understanding of NOSMT formation and quantitative yield data obtained from this project will provide fundamental knowledge in improving modeling the interactions between anthroposphere and biosphere. 在大气中产生的源自单萜烯(MT)的硝基有机硫酸酯化合物(NOS)分子，简称为NOSMT，结合人为源污染物(SO2, NOx)和自然源排放的有机物的化学信息于同一分子结构上。NOSMT无处不在, 从偏远地区，农村，森林地带，郊区到城市的大气环境中，NOSMT都可以被检测到，这类分子与人类圈和生物圈之间的化学关联使其成为监测人类-生物圈之间相互作用的潜在标志物。但由于可用的NOSMT标准样品及主要直接前体物的缺乏，其形成机理并不明确。我们通过对现有实验室研究证据的分析，提出NOSMT可能有三种直接的前体物：二醇化合物(diol)，环氧化合物(epoxide)以及羟基硝酸酯化合物(hydroxyl nitrate)。最近，我们在对源自单萜烯的有机硫酸酯及硝基有机硫酸酯的合成方面取得了进展，部分地解决了上述瓶颈。在本项研究中，我们计划进行烟雾箱实验，在NO2，SO2或酸性硫酸盐气溶胶存在的条件下，对各潜在直接有机前体物进行单独测试，以验证设想的反应路径并获得相应NOSMT的产率。并且，我们将挑选在有关前体物(如MT, SO2, NOx)和关键影响物理参数(如相对湿度，温度)方面反差大的大气环境，采集实际样品来研究NOSMT。我们还将组合气溶胶碳分析仪和NOx分析仪来搭建一台气溶胶碳/氮分析仪，以用于烟雾箱样品和实际滤膜样品中总有机氮含量的测定。本项研究中对NOSMT形成机理的理解以及获得的NOSMT产率的定量数据，将会为今后改善人类和生物圈之间相互作用的模拟提供基本信息。

16304519.label: Realisation of objectives
16304519.value: Objective 1 : Identify the immediate precursors of monoterpene derived nitrooxy OS (NOS) products through conducting chamber experiments of mixing intermediate oxidation products such as diols, epoxides, and hydroxyl nitrates with acidic sulfate seed particles Eight NOS compounds derived from terpenes (denoted NOSTP) were synthesized (Wang et al., 2021). Seven of them are derived from monoterpene precursors, including α-pinene, β-pinene, limonene, and limonaketone. In addition, five hydroxyl nitrates were also synthesized as the intermediate products of our NOS synthesis efforts. Hydroxy nitrates were proposed to be the immediate precursors for NOS, but was never confirmed in chamber experiments due to lack of standards. With the authentic standards created through the synthesis efforts, we were able to directly subject hydroxyl nitrates to controlled chamber experiments to examine their reactivity towards sulfate particles and aerosol liquid water. We conducted a series of chamber experiments, focusing on product observation and identification. In these experiments, -pinene and its related intermediate products (two hydroxy nitrates, -pinene oxide, and -pinenediol) were selected for smog chamber experiments. Both daytime and nighttime chemistry were simulated. We investigated the NOS formation products of a number of perceived immediate precursors to NOS294, namely pinaediol, α-pinene oxide, two α-pinene-derived hydroxy nitrates. Two limonene-derived hydroxyl nitrates were also synthesized and on our list for chamber experiments to investigate their role leading to formation of NOS296. Objective 2: Quantify formation yields of key NOS products and total organic nitrogen from selected monoterpenes. The work aimed at achieving this objective was initially planned as second-phase chamber experiments. Unfortunately, due to the outbreak of COVID-19, our plans for conducting the chamber experiments were severely impacted. Specifically, we faced travel restrictions that prevented us from reaching the chamber facility located in the Guangzhou Institute of Geochemistry. Consequently, this aspect of our work did not progress as originally envisioned at the beginning of the project. To overcome the challenges posed by the travel restrictions to Guangzhou, we initiated a collaboration with Professor Man Nin Chan at the Chinese University of Hong Kong. Our two research groups joined forces and employed an oxidative flow reactor to investigate the chemical transformation kinetics and chemistry of an α-pinene-derived organosulfate (C10H17O5SNa, αpOS-249) under heterogeneous OH oxidation. The findings resulting from this collaborative effort have been documented in a paper published in Atmospheric Chemistry and Physics (Xu et al., 2022). Objective 3: Explore the key factors affecting ambient abundance of monoterpene-derived NOS through analyzing field samples collected from contrast environments of biogenic and anthropogenic emissions China is an important part of the world where emissions of anthropogenic air pollutants (e.g., SO2, NOx, VOCs, and particulate matter (PM)) are large. Due to the abundant availability of relevant precursors (i.e., SO2, sulfate, VOCs, and OM), organosulfates may constitute a significant fraction of SOA in China. Considerable spatial heterogeneities exist from southern to northern China in meteorological parameters, BVOC emissions, sulfur pollution, and nitrate pollution. We have analyzed a set of ambient filter samples collected in two seasons and from 4 locations, including urban sites in Hong Kong (HK, 22°22'18"N, 114° 6'52"E), Guangzhou (GZ, 23°7'55"N, 113°20'36"E), Shanghai (SH, 31°10′N,121°25′E), and a suburban site in Beijing (BJ, 40°13'7"N, 116°14'49"E). The sites span three climatic zones from south to north and differ significantly in degree of anthropogenic pollution and in biogenic emissions, thus forming nice contrasts for our investigation. We employed a combined targeted and untargeted approach using high-performance liquid chromatography-Orbitrap mass spectrometry to quantify/semi-quantify ~200 organosulfates and NOSs. Among them, NOSs derived from monoterpenes totaled ~70 and their combined concentrations were in the range of 1.6-29 ng/m3. The terpenoid NOSs display compound-specific and site-specific seasonal variations, which indicate that their formation is less dependent on biogenic VOCs emission, instead air pollution conditions play a more prominent role. The detailed findings are reported in the paper published in Science of the Total Environment (Wang et al., 2022). Objective 4: Quantify contributions of the monoterpene-derived NOS to the total organic nitrogen in ambient particulate matter We have assembled two versions of aerosol nitrogen analyzer, one for offline analysis (Yu et al., 2021) and one for online field measurements (Li et al., 2022). The instrument adopts a novel approach to achieve simultaneous quantification of inorganic nitrogen (IN) and organic nitrogen (ON) through using programmed thermo-evolution of carbonaceous and nitrogenous aerosols and chemiluminescent detection coupled with multivariate curve resolution (MCR) data treatment. As no sample pretreatment is needed, it is feasible to analyze a large number of samples. We analyzed more than 600 PM2.5 samples from 13 sites along east coastal China, with some samples collected through this project, some from other projects within our research group and others from research collaborators (Yu et al., 2024). Annual average ON concentration was in the range of 0.4-1.4 μg N m-3, representing 17-31% of aerosol total nitrogen. Since the level of monoterpenes-derived NOSs is in the range of ~0.1-1.5 ngN/m3, one can see this group of NOSs only constitutes a very minor fraction (~0.1%) of the total organic nitrogen. Nevertheless, NOSTP are important and useful molecular markers to probe interactions between anthroposphere and biosphere.

16304519.label: Major findings and research outcome
16304519.value: Nitroxy Organosulfate (NOS) compounds derived from monoterpenes (NOSMT) are ubiquitous in the atmospheric environment. In this project we have made significant contributions to filling in knowledge gaps regarding the atmospheric chemistry of this class of secondary organic aerosol compounds. The major findings include: (1) We achieved the first synthesis of eight terpene-derived nitrooxy organosulfates, providing indispensable standards to study this class of multifunctional air pollutants. The availability of these authentic standards has clarified a previous misidentification and revealed the compound-specific propensity of carbon skeleton rearrangements of NOSMT during atmospheric oxidation (Wang et al., 2021). (2) We employed a combined targeted and untargeted approach using high-performance liquid chromatography-Orbitrap mass spectrometry to quantify/semi-quantify ~200 organosulfates and NOSs derived from four types of precursors, namely C2-C3 oxygenated volatile organic compounds (VOCs), isoprene, monoterpenes, and sesquiterpenes, in ambient samples at four locations in China (i.e., Hong Kong, Guangzhou, Shanghai, and Beijing) (Wang et al., 2022). Among them, NOSs derived from monoterpenes totaled ~70 and their combined concentrations were in the range of 1.6-29 ng/m3. The terpenoid NOSs display compound-specific and site-specific seasonal variations, which indicate that their formation is less dependent on biogenic VOCs emission, instead air pollution conditions play a more prominent role. (3) We investigated the chemical transformation kinetics and chemistry of an α-pinene-derived organosulfate (C10H17O5SNa, αpOS-249) through heterogeneous OH oxidation in an oxidation flow reactor (Xu et al., 2022). By monitoring the decay rates of αpOS-249, the effective heterogeneous OH reaction rate was measured and it was inferred αpOS-249 has an atmospheric life time of ~2 weeks. The observations suggest that functionalization reactions are likely the dominant processes and that multigenerational oxidation possibly leads to formation of products with one or two hydroxyl and carbonyl functional groups adding to αpOS-249. (4) We developed two versions of aerosol nitrogen analyzer, one version for off-line analysis of filter samples and one version for continuous online analysis (Yu et al., 2021; Li et al., 2022). The instrument allows sensitive and direct determination of bulk organic nitrogen-content in aerosol samples without any sample pretreatment. The new instrument adds an invaluable tool in quantifying roles of nitrogenous organic aerosol in nitrogen nutrient cycle, toxicological effects, and climate impacts (Yu et al., 2024), as well as analyzing sources of N pollution and evaluating relative significance of individual organic nitrogen compounds such as nitroxy organosulfates (Wang et al., 2022; Yu et al., 2023).

16304519.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16304519.value: This research can be further developed in the following three perspectives. First, oxidation flow reactor (OFR) experiments can be conducted on the newly synthesized nitrooxy organosulfates (OSs). The availability of these authentic standards of multi-functional atmospheric organics provides unique opportunities in expanding our understanding of atmospheric chemistry through controlled experiments. Second, more field measurements can be made for the nitrooxy OSs to provide data for testing and constraining chemical transport models. Third, the synthesis efforts can be expanded to isoprene-derived nitrooxy OSs. Our ambient measurements indicated that isoprene-derived nitrooxy OSs were more abundant than those derived monoterpenes, thus meriting research efforts in studying their transformation chemistry and kinetics.

16304519.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16304519.value: Nitroxy Organosulfate (NOS) compounds derived from monoterpenes (NOSMT) are molecules produced in the atmosphere incorporating signatures from both anthropogenic pollutants (e.g., SO2, NOx) and organic compound emissions from the nature. NOSMT consistently appear in various atmospheric environments, including remote, rural, forest, suburban, and urban environments. Due to their chemical linkages to both anthroposphere and biosphere, NOSMT can serve as potential markers for monitoring anthroposphere-biosphere interactions. We have achieved the first synthesis of eight terpene-derived nitrooxy organosulfates, providing indispensable standards to study this class of multifunctional air pollutants in chamber experiments or flow reactor systems. The availability of these authentic standards has rectified a previous misidentification and revealed the compound-specific propensity of carbon skeleton rearrangements of NOSMT during atmospheric oxidation. Furthermore, aided by this project, we have developed an aerosol nitrogen analyzer, enabling sensitive and direct determination of bulk organic nitrogen-content in aerosol samples without any sample pretreatment. The new instrument adds an invaluable tool in quantifying roles of nitrogenous organic aerosol in nitrogen nutrient cycle, toxicological effects, and climate impacts. It also facilitates the analysis of sources of nitrogen pollution and evaluation of the relative significance of individual organic nitrogen compounds, such as nitrooxy organosulfates.

16304719.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16304719.value: Geometric flows are dynamical systems of geometric shapes, which mathematicians call manifolds. Notable examples include the Ricci flow, the mean curvature flow, and so on. They have been used to resolve a number of important conjectures in geometry and topology in the past decades. Many geometric flows tends to deform an irregular object into a more regular, uniform shape, which enables mathematicians to identify the topological structure of the shape. In the proposed study, the PI and the Co-I will work on the mean curvature flow (and its variants) applied to problems on deforming symplectomorphisms of maps between compact Kahler-Einstein manifolds. The graph of a symplectomorphism between a Kahler-Einstein manifold is a Lagrangian submanifold of the product Kahler-Einstein manifold. Under the mean curvature flow on the graph, the Lagrangian condition is preserved. In the case when the Kahler-Einstein manifold is a compact Riemann surface, the Co-I (and Smoczyk in some cases) has proven that the graph will converge to that of an isometry. Together with Medos, the Co-I has also considered the case where the Kahler-Einstein manifold is the complex projective space with the Fubini-Study metric. They showed that if the symplectomorphism is approximately an isometry, then the mean curvature flow will evolve the graph into one that is actually an isometry. The proposed study is motivated by Medos-Wang's result, and will advance the result by considering (1) various maximum principle arguments, (2) other types of Kahler-Einstein manifolds, and (3) other types of geometric flows. It is expected that the research outcome will give new insight into the symplectomorphism group of Kahler-Einstein manifolds, especially the deformation retract properties of the group. 這個項目旨在研習流形之間的映射圖像在均曲率流下的變化。我們考慮一個凱勒-愛因思坦流形，和他之間的一個辛同胚。這個辛胚的的圖像可以看成是這個凱勒-愛因思坦流形的一個拉格朗日子流形。在均曲率流下，這個圖像能保持為一個辛同胚的映象。現時已知結果是如果這個凱勒-愛因思坦流形是一個複影射空間，和開始時這個辛同胚很接近一個等距映射，那麼在均曲率流之下這個辛同胚會收斂成一個等距映射。我們會在這個項目更深入研究有關問題及對現時結果作推廣，例如我們研究對像會推廣至複影射空間以外的凱勒-愛因思坦流形，又會用均曲率流以外的曲率流去研究同樣及類似問題。

16304719.label: Realisation of objectives
16304719.value: The PI and Co-I have looked at some new geometric quantities that could be improve the results of Medo-Wang's work on the deformation of symplectomorphism between CP^n using Lagrangian Mean Curvature Flow. A lot of tedious computations in Medo-Wang's work could be simplified and became more manageable for further generalization from complex projective space to a wider class of homogeneous Kahler-Einstein manifolds with positive curvature. Some research progress also motivated the PI to consider a related problem on the Kahler-Ricci flow, which is closely related to Lagrangian Mean Curvature Flow. The PI was able to apply some idea obtained from this project on the study of the higher-order deviative estimates of the Kahler-Ricci flow, and obtained a publishable result. Furthermore, the research conducted also prompt the PI to consider a related flow, the harmonic map heat flow, and some ideas will be used to study the deformation problem of maps from CP^m to CP^n (with m > n) and see under what condition will the map deform homotopically to a constant/holomorphic map. This will be a potential new project in the up-coming GRF proposal.

16304819.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16304819.value: Heterocyclic polymers are an important group of advanced functional polymers with unique mechanical, electrical and photophysical properties and wide applications. To date, a variety of polymer systems with five- or six-membered heterocycles have been established and widely studied. However, polymers consisting of readily openable small-ring heterocycles (three- and four-membered rings) have rarely been explored due to their synthetic difficulty. The incorporation of many strained rings in a polymer backbone can endow the corresponding heterocyclic polymers with a variety of new interesting properties and advanced functionalities, such as multiple stimuli-responsiveness and easy chemical modification. Our research group has been actively working on the synthesis of novel functional macromolecules by exploring new acetylenic polymerizations. To date, we have successfully synthesized a large variety of heterocyclic polymers with multifunctionalities based on the reported acetylenic small molecular reactions. Recently, new synthetic strategies toward highly functionalized small-ring heterocycles have been developed. Readily available alkynes, sulfonyl azides and nucleophiles were used as starting materials and these alkyne-based multicomponent reactions were all conducted at room temperature in a one-pot manner to generate small heterocycles in high yields in situ. Considering the mild reaction conditions, simple synthetic and isolation procedures, high atom economy, good functional-group tolerance, and high efficiency of these multicomponent reactions, in this proposed project we aim to develop them into multicomponent acetylenic polymerizations for the synthesis of small heterocycle- containing polymers and investigate their properties and applications. To achieve this goal, a series of functional monomers will be designed and synthesized, and the polymerization conditions will be systematically optimized to generate a variety of small heterocycle-containing polymers with high molecular weights in high yields. Post-modification reactions such as ring-opening and ring-expansion reactions will be carried out on the obtained polymers to generate elaborate heteroatom-rich polymers that are difficult to obtain using other methods. Through the incorporation of different substituents into the monomer structures and the promising post-modification reactions of the obtained strained ring-containing polymers, a library of new polymers with unique structures will be generated. The properties and the underlying structure-property relationships of the polymeric products will be carefully investigated to guide the development of more functional polymeric materials with small heterocycles. Their potential practical applications will also be explored. This project will provide a new platform for the design, synthesis, modification, and functionalization of diverse small heterocycle-containing polymers with potential high-tech applications. 雜環聚合物是重要的先進功能聚合物之一，其具有獨特的機械性能，電性能和光物理性質而被廣泛應用。迄今為止，已有許多具有五元或六元雜環的聚合物體系被建立和廣泛研究。然而，含有易開環的小雜環聚合物（三元和四元環），由於其合成困難而很少被研究過。在聚合物主鏈中引入許多張力環可賦予相應的雜環聚合物更多新奇的特性和先進的功能，例如多重刺激響應性和易化學改性等。 我們課題組一直致力於探索新型的炔烴聚合來合成新型功能性聚合物。迄今為止，基於所報道的炔烴小分子反應，我們已經成功合成了多種具有多功能的雜環聚合物。最近，利用易得的炔烴，磺酰疊氮和親核試劑作為原料，開發出了合成新型具有高性能的小環雜環化合物的方法。這些基於炔烴的多組分反應均在室溫下以一鍋法進行，以高產率原位生成小雜環。考慮到這些多組分反應條件溫和，合成和分離程序簡單，原子經濟性高，良好的功能性耐受性和高效率，在本項目中，我們欲將其發展成多組分炔烴聚合併用於合成小雜環聚合物並研究它們的性質和應用。 為了實現這一目標，將設計和合成一系列功能性單體，並將系統地優化聚合條件以便高產率得到具有高分子量的各種小雜環聚合物。將對所得聚合物進行後修飾反應如開環和擴環反應，以得到難以用其它方法獲得的富含雜原子的複雜聚合物。通過將不同的取代基結合到單體結構中以及對所獲得的含張力環聚合物的後修飾反應，將得到一系列具有獨特結構的新型聚合物。對所得聚合物的性能和構效關係進行仔細研究，以便指導多功能小雜環聚合物材料的開發。我們還將探索其潛在的實際應用。該項目將為各種含小雜環聚合物的設計，合成，改性和功能化提供一個新的平台，具有潛在的高科技應用。

16304819.label: Realisation of objectives
16304819.value: The objective of the present project is to develop new acetylenic polymerization routes for the preparation of heterocycle-containing polymers. We believe through elaborate efforts in the past three years, we have completed all the objectives. Heterocycle-containing polymers are an important group of advanced functional polymers with unique mechanical, electrical and photophysical properties and wide applications in polymer optoelectronics systems, such as polymer photovoltaic cells, field effect transistors and light-emitting diodes. However, they are difficult to synthesize, and their preparations often involve multiple steps, harsh conditions, elaborate controls, and troublesome procedures. On the other hand, multicomponent polymerization (MCP) is a powerful synthetic strategy for preparing functional polymers with complex structures and controlled sequences, and enjoys the advantages of good atom economy, simple procedure, and high efficiency. Attracted by the unique properties of heterocycle-containing polymers and inspired by the advantages of MCP, we aim to develop new polymerization routes and MCPs for the facile construction of these polymers. Their potential applications will be explored as well. In this investigation, we developed a facile multicomponent polymerization route based on the diversity-orientation synthesis to diverse functional polymers with multi-substituted small heterocycles. This strategy enjoys the advantages of readily available monomers, mild conditions, outstanding efficiency, and good tolerance to different functional groups. Because all the alkynes, sulfonyl azides, and Schiff bases can be difunctionalized, all possible monomer combination ways (A2 + B2 + C1, A2 + B1 + C2, and A1 + B2 + C2) can be fully utilized to produce diversified heterocycle-containing polymers with high molecular weights in high yields. The obtained polymers possess distinguished properties such as good stability and stereoselectivity. The tolerance of their four-membered heterocycles to acid and a base was confirmed by DFT calculation. Polymers with tetraphenylethene moieties show strong aggregation-induced emission and can function as promising chemosensors for detecting Pd2+ and Cr2O72–. Simple prototype devices using polymers on solid support for daily detection are also explored. It is expected that the present investigation will promote further research on multicomponent polymerization to construct and expand heterocycle-containing polymers and provides useful guidance to manipulate the properties and functionalities of materials by appropriate structure design. A facile and efficient polyannulation of dual-activated alkyne and pyridines was developed for the first time to construct novel N-heterocycle-containing poly(quinolizine)s. This polymerization can proceed smoothly under catalyst-free conditions with 100% atom utilization and through systematic optimization of the polymerization conditions, soluble and thermally stable poly(quinolizine)s with well-defined structures and high molecular weights (up to 34,100) were obtained in acceptable yields (up to 79%). The resulting polymers show good solubility, high thermal stability, and strong red emission. Those carrying tetraphenylethene moieties exhibit aggregation-induced emission, which are non-emissive or weakly emissive in solutions but become strong emitters when aggregated. Coupled with their low cytotoxicity, these polymers can serve as fluorescent agents to selectively label lysosomes in live cells. Because this new polymerization tool shows the remarkable advantages of readily available raw materials, mild polymerization conditions and atom economy, it will provide enormous opportunities for preparing functional N-heterocycle-containing polymers. The synthesis of functional polymers with complicated structures from handy monomers is an attractive but challenging research topic. In this investigation, we developed an efficient one-pot multi-component polymerization route to poly(tetraarylethene)s (PTAEs) with aggregation-induced emission (AIE) characteristics by an in-situ generation strategy from handy monomers of dihaloarenes, internal diynes, and Grignard reagents. This new polymerization can proceed rapidly in the presence of NiCl2 in a toluene/THF mixture to furnish PTAEs with high molecular weights (Mn up to 16 800) in high yields (up to 93%) in only three hours. The obtained PTAEs show typical AIE characteristics due to the in-situ generated tetraphenylethene units in the polymer backbone. They emit weakly in solutions due to the active intramolecular motions of the TPE units. However, they become highly emissive when aggregated in poor solvent or solid state due to the restriction of such motions. Such a property allows them to serve as efficient fluorescence turn-on chemosensors for picric acid and Ru3+ with amplified sensitivity and enhanced quenching constants. Furthermore, the polymer thin films show modulable refractive indices under UV irradiation in a wide wavelength region of 400–900 nm, presenting great potential in optical fiber applications. Well-resolved 2D fluorescent patterns of PTAEs can be generated by photo-oxidation of their thin films under UV irradiation through a copper photomask. This work thus provides another successful example of an in-situ generation strategy for functional AIE polymers to broaden the scope of the monomer library. We further developed a facile multicomponent polymerization route for the synthesis of processable fluoropolymers with multiple functionalities. The polymerizations of diynes, arylboronic acids and perfluoroalkyl diiodides catalyzed by PdCl2[PPh3]2 and K2CO3 proceed smoothly in THF/H2O mixtures at 39 °C under nitrogen, furnishing fluoropolydienes (FPDs) with predominant E-configuration and high molecular weights (Mw up to 69,400) in satisfactory yields (up to 90.3%) in 12 h. This polymerization route shows high efficiency, great tolerance to moisture, and good atom economy. Most of the FPDs possess good solubility in common organic solvents and could form tough films with good quality by simple techniques such as spin-coating. Because the FPDs contain tetraphenylethene moieties, which are atypical luminogens showing aggregation-induced emission characteristics, in their polymer backbones, they show intense emission in the solid state. As their light emission is sensitive to light irradiation, this allows the generation of well-resolved 2D-photopatterns from their thin films through UV irradiation using copper photomasks. Besides, all the FPDs show excellent thermal stability, showing merely 5% weight loss at temperatures of 283−364 °C. Additionally, their thin films show high refractive indices in a wide wavelength region due to the presence of numerous aromatic rings, heteroatoms, and polarized electrons, they are thus promising functional coating materials for use in various advanced electronic and photonic devices. It is noteworthy that the Co-I has provided manpower support for this project. Thus, lesser staffing cost has been used and more expenses go to General Expenses in 4.2. Such a change does not affect the project objectives and achievements.

16304819.label: Major findings and research outcome
16304819.value: Heterocycle-containing polymers have received consistent academic and industrial interest for their outstanding thermomechanical, dielectric, and optical properties. Particularly those with small heterocycles as they are indispensable in organic synthetic chemistry due to their unique ring-strained structures and distinguished properties such as clusteroluminescence and special stimuli-responsiveness. However, they are difficult to prepare. In this investigation, we have developed new methodologies for their synthesis. They are (i) Cu(I)-catalyzed multi-component polymerizations of (di)alkynes, (di)sulfonyl azides, and (di)Schiff bases to four -membered azetidine-containing polymers, (ii) metal-free polyannulations of dual-activated dialkynes and pyridines to N-heterocycle-containing poly(quinolizine)s, (iii) Ni(II)-catalyzed one-pot multi-component polymerizations of dihaloarenes, internal diynes, and Grignard reagents to poly(tetraarylethene)s, and (iv) Pd(II)-catalyzed polymerizations of dialkynes, arylboronic acids and perfluoroalkyl diiodides to fluoropolydienes. These methods enjoy the advantages of readily available monomers, wide monomer scope, simple operation, high efficiency, mild polymerization conditions, high atom economy, high tolerance to functional groups, facile construction of complex structures, etc. Different monomer combinations can be utilized to afford diverse products with novel structures and functionalities. Most of the polymers are produced in high yields with high molecular weights. They are processable and are soluble in common organic solvents. Additionally, they show high thermal stability, good-filming ability, and high refractive index. Some of them even show strong light emission in the solid state. All these properties make them find high-technological applications such as fluorescent chemosensors for explosives and metal ions, fluorescent photopatterning, visualizing agents for bioimaging, coating materials, optical fibers, etc. As you can see in part C of this report, 11 publications have arisen from this research project. Most of the papers are published in journal articles with high impact factors. We are confident that further research in this field will lead to more fruitful results.

16304819.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16304819.value: Functional polymers play an important role in different aspects of our life and the preparation of these polymers relies on the development of new polymerization methods. Among various functional polymers, heterocycle-containing polymers have attracted much attention for their unique photophysical, electrochemical, and mechanical properties and potential high-tech applications in various fields. selectivity. Unfortunately, they are hard to synthesize, and their preparations often involve multiple steps, harsh conditions, and troublesome procedures. In this investigation, we developed new polymerization routes for their synthesis using alkyne monomers. These methods show many advantages such as readily available monomers, wide monomer scope, simple operation, high efficiency, mild polymerization conditions, high atom economy, functional group tolerance, etc. Polymers with different structures and functionalities are obtained by using different monomer combinations. The obtained polymers are soluble, thermally stable and film-forming. They exhibit unique materials properties that are not found in commodity polymers such as poly(methyl methacrylate), making them promising candidates for high-tech applications. Thus, although the project completion date has passed, we are still working on the exploration of new systems. If we can get further support from RGC, we will hire experts to commercialize our results.

16304819.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16304819.value: Heterocycle-containing polymers show unique properties and have found potential high-tech applications in many fields. However, they are difficult to prepare. Thus, the development of efficient methodologies for their synthesis has both academic importance and application implication. In this investigation, we developed new polymerization routes for their synthesis. These methods show many advantages such as readily available monomers, wide monomer scope, simple operation, high efficiency, mild polymerization conditions, etc. All the polymers are produced in high yields with high molecular weights. They are soluble and film-forming. They exhibit unique properties and can be potentially applied as fluorescent chemosensors for explosives and metal ions, visualizing agents for bioimaging, etc. The present results are expected to bring new inspiration to polymer chemistry, and the fascinating functionalities of the obtained polymers will promote further research on the design, modification, and applications of functional polymer materials.

16305019.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16305019.value: Based on their conductivity, materials can be classified as metals or insulators. A metal can conduct electrons by states at the Fermi level, while an insulator cannot since there is a finite gap between conduction bands and valence bands. A topological nontrivial material is like a composite system, which has gapped insulating bulk states but gapless conducting boundary states. Moreover, such boundary states are protected by the nontrivial topology of bulk states and are robust against local perturbations around the boundary. Topology was first used to describe the quantum Hall state (QHS) discovered in the 1980s. For a long time, researchers believed that topological systems were rare because the QHS usually required low temperature and strong magnetic fields. In 2005, researchers realized that one could define new topological phases by combining topology and symmetry, which dramatically accelerated the exploration of topological phases. Since then, many topological phases like quantum spin Hall insulators (QSHIs), quantum anomalous Hall insulators (QAHIs) in two dimensions and topological insulators, topological crystalline insulators (TCIs), topological semimetals (TSMs) in three dimensions have been realized experimentally. Among the proposed topological systems, antiperovskites possess high cubic symmetry, which makes them ideal systems to realize various crystalline-symmetry-protected topological phases including TCIs (Ca3BiN) and TSMs (Ca3PbO/Cu3PbN). In particular, the PI and his collaborators found that antiperovskites could host generalized high dimensional spin-3/2 Dirac fermions, which are origins of various topological phases. Most studies have focused on bulk states, with very few investigating surfaces, thin films and heterostructures, where the confinement effect would severely modify their electronic and magnetic properties, and offer great opportunities for many novel phenomena and applications. In this proposal, we aim to study comprehensively the confinement effect on topological nontrivial antiperovskites by using surface, thin film and heterostructure geometries. We will first review recent theoretical and experimental developments, and find suitable theoretical methods and corresponding parameters for particular topological nontrivial antiperovskites. Then we will elaborately study the novel properties of surface states by considering different orientations, surface terminations, reconstructions, etc., which will allow us to directly compare experimental measurements with theoretical results. With these solid calculations, we will study thin films and design appropriate heterostructures for the desired properties like QSHIs and QAHIs. This project will increase our understanding of antiperovskites, particularly their properties under different confinements. It will also provide suitable material platforms for studying topological phases and the interplay between topological phases and other collective phenomena. 根據導電性，材料可以分為金屬和絕緣體。金屬可以通過費米能附近的電子態傳導電子，然而由於導帶與價帶中間能隙的存在，絕緣體並不能。拓撲非平庸的材料像是壹個復合的系統，其內部是有能隙從而絕緣的，但是其表面或者邊緣卻是無能隙並且導電的。另外，這種邊緣導電態是由體態的非平庸拓撲性質保護的，並不受在邊緣附近的局域微擾的影響。 在上世紀80年代，拓撲概念被第壹次用來描述量子霍爾態（QHS）。在很長壹段時間內，研究人員認為具有拓撲態的體系是很少見的，因為通常實現QHS要求極低溫和強磁場。在2005年，研究人員意識到將拓撲和對稱性結合起來可以定義新的拓撲態，這極大加速了對拓撲態的深入研究。之後，許多拓撲態比如：二維體系中的量子自旋霍爾絕緣體（QSHIs）和量子反常霍爾絕緣體（QAHIs）以及三維體系中的拓撲絕緣體、拓撲晶體絕緣體（TCIs）和拓撲半金屬（TSMs）都已經在實驗上實現了。 在目前提出的拓撲體系中，反鈣鈦礦材料擁有很高的立方對稱性，這使得它成為壹個實現多種晶體對稱性保護拓撲相包括TCIs（Ca3BiN）和TSMs(Ca3PbO/Cu3PbN)的理想體系。特別是，項目申請人和他的合作者發現反鈣鈦礦材料可以實現高維自旋-3/2的狄拉克費米子，這是許多拓撲相的起源。目前關於反鈣鈦礦材料的大部分研究集中在體態上，只有很少部分研究涉及到表面態、薄膜和異質結，其中的量子限制效應可以極大改變材料的電子和磁學性質，更有利於產生許多新奇現象及可能的應用。 在本項目中，我們的目標是通過表面態、薄膜和異質結結構來全面研究量子限制效應對拓撲非平庸反鈣鈦礦材料的影響。首先，我們將會對近年來這壹領域的理論和實驗發展進行調研，並找到適用於特定拓撲非平庸反鈣鈦礦材料的理論研究方法和對應參數。接著我們將考慮表面的不同去向、表面形貌和重構等仔細研究表面態的新奇性質，從而使得我們可以將理論結果和實驗測量結果直接比較。結合這些可靠的計算結果，我們將研究薄膜的性質，並設計可以實現如QSHIs和QAHIs等期待性質的異質結。 本項目將增加我們對反鈣鈦礦材料尤其是其在不同限域下的性質的理解，也能為研究拓撲相和拓撲相與其它集體現象之間的相互影響提供壹個合適的材料平臺。

16305019.label: Realisation of objectives
16305019.value: All the proposed objectives have been full realized. By combing first-principles calculations with tight-binding methods, we have systematically studied the surface states of topological nontrivial antiperovskites with different orientations, terminations, and possible reconstructions, and we proposed a promising candidate Sr3PbO with novel topological states and high experimental feasibility. We found that Sr3PbO exhibits a topological crystalline insulator (TCI) phase in its three-dimensional (3D) bulk lattice, and a quantum spin Hall insulator (QSHI) phase in its two-dimensional (2D) thin film, presenting a picture of evolution from 3D TCI to 2D QSHI. Moreover, the topological phase transition between QSHI and trivial phases occurs as the thickness of the thin-film Sr3PbO varies. Our low-energy effective model further shows that these intriguing phenomena are due to the confinement effect, which are very general and independent of computational details [Phys. Rev. B 108, 155139 (2023)].

16305019.label: Major findings and research outcome
16305019.value: The major findings of this project are the clear demonstration of quantum confinement effect and the corresponding novel properties of surfaces and thin films of antiperovskite TCIs. We found that the antiperovskites TCIs can host both topological trivial and nontrivial surface states depending on the different terminations, and its thin films can realize both two-dimensional TCIs and quantum spin Hall insulators depending on the orientation. Based on our first-principles calculations, we have also proposed a promising candidate Sr3PbO with novel topological states and high experimental feasibility [Phys. Rev. B 108, 155139 (2023)]. Besides the proposed objectives, this project has also enabled us to the novel anomalous Nernst Effect in an antiperovskite antiferromagnet that originated from the topological Weyl points [Phys. Rev. Applied 18, 024007 (2022)] and to fabricate the hybrid Fe-Cl layered double perovskites. In addition, this project has also helped me explore novel properties of other systems including 1T' and 2H two-dimensional materials [Adv. Mater. 33, 2004930 (2021); Phys. Rev. B 104, 035156 (2021); Chin. Phys. Lett. 38, 057301(2021); Natl. Sci. Open 2, 20220033 (2023)], kagome metal Fe3Sn2[Phys. Rev. B 105, 035107 (2022)], antiferromagnets [Nat. Commun. 12, 2846 (2021)], etc.

16305019.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16305019.value: We will continue to explore other novel properties of antiperovskite TCIs and search for real material candidates to realize these novel properties.

16305019.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16305019.value: Topological materials hold great potential in quantum electronic devices with low heat dissipation and power consumption due to the symmetry protected gapless surface/edge states inside the bulk gap which are robust against elastic backscattering and localization. In addition to individual topological phases, topological phase transition between different topological phases has also attracted enormous interests. However, only very few predictions were confirmed in experiments, especially for the gapped topological matters such as topological crystalline insulators (TCIs) and quantum spin Hall insulators (QSHIs). Moreover, the study of the crossover from bulk materials to their thin film counterparts is even fewer, while it is very important to study the nontrivial topological phases in real materials and is so far not realized in any experiments. Our work not only predicted multiple topological phases in Sr3PbO, but mainly focuses on the topological phase transition from its bulk to thin films and considered all the potential difficulties in the experimental realizations, which distinguishes our work from many other hypothetical works and make it particularly interesting.

16305119.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16305119.value: Understanding how two chemical fragments interact with each other based on their electronic structures is of fundamental importance in chemistry. Recently, on the basis of the principal component analysis, we have developed a novel framework, called principal interacting orbital (PIO) analysis, allowing us to precisely delineate detailed chemical interactions between two chemical fragments in a chemically intuitive manner. The novel framework quickly identifies the “dominant interacting orbitals” that can be visualized as PIOs, which are semi-localized and easily interpretable. We anticipate that the PIO method will be popularly applied to various chemical systems to unravel their chemical interactions and obtain in-depth chemical insights. Thus, in this proposed project, we aim to expand the application of PIO to various complex chemical systems for the first time, with the goal of putting the newly HKUST-developed PIO method on the map. 在化學中, 瞭解兩個化學碎片如何基於其電子結構相互作用至關重要。 最近, 利用主成分分析, 我們發展了一個新的理論框架, 稱為主體軌道相互作用分析方法。這方法使我們能夠精確詳細地研究兩個化學片段之間的化學相互作用。同時给出化學上直觀的成键圖像。可以預計主體軌道相互作用分析方法將普遍應用於各種化學體系。因此, 在這個研究項目中, 我們計劃將這方法的應用擴展至各種複雜化學體系, 以期將普及我們香港科大自己新開發的主體軌道相互作用分析方法。

16305219.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16305219.value: 希格斯玻色子主要與自然界中的兩個謎團有關。第一個是為什麼弱力的載體有質量，而電磁力的載體 （光子）卻是無質量的，既然兩者同為基本相互作用。另一個難題則涉及由電子和質子組成的氫原子。理論上電子更有可能是無質量，以光速移動的粒子，以至於不能被質子捕獲形成氫原子。在這種情況下，我們所看到的宇宙中的天​體物理演化永遠不會發生。 在20世紀60年代，物理學家意識到這兩個謎團可以通過“希格斯機制”同時解決。特別是，彼得 希格斯指出，實現這種機制會產生一個殘餘粒子 - 希格斯玻色子。從那時起，在實驗中尋找希格斯玻色子就成為了粒子物理學家的主要任務之一。在該理論預測大約半個世紀之后的2012年，希格斯玻色子在歐洲核子研究中心的大型強子對撞機（LHC）上終於被發現。 然而，標準模型 - 希格斯機制的最小實現 - 並不完美。 它無法解決其他的已知難題。例如，在標準模型中，理論上激活希格斯機制的可能性微乎其微。此外，我們需要標準模型之外的新物理來解決一些宇宙謎題，例如為什麼今天的宇宙中的物質多於反物質。這種不對稱性對於化學中輕元素的形成以及宇宙中天體物理學對象的隨後演化及其重要。目前所提出的解決方案通常要求希格斯特性不同於其在標準模型中的預言。因此，希格斯玻色子可以作為探索這些謎團的有力工具。 實驗發展為研究希格斯物理提供了新的機會。 2018年，LHC的Run II計劃的數據收集工作順利完成。 LHC的Run III計劃將在2020年至2022年之間進行，這一期間與擬議的資助期大致重疊。同樣在2018年，ACME合作發布了電子電偶極矩（EDM）的新的測量結果。其精度前所未有。而在宇宙學前沿，PLANCK合作組也發布了新的結果。 根據這些以及隨后的實驗進展，PI將使用多交叉的方法探索希格斯物理。自從博士研究以來，PI就一直在研究希格斯物理。他認為，他的經驗對於成功實現擬議的研究目標非常有價值。

16305219.label: Realisation of objectives
16305219.value: Objective 1: we completed one paper to address this objective (see paper No. 4). It is a challenging task to measure Higgs physics (including the Higgs self-interaction) precisely at the Large Hadron Collider where jet identification is extensively involved. To improve jet identification, we developed a new strategy by applying a tool of computational topology dubbed persistent homology to characterize topological structure of QCD jets (gluon jet, light-quark jet) and heavy jets (Higgs jet, top jet, etc.). These topological invariants measure multiplicity and connectivity of jet branches at a given scale threshold, while their persistence records the evolution of each topological feature as this threshold varies. With these messages, we show that the efficiency of jet identification can be improved and hence benefit the collider measurements of Higgs properties in a broad context. Objective 2: We completed two papers to address this objective (see papers No. 1 and No. 2). The astronomical and cosmological observations also provide a window to look into Higgs physics, as the Higgs physics may have contributed to the events of early Universe or significantly influenced its evolution. For example, while most observations are consistent with the predictions from the standard LamdaCDM model, a series of puzzles still can not be explained such as 7Li problem in Big-Bang nucleosynthesis, Hubble tension (a significant discrepancy between the determinations of Hubble constant between the CMB data and the local distance-redshift measurements), the clus- tering S8 tension with the weak-lensing data, and isotropic cosmic birefringence anomaly in CMB. To explore the potential role played by Higgs physics, in this project we have developed a model - "axi-Higgs" to simultaneously address these puzzles, by coupling an ultralight axion to the Higgs field. This study essentially demonstrates how the evolution of Higgs VEV intertwines with cosmic events, which conversely can advance our understanding on Higgs physics and the underlying fundamental theory. The two papers based on this study were published in JCAP and PRR respectively. Objective 3: We completed one papers to address this objective (see paper No. 3). In 2022, the CDF Collaboration at the Tevatron reported an anomaly on the W-boson mass. A significant discrepancy between the direct measurement and the SM prediction was observed. If physics beyond the SM causes this anomaly, it may also leave some imprints in Higgs physics. Motivated by such a consideration, we performed a study in the SM effective field theory (SMEFT). By fitting to the data, we found that this anomaly could be explained with a specific Higgs operator, where the new physics scale should be multiple TeV for tree-level effects and sub-TeV for loop-level effects. This message is highly instructive for the further explorations of underlying physics. The paper based on this study was published in PRD.

16305219.label: Major findings and research outcome
16305219.value: Firstly, we introduced persistent homology, a powerful tool of computational topology, to characterize topological structure of QCD jets (gluon jet, light-quark jet) and heavy jets (Higgs jet, top jet, etc.) for collider data analysis (see paper No. 4). These topological invariants measure multiplicity and connectivity of jet branches at a given scale threshold, while their persistence records the evolution of each topological feature as this threshold varies. This topological method opens a new angle to look into jet physics, and particularly, provides a class of novel observables for jet measurements at colliders. Secondly, we have explored the potential correlation between Higgs physics and a series of cosmological puzzles such as 7Li problem in Big-Bang nucleosynthesis, Hubble tension (a significant discrepancy between the determinations of Hubble constant between the CMB data and the local distance-redshift measurements), the clustering S8 tension with the weak-lensing data, and isotropic cosmic birefringence (ICB) anomaly in CMB. In this study (see papers No. 1 and 2), we found that all of these cosmic puzzles could be addressed in a model - "axion-Higgs" that we have constructed by coupling an ultralight axion to the Higgs field. Particularly, the non-standard evolution of Higgs VEV in the early Universe may yield relatively fewer 7Li relic abundance and meanwhile a larger Hubble constant for the Universe today, compared to the standard LambdaCDM model. The 7Li puzzle and the Hubble tension then get greatly reduced. Moreover, the super-long de Broglie wavelength of this axion and its parity-violating coupling with photons allow the S8 tension and the ICB anomaly to be explained simultaneously. More recently, the CDF Collaboration at the Tevatron reported a significant discrepancy between the direct measurement of the W-boson mass and its Standard Model (SM) prediction based on electroweak precision tests (EWPTs). Motivated by this measurement, we performed a study to explore its potential origin from beyond-the-SM physics (see paper No. 3). Explicitly, we worked in the SM effective field theory (SMEFT). By fitting to the data, we demonstrated that an upward shift in W-boson mass is driven by some specific Higgs operator in the SMEFT, and found that the new physics scale favored by the CDF data should be multiple TeV for tree-level effects and sub-TeV for loop-level effects. We also study the potential to further test the relevant SMEFT by measuring Higgs-coupling, mW, and other EWPTs at future circular e−e+ colliders.

16305219.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16305219.value: Based on this completed project, the PI can see two directions for future exploration. Firstly, one can continue to develop new strategies for Higgs measurements at LHC. It is known to be highly challenging to measure the Higgs properties at hadron colliders. But, before a Higgs factory which has been proposed by several parties starts to operate, one should explore the potential of the LHC as much as possible. Secondly, astronomical and cosmological observations are expected to generate a large amount of new data within next years. To draw a full picture on Higgs boson might greatly benefit from a synergization of these observations and collider measurements.

16305219.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16305219.value: While the Higgs boson, usually called ``God Particle'', has been discovered for more than ten years by scientists, our knowledge on its properties and also impacts on cosmic evolution is still very few. The collider measurements and astronomical/cosmological observations provide a great opportunity to examine these aspects. In this project we have performed the studies in three main directions. Firstly, we have introduced persistent homology, a powerful tool of computational topology, to identify QCD jets (gluon jet, light-quark jet) and heavy jets (Higgs jet, top jet, etc.) which potentially can assist the collider measurements of Higgs physics. Secondly, we have explored the implications of the recent measurement of W boson mass, which was found to be inconsistent with its theoretical prediction, on the relevant Higgs physics. Thirdly, we have explored the potential influences of Higgs physics on a series of cosmic events in a model - ``axion-Higgs'' that we developed and named. These explorations greatly improved our knowledge on Higgs physics and also laid a foundation of next-step explorations.

16305419.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16305419.value: Wave imaging techniques such as optical microscopy play a fundamental role in increasing our understanding of microscopic objects such as living cells, proteins, and nanomaterials. In 1873, the microscopist Abbe discovered that there was a fundamental limit to the resolution of conventional microscopy, such that features smaller than half the wavelength of radiation cannot be discerned. As a result, conventional microscopy cannot distinguish features smaller than 250 nm. This fundamental limit to resolution not only applies to optical imaging, but also to other wave-based imaging techniques such as ultrasound and microwave imaging. Thus, breaking this resolution limit to achieve so called super-resolution is of vital importance to many scientists. Ever since Abbe made his discovery, physicists and engineers have proposed various super-resolution techniques. Notably, in 2014, the Noble prize in chemistry was awarded to three scientists for their invention of stimulated emission depletion microscopy and single-molecule microscopy, both of which can achieve super-resolution at an unprecedented scale of several nanometers. In the proposed study, the PI will propose a new super-resolution technique and investigate its performance through mathematical modeling, analysis, and numerical experiments. The technique will draw on ideas from structured illumination microscopy and the recently developed mathematical theory of super-focusing by using subwavelength resonators. Using ultrasound as an example, the PI will demonstrate the proposed technique by considering the scattering produced by a sound hard slab with an array of subwavelength hole structures, and show that these structures can generate subwavelength resonances. These resonances will be used to generate illumination patterns with subwavelength structures. These patterns, in turn, will be able to be easily tuned by changing the illumination frequency from one resonant frequency to another. For each illumination pattern, a resolution limited image will be obtained by mixing the spatial frequency information of the sample to be imaged and that of the illumination pattern. A high resolution image can then be obtained by combining these low resolution images using optimization and super-focusing based approaches. Overall, we expect that the results of the proposed study will stimulate subsequent physical experiments and generalizations to other wave imaging methods. 能夠辨別超出衍射極限的小特徵的超分辨率成像在許多科學研究領域， 比如生命科學，醫學成像和材料科學中具有根本的重要性。自從阿貝發現普通光學顯微鏡的分辨率極限以來，物理學家和工程師一直在努力發明各種超分辨率技術。 這當中最成功的例子要數受激發射耗盡顯微鏡和單分子顯微鏡。這兩者都可以實現幾個納米尺度上的超分辨率。雖然現時超分辨率成像技術廣泛應用於實際，其在成像速度和效率上仍需改善和提高。人們期待在未來的超分辨率技術中能夠實現以納米尺度上的活細胞的實時成像。 在此背景下，擬議的研究將研究一種新的超分辨率技術。該技術借鑒結構照明顯微鏡和最近研發的使用亞波長諧振器實現超聚焦的數學理論。該技術不會涉及耗時的掃描過程，而且易於操作實行。預計擬議的結果將激發後續的物理實驗和在其他波成像方法上推廣。

16305419.label: Realisation of objectives
16305419.value: We investigated a superresolution imaging approach by using subwavelength hole resonances using mathematical modeling, analysis, and numerical experiments. Specifically, we employ a subwavelength structure in which an array of tiny holes are etched in a metallic slab with a neighboring distance L that is smaller than half of the wavelength. We derived the asymptotic expansion of the resonances of the couple hole structure using a layer potential formulation and the Gohberg-Sigal theory. Numerically, we used high-order numerical discretization of the integral operators to compute the resonances and their associated resonant modes. To speed up the computation, we deployed a combination of the Nystrom scheme for singular kernels, a contour integration approach for the layered Green function, and a Kummer transform acceleration strategy for the evaluation of the series in Green’s function. The numerical method proposed work well in both the weak coupling and strong coupling regime. We were able to show that the resonant modes oscillate on subwavelength scales, and can thus be used to generate strong illumination patterns that are able to probe both low and high-spatial-frequency components of the imaging sample sitting above the structure. The image of the sample is obtained by performing numerical reconstruction from the far-field measurement of the diffracted wave. Two numerical algorithms are used to reconstruct the sample image. One is the gradient-descent regularization method, which yields smooth reconstruction profiles. The other is the total variation regularization, which allows for rougher reconstructed profiles and can capture the sharp edges in the image. An efficient split Bregman iteration is employed to solve the corresponding minimization problem. Both algorithms are computationally inexpensive due to their low complexity. It is demonstrated that a resolution of L/2 can be obtained for reconstructed images, thus one can achieve superresolution by arranging multiple holes within one wavelength. We also tested the super-focusing approach which uses a properly designed linear combination of resonant modes to focus the illumination pattern onto a single point source and then localize its position. We found that this approach is time-consuming, and moreover, the numerical results did not show improvement over the previous two methods. Finally, I want to point out that the project was carried out mostly during the pandemic. As a result, most of the funding was used to support PG students since it is impossible to travel outside HK for conferences or other academic activities.

16305419.label: Major findings and research outcome
16305419.value: 1. In the published work [Superresolution Imaging via Subwavelength Hole Resonances], we demonstrated that a resolution of L/2 can be obtained for reconstructed images if the neighboring hole array has a separation distance of L, and thus one can achieve superresolution by arranging multiple holes within one wavelength. The approach developed attains two advantages that are important for practical realization. It avoids the difficulty of controlling the distance between the probe and the sample surface with high precision. In addition, the numerical reconstructed images are very stable against noise by only using the low-frequency band of the far-field data in the numerical reconstruction. 2. In the published work [A Theory of Computational Resolution Limit for Line Spectral Estimation], we introduce and quantitatively characterize the two resolution limits for the line spectral estimation problem under deterministic noise: one is the minimum separation distance between the line spectra that is required for exact detection of their number, and the other is the minimum separation distance between the line spectra that is required for a stable recovery of their supports. The quantitative results imply a phase transition phenomenon in each of the two recovery problems, and also the subtle difference between the two. We further propose a sweeping singular-value-thresholding algorithm for the number detection problem. 3. In the published work [A mathematical theory of the computational resolution limit in one dimension], we developed a mathematical theory for the deconvolution problem in one dimension. The theory addresses the problem when the source number can be recovered exactly from noisy data. The key component is a new concept called the “computational resolution limit,” which is defined as the minimum separation distance between the sources such that exact recovery of the source number is possible. Quantitative bounds for this limit are derived, and they demonstrate the importance of the sparsity and signal-to-noise ratio for the recovery problem. The stability of recovering the source positions is also analyzed under a condition on their separation distances.

16305419.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16305419.value: The proposed imaging approach in [Superresolution Imaging via Subwavelength Hole Resonances] allows for a very high lateral resolution in the sample plane. However, it can not improve the axial resolution. This is because the highly oscillatory transmitted fields through the subwavelength structures are localized near the slit holes due to their evanescent nature, and they can not propagate very deep to probe the sample in the axial direction. The improvement of the resolution in the axial direction is a very challenging problem and deserves further research efforts. On the other hand, we modeled the metallic slab by using perfect conductors. This may not be a good approximation in the optical regime, where one should use the Drude model instead. The resonances may be affected due to the skin effect, and so was the super-resolution ability of the imaging method. These issues may be investigated in future work using new mathematical models and formulations.

16305419.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16305419.value: We investigated a superresolution imaging approach using subwavelength hole structures. The developed approach may find applications in microscopies as well as wave-based imaging such as electromagnetic and ultrasound imaging. We performed a detailed study of the approach using mathematical modeling, analysis, and numerical experiments. The results from the project clearly demonstrated the feasibility of the proposed approach. We showed that one can achieve superresolution imaging by using subwavelength hole structures. The results obtained built a solid fundamental for the proposed imaging method and paved the way for subsequent physical experiment validation.

16305619.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16305619.value: 群的概念定量地描述了视觉对称性，但它也包含了超越形状的对称性的抽象概念。 在数学中，对称性的研究被系统化并形式化为表示理论。 半单代数群和它们的无限维推广，圈群和Kac-Moody群， 是最重要的群之一。 在之前的GRF资助项目中，我们获得了以下结果：（1）我们构造了在局部域圈辛群的Weil表示，并证明Weil表示的theta涵子的模不变性。 （2）我们证明了圈辛群的Siegel-Weil。 （3）我们研究了圈辛群的theta提升，并证明了圈辛群的尖点自守形的存在，并证明了Rallis的常数公式。 该项目将继续研究圈群自守形theta提升。 我们建议研究提升的非消失特性，研究Hecke代数对提升的作用。

16305619.label: Realisation of objectives
16305619.value: We have realized all the objectives of this proposal, although the exact formulation of the results are slightly different. In this project we constructed a family of representations of certain central extension of loop SL(n) over real field. This family is parametrized by the characters of the multiplicative group. Our construction can be interpreted loosely as an affine analog of the theta correspondence for the dual pair GL(1) and GL(n). This work can be also understood as a minimal representation a loop group. The second result of this project is the theta lifting for loop groups. The method of theta lifting between finite dimensional reductive dual pairs via Weil representations provides a very useful tool and has wide applications in representation theory and automorphic forms. Our work for theta lifting is a pioneering work. In the global theory, one considers the lifting of an irreducible automorphic cuspidal representation of a classical group G to a Witt tower G'(n) such that (G,G'(n)) form a family of reductive dual pairs. Here n stands for the split rank, and the groups (G, G'(n)) sometimes are metaplectic covering groups. S. Rallis proved the tower property of the theta lift. One can deduce several important consequences from the tower property, such as that the first occurrence of the theta liftings is cuspidal while the latter occurrences are never cuspidal, and moreover the theta lifting has an involution property. These properties are now generalized to loop group orthogonal to symplectic theta lift. The generalization of these results are highly non-trivial, we need to overcome several difficulties duo infinite dimensionality.

Rallis to the loop setting. 3. we obtain cusp forms on loop groups by theta lifting. We give the first example where the cusp forms constructed using this method are nonvanishing. Our results on construction of representations of loop GL(n) is published in "Algebra and Representation theory". Our results on theta lifting of loop groups is publish on "Duke Mathematical Journal", see Part C of this report.

16305619.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16305619.value: 1. The method used in this project can be further extended to obtain more results in future. 2. The construction of minimal representations for finite dimensional groups is well-known theme in representation theory. It starts with a coadjoint orbit. In our construction of representations of loop groups, the orbits do not appear. It would be interesting to generalize the orbit construction of finite dimensional groups to loop groups and compare it with our method. 3. Our proof of the existence of cusp automorphic forms on loop groups suggest a further problem: explicit construction of such an automorphic that is also a Hecke eigenform.

16305619.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16305619.value: Loop groups is an important family of infinite dimensional groups, we prove important results about automorphic forms on such groups: (1) we construct a family of representations of loop GL(n) (2) we prove important results of Rallis about towers of lifting can be extended to loop groups. (3) we prove the existence of cup forms for loop groups. These results are notable advancement of the subject.

16305819.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16305819.value: Topology optimization has become an effective design tool for obtaining efficient structures and has attracted a large amount of attention from both engineers and mathematicians. Numerous studies have demonstrated that greater savings could be achieved if selected an appropriate layout at a very early stage of the industrial design. However, despite that great advances have been made in the field of optimal shape design methods for fluid dynamic, and many approaches have been introduced and applied to a broad range of design problems, it is only in recent years that topological optimization has been developed and used in fluid design problems. The threshold dynamics method is a powerful and efficient method for tracking boundaries of the domains. It has been applied successfully to optimization problems in image segmentation and interface problems. In this proposal, we propose to develop an efficient threshold dynamics method for the topology optimization for the fluid design in both two and three dimensions. The properties and efficiency of the proposed method will also studied. 拓扑优化已经成为获得高效结构的有效设计工具，并且吸引了大量工程师和数学家的关注程度。大量研究表明，如果在工业设计的早期阶段选择拓扑优化可以节省更多成本。虽然在流体动力学的最佳形状设计方法领域已经取得了进展，并且已经有许多方法 介绍并应用于广泛的设计问题，它只是在最近几年拓扑优化才被用于流体设计问题。阈值动力学方法是一种强大而有效的跟踪域边界的方法。它已成功应用于图像分割和界面问题的优化问题。在这项拟议的研究中，我们将开发一种高效的二维和三维流体设计拓扑优化的阈值动力学方法。我们还将研究这种方法的性质和效率。

16305819.label: Realisation of objectives
16305819.value: For objective 1, we proposed an efficient threshold dynamics method for topology optimization for fluids modeled with the Stokes equation. The proposed algorithm is based on minimization of an objective energy function that consists of the dissipation power in the fluid and the perimeter approximated by nonlocal energy, subject to a fluid volume constraint and the incompressibility condition. We show that the minimization problem can be solved with an iterative scheme in which the Stokes equation is approximated by a Brinkman equation. The indicator functions of the fluid-solid regions are then updated according to simple convolutions followed by a thresholding step. We prove mathematically that the iterative algorithm has the total energy decaying property. The proposed algorithm is simple and easy to implement. For objective 2, We also developed an efficient iterative thresholding method for topology optimization for the Navier–Stokes flow. The method is proposed to minimize an objective energy functional which consists of the potential power in the fluid and a fluid-solid interface perimeter penalization. The perimeter is approximated by a nonlocal energy, subject to a fluid volume constraint and the incompressible Navier–Stokes equation. The method is an iterative scheme which alternates two steps: (1) solving a system containing the Brinkman equation and an adjoint system, and (2) convolution and thresholding. For objective 3, we perform extensive numerical experiments in both two and three dimensions show that the proposed iteration algorithm converges in much fewer iterations and is more efficient than many existing methods. In addition, the numerical results show that the algorithm is very robust and insensitive to the initial guess and the parameters in the model.

16305919.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16305919.value: 石墨烯的广泛研究推动了原子级别过渡金属硫族化合物的层状半导体材料的物理与应用研究。根据理论，过渡金属硫族化合物有多种变形体，如半导体，金属，拓扑和超导体。对这些变形体的掌控具有极大的应用价值。 例如，在二硫化钼中2H结构最稳定，但是1T 和 1T’结构并不稳定。目前我们发现了利用氧等离子体触发纳米1T和1T’相变的新机制。这种金属-半导体纳米相变可以以原子层的精确控制，从而调控原子级别过渡金属硫族化合物的电学特性。 我们计划系统的研究过渡金属硫族化合物多种变形体的稳定性和可控性。利用高分辨电子显微镜理解结构变化和纳米相变。因为这类纳米相变的特殊性，我们将利用相变实现场效应器件的可控边缘欧姆接触，从而实现能谷可控电导和电子自旋与能谷纠缠电导特性控制。这项研究重点在于（1）氧等离子体在相变方面的作用，（2）控制界面结构实现高效场效应器件，(3) 实现能谷可控的量子输运，（4） 探索新颖的基于半金属拓扑纳米相变器件。本项研究将建立新的器件电极接触方式，利用相变调节器件性能，从而更好理解电子自旋与能谷在过渡金属硫族化合物的电学特性调节方面的应用。

16305919.label: Realisation of objectives
16305919.value: The period of this project was shortened from proposed three years to two years by RGC. We therefore made changes on the objectives. This project started in September 2019. Due to the influence of the society instability and the Covid-19, the research central facility in HKUST campus was closed till April 2020. After this period, the central facility was often partially opened and closed from time to time. We therefore faced difficulties of using some of the equipment in the campus. Because of the Covid-19, we were not able to attend international conference outside Hong Kong. We have made some changes on the conference budget. We spent more money to purchase small equipment so that our students could conduct some experiments in our labs. On the other hand, we heavily used metal electrode deposition for this project. Since the central facility was often closed, we have to purchase following high purity metals (Palladium, Platinum and Gold) and use our equipment to prepare the metal electrodes in our laboratory. These pure metals are expensive and therefore there is significant expenditure changes on the General Expenses budget. Although our research in this project was affected during this period, we have carried out research in the second year mainly focused on the first two objectives to investigate oxygen-plasma-induced semiconducting-to-metallic nanophase transition mechanism, stability and controllability in atomically thin MoS2 and WSe2. In the meantime, we have characterized the structures, defects and electrical transport properties of the semiconducting-to-metallic nano-interface structure in h-BN-encapsulated atomically thin 2D semiconductors. Our main achievement was the discovery of the local structure distortion at the contact interfaces of metal-2D-semiconductors (formed by oxygen plasma treatments) which significantly elevates the electronic performance of WSe2 field-effect transistors, particularly at cryogenic temperatures. The performance increase is reflected by the record-high field-effect mobility we achieved. Working together with Co-Is (Prof. D. Pan and J.W. Liu) on both experiments and theoretical calculations, we identified following unique structure features formed by the oxygen plasma treatment: 1. We found that 1T metallic phase formed by the treatment of oxygen plasma mainly along the edges of the MoS2 samples. This new phase is stable and can be reproduced under a controlled experimental condition. 2. The 1T metallic phase is high distorted. This distorted phase indicates that the band structure of the 1T phase is changed which has great impact on the interface property of the 1T phase. 3. The newly formed metallic phase largely deviated from ideal 1T metallic phase because of the lattice distortion. Our results demonstrated a new electrical contact strategy based on local structure distortion that can significantly increase the carrier-injection efficiency to most popular transition metal dichalcogenide semiconductors (TMDSCs) for achieving ultra-low contact resistance (towards the quantum limit) and record-high field-effect transistor (FET) mobility, which is comparable to that of high-quality graphene FET devices. The superb quality of our TMDSC devices facilitates the exploration of quantum Hall transport and interaction effects at the low/fractional filling factors under a laboratory-accessible magnetic field. This collaborative research was published in Nature Communications 13:1777 (2022); https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-022-29449-4. Our second stage of research focused on the expansion of the nano-phase transition technique to other TMDSCs to realize high performance field-effect devices with layer-selectable Ohmic edge contacts. We chose atomically thin WSe2 to build twist superlattice structures and fabricated high performance devices to study the quantum transport and valley related electronic properties. First, we characterized the layer-dependent interface reconstruction. We discovered that strain modulation in twisted WSe2 was very strong and no publication works demonstrate this kind of structural feature. Our study has shown (by both electron diffraction quantification and atomic-resolution imaging on the interface reconstruction of twisted WSe2) that a strong dependence of strain on the constituent layer numbers and twist angles. The competition between the interlayer interaction, which varies with local atomic configurations, and the intra-layer elastic deformation, related to the layer thickness, leads to rich superlattice motifs and strain modulation patterns, i.e. triangular for odd and kagome-like nano-phase textures for even layer numbers, against the rigid stacking moiré model. The strain effects and local atomic distortion at small twist angles are further demonstrated by electrical transport measurements, manifesting intriguing conducting states at low temperatures beyond the flat band features of large twist angles. Our work not only provided a comprehensive understanding of layer-dependent twist structures, but also shed light on the future design of twistronic devices. This research has been published in Nanoscale 13, 13624 (2021). Based on our newly developed plasma induced nano-phase formation technique, we have explored new device structures with topological nano-phase edges for studying valley-spin dependent quantum transport. Working together with Co-Is, we observed the quantum spin Hall effect (QSHE) in nanoscale phase-engineered (by the oxygen plasma treatment developed in this project) 1T′−1H MoS2 in-plane heterostructure devices at low temperatures up to 50 K. The devices showed quantized resistance plateaus ~h/2e2, with ultra-long transport channels of up to 5 microns. At the plateau, the resistance was proportional to the number of additional metal electrodes in the conducting channels, which was well consistent with our theoretical simulation. The quantized conductance was found to be strongly suppressed by the magnetic field. This paper (with a title “Towards Nanoscale Topological Devices”) has been finalized in December 2022 and will be submitted to a scientific journal in 2023. The copy of the manuscript is attached in this completion report. By the end of 2022, we have achieved all objectives for this project.

16306119.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16306119.value: Ultracold atoms offer a unique platform for emulating interacting many-body problems using their high controllability. Although strong correlations arise from the inter-particle interactions in ultracold atoms, the short-range interaction in a dilute regime enables us to characterize many-body behavior governed by universal relations. One of the striking examples includes a recent finding of several universal relations proposed by Shina Tan, in which many different observables are all determined by a single parameter called Tan’s contact. Surprisingly, Tan’s contact, which briefly measures the number of pairs of neighboring particles, universally determines both the microscopic and macroscopic properties of the quantum gas. Many of such universal relations with Tan’s contact have been experimentally verified in a two-component Fermi gas or in a Bose-Einstein condensate. Tan’s contact was originally proposed to characterize correlations in a two-component Fermi gas with s-wave interactions. Although Tan’s contact has been further measured in higher partial waves or for universal trimers, how to measure it in a multi-component Fermi gas remains an open questions. The proposed project will be the first to generalize the Tan’s contact measurement to a multi-component Fermi gas with SU(N) symmetry, and experimentally verify the scaling relation between Tan’s contact and the number of components. Furthermore, we will broaden our capability to characterize correlations via the contact measurement in spin-orbit-coupled fermions using the synthetic spin-orbit coupling demonstrated by PI’s group. The results of the proposed project promise to bring fresh insights about the correlation effect beyond a two-component Fermi gas. In the proposed project, we aim to (1) measure Tan’s contact in a balanced multi-component Fermi gas, (2) investigate Tan’s contact in a imbalanced multi-component Fermi gas and (3) study the contact parameter in a spin-orbit-coupled Fermi gas. We will perform the experiments using our currently working apparatus that produces a degenerate Fermi gas of ytterbium-173 atoms. 超冷原子以其高度可控性為模擬相互作用多體問題提供了一個獨特的平台。雖然在超冷原子中強關聯由粒子間相互作用產生，在稀薄體系下短程相互作用讓我們能夠描繪由普遍關係主導的多體行為的特性。一個最顯著的例子包括對於檀時鈉提出的幾種普遍關係的最新發現，其中多種不同可觀測量都由單一參數，檀氏接觸參數，所決定。令人驚訝的是，測量緊鄰粒子對數量所得到的檀氏接觸參數通常決定了量子氣體的微觀和宏觀性質。許多和檀氏接觸參數有關的這類普遍關係已經在二組分費米氣體或者玻色愛因斯坦凝聚中得到了實驗驗證。 檀氏接觸參數最初是為了表徵具有s波相互作用的二組分費米氣體關聯性而提出的。儘管檀氏接觸參數已經在更高的分波或者通常的三聚物中進一步測量，如何在多組分費米氣體中測量仍然是一個開放性問題。此項目將首次將檀氏接觸參數的測量推廣到具有SU（N）對稱性的多組分費米氣體中，並通過實驗驗證檀氏接觸參數與組分數之間的比例關係。此外，我們將利用PI組所展示的合成自旋-軌道耦合，通過對自旋軌道耦合費米子中的接触参数的測量來拓展我們表徵相關性的能力。項目的結果有望為二組分費米氣體之外的關聯效應帶來新的見解。 在擬議的項目中，我們的目標是（1）在平衡的多組分費米氣體中測量檀氏接触参数，（2）研究不平衡多組分費米氣體中的檀氏接触参数，（3）研究自旋-軌道耦合費米氣體中的接触參數。我們將使用我們目前產生鐿原子173簡併費米氣體的設備進行實驗。

16306119.label: Realisation of objectives
16306119.value: During the project, our primary goal is to investigate the thermodynamic property of SU(N) fermions by observing Tan's contact in the system of ytterbium-173 atoms. The PI’s group has already developed a highly efficient quantum gas apparatus capable of producing a SU(N) Fermi gas with adjustable spin, which presents a great opportunity to achieve our objective. As part of this project, multiple PhD students have received training through their involvement in the experimental work. Additionally, several junior students have chosen to pursue further studies within the program. In the initial stage of the project, we focused on investigating how thermodynamics are affected by the increase in spin multiplicity in a SU(N) system. We provided strong evidence for bosonization, a unique phenomenon that results in the blending of quantum statistics, and we experimentally verified the presence of bosonization in a 3D SU(N) Fermi gas (Objective 1).
