16503819.value: 许多国家为医疗保险药物提供大量补贴。因为其对民生和财政有重要影响，公共医保药物覆盖经常引起广泛关注和讨论。如同其他公共政策，医保政策制订是一个各相关利益方角力的过程。如果这个过程不足够透明，很多人会担忧政策会偏向更具政治影响的利益方从而导致巨大的社会成本。中国的基础医保政策就是一个值得研究的例子。 中国的基础医疗保险已经覆盖了98%的人口。从2002至今，国家基础医保药物目录修订了三次。每次修订，各省都有相当的权限根据本省情况增删药物。最终各省药物覆盖范围有很大不同。一旦药物被加入目录，预期销量会有很大增长。因此，有些制药公司试图影响各省药物目录修订。本项目试图研究各省医保覆盖是否会被具有政治关系的大制药公司影响。 本项目主要利用上市制药公司的产品和政治关联信息，各省每期医保药物目录，以及各省药品采购数据分析公司的与各省政府的政治关联是否会影响药物目录和采购。

16504019.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16504019.value: 關於智能手機使用對行為，認知和社會結果的影響的實驗證據

16504019.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16504019.value: Mr Cheung, Chi Man Prof Zhang, Yi Qin Jane

16504019.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16504019.value: With the ubiquity of the smartphone comes a host of potential negative consequences associated with smartphone overuse. An increasing number of studies in the public health literature have documented significant negative associations of smartphone usage with sleep, mental health, life satisfaction, etc. However, it remains unclear whether the relationship is causal. In the economics literature, using natural experiments, recent studies have found a negative relationship between smartphone use and school performance, but the results examined are limited to academic outcomes. This project aims to provide the first experimental evidence using a randomized controlled trial on the impact of smartphone usage on a wide range of outcomes, including time use, academic and job market performance, mental health, sleep quality, time preference, cognitive reflection, strategic sophistication, social intelligence, media consumption, and political attitudes. As part of the experimental design, we will also be able to measure the effectiveness of feedback, information, and the combination of the two treatments in reducing smartphone usage. Our confidence in our experimental design is bolstered by the promising results of our small pilot study, which found a significant effect of the treatment, a combination of feedback and information, on reducing time spent on the most popular smartphone apps, and in increasing mental health, sleep quality, and measures of cognitive reflection. 隨著智能手機的普及，對智能手機的過度使用逐漸成為一個問題，這一問題給人們帶來了許多潛在的負面影響。在公共衛生文獻中，越來越多文獻研究表明，智能手機使用時長與睡眠質量、心理健康、生活滿意度等存在顯著負面相關關係。然而，這種關係是否是因果關係目前尚不清楚。在經濟學文獻中，最近基於自然實驗的研究發現智能手機使用時長與學業表現之間存在負相關關係，但所研究的結果僅限於學業成績。本項目旨在通過隨機對照控制實驗首次提供以下實驗證據，即智能手機使用時長對包括時間分配、學業表現、就業市場表現、心理健康、睡眠質量、時間偏好、認知反思能力、複雜性策略制定能力、情緒智商、媒體資訊選擇和政治態度等一系列因素的影響。作為實驗設計的一部分，我們同時能夠衡量手機使用時長反饋干預方法、潛在負面影響信息普及乾預方法，以及混合以上兩種策略的干預方法在減少智能手機使用時長方面的有效性。我們於小型試驗研究中發現，結合了兩種策略的干預方法在減少被試者在最流行的智能手機應用程序上的使用時間方面，在提升心理健康、睡眠質量、認知反思能力等方面都有顯著效果，這一充滿希望的干預結果大大增加了我們對實驗設計的信心。

16504619.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16504619.value: 中美贸易战对中国企业和员工的影响

16504619.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16504619.value: This project empirically assesses the impacts of the 2018 US-China trade war on the performance of Chinese manufacturing firms. To do so, it collects new follow-up survey data from a large sample of Chinese manufacturing firms for which data was previously collected by the investigators as part of the China Employer-Employee Survey (CEES). The richness of the CEES data enable a nuanced assessment of different dimensions of the trade war’s impacts, including the impacts on the performance (sales, employment, profits, productivity) of both exporters to the US and importers of inputs from the US; the impacts of both US tariffs and Chinese retaliatory tariffs; the impacts of greater policy uncertainty caused by the trade war, especially on investment; the ways in which firms respond to the new tariffs (i.e., shifting trade to other countries, producing new or other products, moving production to other countries, rerouting trade through third countries, downscaling or exiting production); and the impact of government policies. These impacts are estimated using a difference-in-difference approach that exploits variation across firms in their ex ante trade with the US, which determines firms’ vulnerability to the trade war’s new tariffs. The research will provide new empirical evidence on how trade wars and tariff increases affect firm behavior and performance by treating a major geopolitical event as a natural experiment. The results will also help policy-makers better understand the impacts of the trade war on the macroeconomy, what types of firms and workers are most harmed by the trade war, and the impact of China’s retaliatory tariffs and other policies on Chinese manufacturing firms. 该项目采用实证调研方法评估2018年美中贸易战对中国制造企业业绩的影响。为此，它计划对大量中国制造企业进行调查和数据收集。数据的丰富性使得该项目可以对贸易战的影响的不同方面进行细致的评估，包括对出口商品到美国和进口美国商品到中国的企业的表现（销售，就业，利润，生产力）的影响; 美国关税和中国报复性关税的影响; 贸易战引起的政策不确定性增加的影响，特别是对投资的影响; 企业应对新关税的方式（即将贸易转移到其他国家，生产新产品或其他产品，将生产转移到其他国家，通过第三国中转贸易，缩减或退出生产）; 以及对政府政策的影响。这些影响是通过利用双重差分法来估算的。这种计量方法利用了美中贸易战前企业之间的差异，这决定了企业对贸易战新关税的脆弱性。该研究将重大地缘政治事件作为自然实验，为贸易战和关税增加如何影响企业行为和绩效提供新的实证证据。这些结果还将有助于政策制定者更好地了解贸易战对宏观经济的影响，贸易战对哪类企业和工人造成最严重的伤害，以及中国报复性关税和其他政策对中国制造企业的影响。

16504819.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16504819.value: This project considers the heterogeneous panel data models with interactive fixed effects, where the slope coefficients vary with both individuals and time. We assume that the slope coefficients have an additive structure with three components: the common component, the individual-specific component, and the time-specific component. The common component measures the average effect, while the individual-specific and time-specific components reflect the heterogeneity along the cross-sectional and time dimensions, respectively. We propose estimation methods to estimate all three components and study the asymptotic properties of our estimators. We also provide specification tests for testing the presence of the individual-specific component, or the time-specific component (or both). The simulations suggest that our new methods perform well in finite samples. We apply our new methods to the Feldstein-Horioka puzzle where we study the relationship between countries' investment rates and saving rates and find substantial heterogeneity in the slope coefficient along both country and time dimensions. 該項目考慮了具有交互式固定效應的異質面板數據模型，其中斜率係數隨個體和時間而變化。我們假設斜率係數是三個部分的加總：共同係數，個體特定係數和時間特定係數。共同係數測量平均效應，而個體特定係數和時間特定係數分別反映橫截面和時間維度的異質性。我們提出估計所有三個係數的估計方法，並研究我們的估計量的漸近性質。我們還提供了檢驗假設來檢驗特定個體係數或特定時間係數（或兩者）是否存在。模擬表明我們的新方法在有限樣本中表現良好。我們將新方法應用於Feldstein-Horioka puzzle，來研究國家投資率和儲蓄率之間的關係。我們發現國家和時間維度上的斜率係數存在顯著的異質性。

16504819.label: Realisation of objectives
16504819.value: All the objectives are achieved. Two working papers are accepted at top journals in econometrics, Journal of Econometrics and Econometric Theory. Objective 1 is achieved. In the first paper, entitled "Uniform Inference in Linear Panel Data Models with Two-Dimensional Heterogeneity", I study a general panel data model with heterogeneous slope coefficients. In the second paper, entitled "Nonparametric Estimation of Generalized Transformation Models with Fixed Effects", I propose a nonparametric estimation method for a transformation model with fixed effects in panel data. Objective 2 is achieved. In both papers, I systematically study the asymptotic properties of new estimators and develop the distribution theory. Objective 3 is achieved. In both papers, I provide extensive Monte Carlo simulations to examine the finite sample performance of the new methods. In addition, the first paper contains an empirical study of the famous Feldstein–Horioka puzzle in international economics.

16504819.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16504819.value: Panel data models have become a main workhorse in empirical research in economics. This project has developed new estimation methods for two general panel data models. In the first paper, entitled "Uniform Inference in Linear Panel Data Models with Two-Dimensional Heterogeneity," we allow the slope coefficients to be heterogeneous. In the second paper, entitled "Nonparametric Estimation of Generalized Transformation Models with Fixed Effects", we allow an unknown transformation function applied to the response of interest. The two methods can be widely applicable to many economic contexts.

16505319.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16505319.value: Private communications between lenders and borrowers are exempt from Reg FD, based on the premise that these communications are protected by a confidentiality agreement and therefore it is not “reasonably foreseeable” that the private information will be used to trade in a public market. This premise, however, has been challenged by findings in recent studies that document the information flow from the private debt market to public markets (e.g., Acharya and Johnson 2007; Bushman et al. 2010; Ivashina and Sun 2011). The misuse of private loan information violates the spirit of the Reg FD and may lead to insider trading lawsuits against borrowers, as in the case of Movie Gallery and Delphi Corporation. This study will investigate whether and how borrowers change their public voluntary disclosures after disclosing private information to lenders as required by information covenants in debt contracts. I hypothesize that information covenants will impact firms’ voluntary disclosures by a tradeoff between increased heightened information asymmetry and bank monitoring. I expect that managers increase voluntary disclosures when the heightened information asymmetry between lenders and shareholders is more severe. 基於貸方和借方之間的私下沟通受到保密協議保護的前提下，私密债务信息不能被使用在公共市場進行交易，因此，这些沟通免於Reg FD的约束。然而，這一前提受到了近期文献的挑戰。最近的研究記錄了私人債務市場的信息流入公共市場及其影響（e.g., Acharya and Johnson 2007; Bushman et al 2010; Ivashina and Sun 2011）。濫用私人貸款信息違反了Reg FD的精神，並可能導致對借款人的內幕交易訴訟，正如针对Movie Gallery and Delphi Corporation的诉讼一样。這項研究將調查借款人在按債務合同中的信息契約要求向貸方披露私人信息後，借款人是否以及如何改變他們的公開自願披露。我假設信息契約会影響公司的公开自願披露，而这种影响取决于对信息不對稱和銀行監控的权衡。在貸款人和股東之間信息不對稱加劇時，我預計管理者會增加公開自願披露。

16505319.value: We have realized all three objectives in the current version of the paper. Specifically, we find that: 1. Firms are more likely to include lender-affiliated analysts in conference calls and use more positive tones so that they can use public information disclosure to facilitate private information communication with the lender 2. The lender-borrower relationship is not associated with lender-affiliated analysts asking more questions about financial information. This indicates that analysts may not know about the potential loan initiation. 3. Firms' preferential treatment to lender-affiliated analysts reduces loan spread because it helps to send a credible public signal to solve information asymmetry in private information gathering. We have large expenses for staffing because we have tried many ways to collect more data around the debt information covenant in the earlier version. The general/conference expense is lower since I can’t travel during the covid and submission & editing fees are lower than expected.

16505319.label: Major findings and research outcome
16505319.value: We investigate whether firms provide preferential treatment to lender-affiliated analysts (i.e., analysts from brokerage houses affiliated with the firms’ lender) during the question-and-answer session in earnings conference calls. We find robust evidence that firms exercise discretion to let lender-affiliated analysts participate earlier in earnings conference calls before loan initiation than non-lender-affiliated analysts, especially for firms with more informative conference calls. We further find that management has more positive tones and answers questions more effectively to lender-affiliated analysts. However, we find no evidence that these analysts’ questions are different from other analysts. In addition, loans tend to have lower spreads, higher loan amounts and an increased probability of future relationship loans if borrowers provide preferential treatment to lender-affiliated analysts. Our results highlight an unexamined role that earnings conference calls play in the debt market to send a more credible public signal that facilitates private communication to lenders through preferential treatment to lender-affiliated analysts.

16505319.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16505319.value: We may investigate more about the analysts' role, and we are preparing for submitting to JAE in a few months.

16505319.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16505319.value: The study looks at whether companies give special treatment to financial analysts who work for the same company that provides loans to the company. We find that companies give these analysts preferential treatment by letting them ask questions earlier in earnings conference calls and answer their questions more positively. This treatment leads to better loan terms for the company, such as lower interest rates and more future loans. The study shows that earnings conference calls can be an important way for companies to communicate with their lenders through these affiliated analysts.

16505519.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16505519.value: Two important puzzles in financial economics are 1) asymmetric volatility of asset prices and 2) asymmetric co-movement of asset prices. Asset price volatility tends to be low in good times and high in bad times. For example, a striking and salient phenomenon of stock markets is that the VIX (volatility index) -- a measure of the stock market's expectation of volatility implied by S&P 500 index options -- is strongly negatively correlated with the movement of stock price indices. VIX rises when the stock price index like S&P 500 drops, while VIX declines when the stock prices go up. Moreover, asset prices tend to co-move strongly across securities in bad times, but not in good times. The asymmetry of volatility and co-movement not only applies to the stock markets but also other asset markets, like bond markets, foreign exchange markets, and so on. The asymmetry is true not only for short-run asset prices like daily stock returns but also for medium-run and long-run asset price movements. The proposed project is to provide a new theoretical framework to explain the asymmetric volatility and asymmetric co-movement of asset prices. Our framework aims to accounts for some stylized facts of asset price puzzles. We theoretically model that the presence of heterogeneous agents and their interplay can be an important reason to explain the puzzles. We will further confront our model with real data and calibrate and quantify the magnitude of our proposed mechanism. 金融经济学中的两个重要难以解释的现象是：1）资产价格的不对称波动性和2）资产价格的不对称同步移动。资产价格波动在经济好时期往往较低，在经济不景气时期较高。例如，股票市场的一个引人注目且显着的现象是，VIX（波动率指数） - 衡量股票市场对标准普尔500指数期权隐含的波动率的指标 - 与股票价格指数的变动强烈负相关。当标准普尔500指数等股票价格指数下跌时，VIX上涨，而当股票价格上涨时，VIX下跌。此外，在不景气时期，资产价格倾向于在证券中强烈同步移动，但在经济繁荣时期则不然。波动性和共同运动的不对称性不仅适用于股票市场，也适用于其他资产市场，如债券市场，外汇市场等。不对称性不仅适用于短期资产价格，如每日股票收益，也适用于中期和长期资产价格变动。拟议的项目准备提供一个新的理论框架来解释资产价格的不对称波动和非对称同步移动。我们的框架旨在解释资产价格现象的一些基本经验事实。我们从理论上证明了异质投资者的存在及其相互作用可能是解释这些难题的重要原因。我们将进一步用真实数据来验证我们的模型，并量化我们提出机制的解释力度（重要性）。

16505819.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16505819.value: In today’s competitive business environment, the practice of using prioritization is widely observed in the service industry, where customers with higher willingness to pay or valuations are typically prioritized for service. Examples include priority counters for platinum card holders in bank branches, dedicated check-in counters at airports for travelers with elite airline membership status, exclusive service hotlines for VIP customers in call center operations, just to name a few. With the prevalence use of prioritization in service operations, in this proposed study, we aim to examine service systems with flexible servers and different priority classes of customers. With the goal of reducing delay probability and the waiting time of priority customers, a dedicated service operations system discipline where an exclusive server (or sometimes an exclusive team of servers) is assigned to serve customers with a higher priority is commonly adopted in practice. However, such a dedicated service system may not always be optimal for customers with a higher priority. In our proposed research project, we consider a service system with two priority classes of customers (i.e., VIP and normal customers) and two servers with heterogeneous service rates. The servers are flexible in that each server is able to serve both customer types. The problem of solving for the optimal service policy can be formulated as a Markov Decision Process, and we aim to fully characterize the properties and structure of the optimal policy and derive the expected waiting times for both customer classes in steady state. The dedicated service system serves as our benchmark and we aim to compare its performance with our proposed system with flexible servers under the optimal service policy. We aim to investigate under what regimes one outperforms the other, which could give insightful guidelines for practitioners regarding the choice of service configurations and optimal policies when managing systems with different customer priority classes. 在当今竞争激烈的商业环境中，服务行业中广泛使用优先级划分的做法，使得具有较高支付意愿或估值的客户通常被给予优先服务。例如，银行的白金卡持有者优先柜台，航空公司精英会员在机场的专用值机柜台， VIP客户专用服务热线等。鉴于优先级划分的做法在服务运营中被广泛使用，在此项目中，我们的目标是研究具有灵活服务器和不同优先级客户的服务系统。 为了减少优先客户的服务延迟概率及等待时间，在实践中通常采取专用服务的运营系统，从而分配专用服务器（或专用服务器组）以服务具有更高优先级的客户。然而，对于具有较高优先级的客户而言，这种专用服务系统可能并不总是最佳的。在我们提议的研究项目中，我们考虑具有两个优先级客户（即VIP和普通客户）和两个具有不同服务速率的服务器的服务系统，其中每台服务器都能够灵活为两种客户提供服务。求解最优服务策略的问题可以建模为一个马尔可夫决策过程，我们的目标是完全刻画最优策略的属性和结构，并求解出稳态下两种客户各自的预期等待时间。我们将以专用服务系统作为基准来衡量我们所提出的灵活服务器系统在最佳策略下的表现。我们旨在研究这两个系统各自在什么情况下会有更好的表现，这将可以为服务系统从业者在管理具有不同客户优先级的系统时选择服务配置和最优策略提供深刻的指导。

16505819.label: Realisation of objectives
16505819.value: The objectives of this GRF research project have been fully achieved. We next summarize the research activities and outcomes related to the project objectives stated in the initial proposal. First, we have developed an analytical model to study the optimal dynamic server assignment control problem for queueing systems consisting of parallel and heterogeneous servers and stochastic and multi-class customer arrivals with different priority levels and waiting cost rates. We would like to remark that, in our initial proposal, we considered a 2-server 2-class service system. During the course of project study, we have been able to generalize the original study to a multi-server multi-class setting. Using a Markov decision process (MDP) modeling approach, we first analytically characterize the structures of the optimal dynamic server assignment policies for two important systems, one consisting of N homogeneous servers and 2 classes of customers (with different priority levels); and the other consisting of 2 heterogeneous servers (with server-dependent service rates) and L classes of customers. We show that the optimal policy is a state-dependent threshold-type policy. Interestingly, our results suggest that it can be optimal to intentionally keep servers idle even when there exist customers in queue. Based on the theoretical results obtained in the above two special systems, we develop a threshold-type heuristic policy for the generalized system consisting of N heterogeneous servers and L classes of customers. To design such a heuristic policy, we first develop techniques for the performance evaluation (such as evaluating the expected waiting times for customers in different priority classes) of general threshold-type policies with any given threshold values. We then propose an approach to search for the optimal threshold values. The comparison between the performance of the best threshold-type heuristic policy with that of the optimal policy shows that our proposed heuristic policy is computationally efficient yet generates great performance. In addition, we have examined the structure and properties of the optimal policy under an alternative objective function that considers the long run average cost criterion. Our base model considers the discounted-total-cost criterion. To complete the analysis, we have also looked at the long-run-average-cost criterion. We show that the threshold-type server assignment policies with intentional idleness are also optimal under the long-run-average-cost criterion. Finally, we have conducted extensive numerical studies to compare the system under our threshold-type dynamic server assignment policy with other commonly seen benchmark systems, such as the dedicated and the work-conserving flexible priority systems. The clear performance advantage observed from extensive numerical experiments demonstrates the importance and usefulness of dynamic server assignment control, for systems serving multiple classes of customer arrivals. We have also conducted sensitivity analysis to explore the impacts of various system configuration features (including the number of servers, the heterogeneity in service rates, the number of customer classes, and the system utilization) on system performance regarding waiting-cost minimization. We have also discussed extensions of our analysis to consider systems with customer-dependent service rates or under sojourn-time minimization. Because of COVID, The PI couldn't travel/invite other colleagues to visit for research discussions during the project period, thus most expenses were used to support research staff.

16505819.label: Major findings and research outcome
16505819.value: The major findings of this research project are summarized as follows. First, we developed an analytical model to study the optimal dynamic server assignment control problem for queueing systems consisting of parallel and heterogeneous servers and stochastic and multi-class customer arrivals with different priority levels. Using a Markov decision process (MDP) modeling approach, we first analytically characterize the structures of the optimal dynamic server assignment policies for two important systems, one consisting of N homogeneous servers and 2 classes of customers; and the other consisting of 2 heterogeneous servers and L classes of customers. We show that the optimal policy is a state-dependent threshold-type policy, where it can be optimal to intentionally keep servers idle even when there exist customers in queue. We have also looked at the long-run-average-cost criterion besides the discounted-total-cost criterion considered in our base model. We show that the threshold-type server assignment policy is also optimal under the long-run-average-cost criterion. Second, we developed a threshold-type heuristic policy for the general system consisting of N heterogeneous servers and L classes of customers based on the theoretical results obtained in the above two special systems. To design such a heuristic policy, we first developed techniques for performance evaluation of general threshold-type policies with any given threshold values. We then construct a path to search for the optimal threshold values. The comparison between the performance of the best threshold-type heuristic policy with that of the optimal policy shows that our heuristic policy is computationally efficient yet generates great performance. Finally, we conducted extensive numerical studies to compare the system under our threshold-type policy with other commonly seen benchmark systems, such as the dedicated and the work-conserving flexible priority systems. The clear performance advantage of our policy demonstrates the importance of dynamic server assignment control, for systems serving multiple classes of customer arrivals. We also conducted sensitivity analysis to explore the impacts of various system configuration features (including the number of servers, the heterogeneity in service rates, the number of customer classes, and the system utilization) on system performance regarding waiting-cost minimization. We have also discussed extensions of our analysis to consider systems with customer-dependent service rates or under sojourn-time minimization. This project has supported three research papers: Wang et al. (2021) published in Production and Operations Management; Wang and Zhang (2022) published in Naval Research Logistics; and Kim et al. (2023) currently under third round review at Management Science.

16505819.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16505819.value: There are several potential avenues to further develop this research, and the PI plans to explore along the following directions. First, we have assumed that the servers are parallel. In many service settings, customers need to go through multiple steps of services in sequence. Therefore, it would be interesting to consider queueing networks with both parallel and tandem servers and see how the service capacity should be coordinated (with strategic idleness) to serve multiple classes of customers. Second, we have considered exponential service times in our model for analytical tractability considerations. It would be meaningful to check whether the results and insights are robust under more general distributions. Finally, in this paper, we have assumed that all customer arrivals will join the queue and wait until being served, regardless of the queue length or waiting time. It is not uncommon in practice that customers (especially those who have a higher waiting cost rate) may choose not to join or abandon waiting while observing a long queue or experiencing a long delay. An interesting future direction is to extend our models to consider customer balking and reneging behaviors.

16505819.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16505819.value: Service industries are under tremendous growth. Under the environment of intensive competition, it is important for firms to delight their customers, especially those who largely contribute to their revenue. One typical strategy used is to categorize customers into different priority classes. In this project, we study the optimal dynamic server assignment control problem for service systems consisting of parallel and heterogeneous servers and stochastic and multi-class customer arrivals with different priority levels. We first analytically characterize the structures of the optimal dynamic server assignment policies for two important special systems, one consisting of N homogeneous servers and 2 classes of customers; and the other consisting of 2 heterogeneous servers and L classes of customers. We show that the optimal policy is a state-dependent threshold-type policy, where it can be optimal to intentionally keep servers idle even when there exist customers waiting in queue. We then develop a threshold-type heuristic policy for the general system. The comparison between the performance of our threshold-type heuristic with that of the optimal policy shows that our heuristic policy is computationally efficient yet generates great performance. Extensive numerical studies suggest that our threshold-based policy can achieve great performance advantage over other commonly seen benchmark policies.

16506019.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16506019.value: A school choice problem is a pair of a preference profile of students and a priority profile of schools. Each student is matched with at most one school and a capacity constraint of a school determines the number of students it may admit. A school choice mechanism is a systematic way of selecting a matching for a given school choice problem. The inefficiency induced by random tie-breaking is unavoidable as real-life school choice problems involve coarse priority orders of schools. We experimentally investigate three matching mechanisms---stable improvement cycle mechanism (SICM) by Erdil and Ergin (2008, American Economic Review), efficiency-adjusted deferred acceptance mechanism (EADAM) by Kesten (2010, Quarterly Journal of Economics), and choice-augmented deferred acceptance (CADA) mechanism by Abdulkadiroğlu, Che, and Yasuda (2015, AEJ-Micro); which have recently proposed as means to reduce the efficiency loss from random tie-breaking that accompanies the deferred acceptance (DA) algorithm. We provide laboratory evidence for how and to what extent tie-breaking matters in the school choice context. 学校选择问题是一对学生的偏好概况和学校的优先概况。每个学生最多与一所学校相匹配，学校的能力限制决定了学校可以承认的学生人数。学校选择机制是为特定学校选择问题选择匹配的系统方法。由于现实生活中的学校选择问题涉及学校的粗略优先顺序，因此随机打破平局所导致的低效率是不可避免的。我们通过实验研究三种匹配机制 - 由Erdil和Ergin（2008，美国经济评论）提供的稳定改进周期机制（SICM），由Kesten（2010，Quarterly Journal of Economics）提出的效率调整延期接受机制（EADAM），以及选择增强Abdulkadiroğlu，Che和Yasuda的延期接受（CADA）机制（2015年，AEJ-Micro）;最近提出的方法是降低伴随延迟接受（DA）算法的随机打破平局的效率损失。我们提供实验室证据，证明在学校选择背景下如何以及在何种程度上打破交易。

16506019.label: Realisation of objectives
16506019.value: In our experiments, we consider three mechanisms, DA, CADA, and SIC, in four environments. Our Baseline environment implements the first of the three preference profiles amenable to experimental analysis. The three additional environments are considered to validate our experimental findings. The Replica environment takes the first preference profile with a variation that each district has two identical students; thus, it implements a six-student-three-school environment. The Cardinal environment also takes the same preference profile but cardinal utilities students attach to schools are different. This cardinal environment is designed to give CADA its best shot because CADA is meant to provide a channel through which not only ordinal but also cardinal preferences affect tie-breaking. The New environment implements a new preference profile, which is more favorable to CADA and less so to SIC in terms of the possibility of realizing efficiency gains. The replica, cardinal, and new environments mainly serve the purpose of a robustness check for our results from the baseline environment to a larger economy, a cardinal preference amendment, and an ordinal preference change, respectively. Our experimental data from the baseline environment presents a clear picture. First, the data reveals that inefficiency created by random tie-breaking in DA was substantial, with more than 45% of the matching outcomes being inefficient. Second, targeting choices made by the vast majority of subjects participating in CADA are consistent with our equilibrium analysis. As a result, CADA attained almost no efficiency gain relative to DA. In particular, the dominated-strategy equilibrium of CADA that Pareto improves upon the DA outcome hardly emerged in the experiment. Targeting in CADA can be viewed as a coordination device among subjects and the device is more likely to be effective in a small-sized environment. It is quite surprising that the coordination did not come into play even in the three-student experiment. Third, subjects participating in SIC reported preferences largely in line with what the Nash equilibria in undominated strategies predicted. Thus, SIC sufficiently improved upon the DA outcome. The cardinal environment implemented a slightly different set of cardinal utilities in order to help subjects coordinate on a Pareto-efficient but ``dominated-strategy'' Nash equilibrium in CADA. However, it did not help reduce the disparity in efficiency performances of SIC and CADA. Further, the disparity became more pronounced in the replica environment with six students. Our data from the new environment deepens our understanding of the main source of the observed disparate efficiency performances of the three mechanisms and thus addresses a concern about external validity of our main findings. Even though CADA's unique equilibrium outcome in this environment predicts that CADA has a full efficiency advantage relative to DA, the advantage was not fully achieved in the laboratory. Uniqueness of the equilibrium outcome does not imply that everyone successfully uses targeting to coordinate on a particular Pareto efficient equilibrium. The additional layer of coordination (equilibrium targeting) required by CADA makes the mechanism more vulnerable to strategic uncertainty. Multiplicity of equilibria embedded in the first preference profile is a fundamental source of strategic uncertainty, but uniqueness of the Nash equilibrium outcome embedded in the new environment does not completely get rid of the issue. In case of SIC, the stringent equilibrium requirement of untruthful reporting for some student indeed leads to a substantial deviation from the equilibrium reporting in the new environment. However, the observed deviation did not undermine the efficiency advantage of SIC relative to DA because stable improvement cycles are implemented not only on the equilibrium path but also off the equilibrium path. That is, SIC achieves gains from trade whenever they exist, both on and off the equilibrium path.

16506019.label: Major findings and research outcome
16506019.value: In school choice problems with weak priorities, the deferred acceptance (DA) mechanism may produce inefficient stable matchings due to tie-breaking. The stable-improvement-cycles (SIC) and choice-augmented deferred acceptance (CADA) mechanisms were proposed to remedy inefficiencies but they are manipulable. In a simple environment, we theoretically and experimentally analyze students' strategic behavior when DA, SIC, and CADA are implemented. We show that obtaining the efficiency gain relative to DA crucially depends on whether students report their preferences truthfully in SIC and whether they play a particular equilibrium strategy in CADA. Our laboratory experiment reveals that (i) non-negligible degrees of untruthful reporting are observed but they are not a major drawback for practical efficiency improvements of the mechanisms we consider; (ii) SIC achieves gains from trade whenever they exist, both on and off the equilibrium paths; and (iii) the additional layer of equilibrium coordination required by CADA makes it harder for CADA to fully produce the promised welfare advantage relative to DA. These findings are robust to various environments.

16506019.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16506019.value: An essential remaining task is to externally validate our findings more broadly. In this paper, we chose a simple setup with three schools and three (or six) students to exploit its analytical tractability. Our results do not indicate that efficiency gains of SIC (with respect to DA) will be always greater than that of CADA in all environments; rather it theoretically and experimentally establishes that different non-strategy-proof mechanisms that result in full efficiency with respect to ``reported preferences'' may demonstrate different efficiency performances with respect to ``true preferences.'' Therefore, the next step, we believe, is not to carry our results directly to the field. Instead, additional experiments of a similar kind should be conducted. They may shift the focus to other competing issues, e.g., when and how students' preference misrepresentation serves to affect actual workings of SIC and CADA in a positive or negative manner. Experiments of a larger scale will render findings more solid. Such further work will not only dispel concerns about external validity of our study but also reduce the social cost of implementing inefficient school choice programs.

16506019.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16506019.value: In a simple school choice environment, we theoretically and experimentally investigated efficiency properties of three important mechanisms in the literature. We provided several valuable insights into whether and how one can achieve efficiency gains in practice by employing a mechanism having a concern of manipulability. First, our laboratory data vividly demonstrated that the efficiency loss due to random tie-breaking was substantial. Indeed, our results confirmed that the extent of the inefficiencies that can arise in the student-optimal stable matching is a matter of real practical importance. On the one hand, SIC showed a significant welfare advantage relative to DA, and preference reporting under SIC observed in the lab was largely consistent with the predictions of our equilibrium analysis. On the other hand, CADA attained no or marginal efficiency gain. In the other three environments involving more students, amended cardinal utility values, or different ordinal preferences, the gap in efficiency persisted (even widened in some case) and brought strategic issues surrounding SIC and CADA to light.

16506519.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16506519.value: Sponsored search, in which advertisers bid for positions in the listing of search results on search engines such as Google and Baidu, has been the dominant online advertising channel. A large amount of literature on online advertising follows a similar framework to Edelman et. al. (2007) and Varian (2007), which establishes the equivalence of the outcome in a Generalized Second-Price (GSP) auction to a static Nash equilibrium in a Vickrey auction. One important assumption of the GSP auction model is that advertisers are forward-looking; that is, their bids account for all other bidders’ valuation and responses. In this study, we aim to investigate advertisers’ bidding strategies when forward-looking strategy is not possible due to limited information. We first propose a game-theoretic model among advertisers that allows for different information sets. We characterize different bidding patterns that arise when advertisers possess different amounts of information about each other. Two different types of bidding strategies will be investigated: forward-looking bidding under complete information, and myopic bidding when advertisers only know their own valuations but not others’. Our objective is to investigate how the auction design by search engine may influence advertiser’s bidding strategy and economic consequences for both advertisers and search engines. Our theoretical development was inspired by a preliminary analysis of a real bidding data from Baidu.com, the largest search engine in China. We have observed empirical evidences that support the inefficient bidding behavior of advertisers. We found that the advertisers did not bid aggressively enough and failed to obtain the best positions given their own valuations of the position. We further conducted a simulation-based analysis to calculate the payoff under different bidding strategies. We found that most advertisers could immediately improve their payoff if they bid more aggressively. These results have encouraged us to further investigate inefficient bidding behavior that deviates from forward-looking bidding strategy and other equilibrium strategies. Given the importance of the keyword auction as a digital marketing channel, the proposed research would potentially carry important implications to both advertisers and search engines. Advertising might not implement optimal bidding strategy and search engine company might benefit from revealing more information to induce advertisers to bid more aggressively and achieve higher revenue. 以在搜索引擎的搜索结果中竞标位置为目标的竞标搜索广告已经成为互联网广告中最重要的渠道，谷歌和百度是最有代表性的例子。大量关于在线搜索广告都是基于Edelman et. (2007) 和Varian （2007）的研究。这两个研究都证明了通用第二价格（GSP）拍卖与在Vickrey拍卖中的Nash均衡有着完全一致的结果。GSP拍卖模型一个重要的假设是广告商是前瞻性的，也就是说，他们的竞标是考虑了所有其他竞标者的估值和反应。在这个研究中，我们的目标是研究广告商在因为信息不全而没有可能做到真正的前瞻性的时候的竞标策略。 我们首先提出了一个基于博弈论并且允许不同的广告商有不同的信息的模型。我们描述了广告商在拥有不同信息情况下不同的竞标特征。我们主要研究两种策略：有全部信息的前瞻性竞标和只知道自己的信息，但是不知道其他广告商的信息前提下的短视性竞标特征。我们的研究目标是搞清楚对广告商竞标策略以及拍卖平台的不同的设计低广告商竞标策略和他们以及搜索引擎平台的经济利益的影响。 我们的理论发展是受到了对百度的实际竞标数据的简要分析的结果的影响。我们已经有一些非常简单的证据来演示广告商的低效率竞标行为。我们发现广告商竞标的不够有侵略性，导致了没有成功获得更好的竞标位置。我们还做了一个仿真模型来计算广告商在不同竞标策略中的经济利益。我们还发现，如果竞标者可以个更激进的竞标，他们可以马上提高经济效益。这些初始结果给了我们很大的鼓舞去研究偏离前瞻性竞标行为的均衡策略。 基于竞标搜索的数字化平台上的重要性，这个提出的研究将来的成果会给广告商和搜索引擎带来更新的启示。广告并没有达到最优策略，并且搜索引擎公司会从披露更多信息来诱导广告商更加激进的竞标中获益。

16506519.label: Realisation of objectives
16506519.value: We complete this research by providing evidences in achieving the five objectives. I will explain our research findings respectively. To answer the first research quesiton, our analyses and results show evidence that there could be deviation in keyword auctions from the established equilibrium in the literature. One deviation source is advertiser’s bounded rationality, as a result of limited information available that is specifically present in our setting. Our stylized model of bidding under incomplete information captures this deviation well by showing the inefficiency in advertisers’ bids. This model also explains the considerable level of deviation we observe in practice (the Baidu data). To answer the second, third and fourth questions, we draw conclusions through the model analyses and the empirical results. First, we find that advertisers with top valuations are not competitive enough in practice because search engines do not provide them with complete information. They target lower positions rather than the top positions that they should choose and submit lower bids than they should. They can obtain a higher surplus if they bid with complete information. Second, we find that lower-valuation advertisers pay less than they should. Because top-valuation advertisers are bidding lower, lower-valuation advertisers obtain higher positions with lower bids and obtain higher profits than they should. Third, search engines can earn higher profits if advertisers have complete information, amounting to almost double profits in our calculation from the data. Disclosing more information to advertisers may be a good strategy for search engines. Our findings provide important implications to advertisers. Many firms that sponsor online keyword ads do not target the top position. For example, Baidu’s advertising group officially encourages their customers to target position 3 but not position 1. In addition, many firms set a daily budget, and if the firm’s spending exceeds that, its ads will be removed from the position. Our findings suggest that, provided with complete information about their competing advertisers, firms should have different target positions according to their private value and quality score. Firms with higher valuations should target higher positions. Firms with lower valuations are better off embracing the incomplete information setting, as they earn higher profits from the ignorance of firms with the highest valuations. To answer the fifth research question, our findings also offer important implications for search engines, which typically do not disclose all information to their advertisers. For example, Google only provides firms with daily aggregated data, such as average exposure and position. We point out that search engines can greatly benefit from disclosing more information to advertisers. Our findings suggest that this would correct underbidding, which allows search engines to not only achieve more efficient allocation of advertising positions but also greatly improves their revenue. Our estimation suggests a profit improvement of 100 percent. Our study primarily demonstrates the evidence of deviation and its economic consequences caused by information limitations. An interesting and related issue is how other sources of bounded rationality, such as the budget limit and cognitive bias, influence advertisers’ bidding and its corresponding consequences. A richer data set that contains advertiser characteristics might help in a more extensive analysis of this issue. Another direction for future research would be models that endogenize these constraints. This research makes three main contributions to the keyword auction literature. First, we extend the framework of Edelman et. al. (2007) , Varian (2007) and Zhang and Feng (2011) by focusing on the information environment in the bidding game. Second, we demonstrate the deviation from the complete information equilibrium and a bidding inefficiency and further validate it through our empirical analysis. Third, we quantify the influence of this deviation on advertisers’ payoff and the economic impact on search engine. Reference Edelman B, Ostrovsky M, Schwarz M (2007) Internet Advertising and the Generalized Second-Price Auction: Selling Billions of Dollars Worth of Keywords. The American Economic Review, 97(1): 242-258. Varian, HR (2007) Position Auctions. International Journal of Industrial Organization, 25: 1163-1178. Zhang X, and Feng J (2011) Cyclical Bid Adjustments in Search-Engine Advertising. Management Science, 57(9): 1703–1719.

16506519.label: Major findings and research outcome
16506519.value: Keyword auctions have been the largest source of revenue for search engines. However, the inefficient biddings can happen and give rise to the misalignment between bidding cost and ad benefit at different positions. We focus on building a stylized model that analyzes advertisers’ bidding strategies with two different information sets: bidding under complete information, and bidding under incomplete informationwhen advertisers know their own valuations but not others’. Our model analysis reveals that the lack of information introduces challenge in advertisers’ rank targeting and results in underbidding behavior which in turn give rise to the inefficient bidding phenomenon. We deepen this finding through analysis with calibration-based method and real bidding data from Baidu.com, the largest search engine in China. We have a working paper of this research. Due to the pandemic situation and travel policy of HKUST in the past 3 years, we didn't submit this research to any conference. Instead, we submitted a manuscript to Management Sciecne(a top journal in business and management). The paper was eventually rejected. We are currently revising it and planing to submit to Information System Research Journal.

16506819.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16506819.value: Policy analysis such as a regulation analysis, innovation evaluation, and merger analysis are often required in an oligopoly industry in which a number of flexible pricing schemes, including non-linear pricing and bundling, are exercised. For example, the NTT group, a telecommunication giant in Japan, has been prohibited from doing so until 2013, although bundling mobile and fixed broadband services is common among telecommunication companies. What are possible implications to the competition and welfare? The upgrade in the wireless mobile telecommunications technology from 3G and 4G co-occcured with drastic changes in the pricing scheme: many telecommunication companies introduced unlimited data usage plans for 4G mobile services. How does the combination of the proccess innovation and changes in pricing scheme affect the competition and welfare? Are effects substantially different if the pricing scheme does not change? During the same period, the internet services expanded the supply of contents requiring high-speed internet such as music, video, and game. As a result, the distribution of demand for mobile and fixed broadband data services has changed shifted up and changed the shape. Does the change explain the change in pricing schmes chosen by the telecommunication companies? These are all important quetions regarding the interaction among pricing regulation and practice, market structure, and welfare. However, addressing these problems is not straightforward, because there is no readily available empirical nor theoretical framework for conducting policy analysis in such an industry. To enable such a policy analysis, our paper will propose a new empirical model for estimating and analyzing an oligopoly competition with non-linear pricing and bundling. We will then apply the framework to a consumer-level plan choice and usage rate data in combination with the actual price scheme data on all plans across mobile voice, mobile data, and fixed broadband services in Japan between 2011--2014 and 2016. The Japanese telecommunication market during the data period is unique due to several major changes in pricing regulation and practices and is ideal for studying the interaction among complicated pricing strategies, market structure, and efficiency. Using the estimated model, we will conduct several policy experiments. The proposed empirical model and findings from the telecommunication industry will help antitrust authorities to monitor and review business practices, regulation changes, and merger cases in a wider class of oligopoly markets than in the telecommunication industry.

16506819.label: Realisation of objectives
16506819.value: In this project, our aim was to develop an empirical model of oligopoly competition with non-linear pricing and mixed bundling and to perform counterfactual simulations for three scenarios. These scenarios included regulation on the dominant firm for mixed bundling, a horizontal merger, and evaluation of the new pricing scheme such as flat rate. However, after assessing the quality of the survey data and the importance of each issue, we decided to narrow our focus in one dimension while expanding it in another dimension. Specifically, on the one hand, we chose to concentrate on oligopoly competition with mixed bundling and treated the nonlinear pricing only in a reduced form. This decision was made because we realized that the survey responses of consumers on usage were not accurate enough to model this feature. On the other hand, we added the entry of fringe firms as a feature of the model because the entry of fringe firms such as MVNO and FVNO has been an important aspect of the Telecommunication period during the data period. This decision was made because we realized that the entry of fringe firms was one of the remarkable changes in the market structure during the data period. Mixed bundling has often been scrutinized as a device that discourages entry, and a large body of theoretical literature has examined the entry-discouraging effects of bundling (e.g., Whinston, 1990; Peitz, 2008). Despite such a theoretical interest, quantitative assessments of the entry-deterring effect of bundling are scarce because there is no tractable empirical model for this setting. To make the model tractable, we imposed a semi-aggregative structure, by which we mean that even though the game played by firms is not aggregative, (i) the optimal strategy of multiproduct firms can be summarized into a uni-dimensional action variable and (ii) strategic interaction between firms can eventually be summarized into a uni-dimensional aggregate variable. This greatly simplified the computation of the equilibrium and the identification of the model primitives from the data. We applied the model and the method to the data of the Japanese telecommunication industry and performed counterfactual simulations to assess the aforementioned objectives. The simulations demonstrated the effects of mixed bundling by dominant incumbent firms, a horizontal merger, and the introduction of a new pricing scheme on the consumer surplus. Although this was not included in the original plan, I included another paper as one of the direct research outputs of this project because it was produced by the same team and shared many ideas with the current project. In this other paper, we developed a similar model of oligopoly competition with multiple markets for other industries, in this case, the mobile apps that face markets of consumers and advertisers. The paper used a similar semi-aggregative approach to reduce the strategic interaction across firms and developed a method for computing the equilibrium and estimating the structural parameters. The paper is requested R&R from the RAND Journal of Economics. Finally, there is a remark on the expenditure: the outsourcing cost of 4,500 was recorded in the midterm review, but it was a mistake. Therefore, we corrected the number by withdrawing 4,500 in this report.

16506819.label: Major findings and research outcome
16506819.value: Theories often show the entry-deterrence effects of product bundling, but its quantitative impacts have been unexplored. We develop a semi-aggregative framework for analyzing price competition in asymmetric multi-market oligopoly with mixed bundling and fringe entry, which is tractable yet flexible enough for examining the impact of the bundling of large firms on fringe entry and consumer welfare. In the model, the value referred to as aggregate complementarity serves as a sufficient statistic of the effect of incumbent firms' conduct on consumer surplus. We apply the model to the mobile and fixed-broadband data services in Japan, where a dominant ex-national firm effectively started mixed bundling in 2015 by circumventing the regulation prohibiting it from bundling. We estimate the model using consumer surveys on plan choice from 2010 to 2016 and find that the estimated aggregate complementarity sharply increased in 2015, indicating a potential anticompetitive effect of mixed bundling. Counterfactual simulations demonstrate the impacts of dominant firms' conduct, market structure, and the introduction of new pricing schemes.

16506819.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16506819.value: Although the current paper used data between 2010 and 2016, we could recently obtain additional data until 2022. We can extend the analysis to the latest date and cover additional policy questions in the telecommunication industry, and/or validate the out-of-sample prediction of the estimated model. We can also extend our approach using a semi-aggregative structure to other settings with potential complementarity. For example, when supermarkets are competing for consumers who purchase multiple categories and prefer a one-stop shopping, the complementarity across categories within a supermarket arises. Formulating the competition in such a setting is challenging (Thomassen et al. 2017), but we may be able to simplify the analysis with our approach. Other settings where our approach is applicable include the conglomerate competition of platforms.

16506819.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16506819.value: When firms compete in multiple markets such as mobile data service and fixed broadband services in the telecommunication industry, the incumbent firms may offer a discount for the mix of the products. This may look good for consumers but may damage consumers because it could remove the room for fringe firms offering cheap plans such as virtual network operators to survive and soften the competition the incumbent firms face. This was indeed a concern when the ex-national dominant incumbent firm NTT started the bundling in 2015 despite the strong criticism by the competing firms. Analyzing the potential harm of this kind of conduct is not easy because there are many features in this setting; the multiple markets, complementarity and substitutability across markets, complementarity created by bundling, and the profitability of fringe firms. We developed a model that could capture all of these features yet tractable, and evaluate the damage on the consumer surplus of the dominant firms' conduct. The framework can be used in other country's telecommunication industries or other industries with similar features.

Does purchase quantity lead to greater subjective wellbeing than purchase quality, or vice versa? How does this relationship vary across countries that vary in inequality? What drives the link between these two? Do perceptions of inequality have the same effect as actual inequality? Do country-level economic indicators, such as income inequality, correlate with subjective wellbeing? Objective 2: Understanding the effect of recalled consumption experiences on subjective wellbeing. Do recalled consumption experiences directed to pride versus happiness produce different effects on subjective wellbeing? Do pride and happiness decay at different rates? Do the effects of pride and happiness vary with income inequality?

16507119.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16507119.value: he 2016 United Nations World Happiness Survey found that Hong Kong was ranked 72nd amongst the 155 surveyed countries, slipping 25 places from its rank of 46th in the first such survey conducted in 2012. Indeed, while our society scored well on objective indicators such as per capita GDP and life expectancy, which are known correlates of happiness (but only imperfectly so, Diener et al. 2015), the real “downer” was visible in the trend. Of the 126 countries that have been assessed since 2005, Hong Kong showed a negative trend in happiness, and ranked 75th overall in terms of this trend. Occurring simultaneously with this negative development, the last few years have seen a large, but positive, trend in a different domain. It is no secret that Hong Kong is a consumer economy, but the rate of growth of consumption is accelerating. According to the latest Census figures, household consumption expenditure increased by 46% from 2004/05 to 2014/15. This is coincident with increasing income inequality. The Gini coefficient for Hong Kong is now 53.9, making it one of the most unequal societies in the world. Might these trends be related to each other? Consumers often find themselves on a hedonic treadmill, deriving pleasure from buying products but failing to derive happiness from these products in the long-term. This behavior is accentuated in unequal societies as we race to keep up with our neighbors, and it is bad for our wallets, planet, and wellbeing. It is therefore critical to understand how consumers can get off this treadmill and derive well-being from the possessions they own and the experiences they have had. This research investigates these important questions. We study how purchases and memories of purchased experiences impact subjective wellbeing, under high inequality. We break this investigation down into two objectives. The first objective considers the effect of the trade-off people make when they spend their discretionary money. Given a fixed budget, they can choose to either buy multiple items of relatively low value (what we call “quantity”) or fewer items of greater value (i.e., “quality”). We propose that purchases of quantity can lead to lower subjective wellbeing. The second objective then looks at how people construe their recalled experiences. Many purchases are made in the pursuit of happiness, but we propose that recalling experiences that made people feel proud, rather than happy, will lead induce greater subjective wellbeing. 《2016年聯合國世界幸福調查》發現，在接受調查的155個國家或地區中，香港排名第72位，從2012年首次進行的同類調查中排名第46位，下跌了25位。誠然，雖然我們的社會在人均GDP和預期壽命等客觀指標上取得了很好的成績，而這些指標均與幸福感相關（但不完全如此，Diener et al. 2015），真正的「下行因素」則在趨勢中可見。自2005年以來被評估的126個國家或地區中，香港的幸福感呈負面趨勢，在此趨勢中排名第75位。 與這個負面發展同時發生的，是過去幾年在另一個領域出現了一個巨大而正面的情況。眾所周知，香港是一個消費型經濟體，但消費增長率正在加速。根據最新的人口普查數據，2004/05年度至2014/15年度的家庭消費支出增長了46%，這與收入不平等的上升同時出現。現時香港的堅尼系數為53.9，使其成為世界上最不平等的社會之一。 這些趨勢可能彼此相關嗎？消費者經常發現自己處於享樂的跑步機上，從購買產品中獲得樂趣，但長遠來看卻未能從這些產品中獲得快樂。這種行為在不平等的社會中更為突出，因為我們要跟上鄰居的步伐，這對我們的錢包、地球和福祉都是不利的。因此，了解消費者如何能擺脫這跑步機，並從他們擁有的財產和他們的經歷中獲得幸福至關重要。這項研究探討了這些重要問題。 我們研究在高度不平等的情況下，購物情況和購物經歷的記憶如何影響主觀幸福感。 我們將這項研究分成兩個目標。 第一個目標是探討人們在花費他們自由支配的金錢時所作出的取捨對他們的影響。若有一個固定的預算，他們可以選擇購買多項價值相對較低的物品（我們稱之為「數量」）或少量但價值較高的物品（即「質量」）。我們認為購買「數量」會降低主觀幸福感。第二個目標則著眼於人們如何解釋他們回憶的經歷。 許多購物情況都是為了追求快樂，但我們認為回憶一些讓人們感到自豪而不是快樂的經歷，會導致更大的主觀幸福感。

16507119.label: Realisation of objectives
16507119.value: In the Mid-Term Progress Report, we had described the challenges in studying subjective wellbeing during the pandemic. In the time since then, unfortunately, the pandemic has ebbed and flowed in different parts of the world at different times. Moreover, even when caseloads have decreased, the correlation with people's wellbeing has not been apparent. There have been brief periods of great relief and ecstasy, which have coexisted within populations, with lingering resentment at restrictions, sorrow at the loss of loved ones, and anxiety due to lingering economic effects. Compared to these major and immediate effects, the phenomena studied in this research, have been shown to be stable and reliable, but unpredictable to isolate statistically in a given population during the pandemic. We are highly grateful that our Mid-Term Progress Report was described as "being well-handled" and our stewardship was acknowledged. Unfortunately, the Panel Member's hope for changes in the pandemic leading to more stability in subjective well-being have not evinced during the duration of this project. However, despite these challenges, we are pleased to report that the objectives of this project have been achieved to a substantial extent. Most importantly, an article based on the first objective was recently accepted at the Journal of Marketing Research, which is the premier journal in the field. It has attracted attention in the field, and leading researchers have expressed interest in collaborating on follow-up investigations. In contrast, investigations towards the second objective are still ongoing. With the resumption of normalization in several countries, data collection is again possible and we are looking into the possibility. Especially given the interest the first publication has received, we are hopeful of pursuing this line of research in the near future.

16507119.label: Major findings and research outcome
16507119.value: Rising income inequality is taking a toll on people’s subjective wellbeing (SWB), and many commentators have implicated the role of material possessions, and thereby marketing, in this regard. Making a more nuanced argument, the present research proposes that certain material possessions – namely, favorite possessions – can mitigate the detrimental psychological effect of income inequality on SWB. In support of this proposition, experimental data from nine countries (N=3,687) and social media posts from 138 countries (N=31,332) converge to show that, while SWB generally declines as income inequality increases, encouraging consumers to attend to their favorite possessions can mitigate the negative effect of inequality on SWB. This is because attending to favorite possessions reduces consumers’ tendency to make social comparisons related to material resources and wealth, which otherwise arise when income inequality is high. Consequently, even when they perceive high income inequality, consumers feel less deprived relative to others, thereby buffering their SWB. These findings have meaningful consumer welfare implications. In particular, one way consumers can feel happier with their quality of life in an unequal society is to avoid comparing their material wealth to that of others and instead attend to the material possessions that are most special to them.

16507119.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16507119.value: There is much scope to develop these findings further, and a follow-up GRF application is possible. While the published research investigated effects on subjective wellbeing, there are possibly distinct effects on specific emotions such as hope and pride. The current research also opens up the possibility of investigation of consumption in different contexts (e.g., conspicuous or not; public versus private), and product categories (e.g., price premiums for different types of food). We are actively investigating these possibilities.

16507119.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16507119.value: Income inequality is pervasive in today's world, and has serious negative effects on wellbeing as people compare themselves with others and strive to keep up with the Joneses. This research shows that the key to maintaining wellbeing under income inequality may not depend on how many, or even what, material goods one owns. Instead, wellbeing depends on how one relates to one's possessions. Specifically, we find that thinking about one's favorite possession buffers wellbeing for people facing income inequality. This relates to the growing popularity of the notion that possessions should “spark joy” (Mari Kondo 2016). We are not arguing that favorite possessions can mitigate the various and serious negative impacts that income inequality has on individuals and societies (e.g., poor health, increased crime rate, increased mortality, etc.). Rather, our findings suggest one way in which people can cope with the psychological effect of perceived income inequality on their sense of wellbeing. Despite the great income inequality in the world, we all have a few favorite things that can make us happy. We do not all need a Mercedes Benz.

16507219.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16507219.value: Institutional diversity represents the extent of variation in the institutional environment to which an multinational enterprise (MNE) is exposed. International business scholars have increasingly recognized the pivotal role of the institutional environment in shaping MNEs’ international activities (Meyer, Estrin, Bhaumik, & Peng, 2009; Peng, Wang, & Jiang, 2008). Institutional environments vary substantially internationally (Berry, Guillén, & Zhou, 2010; Jackson & Deeg, 2008). Although MNEs all operate in multiple countries, the diversity of the institutional arrangements they are exposed to differs. We suggest that the institutional diversity they face can help MNEs develop dynamic capabilities. Wrestling with heterogeneous stakeholders in different countries tends to equip MNEs with diverse knowledge and adaptive organizational processes, and to offer arbitrage opportunities. Dynamic capabilities are defined as ‘…the firm’s ability to integrate, build, and reconfigure internal and external competences to address rapidly changing environments’ (Teece, Pisano, & Shuen, 1997: 516). Dynamic capabilities generally involve an ability to sense opportunities and threats, seize the opportunities, defuse the threats and periodically transform the enterprise’s intangible and tangible resources (Teece, 2007). Business scholars have examined how dynamic capabilities facilitate operating internationally, but scholarly understanding of how dynamic capabilities develop remains incomplete. In this research we propose to study how MNEs’ dynamic capabilities arise from their specific “global footprints”, reflected by their portfolio of foreign subsidiaries. We will first propose a conceptual model, suggesting that the greater the institutional diversity a firm deals with, the more likely that it will develop dynamic capabilities and have superior financial performance. If that proves to be the case, we will then examine the limits to this process and contingent factors such as an MNE’s speed of internationalization, its international experience, learning orientation and the international experience of its managers. We will design and implement an empirical study to test the theoretical relationships proposed. The results will provide a better understanding of the relationship between institutional diversity and capability building for MNEs. 制度多样性代表了跨国公司所面临的制度环境变化的程度。国际商务学者开始逐步的意识到制度环境在影响跨国公司的活动方面所起到的关键作用(Meyer,Estrin,Bhaumik,& Peng,2009;Peng,Wang,& Jiang,2008)。不同国家的制度环境差异很大(Berry,Guillén,& Zhou,2010;Jackson & Deeg,2008)。虽然跨国公司本质上是在多个国家开展运作，但它们在东道国所面临的制度安排的多样性程度并不是同质的。两个跨国公司即便在同样数量的东道国开展运营活动，他们可能面临非常不同的制度多样性水平。因为在其中一个跨国公司的东道国中，各个东道国在制度条件（即低制度多样性）方面可能非常相似，而在另一跨国公司的东道国中，各个东道国的制度环境可能非常多样化（即高度的制度多样性）。 我们认为跨国公司在国际扩张中所体现的制度多样性可以促进动态能力的发展。跨国公司可以通过制度多样性构建动态能力。因为跨国公司在不同的东道国与不同的利益相关者进行互动，能够促使跨国公司具备知识多样性，适应性组织流程和更多套利机会。 动态能力被定义为“公司整合，构建和重新配置内部和外部能力以应对快速变化的环境的能力”（Teece，Pisano，＆Shuen，1997：516）。动态能力通常可分为三类，即：（1）感知机会和威胁的能力;（2）把握机会的能力;（3）定期改造商业企业的无形和有形资源的能力（Teece，2007）。虽然现有的研究已经探究了动态能力的如何促进国际化运作，但关于如何开发动态能力的研究仍然不完善。 该研究项目旨在探究跨国公司如何从其特定的“全球化进程”——即其海外子公司的投资组合中获取动态能力。我们将首先提出一个概念模型，表明跨国公司面临的制度多样性水平越高，他们发展动态能力的可能性越大，财务绩效也越高。然后，我们探究以上关系的一系列边界条件，诸如跨国公司的国际化速度，国际化年限，学习导向和管理者的国际化经验等因素。我们将设计并实施一项实证研究来检验以上所提出的理论关系。改研究结果将更好地帮助学界理解制度多样性与跨国公司能力建设之间的关系。

16507219.label: Realisation of objectives
16507219.value: We have now completed the project and achieved the project objectives as listed above. In the first phase of the research project, we focused on building the theoretical framework, developing the constructs, and preparing for empirical data analyses. We have conducted a comprehensive literature review in building a conceptual model. We are very pleased to report the recent publication of a top tier, UTD-24 journal article from this project in the Journal of International Business Studies, on a comprehensive literature review of institutions and the international strategy of MNEs, together with several coauthors (Dau, L., Li, J., Lyles, M., & Chacar, A., 2022. “Informal institutions and the international strategy of MNEs: Effects of institutional effectiveness, convergence, and distance”. Journal of International Business Studies, 53 (6): 1257-1281). In the second phase of the project, we conducted an empirical study to test the theoretical relationships proposed in this study. We are pleased to report a completed working paper which is currently under revision for submission to a top tier management journal, the Strategic Management Journal (Li, J. Du, J., & Yi, J., 2023. “Learning from Institutional Diversity: Global Footprints and the Development of Dynamic Capabilities”). This empirical paper examines the relationship between institutional diversity and the development of dynamic capabilities. In summary, we have published one top-tier UTD-24 article (JIBS) and have completed a working paper targeting a top tier management journal.

16507219.label: Major findings and research outcome
16507219.value: While studies have examined how the deployment of dynamic capabilities facilitates international operations, knowledge regarding how dynamic capabilities are developed remains incomplete. This study suggests that MNEs’ dynamic capabilities can derive from their specific “global footprints”, and that the higher the level of institutional diversity of their “global footprints”, the more likely they will build up dynamic capabilities. This effect is strengthened for MNEs that start internationalization at a younger age but weakened for MNEs with a rapid speed of internationalization. Empirical analyses based on a panel dataset of 1,093 MNEs from 27 countries support our propositions. This research contributes to the literature by incorporating cross-country institutional complexities to the dynamic capabilities’ perspective. We specify the crucial role of MNEs’ global footprints across heterogenous institutional environments in building up their dynamic capabilities. Operating in multiple host countries, MNEs are not only exposed to industry dynamism such as fast-paced changes in technologies, customer needs, and competitor activities, but also to country dynamism derived from heterogeneous institutional environments (e.g., different political regimes, regulatory structures, and social norms across countries). Although such country-level complexities are the key concern of international business scholars, extant dynamic capabilities research that normally based on a single country context seldom incorporates this country dynamism. Moreover, this study examines the intertwined effects of both spatial and temporal variations in MNE internationalization process that shape the development of dynamic capabilities. While studies have examined the role of experiences in shaping firms’ dynamic capabilities, under what conditions prior experiences are more (or less) likely to facilitate the development of dynamic capabilities are underexplored. This study shows that, in the MNE context, firms benefit more from their institutionally diverse experiences when they have less entrenched routines or constrained structures (i.e., start internationalization at a younger age). On the contrary, firms benefit less from their institutionally diverse experiences when they proceed with internationalization at a rapid pace. This result resonates with previous studies suggesting that firms often learn less from their experience that is accumulated at a rapid pace and replicates this effect in the internationalization context.

16507219.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16507219.value: There are several areas for future research. First, drawing on theoretical foundations, we explain the effect of institutional diversity from a capability building perspective. However, our data limit us to directly measure dynamic capabilities. Although we chose different performance variables to reflect the effect of dynamic capabilities and did additional analyses to test underlying mechanisms, it is still useful for future research to examine the evolution of dynamic capabilities with more direct and fine-grained measures. Second, future research should also explore the antecedents of institutional diversity. The heterogeneity of MNEs’ portfolio of foreign subsidiaries may derive from various reasons, for example, industrial features that require inputs from distant countries, or MNEs’ market-seeking motivations that lead them to explore new customers and locations. Although, in this study, we have adopted the Heckman two-stage models with the exclusive restriction to handle the potential endogeneity issues, it would be intriguing for future research to explore what factors induce MNEs to locate in diverse institutional environments.

16507219.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16507219.value: The key motivation of this project is to understand how expanding globally across heterogenous institutional environments shapes the development of MNEs’ dynamic capabilities. We suggested that MNEs that are exposed to distinctive institutional environments are more likely to have diverse knowledge bases, adaptive organizational processes and more arbitrage opportunities that enable them to integrate, build, and reconfigure internal and external resources on a global scale to address dynamic industrial and institutional environments. Our results demonstrated that MNEs indeed benefit from institutional diversity, reflected in improved financial and innovation performance. Moreover, we investigated temporal variations in MNEs’ international process that affect the building process of dynamic capabilities from institutional diversity. We found that the capability building process is strengthened in MNEs that start internationalization at a younger age but attenuated when MNEs proceed internationalization with a rapid speed. Unlike extant research that predominantly focuses on how MNEs deploy dynamic capabilities to facilitate international operations, our findings elaborate how MNEs develop dynamic capabilities from their global expansions. In addition to the conventional focus of dynamic capabilities perspective on technological and industrial dynamism, we highlight the role of institutional dynamism in shaping the development of dynamic capabilities in the MNE context.

16601319.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16601319.value: Our early experiences shape how we perceive ourselves and other people in the world. From a young age, we interact with the environment in which we are raised to gather information and use various cues to make judgments about informants. Children are particularly sensitive to social group membership when considering the trustworthiness of informants, preferring to learn from and socialize with those who belong to the same social group (e.g., ethnicity) as themselves. Children are also aware of how their social group compares (in terms of social status) to other groups in their society and may adjust their preference for their own group if it is relatively low in status. In the proposed project, we will investigate the ability of kindergarten children to consider multiple social group cues (i.e., ethnicity and social status) in three Hong Kong populations: children from the ethnic majority (Chinese), and children from the two main ethnic minorities (White, Asian). We will focus on the following: 1) whether both ethnic majority and minority children demonstrate an awareness of ethnic group differences and show a preference for their own ethnic groups; 2) whether the three groups of children are aware of differences in social status and prefer high-status individuals to low-status ones; 3) how children consider ethnic group and social status when these two types of information are presented together; and 4) whether family background influences children’s sensitivity to ethnic group and social status. We will work with children enrolled in Hong Kong kindergartens. We will also collect information about family background from the parents. Given the rapid growth of the Hong Kong ethnic minority population, understanding the needs of all young children will be crucial to reducing their vulnerability to ethnicity- and status-related prejudice and discrimination, and to ensuring their ability to become productive members of society. The proposed project will focus on the social experiences children have at a young age and the influence these experiences have on their perceptions of themselves and those around them. Previous research on social cognition and early childhood development has largely drawn on samples from populations in the West. Extending this body of work, we will investigate three separate groups of children from a non-Western culture to gain a deeper understanding of the potential universal effects various types of social group information can have from an early stage in life. 從幼兒時期起，孩子們就能與他們成長的環境進行互動，以收集信息並使用各種線索來對信息提供者進行判斷。在考慮信息提供者的可信度時，兒童對社會群體的成員身份特別敏感：他們通常喜歡向屬於同一社會群體（例如種族）的人學習、並與他們社交。在此計劃的研究課題中，我們將研究多種社會群體線索（即種族和社會地位）對於幼兒思考能力的影響。我們研究將關注以下內容：1）幼兒自己所屬的種族是否會影響他們對種族群體差異的認識及影響他們對不同種族群體的偏好程度; 2）幼兒是否能意識到社會高低階級的差異，並且是否會對高低階級有不同的偏見; 3）當種族群體和社會階級的線索一起呈現時，幼兒會如何思考; 4）以及幼兒的家庭背景是否會影響他們對種族群體和社會階級的敏感性。我們將邀請在香港幼稚園就讀的兒童參與實驗研究，也將向兒童的父母收集有關兒童家庭背景的資訊。鑑於在香港來自於少數種族人口的快速增長，理解所有幼兒的需求對於減少他們對種族和地位相關的偏見和歧視的易感性至關重要，並且可以保證所有孩子長大之後有能力成為有生產力的社會成員。

16601319.label: Realisation of objectives
16601319.value: All four objectives have been realized in their entirety. We have elaborated on how these objectives were completed in Section 6.1 (Major findings and research outcome). In brief, we have determined that young ethnic majority and minority children were able to distinguish between their ethnicity and other ethnic groups, and between high- and low-status individuals. We found that ethnic majority Chinese demonstrated a clear preference for their ingroup members, while EM White children showed no preference for either group and EM Asian children showed a preference for outgroup members. Chinese and Asian children did consider the immediate status of the portrayed characters, though White children did not. Finally, family background had limited impact on children's socializing preferences.
