27203319.label: Major findings and research outcome
27203319.value: The project provided empirical evidence for the following major findings: i) The survey and field measurement studies indicate that underground development users' health was significantly affected by space design, greenery, thermal comfort, indoor air quality, ventilation, and acoustic comfort, but not visual comfort in underground built environment (Chan and Chen, 2022; Chan and Chen, 2023; Chan, Soh, and Chen, 2021; Chen and Chan, 2022). ii) Among the various identified factors, space design (e.g., connectivity) had the strongest predicting effects on human health (Chan and Chen, 2022; Chan and Chen, 2023). iii) The virtual experiment provided physiological data supports that physical connection to the outside environments had no significant impact on the psychophysiological states of underground space occupants under stress (Chan, Dong, Chen, 2024). iv) The VR experiment further indicated that, while visual connection had no significant impact on occupants' mental workload and fatigue, it buffered the increase in their alertness levels under stressful situations (Chan, Dong, Chen, 2024). v) In low noise underground spaces, all green density levels mitigated the negative effects of stress on occupants' intuition, attention, and relaxation, with a medium green density level further significantly enhancing relaxation (Chan, Dong, Guo, Li, and Cooper, 2024). vi) In medium noise underground spaces, all green density levels mitigated the negative effects of stress on occupants' attention and relaxation, although the stress impact on intuition was only mitigated by a medium green density level (Chan, Dong, Guo, Li, and Cooper, 2024). The findings led to the development of a series of guideline recommendations for underground FM-H, e.g., i) For underground spaces designed for work requiring a high level of attention, e.g., clerical and technical work, visual connection does not make a difference in occupants' mental workload and fatigue. ii) Visual connection to the outside environments (e.g., glass ceiling/ designs visualizing outside elements) is recommended for underground spaces designed for artistic and creative purposes, e.g., art studios, creative media production, museums, and exhibitions. iii) In medium-noise underground spaces designed for individuals playing personnel management and leadership roles, e.g., management offices in subway stations, a medium level of green density is recommended. iv) In low-noise underground space designated for art-related purposes, a medium level of greenery is crucial for enhancing individuals' relaxation levels and fostering creativity. v) Greenery at all levels, even a low greenery level, is recommended for space designed for complex tasks requiring accuracy and precision to maintain users' attention levels.

27203319.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
27203319.value: In this study, the virtual experiment was carried out for a relatively brief period to minimise any potential discomfort associated with using virtual reality headset technologies. Consequently, participants were exposed to the underground environment for a comparatively short time. Future research could explore longer exposure times and occupant adaptations to the environment, more closely mimicking real-life situations. CAVE-facilitated VR experiments could be a promising approach to investigate the impact of extended exposure to underground spaces on the health of occupants. This research provided valuable insights into relationships between underground features, like connectivity types, green density, and noise levels, and users' physiological and psychological health. However, further investigation is needed. The study found visual connectivity buffered users' alertness levels compared to physical connectivity. In the virtual experiment, the sky ceiling's outside view primarily featured an urban landscape. Different views (e.g., city, green, and blue views), window sizes, layouts, and geometric variables might impact occupants' health. Further studies should explore various outside views and sky ceiling settings' influence on occupant health in underground spaces. Additionally, investigating other underground green factors, such as types, quality, and greenery-human interaction, and their effects on users' health and behaviours is recommended.

27203319.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
27203319.value: The cost of underground developments is significantly higher than that of aboveground. The economic burden can be even greater if the environment is built without adequate consideration of users' health (building-related health problems cost the NHS £1.4bn annually; BRE, 2016). Proper FM can enhance building users' health. However, most existing literature focuses on aboveground development, while limited underground FM literature is generally outdated and lacks empirical support. This study developed an FM-Health (FM-H) model, shedding light on significant health-influencing underground FM components, such as connectivity, greenery, and noise level. Detailed recommendations were provided on enhancing underground space users' health through careful management of these FM factors. Besides advancing FM knowledge from aboveground to underground, the study results also promote empirically supported guidelines to FM and design professionals, enhancing underground users' health. It is envisaged that major industrial partners can make reference to these findings in reviewing existing underground developments and designing future ones. This project also helps increase social acceptance of underground developments in the long run, benefiting future policies on Hong Kong underground developments.

27210019.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27210019.value: 用於耐用、可呼吸的皮膚共形電子的仿生芳綸納米纖維複合材料

27210019.label: Project Objectives
27210019.value: To synthesize biomimetic ANF composites with engineered mechanical properties for skin interfaces. To develop fabrication techniques that allow integration of ANF composites with electro-active materials for building conformal membrane devices. To demonstrate ANF-based skin-integrated electronics with the ability to continuously monitor physiological information.
rows: To synthesize biomimetic ANF composites with engineered mechanical properties for skin interfaces.
To develop fabrication techniques that allow integration of ANF composites with electro-active materials for building conformal membrane devices.
To demonstrate ANF-based skin-integrated electronics with the ability to continuously monitor physiological information.

27210019.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27210019.value: Recently emerged concepts in soft electronics have created opportunities for seamlessly merging advanced electronic devices with the human body. Among the many applications, integration of devices on the human skin represents an area with growing interest. The skin-integrated systems can allow continuous monitoring of physiological information about the human body in non-invasive and miniaturized platforms, providing critical utilities for healthcare and wearable technologies. Although extensive research efforts have been devoted to novel soft conductors or semiconductors for creating electronic functions, the basic structural materials for these devices has remained mostly limited to a few conventional polymers constructed as dense films. Although these polymer films can serve as the substrates for skin-mounted electronics, they are “non-breathable” as they hinder gas and water transport. In addition, there are some trade-offs between the mechanical robustness of the devices and their conformability to the skin surface. Such material limitations have meant the previous classes of skin-mounted electronics may have many issues during usage, such as discomfort, delamination from the skin, fracture of circuit components, or other problems. We recently developed a new method of preparing biomimetic composites that replicate the structures and physical functions of soft tissues, such as skin, cartilage and other connective tissues. A typical material can be made from aramid nanofibers (ANF) interlaced with soft polymers such as poly(vinyl alcohol) (PVA), which emulate the collagen-proteoglycan network in load-bearing soft tissues. These biomimetic nanocomposites possess a rare combination of high porosity (~92%), stretchability (~325%), mechanical strength (~30 MPa), and fracture toughness (~9200 J/m^2). Their similarity to natural tissues suggests their uses in advanced bio-integrated devices, which could minimize material mismatch at the biotic/abiotic interfaces leading to significant improvements in device performance. In this proposed research, we aim to develop biomimetic ANF composites as the base materials for robust, breathable, and skin-conformal electronics. We will engineer the physical properties of the ANF-based composites for skin interfaces. Their intrinsic high toughness and porosity can be coupled with micro-fabricated soft membrane structures, including those with reconfigurable 3D patterns inspired by kirigami paper art. Electro-active materials will be incorporated into these conformal, breathable, and mechanically robust membranes to realize physiological sensors and stimulators that can reliably interface with the natural skin. The outcome of this research could pave the way to building advanced bioelectronic tools that naturally integrate with the human body for promoting human health. 近年來，柔性電子的發展為實現先進電子器件和人體的融合提供了機會。在若干應用領域中，器件與皮膚表面的集成代表了一個前沿的研究方向。這些皮膚集成的電子系統可以以微型化、無創的方式對人體健康參數進行連續實時監測，為醫療健康和可穿戴技術提供關鍵的功能。儘管在用於電子功能的柔性導體和半導體材料方面已經有了大量的研究工作，這些器件的基礎結構材料仍然局限於少數幾種緻密的傳統高分子膜。雖然這些高分子膜可以作為皮膚集成電子的基底材料，但其通常阻礙氣體和水分的傳輸，不具備“可呼吸性”。此外，它們在力學耐用性和共形性方面通常需要做出取捨。由於這些材料方面的局限性，之前的皮膚集成器件在使用時通常會遇到一些問題，例如佩戴不適、 從皮膚表面脫離、電子元件的機械失效等。 我們最近發明了一種製備與天然軟組織結構和性能相似的仿生復合材料的方法。一種典型的材料由芳綸納米纖維與柔性高分子材料（如聚乙烯醇）交織而成。這種材料模擬天然軟組織中膠原蛋白-蛋白聚醣的網絡結構。這些仿生納米複合材料同時具備高孔隙率（~92%）、可拉伸性（~325%）、力學強度（~30 MPa）和斷裂韌性（~9200 J/m^2）。它們與天然組織的相似性使得其可用於製造生物集成器件，以滿足生物/非生物界面的材料匹配性，並提高器件的性能。 在這項研究中，我們將研發用於耐用、可呼吸共形皮膚電子的仿生芳綸納米纖維複合材料。我們將針對皮膚界面應用，調節芳綸納米纖維複合材料的物理性質。它們固有的韌性和高孔隙率將與微加工成型的柔性膜結構結合。相關的微納結構包括由剪紙啟發的可重構三維圖案。電子功能材料將集成於這些皮膚共形、可呼吸和強韌可靠的薄膜中，以實現與皮膚貼合的生理傳感器和刺激器。研究的成果將為發展與人體自然集成的先進生物醫療電子鋪平道路。

27210019.label: Realisation of objectives
27210019.value: We have successfully achieved the objectives. Specifically: (1) The ANF composites were synthesized with solution-based methods. We were able to tune the mechanical properties based on the composition of the materials. Theoretical models were developed to quantitatively analyze the mechanical behaviors of the hybrid nanofiber network. The resultant materials exhibited outstanding mechanical strength and toughness as well as good porosity and permeability, which are desirable for applications in wearable devices. (2) Fabrication techniques were developed based on planar processing and soft transfer printing techniques. We were able to generate ANF-based membranes with controllable thickness. Conductive polymers or microfabricated multifunctional sensors were integrated on the ANF-based device platform. Kirigami-inspired patterns were incorporated in to the membranes to yield 3D conformal devices. (3) We demonstrated multifunctional skin-integrated platform involving sensors for temperature, strain, electrophysiological signals, skin hydration and other parameters. These sensors were important for continuous monitoring of health condition or providing interfaces for human-machine interaction.

27210019.label: Major findings and research outcome
27210019.value: 1. For the nanofiber composites, we found that interactions between ANFs and PVA lead to assembled networks with high nodal connectivity and strong crosslinking between fibrils. As revealed by theoretical simulations of 3D networks, these features at fibrillar joints may lead to an enhancement of macroscopic mechanical properties by orders of magnitude even with a constant level of solid content. Indeed, the polymeric aerogels achieved high fracture energy of ~4700 J m^−2, which are advantageous for diverse structural applications. 2. For the device processing, we found that various electronic components can be integrated into the device platform based on solution processing and surface chemical activation. 3. For functional integration, we demonstrated sensors for temperature, electrophysiology, strain, and other parameters in a wearable platform. They enable human-machine interaction as exemplified by gesture recognition and monitoring of skin health.

27210019.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
27210019.value: Further studies could be focused on long-term monitoring of health conditions and expansion of the functionality to biochemical sensing. They could provide critical capabilities for clinical applications. Furthermore, functionalization of the composite with magnetically, optically and thermally active materials will enable other functional systems. Thorough investigation on the mechanics of random microfibrillar network would provide general design rules for porous functional materials.

27210019.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
27210019.value: In this project, we have developed biomimetic nanocomposites for the construction of robust and skin-conformal electronics. The ANF-PVA hybrid network captured some of the key features of natural soft tissues and provide a biomimetic materials platform for skin-integrated devices. We have developed theoretical understanding and engineering control of the materials processing, leading to materials tailored for realistic applications. Advanced fabrication techniques were developed, generating hybrid device platform for continuous physiological monitoring on the skin. The results obtained from this work would provide routes for further development of advanced wearable systems.

27300819.label: Project Objectives
27300819.value: To investigate the microscope nature of the recently discovered B=0 many-body phase transitions in graphene multilayers. To develop various techniques to realize ‘disorder-free’ graphene nano-structures in advanced geometries. To investigate whether new interaction effects can be engineered in ‘disorder-free’ graphene nano-structures that host new types of electronic band-structures (e.g., in suspended twisted bilayer graphene or at the graphene-TMDC interfaces). To explore—first theoretically and later experimentally—various other possibilities for graphene on different 2D crystals to be realized in a ‘disorder-free’ limit and create new many-body phenomena.

27300819.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27300819.value: Discoveries of many-body phenomena induced by electron-electron interactions have drawn profound interest as they challenge the most-up-to-date theories of quantum materials and lead to new experimental developments at the forefront of modern scientific researches. Here, we propose to go beyond these developments by taking graphene as an exemplary platform, which we can use to devise and perform experiments that not only allow us to reveal new many-body phenomena in ultimate two-dimensional (2D) systems—confined in only a few atomic-layers—but also to gain full control over their properties and design new many-body states. We will take full advantage of ‘three’ specific characteristics of graphene: 1) chemical and structural perfectness preserved down to one-atom-thin-layers, enabling the realization of ultrathin clean devices, which is the most significant hurdle for studying electronic interactions in many 2D systems; 2) electron orbitals exposed on the surface, which allows unprecedented control over its properties (e.g., by strain, electric-fields, or superconducting/magnetic contacts); and 3) atomically smooth surface that can form clean interfaces with other 2D crystals, where wave-function overlap can create new electronic band-structures. Specifically, we will embody suspended graphene devices—that are profoundly less disordered than any other device type—into different nano-structures, such as (split-)dual-gates, magic-angle-twisted bilayers or elongated Moiré superlattices, and then investigate how the many-body phenomena evolve with these structural variations. Particularly, we have recently developed a new scheme to measure density of states of suspended graphene multilayers in transport and used it to detect critical temperatures of the many-body phase transitions emerging at zero magnetic-fields. By employing this scheme in the dual-gate geometry, we expect to explore how applying interlayer bias alters the transitions that may also be associated with changes in topological phases. This study, therefore, will not only help us to understand the phenomena better, but also to engineer new many-body topological states at zero-fields, which is of potential interest for topological quantum computing. We will also advance the existing techniques to realize the cleanest graphene-2D crystal interfaces in various geometries and explore whether new many-body phenomena can be tailored by designing new graphene band-structures. Examples include the spin-split bands in graphene-transition metal dichalcogenide interfaces and the nearly flat ‘Chern’ bands in magic-angle-twisted bilayers. Having seen that over a thousand of 2D crystals exist with various properties that depend on their chemical and crystalline structures, we believe this proposal will lay the cornerstone of the much broader field of ‘designer’ many-body quantum materials. 电子-电子相互作用诱导的多体现象挑战了最新的量子材料理论，并在现代科学研究的最前沿引领了新的实验发展，因此多体现象引起了人们极大的研究兴趣。 这里，我们提出以石墨烯为平台设计并进行实验来推进这些发展，该实验不仅有助于揭示二维（2D）体系中新的多体现象，而且可以实现对其性质的完全操控并设计新的多体态。 我们将充分利用石墨烯的“三个”特性：1）低至单个原子层时仍可以保持其化学和结构的完整性，从而实现超薄干净的器件，克服许多2D体系中电子相互作用研究的最大障碍；2）电子轨道暴露于表面，因此我们可以对其性质进行调控（例如，通过应变、电场或超导/磁接触）；3）原子级平滑的表面可以与其它2D晶体形成干净的界面，使得界面处波函数产生重叠，进而形成新的电子能带结构。 具体而言，由于悬浮石墨烯器件的无序度要远低于其它器件，我们可以利用这个优势将其制成不同的纳米结构，比如分/双栅、魔转角双层或细长Moiré超晶格，并研究多体现象随这些结构的演变。 我们最近发展了一个新方法来测量输运中悬浮多层石墨烯态密度，并利用该方法探测零磁场下多体相变的临界温度。此外，我们将其应用到双栅几何结构中，探索如何应用层间偏压来改变可能与拓扑相位变化有关的转变。因此，该研究不仅能够帮助我们更好地理解多体现象，而且有助于设计零场下新的多体拓扑态，这为拓扑量子计算提供了非常好的实验基础，具有重要的潜在意义。 我们还将推进已有的技术，在各种几何形状中实现最干净的石墨烯/2D晶体界面，并探索是否能够通过设计新的石墨烯能带结构调控出新的多体现象，例如石墨烯/过渡金属二硫化物界面的自旋劈裂能带和魔转角双层石墨烯中近乎平坦的“陈”带。目前已经发现一千多种2D晶体存在各种优异的性质，这些性质取决于它们的化学和晶体结构，因此我们的方案将为更广泛的“设计者”-多体量子材料领域的研究奠定基础。

27300819.label: Realisation of objectives
27300819.value: The project has four objectives which had all been addressed with 6 papers published, two submitted [arXiv:2405.10079, arXiv:2405.20393], and one or two in preparation, as well as 7 invited/oral presentations in international conferences and 1 PhD student graduated. Below, I summarize the achievements made, challenges encountered, and our attempts to overcome such challenges. First, in the objective 1, we initially proposed to use suspended graphene nanostructures to study many-body states at zero magnetic fields. We had tried to fabricate and measure such devices, but there had been quite some difficulties in annealing the samples to reach high quality needed to observe many-body effects. We had tried to change chemicals used in device fabrication, add series of noise filters to reduce possible electrical shocks during current annealing, and make cleaner vacuum environment, but the yield remained extremely low. In addition to unexpected significant delays in installing cryogenic measurement systems due to pandemic, such a low annealing yield had prevented us from studying sufficient number of suspended graphene nanostructures to pursue the original plan. Thus, alternatively, since the main goal is to study many-body effects in graphene multilayers at zero magnetic fields, we had switched to graphene-based van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures thanks to the recent developments of the vdW stacking technique to realize high-quality samples. The first system we studied is graphene-hexgonal boron nitride (hBN) moiré heterostructures where graphene is aligned with hBN to form long-period moiré patterns that induce superlattice potential in graphene. Such a long periodicity significantly reduces the reciprocal lattice size and create so-called moiré mini-bands that had exhibited many interesting many-body effects. In our study, we added an intrinsic graphene very close (only a few nanometer distance) to the graphene-hBN moiré structure in order to measure the Coulomb interactions between the charge carriers in the moiré mini-bands and those in the intrinsic Dirac bands. Through systematic transport study, we found that these carriers interact with each other strongly enough to generate a finite Coulomb drag resistance despite the fact that their reciprocal lattice sizes are an order of magnitude different. This suggests that one can use this Coulomb drag experiment to investigate many-body interactions in various moiré systems. Having seen a rapidly growing interests in moiré physics, we believe our study provides an excellent new platform to explore new moiré physics. The paper is about to be submitted [arXiv:2405.20393]. The second system studied is the twisted double bilayer graphene systems where two bilayer graphene was twisted at a small angle to form a homo-moiré structure that has so-called flat moiré mini-bands. Using the microneedle cut-and-twist technique developed by us (AIP Adv. 2024; see below), we were able to create the devices with different twisting angles, 0.3° and 0.7°, from which we found correlated insulating states and the change of the thermally excited charge carrier density (n*) in temperature by following the technique used to detect the many-body phase transition in suspended graphene multilayers [Science 362, 324 (2018)]. We are currently analyzing the data to check how n*(T) varies with electric fields and twisting angle. Furthermore, we found series of Landau level crossing in the sample with 0.3° twisting angle which may originate from the interaction-driven symmetry broken Landau levels. For the objective 2 that aims to develop new technique to build vdW heterostructures with high precision, we had developed an economic technique that uses commercially available microneedle probes in existing transfer stages. Since the technique doesn’t require expensive equipment like a laser or an AFM or there is no need to modify the existing transfer stages while providing sub-micrometer stacking precision, it has allowed us to build various types of vdW heterostructures easily and economically. In fact, the twisted double bilayer graphene discussed above was fabricated by using this technique. We are currently using this technique to build different moiré structures to study the many-body effects. The work had been published in AIP Adv. 14, 015333 (2024) as an Editor’s pick. For the objective 3 where we aim to study graphene nanostructures with electronic bands other than intrinsic graphene, we had fabricated and measured four different types of devices, graphene-hBN-graphene moiré heterostructures, twisted double bilayer graphene, graphene on transition metal dichacolgenides (TMDCs), and graphene on twisted hBN substrate. The results from the first two were discussed above that had shown interesting new correlations effects. In graphene-TMDC heterostructures, we confirmed that the TMDC induces strong spin-orbit coupling in graphene while keeping the high-quality transport properties of graphene. This allowed us to investigate ballistic transport in the system that is important for emerging ballistic spin-orbitronics. Moreover, by applying large magnetic field, we observed symmetry broken Landau levels. In graphene on twisted hBN substrate, we find that the moiré potential formed in twisted hBN can be induced into graphene, creating a series of Dirac points. The works on graphene-TMDC heterostructures had been published in Nature communications [Nat. Com. 14, 6124 (2023)] and in Phys. Status Solidi B [pssb 2300397 (2024)], and the work on graphene-twisted hBN is currently under review [arXiv:2405.10079]. Lastly, the objective 4 aims to study the effects of different 2D materials on many-body states in graphene. For this, we had collaborated with different groups to explore diverse materials including CVD-grown In2Se3 nanoflakes [J. Alloys Compd. 870, 159344 (2021)], Tellurium nanobelts [Nano-Micro Lett. 14, 109 (2022)], and MBE-grown wafer-scale MoSe2 and WSe2 [Nat. Sci. 3, 20220059 (2023)]. We had also been studying new magnetic materials such as NiCl2 which is expected to be electrically insulating with a unique in-plane magnetic texture. These new materials can be used to induce ferroelectricity (In2Se3) or magnetism (NiCl2) in graphene to study how these new properties affect the interactions effects. With these, we have shown that all four objectives proposed in this project were achieved.

27300819.label: Major findings and research outcome
27300819.value: During the project, we had published 6 papers in international journals like Nature Communications, Natural Sciences, and AIP Advances (listed in Part C), submitted two paper (arXiv: 2405.10079, arXiv:2405.20393), and given 7 invited/oral presentations in international conferences including IWSSQC, CSW, and APS March Meeting (listed in Part C). Below, I summarize the major findings. First, published in AIP Adv. 14, 015333 (2024) as an Editor’s pick, we had developed and demonstrated new techniques to build various types of van der Waals heterostructures using commercially available microneedle probes without modifying the existing transfer stages nor using expensive equipment like a laser or AFM. Using this technique, we have so far been able to build diverse types of heterostructures including graphene-hBN-graphene moiré heterostructures, twisted double bilayer graphene, and graphene on twisted hBN substrate, from which new interactions effects originating from the moiré patterns were found. The work on graphene-twisted hBN was submitted for publication recently (arXiv:2405.10079) and we are preparing another discussing the work on graphene-hBN-graphene moiré heterostructures for submission (arXiv:2405.20393). Second, by building high-quality graphene-transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) heterostructures, we have shown that the spin-orbit coupling in graphene is enhanced by more than three orders of magnitude (from only a few micro-electron Volt to about 10 milli-electron Volt) due to TMDC while high-quality transport properties of graphene are conserved. By taking advantage of this unique property, we have successfully measured ballistic transverse magnetic focusing effect from which we finally confirmed the spin-orbit coupling induced band splitting in graphene by transport measurements. This work, as the first experimental proof of the ballistic transport in graphene with spin-orbit coupling, introduces graphene-TMDC heterostructures as one of the promising material platform to investigate emerging ballistic spin-orbitronics where one uses spin-orbit coupling and ballistic electron motion to realize a full control of both spin and orbital moments of charge carriers. The work was published in Nature Communications 14, 6124 (2023). Lastly, we have applied large magnetic fields on graphene-TMDC heterostructures and found the series of symmetry broken quantum-Hall states from which we were able to estimate the spin-orbit coupling strength and understand the Landau level crossing behavior. This can allow us to investigate exotic quantum-Hall states that appear in graphene with spin-orbit coupling such as non-Abelian fractional quantum-Hall states or topological Chern insulating states, etc. The work was published in Phys. Status Solidi B, 2300397 (2024).

27300819.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
27300819.value: Having seen rapid developments in vdW hetrostructures, we expect the research carried out in this project can lead to diverse new directions. First, the work on graphene-TMDC heterostructures [Nat. Comm. 2033] can be extended to study the effect of spin-orbit coupling on many-body states, while the study on graphene-hBN-graphene moiré heterostructures where strong couplings between the moiré and original Dirac bands were confirmed can lead to the similar studies in different moiré systems. Moreover, the study on graphene-twisted hBN [arXiv:2405.10079] can be easily extended to other 2D materials such as black phosphorus to induce new moiré potential. All these studies can lead to discovery in new many-body phenomena. To seize these new opportunities early, we have already started working on few of them. For instance, we have sandwiched twisted bilayer graphene between TMDCs to see if the spin-orbit coupling can induce new interaction-driven anomalous Hall states in the flat bands. Moreover, we made graphene-monolayer hBN-graphene heterostructures with two graphene layers aligned to investigate how each graphene bands can be coupled to form the flat bands. Since the field advances quickly, we will continue working on these experiments while proactively searching for new interesting systems to study in parallel.

27300819.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
27300819.value: The project aimed to explore how charge carriers in only one or few-atom-thin layer of graphite, mono- or few-layer graphene respectively, interact with each other by making new types of high-quality nanostructures. Since the carriers in graphene are strongly confined in atomic thickness, they are strongly coupled to each other much more than in bulk materials where the carriers can move away from each other in all directions. Because of this, studying interactions in graphene had been an interesting topic in modern science. In this project, we have carried out such studies in several different graphene nanostructures. By placing two graphene close with only a few nanometer distance, we found that the carriers in separated layers are coupled by Coulomb interactions to create new interaction phenomena. Further, by aligning two graphene bilayers with an angle less than only one degree, we found the strong interactions effects due to the formation of flat bands that vary with the angle. By placing graphene on another 2D materials, we have also proven that the carriers in graphene gain new properties such as strong spin-orbit coupling. All these studies demonstrate that one can engineer and discover new physics by design in graphene nanostructures.

27305119.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27305119.value: When a star wanders too close to the supermassive black hole in the center of the host galaxy, the tidal force exerted by the black hole can tear the star apart. As the stellar debris is accreted onto the black hole, a very luminous flare can be produced illuminating the previously quiescent black hole for a few years. This is called a tidal disruption event (TDEs), and currently we have observed a few dozen candidate events. We propose to study the accretion and emission physics in TDEs. Due to the unique pattern that the stellar debris falls back to the vicinity of the black hole, we expect that lot of debris material is quickly supplied to the black hole, causing an extreme type of accretion event called super-Eddington accretion to happen around the peak of the flare. Then the debris supply rate gradually declines over a few years following a characteristic pattern, during which course the accretion rate onto the black hole should drop from super-Eddington to sub-Eddington. The PI and collaborators have several state-of-the-art numerical tools which have been developed to study the accretion and emission processes around black holes, and especially in the super-Eddington regime which is relatively understudied. The proposed study will help us address some of the challenges posed by observations of TDEs, which are likely linked to our current incomplete understanding of TDE accretion and emission physics. The results from this study are much needed for extracting the information of black hole mass and spin parameters from TDE observed properties. In the upcoming decade, various wide-field transient surveys such as the LSST, Einstein Probe and eROSITA will allow us to detect thousands of TDEs per year. This work will be useful in providing interpretation of the overwhelming, imminent data. 當星系中的恆星移動至距離星系中心的超大質量黑洞過近的時候，黑洞的潮汐引力會把恆星撕裂。其後，恆星碎片被黑洞吸積，而此過程中輻射出的亮光可照亮黑洞長達數年。這被稱為潮汐瓦解事件(TDE)，目前我們已觀測到幾十個此類天體現象。 我們申請研究TDE中的黑洞吸積以及輻射物理學。由於恆星碎片落回黑洞附近的獨特模式，很多碎片物質預計會被快速供應到黑洞附近，因而產生一種極端類型的吸積事件。在供應率的峰值，黑洞的吸積率遠超過愛丁頓吸積率。峰值過後的幾年內，恆星碎片供應率逐漸下降。在此過程中黑洞的吸積率從超愛丁頓也逐漸下降到亞愛丁頓。 申請人和合作者擁有幾種最先進的數值模擬工具，這些工具是為研究黑洞周圍的吸積和輻射過程，特別是目前了解較少的超愛丁頓吸積物理而研發的。目前對TDE的觀測結果已經對TDE理論有所挑戰，而這些問題可能源於目前對TDE中黑洞吸積和輻射物理學未能充分理解。擬議的研究課題將幫助我們解決這些問題。此外，這項研究課題對于從TDE觀測中提取黑洞質量和自旋參數的信息也非常關鍵。最後，在接下來的十年中，LSST，Einstein Probe和eROSITA等各種大型巡天項目將每年觀測到數千個TDE。本項研究工作也將有助於解釋這些即將到來的大量TDE觀測數據。

27308219.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27308219.value: In high-dimensional data analysis, the factor model has been widely employed as a typical tool of dimension reduction, with the feature that only a few important latent variables affect a vast number of original series. However, researchers applying factor analysis to nonstationary data always face a choice: keep the data in levels or first difference them. This proposed research sets out to provide a strong warning to empirical researchers tempted by the arguments advocating factor estimation in levels, by conducting the principal component analysis (PCA) of factorless high-dimensional nonstationary data. The proposed project has four primary objectives: (i) conduct PCA of independent nonstationary data; (ii) estimate the number of spurious factors; (iii) derive Dickey-fuller test for the estimated idiosyncratic terms; and (iv) establish inconsistency of genuine factor estimates. To be more specific, we aim to prove that although independent nonstationary data do not contain factors in the usual sense, they do admit an unusual factor-like structure, such that a few of the "factors" absorb nearly all the data variation. An application of standard panel information criteria to such data will give a nontrivial estimate of the number of spurious factors. Furthermore, the standard Dickey-Fuller tests of the unit root hypothesis applied to the estimated idiosyncratic terms are expected to often reject the null hypothesis, creating an impression that a few factors are responsible for most of the nonstationarity in the data. Lastly, when there are true pervasive factors in the data with persistent idiosyncratic terms, applying PCA without first differencing the data will deliver inconsistent estimates of the true factors. 在因子模型中，大部分数据变化可由少数变量解释。这使得因子模 型在高维数据分析中有着广泛的应用。然而，当数据为非平稳时， 实证研究者经常面临是否需要差分数据的选择。本项目以此为出发 点，研究高维无因子非平稳数据的主成分分析。具体地， 通过类比 经典的伪回归分析，证明了独立非平稳数据依然具有类似因子模型 的主成分结构：少数主成分解释了大部分数据变化，并给出主成分 的具体形式。该结果对实证研究者判定是否需要差分数据有着重要 的指导意义。

27308219.label: Major findings and research outcome
27308219.value: Research outcome [1] draws parallels between the principal components analysis of factorless high-dimensional nonstationary data and the classical spurious regression. We show that a few of the principal components of such data absorb nearly all the data variation. The corresponding scree plot suggests that the data contain a few factors, which is corroborated by the standard panel information criteria. Furthermore, the Dickey–Fuller tests of the unit root hypothesis applied to the estimated “idiosyncratic terms” often reject, creating an impression that a few factors are responsible for most of the non-stationarity in the data. We warn empirical researchers of these peculiar effects and suggest to always compare the analysis in levels with that in differences. Research outcome [2] studies the empirical spectral distributions of two sample-covariance type matrices associated with high-dimensional time series with unit roots. The first matrix is S = XX'/T; where X is an n×T data set, with rows represented by n independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) copies of T consecutive observations of a difference-stationary process. The second matrix is W = n int_0^1 Wn (t) Wn (t)' dt; where Wn (t) is an n-dimensional vector with i.i.d. Brownian motion components. We show that as n and T diverge to infinity proportionally, the two distributions weakly converge to non-random limits. The limit corresponding to S has a density that decays as x^{-3/2} when x oinfty. The limit corresponding to W is a Feller-Pareto distribution. An illustrative application is provided. Research outcome [3] extends [1] to high-dimensional data with heterogeneous local-to-unit roots. We find a spurious factor phenomenon similar to that observed in the data with unit roots. Namely, the “factors” estimated by the principal components analysis converge to principal eigenfunctions of a weighted average of the covariance kernels of the demeaned Ornstein–Uhlenbeck processes with different decay rates. Thus, such “factors” reflect the structure of the strong temporal correlation of the data and do not correspond to any cross-sectional commonalities, that genuine factors are usually associated with. Furthermore, the principal eigenvalues of the sample covariance matrix are very large relative to the other eigenvalues, creating an illusion of the “factors” capturing much of the data’s common variation.

27308219.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
27308219.value: Research outcome [3] conjectures that the spurious factor phenomenon holds, more generally, for data obtained from high frequency sampling of heterogeneous continuous time (or spacial) processes and provide an illustration. In the future, the PI aims to prove this conjecture and to publish more research outcome along this direction.

27308219.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
27308219.value: The project quantifies dangers of factor analysis of nonstationary data that are not first differenced. Even in the absence of any factors, about 80% of variation of such data is "explained" by the first three principal components. The corresponding factor estimates are cosine waves that represent eigen-functions of the covariance operator of the Brownian motion. Linking this phenomenon to the classical spurious regression problem, this project shows that such phenomenon not only occurs in data with unit roots, but also in data with heterogeneous local-to-unit roots, and conjectures that it holds more generally for data obtained from high frequency sampling of heterogeneous continuous time (or spacial) processes.

27502019.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27502019.value: The proposed project will examine the extent to which international trade affects business cycle volatilities: does more international trade increase or decrease the depth of business cycles? We will answer this question using data on 40 countries for the 1960–2016 period. More specifically, we will quantitatively evaluate how changes in the international trade pattern have affected the changing volatilities of business cycles over time. Our motivation comes from several observations. There has been a significant increase in international trade volumes in the past 50 years, with a median country seeing an 80% increase in international trade over output in the manufacturing sector, for example. Countries have also changed their trading partners. For example, China has been the top trading partner of the United States since 2005, when it replaced Japan in that spot. These trade patterns can affect the properties of countries’ business cycles. Intuitively, if, say, Canada trades more with the world, it can diversify its own shock, thereby reducing output volatility. At the same time, if Canada trades more with China, whose shocks are volatile, and it cannot diversify those shocks, then Canada will experience an increase in business cycle volatility. In fact, during the recent global financial crisis, countries that traded more with the United States, where the crisis originated, tended to suffer more. In other words, international trade linkages may play an important role in changes in business cycle properties over time. In addition to quantifying the effects of international trade in driving business cycle volatility, the project will also examine other leading explanations. For example, the decline in the importance of the traditionally volatile manufacturing sector in many developed countries may have contributed to the reduction in business cycle volatility. Changes in stabilization policy, such as the implementation of better monetary and fiscal policies, may also be explanatory, or there might simply be changes in the shock volatility hitting an economy. The project methodology will be as follows. We will construct a comprehensive World Input Output table dating from 1960–2016, enabling us to examine how international trade has changed over the long term. We will then develop a model that takes between-country trading networks into account and quantify the historical importance of the aforementioned channels. This project will make important contributions to academic research and policymaking, with important implications for external trade policies, particularly those aimed at stabilizing business cycles.

27502819.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27502819.value: Modern asset pricing theory highlights that risk premia are determined by their covariance with the marginal value of wealth of representative households. Financial intermediaries operate on behalf of the households and are treated as a veil. Recently, intermediary-based asset pricing views financial intermediaries as marginal investors (He and Krishnamurthy, 2013; Adrian and Shin, 2014). The pricing kernel should include the marginal value of wealth and characteristics of intermediaries. This theory is supported by empirical evidence. Adrian et al. (2014) show that the marginal value of intermediaries, measured by the leverage of securities broker-dealers, is a priced factor in the cross section of stock and bond returns. This single-factor model prices stock portfolios sorted on size, book-to-market and momentum and bond portfolios with an R-squared of 77%. The model outperforms standard benchmarks such as CAPM and the Fama-French three-factor model. While households are still heavily involved in the stock market directly, intermediaries are dominant in other financial markets. He et al. (2017) exploit the capital ratio of primary dealers as the risk factor and extend intermediary asset pricing to many asset classes such as corporate and sovereign bonds, commodities and currencies. As financial markets have become more integrated globally, asset pricing is not limited to a local perspective. We study global asset pricing with an intermediary-based perspective. The intermediary-based theory is especially appealing for global financial markets. Country-level heterogeneity and local risks often interacts with financial intermediaries. First, the literature points to the importance of exchange rate risks that potentially are determined by intermediaries (Gabaix and Maggiori, 2015). Second, one large local risk is monetary policy that is often transmitted through the banking system (Drechsler et al., 2014). Third, the degree of market segmentation can be explicit as information friction, capital control and regulations related to trading such as margin requirements and prohibitions on non-domestic holders (Lewis, 2011). We attempt to empirically test intermediary-based asset pricing in the international asset markets. First, we start with a construction of measures of the local intermediary marginal value of wealth in major countries. Second, we test whether global and local intermediary factors capture the cross sectional returns across countries. Third, we explore the economics behind the difference in pricing performance across countries and the circumstances under which intermediaries matter more. Last but not least, exploiting the fact that many international mutual funds are bank-affiliated, we test whether certain stocks have large exposure to intermediary factors. 现代资产定价理论强调风险溢价由资产的价格和代表性个人投资者的财富边际价值之间的协方差决定。金融机构代表个人投资者进行投资交易，而其作用一直被忽视。近年来，基于金融机构的资产定价理论将金融机构视作边际投资人(He and Krishnamurthy, 2013; Adrian and Shin, 2014)，该理论认为定价的核心应该包括金融机构的特征变量和财富边际价值。这个理论获得了许多实证证据支持。Adrian et al. (2014) 的研究表明通过证券交易商的杠杆所衡量的金融中介边际价值是解释横截面层次的股票和债券收益率的一个定价因素。这个单因素模型很好地对基于公司规模，市净率和惯性的股票组合以及债券组合进行了定价，实现了77%的回归拟合度。该模型相较于一些基准模型，例如资本资产定价模型（CAPM）和Fama-French 三因素模型有更好的表现。虽然个人投资者的直接投资在股票市场仍占有较大比例，但是金融中介在其他金融市场的参与率占有主导性。He et al. (2017) 采用主要交易商的资本率（杠杆率）作为风险因素，将基于金融机构的资产定价理论拓展到多类金融资产，例如公司债券，市政债券，商品期货和货币市场。 随着金融市场的全球化发展，资产定价的分析角度不再只是局限于单一国内市场。因此，我们研究全球层面的资产定价，同时结合基于金融机构的资产定价理论。该理论对于研究国际金融市场十分重要， 这表现在本国风险和国家异质性通过金融机构互相影响。首先，文献指出了汇率风险的重要性并提出汇率风险潜在地由金融机构决定(Gabaix and Maggiori, 2015)。其次，一个重要的本国风险源于货币政策，而该风险经常通过银行系统传递(Drechsler et al., 2014)。再次，各国市场一体化程度通过金融机构中反映在信息摩擦，资本控制和交易限制（保证金要求以及禁止非本地持有人）等多方面(Lewis, 2011) 。 我们尝试在国际资产市场中对基于金融机构的资产定价理论进行实证检验。首先，我们构建一个衡量当地金融机构财富边际价值的指标并对国际主要国家分别进行计算。其次，我们研究全球金融机构因素和本国金融机构因素对于解释不同国家的股票收益率的不同作用。接着，我们将会研究基于金融机构的资产定价理论在不同国家的表现以及背后的经济解释，同时我们也将探索国家特征与金融机构定价重要性的关系。最后，基于许多国家的共同基金被银行实际控制，我们将检验是否相关股票在更大程度上被金融机构因素所解释。

27502819.label: Major findings and research outcome
27502819.value: Currencies in emerging markets with stricter capital controls exhibit lower average returns, unexplained by standard currency risk factors. This relation is pronounced in debtor countries with high foreign currency liability shares. Capital controls mitigate currency risk by preventing depreciation during market turmoil. We propose an intermediary asset pricing model incorporating an occasionally binding credit constraint for borrowing countries. Capital controls lower crises probability and reduce currency crashes. The model replicates the empirical findings and quantifies the financial impact of pecuniary externality. Based on the model, currency risk premia serve as a tool for policy evaluation.

27502819.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
27502819.value: Future work can study the optimal policy in a production economy taking into account the documented effects on currency risk. Potentially, the joint dynamics of capital controls and the exchange rate can serve as a barometer to evaluate the resilience of the economy to capital flows and guide the policy designs. The interaction between capital controls, currency intervention, and reserve management is worth more investigation. Furthermore, a richer model with gross position in different asset classes can be used to study different types of capital controls. Empirically, the portfolio-based demand system approach can be a useful and coherent laboratory to further study the effect of capital controls on flows and asset prices.

27502919.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27502919.value: News aggregators such as Google News and Jinri Toutiao pose a major threat to the existence of news publishers. Unlike publishers, news aggregators do not invest resources in producing their own content but instead offer consumers a customizable feed of news snippets from a range of publishers. Many publishers view the practice of news aggregation as theft not just of content but also of potential consumers and advertising revenue. News aggregators, on the other hand, argue that they direct new and increased traffic to publishers. Interestingly, even as many publishers use paywalls to monetize their online content, some intentionally make their paywalls “porous” to traffic from news aggregators. For example, consumers clicking on a Reddit link to a Wall Street Journal article can bypass this publisher’s paywall and read the article for free. There is a significant body of multi-sided market literature addressing the strategic relationship between platforms, consumers, and advertisers (Gal-Or and Dukes, 2003; Weyl, 2010; Ambrus et al., 2014; Amaldoss et al., 2016), and deriving insights on issues such as pricing structure, advertising contracts, and content differentiation. However, given the relative newness of the news aggregation phenomenon, little work has been done to thoroughly examine the role news aggregators play in the media market. As a result, important research questions remain. For example, how should publishers respond to the presence of a news aggregator? What impact does an aggregator have on a publisher’s paywall strategy and profitability? The proposed project aims to build a theoretical model to investigate the strategic interactions between three players: one news aggregator, a continuum of publishers, and a continuum of consumers. We will focus on three key questions. (1) Should a publisher allow the aggregator to collect its news snippets? (2) How should a publisher adjust its paywall strategy in the presence of an aggregator? (3) If an aggregator can identify news snippets that better fit consumers’ interests, will this improved news gathering algorithm benefit or hurt a publisher’s profits? The model and the findings will enhance our understanding of the news aggregation phenomenon, and can provide guidance to media firms on managing aggregator relationships as well as optimally pricing to consumers. In addition, the project will generate significant insights for policymakers who want to maximize the overall welfare of the media industry or to protect the welfare of certain group of market participants. 新闻聚合器，例如谷歌新闻、今日头条等，对很多新闻出版商构成威胁。同新闻出版商不同，新闻聚合器不投入资源生产自己的内容，而是从不同的新闻出版商处摘录新闻链接，并定制化地提供给消费者。许多新闻出版商将新闻聚合器的做法视为对不仅是消费者同时也是广告收益的盗窃。然而，新闻聚合器则认为它将新的更多的消费者流量引向了新闻出版商。有趣的是，即使很多出版商开始使用付费墙来赚钱，一些出版商故意让自己的付费墙不阻挡来自新闻聚合器的流量。例如，如果消费者点击Reddit上的链接到华尔街日报的文章时，他们可以绕过华尔街日报的付费墙而直接阅读其文章。 目前有大量关于多边市场的研究文献，着眼于这个市场中平台、消费者、广告商之间的战略关系 （Gal-Or and Dukes, 2003; Weyl, 2010; Ambrus et al., 2014; Amaldoss et al., 2016）, 并且得到了关于定价结构、广告合约、内容差异化等方面问题的深刻见解。然而，鉴于新闻聚合现象相对较新，对于新闻聚合器在媒体市场中的所扮演角色的系统完整的研究还很少。因此，很多重要的研究问题有待解答。例如，新闻出版商应该如何应对新闻聚合器的出现？新闻聚合器对于新闻出版商付费墙的策略以及盈利能力带来怎样的影响？ 这个研究项目旨在建立一个理论模型来研究这个市场中三种不同参与者 （一个新闻聚合器，一些新闻出版商，以及一些消费者）之间的战略互动。我们将主要关注三个关键问题：（1）新闻出版商是否应该允许新闻聚合器摘录自己的新闻提要？（2）当市场中出现新闻聚合器时，新闻出版商如何调整自己的付费墙策略？（3）如果新闻聚合器可以优化算法从而挑选出更加适合每个消费者的新闻摘录，这种更好的聚合算法会有利于还是损害出版商的利益？我们的模型和发现会提高我们对新闻聚合器现象的理解与认识，并对媒体企业处理与聚合器的关系以及优化定价上做出指导。此外，如果政策制定者希望提高媒体行业的整体福利，或者保护媒体行业中特定的市场参与者，这个项目亦可以在此方面提出更深刻的见解。

Objective 2: The objective is successfully achieved. Our analysis identifies how a publishers strategically react to the entry of an aggregator, and how the responses depend on the additional traffic brought by the aggregator as well as the aggregator's own pricing strategy. 27502919.label: Major findings and research outcome
27502919.value: 1. Is it profitable for both publishers to join a free aggregator that does not bring sufficient new traffic? No. The aggregator's ability to help a publisher unbundle its composite publication and reduce inter-publisher competition is not a sufficient motivation to join an aggregator. It needs to be complemented with additional traffic from the aggregator to encourage publishers to join a free aggregator. 2. Can an aggregator that does not bring new traffic motivate publishers to join it? Yes. A micropayment-facililating aggregator can improve publishers' profits even if it does not bring additional traffic to the publishers. The aggregator not only softens inter-publisher competition on subscription prices but also restrains publishers' incentive to cut micropayments, thus facilitating price discrimination. 3. Would an increase in the market power of the news aggregator reduce publishers' profits? Contrary to popular belief, a subscription-charging aggregator can unbundle publishers' articles and maximize its profits without hurting publishers' profits. However, if we treat publishers' profits in the presence of a micropayment-facilitating aggregator as the benchmark, a subscription-charging aggregator earns higher profits at the expense of publishers. 4.Would an increase in the market power of the news aggregator hurt consumers? Compared to a micropayment-facilitating aggregator, a subscription-charging aggregator improves the welfare of all consumers and yet earns higher profits. Compared to when an aggregator is absent, a subscription charging aggregator only improves the welfare of consumers who highly value the articles on the aggregator but hurts others. 5. In the presence of an aggregator, what content-sharing strategy should a publisher adopt? In the presence of a free aggregator, publishers share articles on the same topic with the aggregator if the publishers are less differentiated. However, if the publishers are sufficiently differentiated, they share articles on different topics. In the presence of a micropayment-facilitating or a subscription-charging aggregator, publishers always share with the aggregator articles on different topics. 6. In a media market with an aggregator, what pricing strategy should competing publishers pursue? With a free aggregator, publishers that are sufficiently differentiated can charge positive subscription prices. However, if consumers' attention on its content pages becomes highly valuable, the publisher earn all their revenue through advertising. With a micropayment-facilitating aggregator, publishers can charge even higher subscription prices than those observed in the absence of an aggregator. With a subscription-charging aggregator, publishers would charge lower subscription prices compared to those in the presence of a micropayment-facilitating aggregator.

27502919.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
27502919.value: First, in response to the free-riding criticism of publishers and regulators, the free aggregator could share some of its advertising revenue with the publishers. Future research can examine this possibility. Second, consumers could search through snippets and consume only a fraction of the articles. By tracking its consumers, the aggregator could build a rich profile of their readership habits and browsing behavior, leverage the information to offer curated contents and pursue behavior-based pricing. Future research can investigate how publishers should compete with an aggregator that curates its content. Third, it would be fruitful to examine how publishers can customize their content and pricing based on consumers' adblocking behavior and how the presence of the aggregator can temper the publishers' motivation to use anti-adblocking technology. Fourth, in the current study publishers do not permit consumers who strongly dislike ads could pay a higher price and be insulated from ads. Moreover, advertisers do not compete for consumers. Future research can relax these assumptions and examine the impact of tiered prices and competition on the advertiser side of the market. Fifth, it would also be useful to explore the impact of competition between aggregators.

27502919.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
27502919.value: Publishers face an existential threat from a variety of news aggregators, such as free aggregators (e.g., Google News, Yahoo! News), micropayment-facilitating aggregators (e.g., Blendle), and subscription-charging aggregators (e.g., Apple News+). In the absence of a news aggregator, publishers sell their content as a composite publication; this intensifies inter-publisher price competition and hurts publishers' profits. A free aggregator could help unbundle the articles of a publisher. Moreover, if publishers share articles on the same topic with a free aggregator, they can completely eliminate inter-publisher competition and replace it with competition between the aggregator and the publishers; but only partially eliminate inter-publisher competition if they share articles on different topics with it. Yet, the free aggregator needs to bring sufficient additional traffic to the publishers to motivate them to share content. Conversely, publishers will collaborate with a micropayment-facilitating aggregator even if it does not bring additional traffic to the publishers. This is because a micropayment-facilitating aggregator helps publishers unbundle their content and price discriminate. Lastly, publishers can be motivated to collaborate even with a subscription-charging aggregator that can dictate the terms of the revenue-sharing arrangement with the publishers. This is because the subscription-charging aggregator improves its profits without hurting the publishers' surplus.

27503719.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27503719.value: Well-functioning labor markets are critical to the success of any business and the economy as a whole. This project furnishes a novel combination of labor supply and labor demand data at the firm and geographic levels to study questions at the intersection of labor and financial economics. To start, I will use job posting and worker-by-occupation headcount data to measure labor shortages and their implications for a wide variety of economic outcomes: labor flows, wage-growth and overall labor market tightness, upskilling, firm investment and corporate financial policy, and entrepreneurial entry. Labor shortages likely have a profound impact on the way firms operate, but are difficult to measure. Filling this gap as a first step is an objective of interest to both regulators and academics. Also, the datasets assembled in this research project give rise to dozens of other related questions in labor and financial economics. I focus initially on rank-and-file diversity given large regulatory interest around the world in pursuing diversity in the workplace. I aim to document patterns of diversity at various layers and occupational sub-groups in US public corporations. I also aim to understand the determinants of which firms achieve greater workplace diversity, as well as to examine the consequences for future firm performance. 運作良好的勞動力市場對任何企業和整個經濟的成功都至關重要。該項目在公司和地區層面提供了勞動力供給和需求數據的新組合，以研究勞動經濟學和金融經濟學的交叉問題。首先，我將使用職位發布和按照職業劃分的人數來衡量勞動力短缺及其對各種經濟結果產生的影響：勞動力市場的匹配和緊缺程度，員工技能的提陞，公司投資和財務政策以及創業者的進入。勞動力短缺可能對企業運營方式產生深遠影響，但勞動力短缺難以衡量。填補這一空白作為後續研究的起點是監管機構和學者都感興趣的目標。 此外，本研究項目中匯集的數據引發了勞動經濟學和金融經濟學中的許多其它相關問題。這些问题包括研究企業一般員工的多樣性，了解企業如何在不同地理位置，各業務線和內部資本市場之間分配人員，以及研究企業如何決定提陞員工技能。了解企業如何决定對新技能的需求和一般員工的多樣性也是政策制定者所感興趣的內容。

27503719.label: Realisation of objectives
27503719.value: Overall, I would say the proposal has achieved its higher level objectives, but less so its specific objectives. Specifically, while I've been able to leverage the grand to conduct great labor-related finance research, but I haven't answered the specific questions and through the specific datasets outlined in the proposal. Instead I have pivoted onto using big data to study labor economics more broadly, carving out some research papers that potentially open up a new area of economics. This is an opportunity I did not anticipate when writing the grant, as it came to me in early 2019 - but I felt was an ample and once-in-a-lifetime opportunity made available First, I did not pursue the question of diversity, although it is possible I will continue this down the road. This unfortunate setback was outside of my control. As explicated in my progress report, one issue is that BizQualify - the company run by Jose Plehn-Dujowich - was sued for fraud and the company subsequently disbanded. To be specific, the fraud allegations were not related to data, but rather that he created a summer camp at Berkeley Haas promising to place students into data science jobs - but the allegations were instead turned out to be essentially an unpaid internship for BizQualify. I spoke with several industry participants and former employees (who left as a result of this class-action lawsuit), and while they were not doubtful the data could eventually be real, they were doubtful given his legal troubles and unusual business practices that it would be wise to continue doing business with him. Therefore, I discontinued the relationship. I tried working with an employee at the EEOC but the employee was only doing research in spare time and it became difficult to motivate the worker, especially during COVID. Second, I pivoted away from Linkedin and the job market. I eventually acquired both of these datasets. Originally, I had wanted to buy resume data from Cognism but an academic already working with the company (whose domestic partner was a data scientist there) vetoed the sale. That led to substantial delay. I tried finding other sources. For example I partnered with Entelo, a job search network - but their data was not ready for research. Eventually, I bought scraped Linkedin data from Revelio Labs, which is used by a lot of researchers in this space, and the school bought Burning Glass. Therefore, I can pursue some of the questions outlined in the proposal at a later date. However, I also noticed the Revelio data had numerous problems - imperfect tracking of location, making it difficult for me to accurately identify skills gaps by geography. The data issues aside, the main reason I pursued a new direction is that I had an opportunity to study a new type of labor market data - namely the real time internet content consumption activity of organizational employees from the media. Specifically, for any covered firm, I can observe at event-level articles read. For a longer period of time, they are categorized into specific topics, but more recently I can see specific URLs. This allows us to study many datapoints about firms’ employees previously unmeasurable in economics - attention allocation, shirking, or - if one believes this content consumption is productive - firms’ learning – at the organization or even anonymized individual level. To obtain this data, I partner with a company in the United States that operates a media publisher cooperative totaling tens of thousands of websites. With over 1 billion events per day observed across business publishers, they map this content to companies and classify topics that they read. I formed a deep partnership with them.. Given that the data are very large and must be pre-processed in the cloud, I re-allocated a significant portion of my financial resources and time here. There are a ton of questions one could answer, but I have focused on various questions of asset pricing and corporate finance. In addition, I’ve produced a very important labor question, namely the question of remote work. Given the Covid-19 pandemic, there was a big shift toward remote work. I have chosen to answer the following: 1. First, join with Ben Matthies and Alex Yuskavage I have used the article-level data to study how employees engage in remote work. I built a remote work measure classifying the article-level data by IP addresses, which then implies whether the worker associated with a company. I collaborated with Alex Yuskavage from the Social Security Administration to collect firm-level financial filings, permitting us to deliver the first firm-level estimates of the relationship between TFP and firm productivity. This paper has been presented at the Stanford Remote Work Conference, Dartmouth College, Society for Financial Studies Cavalcade, CICF, and others. We will submit the paper to top economics journals in the Fall of 2023 after the Social Security Administration approves the final draft. 2. Investor attention: We link the URL level data to RavenPack to study investor attention theory. In theories of rational attention, investors optimally allocate their attention across firms based on their priors, produce relevant information about the firm, and invest accordingly (e.g., Kacpercyk, Van Nieuwerburgh and Veldkamp (2010). these models, fund attention to a stock adds value to a fund's performance on average. In contrast, if investor attention is driven by salience, fund attention to a firm may or may not produce value-relevant information (e.g. Barber and Odean 2008 or Bordalo, Gennaioli and Shleifer (2021) ), leading to a null or potentially negative relationship between attention-driven trading decisions and performance. Finally, Peng and Xiong (2006) show that the interaction between rational attention allocation and overconfidence makes the relationship between attention and fund performance ambiguous. We use article level attention to calculate measures of attention to macro variables, as well as firm-specific news, to test the various corollaries of these theories. 3. ESG: Joint with Wendi Huang, Poyu Liu and Andrew Karolyi, I have utilized the firm-level ESG attention data from The Company to study how corporate attention to environmental, social, and governance (ESG) issues relates to outcomes. Specifically, I have examined how firm employee attention to ESG topics correlates with improvements in ESG performance based on metrics like green technology investments, employee benefits, and regulatory violations. We also compare our attention measure correlates with external ESG ratings from providers like Refinitiv, RepRisk, and MSCIThis paper has been presented at conferences including the AFA, SFS Cavalcade, and others. We have submitted to journals but hope to find a home sometime in the next year. I also have two other earlier papers. My paper “Looking Online to Understand Firms’ Intangible Capital Acquisition” (joint with Gaurav Kankanhalli) was presented at NBER in 2022 and studies how one can use this online data to understand what types of intangible capital firms like to build. My paper Managerial Learning from Decoding Noisy Stock Prices joint with TC Lin and Po-yu Liu has been presented at the WFA and ABFER. Here, we study how attention to one’s own firm-specific news can help us better understand managerial learning theory (ala Chen, Goldstein and Jiang (2007), RFS). Overall, these research paths would not have been possible without the generous funding from the Graduate Research Fund.

27503719.label: Major findings and research outcome
27503719.value: The overarching conclusion across my research made possible by ECS funding is that firm and investor attention, as directly measured through online content consumption, is a good indicator of intra-firm activity and meaningfully predictive of firm outcomes. This establishes attention data as a novel setting to empirically examine concepts in asset pricing, corporate finance, and labor. First, my research on investor attention documents that funds rationally reallocate attention between macroeconomic and firm-specific news over the business cycle, as attention models predict. It also shows attention paid to a firm associates with portfolio holdings and adds value for sophisticated investors like hedge funds. This affirms theories where attention facilitates value-relevant information production. Second, it is useful for studying corporate finance outcomes. Linking the data to firm productivity, my remote work study provides the first firm-level evidence that remote work activity is associated with productivity gains. This highlights the usefulness of attention data for nowcasting outcomes. Studying narrower topics within corporate finance such as ESG and intangible capital, my work on corporate attention broadly demonstrates the value of the data for measuring primitives of standard economic theories. on corporate attention to ESG topics finds it meaningfully correlates with ESG performance and external ratings. My intangible capital investments study demonstrates firms' attention allocation across knowledge assets forecasts their intangible spending mix. This shows the data's practical use for nowcasting. My managerial learning paper validates theories that firm news enables learning about fundamentals from the stock price. Finally, my paper on ESG shows that demand for ESG attention meaningfully predicts future ESG outcomes positively, providing a new tool for nowcasting.

27503719.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
27503719.value: The funding from ECS has opened up several fruitful avenues for future research leveraging these novel data on investor and firm attention. First, I have to finish publishing the studies spawned from this grant. Next, I plan to conduct further studies on investor attention allocation, including projects with Zhi Da, Yukun Liu, and Ben Matthies. Attention data provides a powerful new setting to test additional theories and mechanisms related to asset pricing. Second, focusing on the mreote work measure there are many follow-on labor questions that can be examined through the lens of employee attention, such as quiet quitting, job relocation, and entrepreneurship. The remote work study highlights the potential for insights into employee behavior using these data. Third, the findings motivate exploring models of endogenous information acquisition in macrofinance. The investor attention results provide empirical support for limited attention theories, warranting further work on formal modeling of attention allocation. In summary, the projects funded by ECS demonstrate the usefulness of the attention data for research at the intersection of finance and labor economics. I aim to continue advancing these research streams in collaboration with others. The funding has opened exciting possibilities that I look forward to pursuing further.

27503719.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
27503719.value: The internet produces vast amounts of data on how organizations consume information. Specifically, I use data on employee-mapped consumption of internet business articles. The data allow tracking of workers’ activities like never before. We link this to government data on company performance. We find that companies where workers tend to engage more in remote work tended to become more productive during the pandemic. This provides the first archival evidence that remote work can benefit employers. I also apply the data to study investor behaviour. We find that when overall market volatility is high, fund managers shift attention toward reading general news about the economy rather than firm-specific news. This matches theories about how constrained attention works, which is useful for explaining the episodic behavior of business cycles. In addition, we find greater attention is associated with better stock investment outcomes on average. This suggests attention helps investors pick winning assets, rather than just reflecting attention to salient events. Overall, in these two papers an three others my research demonstrates these new data on online activity provide valuable signals. This is a new finding that will unlock the value of digital footprints in the financial sector as a new source of data.

27606919.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27606919.value: This project will examine three features of the international legal system in light of an inter-related group of moral values, which I refer to as ‘political community’. These three features each concern legal statehood as an international status. The first is that, through their representatives, states can modify the content of international law. The second is that states possess equivalent status insofar as they are equally subject to the international rule of law. Finally, the third is that states are fundamentally territorial entities. Through interdisciplinary legal and philosophical analysis, I will ask whether these features can each be justified in terms of political community, such that those values should be considered indispensable when explaining international law. These values each relate to the idea that states are valuable because they partake of the intrinsic value possessed by the political actions of private individuals. This novel conception of political community will be used to provide original insights into the content of international law, making a significant contribution to existing philosophical and legal debates. It also has the potential to provide new argumentative resources for a number of international legal actors, including United Nations treaty bodies. Whilst ‘the state’ has received significant attention from philosophers, few have examined statehood as an international legal status. Even relatively recent scholarship concerning the creation of international law, international legality, and the idea of territory, has problematically conflated states with their governments. By integrating theory with a careful reading of legal practice, I aim to provide legal context to existing philosophical arguments, as well as produce philosophy that speaks more directly to the concerns of doctrinal international lawyers. My doctoral thesis accomplished this by establishing a connection between political community and the law on emerging statehood. This project will instead consider the legal status of established states. I shall publish two articles in peer-reviewed law journals. One shall address the generation of international law through state practice, with the other examining the international rule of law. A third piece– concerning the idea of territory – will be published in a collection of essays that I will edit, entitled ‘Structural Principles for International Law’. This collection will be the product of a two day interdisciplinary conference, held at my home institution. This will disseminate my research and provide opportunities for feedback. I shall also produce one policy briefing paper to promote impact amongst two key international actors. 鑑於一組相關的道德觀 ---- 在此我會把它指作“政治共同體“，這個項目會檢驗三個國際法系的特徵。這三個特徵，每一個都把合法的國家地位視作國際地位。當中的第一個是，通過它們的代表，國家能修改國際法的內容。第二，當國家同樣地受制於國際法治，它們就擁有一樣的地位。第三，國家根本上是領土實體。通過跨學科的法律和哲學分析，我會問到底這些特徵是否能在政治共同體方面成為正當理由，從而令這些價值觀在解釋國際法時不可或缺。 這些道德觀都與國家是價值重大的概念有關，因為它們擁有私人個體的政治行動所具備的固有價值觀。這個新的政治共同體的概念會為國際法的內容供原始的見解，從而為現存的哲學和法律辯論作出巨大的貢獻。它也有潛質去為一些國際行動者，包括聯合國條約機構，提供新的爭辯性資源。 雖然“國家”引起哲學家巨大的關注，他們很少曾把國家地位檢驗為國際地位。即使是最近在探討國際法的產生、國際合法性和領土的概念的學術界，都曾有問題地用國家來形容政府。結合理論和嚴謹的法律實踐，我計劃為現存的哲學性論據提供法律背景，和創造更直接地提及學說性國際律師的關注的哲學。通過建立政治共同體和正在出現的國家地位的法律之間的關聯，我的博士論文會達成這個計劃。這個項目反而會研究已確立的國家的法律地位。 我會在法律同行評審期刊上發表兩篇文章，一篇關於通過國家實踐的國際法的一代，另一篇檢驗國際法治。關於領土的概念的第三篇，會在一系列我會編輯的文章 ----“國際法“中發表。這個系列會是一個在我所在的機構舉行的、為期兩天的跨學科會議的成果。我也會寫一篇政策簡報，在兩個主要國際行動者當中宣傳它的影響。
